sanskrit: miśre ca gṛhiṇāṃ yogyaṃ parārthayajanārthakamprātarāvaśyakaṃ śaucaṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhāya capītvā saṃmārjayet tadvat dadhikrāviṇṇeti cādibhiḥpunastenaiva, mantreṇa daśavāraṃ japannayetśruti smṛtyādi saṃsiddhiṃ anuṣṭhānantu yadbhavetsaṃdhyāyāṃ vandane vāpi tarpaṇe homakarmaṇikartavyaṃ vā na kartavyaṃ śaivamāvaśyakaṃ matamvrajeddevālayādyaṃ tu pādaśaucaṃ vidhāya catripuṇḍraṃ bhasmanā kṛtvā sāndreṇa dhavalena cadhyātvā jvalantaṃ huṃkāraṃ prāṇān saṃyamya niścalampañcagranthīṃ stato bhitvā tasmātprati nivṛtya cakuṃbhakena samopetaṃ vāyumūrdhvagataṃ nayetātmayojana metatsyāt tato bhūtādi śodhayetvyāpya vyavasthitānīti matvā tāni viśodhayetmaṇḍalādi samāyuktaṃ bhūtaśuddhirihoditāvicintya divyadehārtha mamṛtāplāvanaṃ nayettadud bhūtāmṛtastrāvaissiktāṃ divyāṃ kalāṃ smaretpunarāplāvanaṃ kṛtvā karanyāsaṃ samārabhettayorbrahmāṇi vinyasya netraṃ karatale nyasetkavacenāva kuṇṭhayātha sarvakarmasu yojayetmūrdhādi pādaparyantaṃ aṅgabrahmāṇi vinyasetśivaṃ hṛdi yathāsthānaṃ (hṛ) hṛdayādyaṃ niveśayetmahāmudrāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivamantraṃ anusmaranlipinyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt rudraśakti samanvitamkevalaṃ mātṛkānyāsaṃ kuryāttadrahitaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjā homasamādhisyāt hṛdi nābhau lalāṭakehastāsphālana digbandhāva kuṇṭhaiśca sammatāpādyāditritayaṃ teṣu kalpayedvidhināmunāuttamaṃ pādya muddiṣṭaṃ madhyamaṃ gatakuṃkumamvarālośīra karpūra truṭi jāti lavaṅgayukelālavaṅga karpūra mura jātiyutaṃ samamāpaḥkṣīra kuśāgraistu yavākṣata tilairyutamtaṇḍulairmadhyamaṃ proktaṃ śālitaṇḍula saṃyutamsiddhārtha candanośīra dūrvāyuk pādyameva caetadācamanīyaṃ vā yajet yajanāṅgakeyavasarṣapa sad vrīhi taṇḍulai rakṣataṃ bhavetpañcāṅga mathavā tryaṅgaṃ kevaṃ cārdhyameva vādravyāṇyastreṇa saṃprokṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhayettilakaṃ candanaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaṃ śirasi vinyasetmantramuccārayenmantrī mantraśuddhirbhavediyamgaṇapaṃ bhāratīrmūrdhve nandinaṃ jāhnavīyutamvimalaṃ ca subāhuṃ ca talpayośca kramādyajetvāstoṣpatiṃ tataśceṣṭvā pūjāṃ paryuṣitāṃ yajetpiṇḍikāṃ śivaliṅgaṃ ca jalena kṣālayet sudhīḥsaṃpūjya dvārapān vātha pañcaśuddhiṃ samācaretyajanaṃ devadevasya sarva kāmārtha sādhanamgaṇeśaṃ ca guruṃ śaktimanantaṃ dharmasaṃmukhānvāmādi nava sūryādi maṇḍalaṃ seśvaraṃ yajetpañcāsanātmakaṃ hyetadekāsana mudīritamdharmā dharmādibhirvargaiśchadanābhyāṃ samanvitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmaṃ vaigheśvaraṃ padmamaṇḍalaṃ vimalāsanamsaṃkalpyāsanamevaṃ tu mūrtiṃ tadupari nyasetlipinyāsaṃ tu vā kuryācchīkaṇṭhādi yutaṃ tu vāvidyādehaṃ tato nyastvā śivamāvāhayettataḥsvasva sthāne hṛdādīni vinyasedānupūrvakamprarocanaṃ vā kartavyaṃ mahāmudrā prayogataḥsaṃskārā daśa vikhyātāḥ upacāraiḥ śivaṃ yajetnānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi nūtanāni prakalpayettailājyakalpitān dīpān karturvāñchāvaśānnayetāmantraṇa haviḥ proktaṃ mudgādyaṃ cāḍhakādikamtasmin maṅgalagānaiśca sarvātodya samanvitaiḥārātrikaṃ tato dadyāt dhūpadānāvasānakebhrāmayitvā tatastyaktvā tilakaṃ dāpayecchiverātrau nīrājanaṃ kuryāt dīpadānāvasānakeāmantraṇa haviḥ kāle baliṃ vā homamācaretsnapane mantrageyaṃ vā vīṇā gāna mathāpi vātadūrdhve gauḍabhāsādyairgānaṃ dhūpāntamācaretsaṃskṛtaṃ tadapabhraṃśaṃ nānā svara samanvitamnānā deśa prasūtaṃ ca nartanaṃ parikalpayetnityotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryānnānā strībhissamanvitammama dāsyassamākhyātā rudrakanyā bhavanti cetutsavassyāttadante tu nityotsava vidhānataḥtadante śuddhanṛttaṃ syāttadante culukodakamsādhakena ca siddhyarthaṃ pūjāmāhṛtya liṃgataḥnetatpratidinaṃ kuryāt kiṃ tu sādhyāvasānakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kevalaiśśuddha śaivoktai rmantrairuttama mucyatenitye naimittike'pyetadvidhānaṃ parikīrtitamtatrāpi mūlamantrastu bījātmā śreṣṭhamucyatebījamantrasamudbhūtā rudrādhyāyādayo'pi cabījāṇu sadṛśo nāsti mama prītikaraḥ paraḥkauberāsye ca liṃge ca sakale miśra liṃgakeprāgvadanyatsamuddiṣṭaṃ viśeṣaḥ kaścidiṣyatevāme vā dakṣiṇe vāpi sthāpanīyā manonmanīīśāna mīśadeśe vā niṛtau vā samarcayetdakṣiṇe cottare vāpi bahurūpaṃ vicintayetpaścime pūrva deśe vā sadyavaktraṃ smaran nyasetśiraścaiśetha naiṛtyāṃ śikhāṃ pitari vaiśakepūrvasmin paścime vāpi caturdikṣvastramarcayetgaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ somāddakṣādārabhya vārcayetdevāgre vṛṣabhaḥśūlaṃ dhvajasthānaṃ ca gopuramvāruṇādi niṝtyantaṃ parivārārcanaṃ tu vācaṇḍeśastvīśa deśe syāt vighnarāṭ pitari smṛtaḥliṃge vā pratimāyāṃ vā mukhaliṅge tu vā matāmiśre tu madhyamā proktā liṅge'rvā tvadhamā matānṛttamūrte rviśeṣeṇa tvati śobhana miṣyateavyaktaṃ mokṣadaṃ liṃgaṃ vyaktaṃ bhūtipradāyakamśaucamācamanaṃ snānaṃ sandhyopāsana meva cadvāra mastreṇa saṃprokṣya dvārapānarcayet kramātyamunāṃ ca mahākālaṃ gandhādyaiḥ kramaśorcayetpūjayet pūrvavaktrastu śivaṃ ṣaḍguṇa saṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aghoraṃ puruṣaṃ vāpi dakṣiṇe samyagarcayetsadyavaktraṃ tu vāmāṃ vā saumyadeśe samarcayetīśānamagni deśe tu nyaset pūrve manonmanīmathavā prāgvadevaṃ syād vidyeśā dakṣiṇāditaḥpūrva dārabhya śakrādyā vajrādyāśca tathā matāḥprāgvadeva vidheyaṃ syāt anyatsarvaṃ samāhitāḥtaducyate samāsena śrūyatāṃ munisattamāḥcitrahīne śilābiṃbe mūlaliṃga vadācaretabhīṣṭa divase kuryād yāvadberaṃ sadhūsaramkarmārcāryāmathānyeṣāṃ maṇiliṅge'tha pīṭhakeādhārākhya manantaṃ ca dharmādyaṃ hi catuṣṭayamvāmādi navakaṃ sūryamaṇḍalādyaṃ ca sādhipamīśāne sakale mūrdhni puruṣaṃ vadane smaretkalānyāsassamākhyātaḥ pratimānāṃ viśeṣataḥhṛdbījātpaścime varṇe ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ niyojayetmantra metatsamuccāryā'vāhayet pratimāhṛdividhāyaivaṃ hṛdā pādyaṃ pādayostu nivedayetelālavaṅga karpūra varāla phala kalpitamkṣīra siddhārtha sasyendra tilaśālyakṣātānvitamyavasarṣapa sad vrīhi taṇḍulai rakṣataṃ bhavetpādyādi pañcakaṃ hyetat sakale niṣkale'pi capavitrāhohaṇādau ca proktaṃ vātha samācaretekahīnaṃ tu madhyaṃ syād dvābhyāṃ hīnaṃ tu kanyasamgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyameva cabali homotsavaṃ nṛttaṃ yathākālaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāḍyo'thavāsyuḥmadhyame daśanāḍyassyādyāma mātreṇa kanyasaḥkarṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhāntaṃ karma saṃvatsarotsavamnityārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ tantresmin pratipāditamanenaiva prakāreṇa nyāyenānvīkṣya deśikaḥantarālaṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ diśi vyakte viśiṣyatetasya devasya sā prācī niścitā dvijasattamāḥtadvaśādaparā kalpyā diśo digvedibhissadāśaucamācamanaṃ snānaṃ sandhyāvandanatarpaṇamsamyagācabhya saṃgṛhya bhasitaṃ vāriṇā sahatatkareṇa ca saṃyojya śivehyātmānamādarātkaranyāsaṃ ca vinyāsaṃ brahmaṇāmīśa pūrvakampuruṣaṃ vadane sarvaṃ malāmantramanusmaranantaryāgamataḥ kṛtvā sthānaśudhdintato nayetkṛtvātmānaṃ samabhyarcya mantraśuddhiṃ samācaretdvārapārśvobhayaṃvāpi gaṇapañcasarasvatīṃsaṃpūjyodumbare śastraṃ praviśyāntaḥ puraṃ punaḥśivasyeśānamantreṇa mālādyamapanīya caādhārāravyamanantañca dharmādharmādyameva cavāmādyaṃ hṛdayopetaṃ śivāsanamanusmaransadāśivo maheśaśca rudraśceci tridhāmataḥyā tasya vimalāśaktiśśivasya samavāyinīhṛtsaṃpuṭena saṃyojya tasyāṃ brahmāṇi vinyasetsadeśe deha siddhyarthamaṣṭatriṃśatkalā matāaṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsaṃ prāgeva pratipāditam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekameva śirovaktraṃ maheśe rudravigrahemalātmanā viśiṣṭantu pūrvavatparikalpayetṣaṣṭhasvarasamopetaṃ bindunādavibhūṣitambere sadāśivevāpi liṃgepyevaṃ samācaretpratimālakṣaṇoktañca maheśamanunāyutamtanmantreṇa samopetaṃ vidyādehaṃ prakalpayetvidyādehārthamuddiṣṭassarvataśśiva eva catenāvāhya śivandehatritaye pūrvavartmanāgandhaṃ puṣpaśca dhūpaśca dīpannaivedyamapya capañcāvaraṇasaṃyuktañcatustridvayekasaṃvṛtauparivārayutañcettu balintasminsamācaretśuddhanṛttañcayannoktaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛtivannayetśuddhanṛttañca hitvā vā karma sarvaṃ samācaretutsavaṃ snapanañcaiva damanārohaṇakriyāmsaṃvatsarādi lekhāñca vasantākhyaṃ tadutsavamprāyaścittañca jīrṇānāṃ uddhārañca gurūttamāḥkiñcāṣāḍhe'śvinī māse pūrvaphalgunisaṃgamegaurīmaheśvarīmūrtīsadeśe tu manonmanīgaurī mantreṇa gauryāstu ṣaḍviṃśatikalānvitāmādiśaktyaṇunā tasyāmādiśaktiṃ prapūjayetaṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ viṣuvāyanasaṃkramesuyoge sūryavāre vā cotsavānte dinaṃ trayamrājñobhiṣekanakṣatre durbhikṣe durnimittikepratiṣṭhānte dbhute sarvarogotpattāvavagrahesnapanantu yathānmāyaṃ taccānekavidhaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāguktamaṇṭape vāpi vedikāvarjitepi vāathavā pūrvakḷptau tu tammānādyanapekṣayācaturgātrādikeṣṭāṣṭagātraparyanta saṃyutenṛttavādyādisaṃyukte gānadhvanisamanvitesūtranyāsamaghoreṇa tālamātrāntaraṃ yathātritālaṃ karṇikāmānaṃ sarvasāmānyamīritamtadā dvitālamānena karṇikāmānamīritamvidikṣvapi navākhyaṃ syātsamantādekamāvṛtamekonapañcāśatsaṃkhyāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ dvijāḥpañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyātān kalaśān madhyamasthitamaṣṭadvārasamāyuktaṃ bahiṣṭhādādavṛtitrayammadhyame tithisaṃkhyetu madhyamatritayaṃ tyajetcatvāriṃśacca vyūhaṃ syāt pṛthak syāt pañcaviṃśatiḥmadhyavyūhasya paritaścatuṣkuṇḍantu vāṣṭakamantarmārgaṃ samāvāhya vīthiśśāstre samīritamsūtranyāsassamākhyātaḥ anyathāpi bhaviṣyatimārgabāhye tu koṇesyādekaviṃśati saṃkhyakaḥsūtradvayaṃ nyasetpūrvāparagaṃ yāmyasaumyagamsyāccaturdaśasaṃkhyātā vīthibāhye krameṇa casthaṇḍilaṃ puruṣeṇasyāt catuḥ prasthamidaṃ varamhīnahīnataraṃ prasthamānamityabhidhīyateadhaścedhabhicārārthaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥmānantu śivakumbhesyāt tasyordhvekarakemataḥtilārdhaṃ lājamānaṃ syādaṣṭadroṇaṃ sahasrakehṛdayena nyaset mumbhān svarṇādiviniveśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivakumbhasyamānaṃ syāt tadarthaṃ karakematamūkalaśe veṣṭanaṃ tridvivyomasūtraiḥ krameṇa tuvarmaṇāvihitaṃ taccakumbhanyāso hṛdāmataḥkūrcānvaiśenamantreṇa dravyaṃ mūlena vinyasetmuktā ca pañcaratnaṃ syādabhāve hemasammatamtayorardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā māṣaṃ vātidaridrakemādyamācamanañcārghyaṃ pañcagavyañcaturdiśikuśodakaṃ tataḥkṣīraṃ dadhikoṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhavetdvitīyasthāpanaṃ proktaṃ tṛtīyañca nigadyatebhūtikṣusāra kadalītilasarṣapapānasāḥnālikerañca nāraṃṅgadvayaṃsyānmātulaṃgakampanasāmrakadalyuttha nālikerañca sarṣapamnāraṃgadvitayantasmādyavanīvāralājakamkuṣṭhaṃ gulaṃ payaḥ paścāt sarṣapañca lavaṃgakamsattukannālikerañca haridrācūrṇakantathāpañcaviṃśati madhye tu santyajedantarāvṛtimcaturdikṣu ca koṇeṣu pādyādyaṣṭakamīritamūrdhvamekonapañcāsatkrameṇa paripaṭhyatepatrakarpūranīrañca dāntaṃ māṃsimurantṛṇamapāmārgantato viṣṇukrānti dhurtūrasaṃjñakamathavānyaprakāreṇa tadeva punarucyatekṣīraṃdadhighṛtaṃ kṣaudramāgneyādi vidikṣu canālikerañca bilvañca jambukaccolapāṭalīsimhadhurtūrasaṃjñe ca ṣoḍaśāstravinirdiśetkadalīśatapatrañca dhātakī śvetalodhakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīvārakuṃkumatilamāñjīmurajasattukampañca kḷptau ca brahmāṇi hitveśānaṃ dvijottamāḥantare vāmadevādyāḥ pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyayākrodhādyā vasusaṃkhyātāḥ śatarudrādikastu vākṛtvā padāni ṣaṭtriṃśat tyajedaṃśaṃ catuṣṭayamdakṣiṇārdhaṃ samārabhya cottarārdhaṃ samāvadhiatrānuktamathaikona pañcāśatsadṛśaṃ matamcandanāgarukuṣṭhāni kaccolaṃ puṣpapatraketṛtīyavaraṇasthāni dravyāṇi dvādaśaiva hibilvaṃ yavā śamī dūrvā takkolaṃ meghasamjñakamrāsnā ca vyāpalāśañca śvetārkaṃ karavīrakamplekṣebhapippalī saṃjñā viṣṇukrānti nṛpāhvayātulasī tagarañcaiva turuṣkaṃ tejanīpunaḥśrīveṣṭakam gandharasaṃ phalinī raktacandanamdārvīśuktinakhaṃ dāru sitāhvaṃ ca kuṭaṃ naṭamvaṭaśṛṃgendriyāhvañca phaṇirjambu manaśśilāāmramocarasaṃ jātiḥ pāṭalī mārjanaṃ punaḥśamīdūrvārka bilvañca campakaṃ śaṅkhapuṣpakamnandyāvartaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ śvetapadmaṃ tato matampunnāgaṃ jātipuṣpañca pāṭalī sahadevikātulasī karavīrañca kṛṣṇavallī ca malliāmahādroṇapunardroṇamahābhadrīca bhadrikāvyāghranakhyā ca maṃjiṣṭhaṃ saralaṃ bhadrakoṣṭhakamcañcalātibalācaiva balāsiṃhāpriyaṃgukamaśvattho gugguluñcaiva lājiraṃ kṛṣṇajīrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dānaṃ kuryādyathāśakti piṇḍaṃ dadyācca tadbhuvityajeyustridinaṃ karma nityādanyajjapādikamdinamekaṃ kṣipeyuste śāvāśaucāya dīkṣitāḥācāraṃ dīkṣitāstasmātkurvīra/llokasaṃvṛtimpūrvāśramānapekṣatvādastasaṃsārahetutaḥastasaṃsārabījasya jñāninaḥ satkriyāvataḥvipre śuddhirdaśāhe syāt kṣatriye dvādaśāhikāudvāhitāścatasrastu brāhmaṇena striyo yadāsūtakaṃ tatsutādīnāṃ mātṛpakṣe yathāmatammāsasaṃkhyoditā mātuḥ strīpuṃsorgarbhanāśanesnānamekadinaṃ proktaṃ tridinaṃ ca krameṇa tukṣaurādaṣṭamavarṣācca vivāhāt pūrvavat kramātpitrordaśāhameva syāt sarvatrāśaucamagrajāḥtatsutānāṃ prayāṇe ca pakṣiṇī dvijasattamāḥdinaṃ vā pakṣiṇītyuktā jñātvaivaṃ karma kārayetsamānodakavargāṇāmāśaucaṃ vihitaṃ vidhauāmauñjībandhanādvipraḥ kṣatriyaśca dhanurgrahātpūrṇāśaucaṃ bhavedūrdhvaṃ mṛto yadi narottamāḥvaiśyaścennavabhiśśuddhaḥ śūdro dvādaśābhidinaiḥbhavet trirātramāśaucamācāryamaraṇe satiśāvāśauce samutpanne sūtakaṃ tu yadā bhavetsūtake sūtakaṃ bhūyo yadyapi syād dvijottamāḥsūtake mṛtakaṃ cet syāt sūtake sūtakaṃ tathāatikrānte daśāhe tu trirātramaśucirbhavetkṛtanityāgnikāryasya mṛtasya dahanādritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ye ca māheśvarāśśūdrā bhasmarudrākṣadhāriṇaḥtathaiva rudrakanyānāṃ pañcācārye'pi saṃmatamna spṛśeyussapiṇḍāśca dāhakaṃ tatra kathyateārtavād dviguṇā sūtistasyā api ca dāhakamnakṣatradarśanādvāpi vaseyussūryadarśanātidaṃ sāmānyamartyānāṃ vidhānaṃ parikīrtitamśivagānavidāṃ tadvacchivāśramaniṣeviṇāmāśaucaṃ dāsadāsīnāmadhiṣṭhātṛkulocitamkulaṃ tu rudrakanyānāṃ mātṛjaṃ parikīrtitamrājñāṃ purohitānāṃ ca nāśaucaṃ mṛtasūtayoḥgṛhiṇo'gṛhiṇo vāpi vratayuktasya sarvataḥhṛhasthānāṃ ca nāśaucaṃ nitye naimittike'pi vāsnānaṃ ca vratīno noktaṃ pṛthak pākabhujo yadiparityayet parārthaṃ vā lokasaṃvaraṇāya cajñātīnāṃ strīṣu jātāsu nāśaucaṃ pravidhīyatetatrāpi tryahamāśaucaṃ parataḥ pañcapauruṣātviprasya vidhinoḍhāsu raktādyāsu tisṛṣvathaanyāyajānāṃ śuddhistu dvitrivedadinarddhitaḥsādhāraṇastriyo yāśca pūtā naiva kadācanamahānto mantriṇāścāpi yadi bhaktā maheśvaredinairviṃśatibhiśśuddhāḥ pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ paretasya tāvattikṣau śuddhiryāvattāni dināni tutrikālasnānapūjāgnijapahomapurassaramyogaṃ vinā yadā hānistatrāpyante dinatrayamyasya samyag bhavettena kāryaṃ samayinārcanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: antaryāgaśca tenāpi kartavyo'nte dinadvayamjapedaghoraṃ snānānte daśāṃśo homa eva vāayameva vidhiḥ proktaḥ samayasthasya he dvijāḥnitye naimittike kāmye sarvatraivādhikāritāeteṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ prāsādādipraveśanamagramaṇḍapabāhye tu na doṣāya prakalpateāvaśyakaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ lokamārgānuyāyināmpīṭhaṃ pīṭhoktarītyā tu satrimekhalamācaretgomayāmbhobhirālipya nyasya pīṭhasya madhyameviprādīnāṃ kramādvāpi rudrāntakasusaṃmitaiḥpraṇavenāsanaṃ dattvā mūrtimāvāhayettataḥsvadhetyuktvā vinikṣipya tadvatātmāṇu samyutampādyādinicayaṃ vastraṃ gandhapuṣpatilānvitamtadardha nirmitaṃ vāpi tasya prītikaraṃ ca yatāśauca rahitaiḥ navamadbhāṇḍa eva hidvayamahyeva kartavyameka kāle'thavā dvayamathavārghyabaliṃ dadyādanyatrānnaṃ prakalpayetkṛtveṣṭakāṃ vā pāṣāṇaṃ śarāve vā nidhāya casaptāhaṃ vā navāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā tadācaretmṛdamudvāsya tatsthānāt piṇḍaṃ puṣpasamanvitamsaṃgrāhya pīṭhikādau ca dhūpa dīpādi saṃyutametatsarvaṃ tu vā puṇyasthāne nadyādike nayetbrāhmaṇe daśapiṇḍāstu kṣatriye dvādaśa smṛtāḥāśaucaṃ yāvadeteṣāṃ tāvat piṇḍodakakriyātṛtīye pañcavai dadyāt tridinādau mato vidhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: piṇḍamekaṃ tadā deya māśaucaṃ cāpradānataḥnityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhiḥ pārvaṇameva canityaṃ dadyādaharaharnaimittaṃ syānmṛte'hanivṛddhi śrāddhaṃ vivāhādāvevaṃ pañcavidhiṃ bhavettatsaṃśuddhi dinādyāvadabdamāsādibhedataḥśrāddhaṃ syādeka varṣordhvaṃ śrāddha pakṣe viśeṣataḥcaturthe pañcame tvahni navāhaikādaśāhayoḥnava śrāddhamamantraṃ tu piṇḍodakavivarjitamāśaucānte prakartavyamekoddiṣṭaṃ dvijottamāḥvatsarārdhe ca yatkarma sāṃvatsarika samyutametacca ṣoḍaśa śrāddhamekoddiṣṭamiti smṛtampiśācatvaṃ ciraṃ tasya dattaiśśrāddha śatairapitryahāṇi trīṇi caikaṃ ca pretā bhūtassatiṣṭhatimaraṇāhāt samārabhya pratyahaṃ vatsarāvadhividhāyātha navaśrāddhamekoddiṣṭa samanvitamvidhātavyaṃ prayatnena brahmacaryamanujjhataekoddiṣṭa dvitīyāhe sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kriyāmtasyāpyannaṃ sodakuṃbhaṃ dadyādsaṃvatsadguruḥsapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryādbhojanaṃ caikavardhanamśivāya vā pradātavyamathavā dīkṣitātmanepākṣikaṃ māsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca tathā bhavetghaṭakanyāgate sūrye kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥamāvasyā maghā cāsu pitṛpakṣaṃ prakalpayetvyatīpāte'yane vāpi svarbhānorapi darśaneśastrāgnibhṛgupātāmbupraveśa vidhinā mṛtāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyadā vāpi kartavyaṃ saṃbhave vasupātrayoḥrātrāvapi ca kartavyaṃ yadi syādrāhudarśanammaghāsu kurvataḥ śrāddhaṃ jyeṣṭhaputro vinaśyatiyadi kuryānnavaśrāddham. kulakṣayakaraṃ bhaveteteṣu kurvataḥ śrāddhaṃ karturmaraṇamādiśetātmanaśca trijanmāni caturviṃśatibhaṃ tathāgarhitaḥ pitṛdevebhyaḥ sarvakarmasu saṃtyajetvaiśākhe śuklapakṣasya tṛtīyā śuklakārtiketithistrayodaśī māghe tathā pañcadaśī matākāleṣveteṣu vā dadyādudakaṃ tilasaṃyutamkanyāṃ gate savitari pitaro yānti vai sutāntataḥ svabhajanaṃ yānti śāpaṃ datvā sudāruṇamupātteṣu susaṃtānaṃ śakunā iva pippaleeṣa no dāsyati śrāddhaṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsvapiekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhṛṇe prātarvṛddhi nimittakamāma śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūrvāhṛṇe dvijasattamāḥāmaśrāddhamaśaktau syācchūdrādyaistu sadaiva hisvajātyurkarṣato grāhyāḥ svasvajātyudbhavāśca vāna brāhmaṇaṃ parīkṣate daiva karmaṇi dharmavitupakāra viyuktāya dattaṃ yat taddhi sātvikamdāridrāya pradattaṃ yat sātvikaṃ hṛṣṭa cetasāsamṛddhāya ca yaddattaṃ tatsarvaṃ rājasaṃ matamphalārthibhiśca rātrau ca taddānaṃ rājasaṃ matamdīyate taskarāyāpi taddānaṃ tāmasaṃ smṛtamsevakāya ca yaddattaṃ taddānaṃ tāmasaṃ smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātāmaho mātulaśca svastrīyaḥśvaśuro guruḥvratasthamapi dauhitraṃ śrāddhe yatnena bhojayetśrāddhaṃ kṛtvā paraśrāddhaṃ yasta muñjīta mohitaḥpunarbhojanamadhvānaṃ bhārādhyayanamaithunamśrāddhārthaṃ varaṇaṃ kṛtvā na prayacchati yaḥ pumānpraṇīta śrāddha tantro yo na bhuṅkte śrāddhakarmaṇitrīṇi cātra praśaṃsanti śaucamakrodhamatvaramsaindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva tathā mānasa sambhavamrāmaṭhaṃ ca praśastaṃ syādaśuṣkavyañjanāni caanivedya na bhoktavyaṃ piṇḍārthaṃ na kadācanakūśmāṇḍālābuvārtākaṃ māhiṣaṃ kṣīrameva cakṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vaṃśāgraṃ ca vivarjayetāraktā ye ca niryāsāḥ pratyakṣalavaṇāni capiṇyākaṃ mathitaṃ cāpi tathātilavaṇaṃ ca yatdātāraṃ nopatiṣṭhante bhoktā bhuṅkte ca kilbiṣambahirjānu ca bhaktaṃ yat sarvamevāsuraṃ bhavetsāṅguṣṭhena tathā kāryamāsuraṃ syāt tathānyathādarbhāḥ pavitraṃ pūrvāhṇe haviṣyāṇi ca sarvaśaḥyāvanti paśuromāni tāvannarakamṛcchatisopānatkaśca yo bhuṅkte tadvai rakṣāṃsi bhuñjateadeśikenānnadātā ca bhoktā ca narakaṃ vrajetnābheradhaśca saṃsparśaṃ karmayukto vivarjayetmitrāṇyārogyasaṃpaśca bhavecchraddhādaninditātkalaho vipravāsaśca ninditaśrāddhato bhavetśaivaṃ santānikaṃ labdhvā pitṛdevārthamiṣṭadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturvedārthaviduṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanāmlakṣaṃ tu sādhake bhukte dīkṣate'yutameva tusādhakadvitayaṃ devaṃ pitrarthaṃ deśikatrayamīśassadāśivaśśāntaśśivaśrāddhe prakīrtitāḥdīkṣitānāmamī proktā rudrāṃśānāmathoacyatetatra nandimahākālau dvau gaṇau dvitaye sthitaupañcābhāvo yadā tatra tadā taddvayakalpanāekatrānyatra kartavyaṃ sthānamaṃsadvayaṃ dvayoḥṣaḍdaivataṃ gṛhasthānāṃ liṅgināṃ tu tridaivatamnimantrayīta pūrvedyuryathāvṛddhamatandritaḥyavīyasaḥ priyoktyā tu samāśvāsya kṣaṇedamūnvased rajanīṃ tāṃ ca smarantaḥ parameśvaramanyedyaḥ snānapūjādikriyā nirvartya tānayāabhyutthānāsanādyena svāgatenāgatānathasusame gomayāmbhobhissupralipte gṛhājiredve catuṣkoṇake prācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ dve suvartulepratimaṇḍalamagre vāvaṭaḥ syāddvādaśāṅgulaiḥkalpayedeva pitrarthamarghyaṃ pātreṣu pañcasudevārthaṃ yavasaṃyuktaiḥ pitrarthaṃ tilasaṃyutaiḥpuruṣeṇa ca vastrāṇi gandhaṃ hṛdayamantrataḥanuktamanyacchrāddhāṅgaṃ hṛdayenābhimantrayetsāgrayoravakīryātha yavān sadvṛttayostilānvidyāṅgāstreṇa dakṣasthaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sāśramarcayetsaumyasthaṃ praṇavādyena svasvanāmnā samanvitammaṇḍale karapṛṣṭhena svadhāntena samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dattvārghyaṃ mṛdamādāya pādau prakṣālayedanutoyairācamanaṃ paścādācāntassaṃpraveśya tuāsaneṣu sudhauteṣu jñātvā tānupaveśayetkuruṣvetyabhyanujñāto dadyāddarbhāsanaṃ dvayoḥudagagramajātena savye kṛtvottarīyakamāvāhayetyanujñātaḥ svanāmnā praṇavādināatha rakṣārthamādāya yavānavakiret parirūpiṇā saṃnidhānāya dvitayasya sakṛt sakṛtjānubhyāmavanau sthitvāghoreṇābhyarcayedyavaiḥgandhairālipya sarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣayatpuṣpadāmabhiḥdīpaṃ ca tena saṃdadyādīśānena pavitrakamtadaṅgamaparaṃ dadyādupavītikrameṇa tukuśāṃstu dviguṇaṃ dattvā sadyojātena mantrataḥsthāpanādi trayaṃ kṛtvā vāmenaivāpradakṣiṇamtrayāṇāṃ saṃnidhānārthamaghoreṇāñjalau pṛthakbhūmiṣṭhajānurīśena śirasaḥ prabhṛti kramātgandhādyaṃ dhūpadīpau ca rūpiṇā dāpayettataḥpūrṇamastviti vaktavyaṃ pūrṇamastviti tairapipitṛsthānamasītyevaṃ vyubjaṃ pātramadho nyasetbhājanaṃ śuddhamādāya bhojanāyopapādayetpaṅktidoṣanivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtvā tuparihārakānśivānale kariṣye'haṃ pṛccheddhomamiti dvijāḥsomāya pitṛmacchabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ svadhā namaḥuktvāgnaye tataḥ kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥpitrarthaṃ caiva piṇḍārthaṃ na dadyādviśvadevayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadyāttu madhurānnaṃ tu puruṣeṇa ghṛtaplutampavitrīkaraṇāyeti tatassavyamadhomukhamguhyamantraṃ japedvāyamṛtyujinmantrameva vāāpośanārthamādyena pradadyāt pāṇipaṅkajeatithiṃ bhojayecchaktyā tatkāle na vicārayetcarantyatithirūpeṇa tasmāt tānna vicārayettṛptāsstheti bhṛtānnassantṛptāssma iti kīrtiteucchiṣṭasannidhau kuryādgomayenaiva maṇḍalamvāmena tilasaṃyuktaṃ sarvaudana samanvitammadhvājyatilasaṃyuktaṃ bhūmiṣṭhassavyajānunāvidhāya vāriṇo dhārāṃ vāmadevamudīrayansaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpayetpūrvamācamanaṃ tribhyo dvābhyāṃ dadyādanantaramsakarpūraṃ tadaṅgaṃ sad gṛhopakaraṇaṃ tathāvarddhanīmudakāpūrṇāṃ śrāddhakṛddakṣiṇānanaḥīśāditritayaṃ paścāt caturthyantamudīrayetastu svadheti brūyuste bhūmausiñcettato jalamdevā rudrāśca tṛptyantāmityete ca svayaṃ paṭhatityukte tairidaṃ vākyaṃ prati dvijasattamāḥśraddhā ca no mā vyavagād bahudeyaṃ ca no'svitiyasmiṃste saṃsravāḥ pūrvamarghyapātre niveśitāḥsadyojātena mantreṇa pitṛpūrvamanuvrajetiṣṭaissahopabhoktavyamiti te brūyuriṣṭadāḥprakṣipet kulapatnī vā madhyamaṃ piṇḍamaśruyātdhīraśśrīmānyaśasvī ca vidyāsantānapāragaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛddhau nāndīmukhe naiva pitṛn śrāddhe'nutarpayetdadyācca dadhikarkandhumiśrān piṇḍānyavaiḥ kriyāḥpradadyāt prāṅmukhaḥ piṇḍān vṛddhiśrāddheṣu nityaśaḥaniṣṭvā tu pitṛn śrāddhe sarvakarma na kārayetekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghyaikapavitrakamuttiṣṭatāmityakṣayyasthāne teṣāṃ visarjanameko vātha naro grāho nimittasya ca saṃmataḥgobhūhiraṇya sadveśmavāhanācchādanādikamāsanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca chatraṃ pādukasaṃyutamdadyāddakṣiṇayopetaṃ jaladānayutaṃ pṛthaknavaśrāddhamantraṃ tu piṇḍodaka vivarjitampiṇḍodakaṃ samākhyātaṃ piṇḍapātragatasya capraṇāmaṃ na ca kurvīta svadhākāraṃ tathaiva caagnau kariṣya ityedadekoddiṣṭe'pi smṛtamtiṣṭhanti yuktāśīrvādāḥ stuvanti ca pitāmahāḥtṛpyanti pitaro dattairmāsavṛddhyā na saṃśayaḥgandhodakatilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātraṃ catuṣṭayamtannāmabhiradhorādipūrvakairbhavapaścimaiḥpātratrayaṃ tu pitrarthaṃ nimittārthaṃ paraṃ matamkartavyaṃ sarvakarmārthaṃ yathāpūrvamudāhṛtamīśādināmabhiḥ paścātsarvakarma samācaretpitṛghno jāyate kartā mātṛhā ca bhaveddhruvamvidyākāmo'malāṃ vidyāṃ ratikāmo varastriyaḥetāni labhate nityaṃ śrāddhado nāvasīdatijñātibandhusuhṛcchiṣyairbhṛtyācāryaiśca dīkṣitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīveṣṭako gandharasaḥ pippalī hastipippalīraktacandanasaṃjñañca lavaṃgaṃ rātricūrṇakamcatuḥ kṣīra kujodbhūtatvaksārvasyātkaṣāyakaḥdūrvātilakuśāgraistu mārjanaṃ tvabhidhīyatepādyamācamanañcārghyaṃ gavyaṃ dikṣu vidikṣu catilaṃ śrīvṛkṣapatrañca candanaṃ meghasaṃjñakamtakkolañca phalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kaccolaṃ lohasaṃjñakamtṛtīyāvaraṇe saktūn agnau bhūtaghaṭeṣvapidhātrī ca nālikerañca likucaṃ mātulaṃgakamlakṣmīñca sahadevīñca viṣṇukrāntiṃ krameṇa tuguñjādi niṣkaparyantaṃ pādyādyaṃgaṃ pramāṇakammadhyamānaṃ tathā proktaṃ pādamardhaṃ tathāpi vākarpūrakuṃkumādīnāṃ mānamiṣṭaṃ pradīyatāmevaṃ trividharītyā tu śatamaṣṭottaraṃ matamaṣṭādvārasamāyuktai rekāśītistu pūjyatevarālatruṭikarpūratvagelośīrajātayaḥtenaiva pūrayetkumbhān vardhanī kalaśānapikṣīrandadhighṛtañcaiva prathamāvaraṇe nyasetsarṣapaṃ nālikerākhyaṃ rajanī mātulaṃgakampañcaviṃśatimadhyastha dravyāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśapūrvasmin saṃsthitaṃ jñeyaṃ koṇadvayavivarjitamdakṣiṇe paścime jñeyaṃ mānyāstraphalatoyayukkāntamūlodakaṃ brahmakūrcaṃ śāntyudavalkalepuṣparāgaṃ pravālañca sphaṭikaṃ (marakatantathā)ratnodakamiti proktaṃ lohodakamataḥ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yogyo hyanupanīto'pi śrāddhakarmaṇyadīkṣitaḥsvadhākāraṃ prayuñjīta mantroccāraṃ na kārayetdānamācamanaṃ homaṃ bhojanaṃ devatārcanamāsanārūḍhapādaśca jānvorvā jaṅghayostathātadbhūmisvāmipitṛbhiḥ śrāddhakarmopabhuñjatesarvāṇyasvāmikānyeva teṣu śrāddhādikaṃ nayetrajasvālā ca ṣaṇḍaśca nekṣerannaśrato dvijāndaive havīṃṣi pitrye ca tadgacchatyayathātathamye dharmānnānuvartante te ca nagnādayo matāḥutsṛṣṭavyaṃ pradhānārthaṃ saṃskāraścāpadi smṛtaḥsa kālaḥ kutapaḥ proktastasmin paitṛkamācaretśivoktiśśaucamakrodhastatparāḥ pātravahnayaḥpitā pitāmahaścaiva prapitāmaha eva cakramādīśādayaḥ proktāstadvanmātāmahādayaḥpitāmahī tathā svena tathaiva prapitāmahīmātṛśrāddhaṃ tu yugme syāt sadaivaṃ prāṅmukhaissadāaputrāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ tu patiḥkuryāt sapiṇḍatāmsapiṇḍīkaraṇādūrdhvemekoddiṣṭaṃ nivartayeaputrakā mṛtāḥ kecit striyo vā puruṣāśca yepitrāditraya patnīnāṃ bhojyā mātre vṛtā dvijāḥsvagotrād bhraṃśate nārī udvāhān saptame padecaturthīhomamantraistu māṃsamajjādibhissahapāṇigrāhaṇikā mantrāḥ pitṛgotrāpahāriṇaḥstrīṇāmanyasya bharturvai yadgotraṃ tena nirvapettad gotreṇa tu dātavyaṃ piṇḍaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathodakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paitṛkaṃ tu bhavet gotraṃ ūrdhvaṃ tu pitṛ daivatampitṛgotraṃ samutsṛjya na kuryādmātṛ gotrataḥvidhirniṣedha ityevaṃ codanā dvividhā matāvaiparītye tvadharmasyāttena pāpaṃ mahadbhavetyatkarmanayatītyuktaṃ prāyaścittamihāgamecidātmā kathitaśśāstre taraṇaṃ tu takārataḥtasmātprakīrtitaṃ viprāḥ prāyaścittaṃ śivāśritāḥtasmin puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ vā neti śāstrārtha niścayaḥkartavyā paścimāsyena koṇāsyena na veti cakarmaṇāmapyanantatvād granthavistāra doṣataḥsnānaṃ japaśśivadhyānaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ pradakṣiṇamśivajñānaratānāṃ ca darśanaṃ tannirīkṣaṇamśivāgni guru pūjā ca bhojanaṃ dīkṣitātmanāmśivāstrāmbhastato dīkṣā puṇyakṣetrādhivāsanamśāntiśca śāntihomaśca diśākhyaḥ saṃhitāhutiḥekāhādyutsavaśśītakumbho vaiśeṣikārcanamvibhajya lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ keṣāṃcidiha kathyatesoṣṇīṣassottarīyaśca navāmbara samanvitaḥprāyaścitte'dbhute vāpi śāntiṃ sadyasmamācaretprāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ sadyo yadi śreṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitamtasmānmāsāvasānaṃ tu hīnamityabhidhīyateliṅgapīṭhavimānādi prāyaścittādikaṃ nayetprāyaścitte samutpanne kartā vā deśiko'thavāvittābhāvānmanaḥ kṣobhādrāgadveṣādihetubhiḥnṛpa bhaṅgāya jātāste rāṣṭravikṣobhakāriṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devasvahāriṇo martyā ye'pyevaṃ śāsanārhakāḥrājño hitakarāḥ puṇyakarmāṇo rāṣṭrapoṣakāḥiti jñātvā tu yatnena prāyaścittaṃ samācaretmantrakāya udagvaktraḥ pūrvāsyaḥ sākṣamālikaḥaghorāstraṃ śivāstraṃ vā brahmāṇyaṅgāni vā punaḥjapettadanurūpeṇa mitagrāso haviṣyabhukśākayāvakapiṇyākakandamūlaphalāśanaḥjapaṃ eva samākhyātaḥ pradakṣiṇa mathocyateliṅga prāsādayormadhye śreṣṭhāśreṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitamgarbhe pradakṣiṇaṃ kartuṃ na śakyaṃ bahudoṣakṛtsomasūtrasya mūlaṃ ca devasamīpyameva vāantarmaṇḍaladeśe'pi somasūtraṃ ca vidyatenirmālyasaṅkaro'pi syāddhāmachāyā ca vidyatesavyāpasavya mārgeṇa kartavyaṃ vā pradakṣiṇamsavyāpasavyamārgeṇa mṛdugatyā samācaretchāyāyā laṅghanaṃ dhāmno devadevotsave'pi vātadbāhye naiva doṣasya praveśo'sti manāgapipade pade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhavetanayoḥ puṇyamāhātmyaṃ na śakyaṃ vaktumagrajāḥevaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ khyātaṃ śivāmbhastatra kathyatesūtravastra suvarṇāmbu kūrcacandana saṃyuteśivāmbha iti nirdiṣṭamastrodaṃ cāstra jāpataḥatikṛcchraparākau dvau cāndrāyaṇavidhistataḥevaṃ kṛcchraḥ samākhyātaḥ prājāpatya iti smṛtaḥsoṣṇāmājyaṃ tryahaṃ cādyāt tridinaṃ kevaloyadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eka viṃśati nakṣatraṃ tripalaṃ kṣīrabhojanamdvādaśāhanirrāhāraḥ parāka iti saṃsmṛtaḥcāndrāyaṇa vidhiḥ prokto jalenaiva jalātmakaḥcariṣṇurupavāsaṃ ca tyajet bhukti catuṣṭayamupavāsaḥ samākhyātaśśāntistvatra nigadyatetanmadhye kuṇḍamāpādya kṛtaṃ hastamitantathādevaṃ saṃśodhya vidhinā snapanaṃ pratyahaṃ nayetsaṃskṛtya kuṇḍaṃ vahniṃ ca śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ ca tarpayetaghorāstramathānyaṃ vā susiddhaṃ deśikātmanāsamidājyaṃ ca gavyaṃ ca madhuratraya saṃyutamsahasraṃ vā tadarthaṃ vā śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tu vāsvāhānte bhagavan sarvakṣopanāśaṃpadaṃ tataḥpañcāśadantaraṃ vāpi śatamantrāntaraṃ tu vāmukhavāsasamāyuktaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedya catattaddiṅmukha saṃjātaṃ paṭheyuśśāstrapāragāḥpaścime jātamīśānaṃ japeyustatra dīkṣitāḥstotāro bahavo vaikaḥ paṭheyuḥ stotra saṃhatimetat sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ snātairhoma pravartakaiḥnirodhya tatra deveśaṃ dadyādantarbahirbalimhomakarma nivedyāsmai prārthayet durita kṣayameka tripañcasaptāhanavāhaiśca dvisaptakaiḥkuṇḍe visarjanaṃ noktaṃ devasyāgneḥ purāvidheḥśāntirevaṃ samāravyātā śāntihomo vidhīyateśubhāśāsvagnideśe vā maṇḍape samalaṃkṛtesasūtraṃ sodakaṃ kūrcavastrahemāmbujānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paritaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau vastrakūrcādi saṃyutānpraṇavāsanamāruḍhaṃ durādharṣaṃ mahābalamdaṃṣṭrākarākamatyugraṃ muktanādaṃ sudurjayamkekarākṣaṃ mahāmālānāgābharaṇalelihambhujairdaśabhiratyugrairbhairavāstraissamanvitamkheṭabāṇā kapālāṃśca varaprāsau ca vāmataḥdhyātvaivaṃ samuccaran mantramāvāhyārcanamārabhetpraṇavaṃ vahni digbhāge ślīṅkāraṃ śāṅkare yajetoṅkārādi phaḍāntāśca varṇāḥ sthāne hṛdādayaḥphaḍantān praṇavopetān vajrādīn kalaśeṣu tāntadagre hāstike vṛtta kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vādevaṃ pāśupataṃ sāṅgamāvāhyābhyarcya tarpayetsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vābhagavan doṣaśāntiṃ tu kurukurviti deśikaḥpūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyādastraṃ pāśupataṃ smaranpunaḥ pūrṇāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ datvārghyaṃ ca parāṅmukhampratyahaṃ vā tadutpādya tarpayedastra rūpiṇamsamarpitakriye deve tvabhīṣṭaṃ prārthayedguruḥtatastatkumbha pānīyaiḥ prokṣayedabhitastataḥkartavyaśśāntihomo'yaṃ śāntyuktadinasaṃkhyayāprāyaścittārthamanyo'yaṃ snapanādyaṅga bhāgbhavetmaṇḍape mālikādau vā vṛkṣādermūla eva vādikṣu kūṭān prapāṃ vāpi kṛtvā kuṇḍa catuṣṭayamsthaṇḍilaṃ vā samāpādya prokṣayedastra vāriṇāekaṃ vā kūṭamāpādya tatra sarvaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athaitadyāgaśālāyāṃ karma sarvaṃ samāpayettarpaṇārthaṃ maheśasya kalpyaṃ vā munipuṅgavāḥtadagre saṃyajedastraṃśivākhyaṃdeśikottamaḥcandrakhaṇḍasumūrdhānaṃ sacatuṣkara pallavamdvādaśākṣiyutaṃ śaktiśūlābhayavarānvitamdakṣe'ghoramabhyarcya paścāt pāśupataṃ yajetoṃ hrīṃṅkāraṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇavāsase ceti yatpadammahābhairavivarṇe ca sarvaśatrupadaṃ tataḥcchedanītyuddhare paścāt sarvabhūtadamanyapisarvavighnāniti padaṃ chindhichindhīti yatpadamsarvaduṣyāṃstato bhakṣa bhakṣeti padamuddharetpratyaṅgire padaṃ paścāt hrīṃ namostviti yat padampraṇavāt saptavarṇaṃ hṛcchiraḥ pañcadaśākṣaramtathaiva tasmānnetrāṇuścatustriṃ/śadbhirastrakamnamaḥ svāhāvaṣaḍvauṣaḍ hruṃphaḍ yuktā hṛdādayaḥkṛṣṇāñjananibhāṃ vṛttaraktanetratrayānvitāmvahantīṃ vāmahastābhyāṃ muṇḍaṃ śeṣe tu pallavammauktikābharaṇairyuktāṃ sarvāvayavabhūṣaṇāmdhyātvaivaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairarcayetparameśvarīmgandhodakodarān kūrcahema paṅkajasaṃyutāncandanāliptadehāṃstu vinyasya karakeṇa caprāguktayā parito'strāṇi tataḥ pratyaṅgirāmapikuṇḍaṃ svakīyaṃ saṃskṛtya pāvakaṃ ca yathā purātarpayeyuryathānyāyaṃ mūrtipā guruṇā sahaprāgvat samāhitāḥ svasvadikṣu samyag vyavasthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradhānasya palāśassyāt sa ca sarvatra vā mataḥcarūśca homadravyāṇi śataṃ pañcāśadeva vāprāyaścittāhutiṃ pūrṇāṃ tāmbūlāhutisaṃyutāmantarbahirbaliṃ paścādācānto mantravigrahaḥkarturbhasmapradānaṃ ca kuryātsarvamanukramātdeva dhāmnikṛtaṃ caitadyadi kumbhodakaistadādiśāhomassamākhyātassarvāriṣṭa nivāraṇaḥpratyaṅgirāyāścāstrāṇāṃ pūjā nātra samīritāhomaśca puruṣāghoravāmājairdikṣu saṃmataḥvakṣyehaṃ saṃhitāhomaṃ sarvadoṣanikṛntanamutsavādyagnimadhye vā sthaṇḍile vā samācarettairmantraissaṃskṛte vahnau gandhādyairarcito guruḥśivāddaśāṃśato'ṅgānāmāhutirbrahmaṇāmapiprāyaścittārthamāpādya pūrṇāṃ kuryādvidhānataḥharmyāgre'nyatra vā kṛtā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtamaṇḍaleaṣṭadikṣvaṣṭa kumbhāṃstu vajrādyāyudha saṃyutāngandhodakodarān gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpa pradīpakaiḥyadvāghorāstrarājānaṃ madhyakumbhe śivaṃ vinādatvāsanamathāstrāsanāya huṃ phaṇṇamastvitidhyāyetsūryasahasrābhaṃ pralayāmbudanisvanamtryakṣaṃ taṭillatājihvādīptabhrūśmamaśrumūrdhajamcaturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ sphuraccandrārdha śekharamdevadānavadaityānāṃ darpitānāṃ vimardakampadmaṃ cakraṃ tathaiśāne naiṛte ca kramādyajetsthaṇḍile saṃskṛte vāpi vahniṃ vinyasya deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatrāvāhya yajetsāṅgaṃ aghorāstraṃ śivānalehaviṣyānnaṃ sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ śatameva vākarmanirdeśa saṃyuktamaṅgairastraiśca tarpayetpunaḥ pūrṇāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ datvā stutvābhivandya casvārthaṃ ca yajamānārthaṃ ca dadyādarghyaṃ parāṅmukhamtatraiva rakṣayennityaṃ yāvatkarma samāptayeantarbahirbaliṃ datvā samācamyāṇuvigrahaḥtatastatkumbha pānīyaiḥ snāpayet parameśvaramsaṃprārthya vāñcitaṃ devāllabdhānujñaḥ prasādajamatrāpyadhyayanaṃ mantrajapaṃ śāntivadācaretanyo'pi mūrtihomasya viśeṣastvatra kathyatesaṃyajenmūrtimūrtīśānaṣṭa kumbheṣu bāhyataḥsthaṇḍileṣvaṣṭakuṇḍeṣu vedikāsahiteṣu vāpañcāśatsaṃkhyakaṃ vāpi tadarthaṃ vā pṛthak pṛthakśamyapārmaśrīvṛkṣaplakṣāssamidha īritāḥpañcapakṣe'ṣtapakṣe vā sthaṇḍilaṃ pūrvadiggatampūrvasminnīśa kuṇḍe vā gurussaṃhitāyāhutimsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ prārthayediṣṭasiddhayekartavyo mūrtihomoyaṃ mūrtīśārcanahomayukśāntyuktadina saṃkhyāyā vaśenaitatsamācaretyato mayā samadiṣṭa stato nādyāpi kathyatedvāreśārcanalope ca pañcaśuddhivilopanepādyādīnāṃ catuṣke cābhyaṅgakodvartane'pi vāarcite pañcagavye vā lupte pañcāmṛte'pi vādīpe cārātrike lupte dhūpārātrikayoratha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūṣikādyaistu dīpena vahninā vā dvijottamāḥliṅgādisthe'mbare dagdhe dagdhe sadmanivātathāhīne kāṇḍapaṭe gandhe puṣpe naivedyakādiṣudevāya dattadravyeṣu nakharomādidarśanesāmānyaprāṇisaṃbhūta malayuktairathāpivātadākrame vā śaṅkhasya nisvane vā tadujjhiteliṅge berādike śūnyamastake pūrvakalpitebalāvadatte nitye vā vahnikarmaṇi nityakeaśaivāgnau kṛte home vaidikādi kriyākṛtauhomadravye'thavā hīne nityotsavavilopanevṛṣṭipātādibhirvāpi rāṣṭrakṣobhādi hetubhiḥatodya nṛttakaraṇe vitānasya vilopanepādukārādhana hīne tadyāne vā vilopiteuktapradakṣiṇe hīne vaiparītyapradakṣiṇesaukhye kṛte tadaṅge vā pañcācāryādhipojjhitetadā dīpe'thavā gāne vihīne tu dvijottamāḥtadaṅge vāpyadattāyāṃ rakṣāyāṃ bhasmanastathākṛte paryuṣita puṣpādyairarcane garbhagehakenirmālyasaṅkaropetaiḥ kṣayakuṣṭhādirogibhiḥduṣṭalakṣaṇayuktaiśca hīnāṅgairvādhikāṅgibhiḥādiśaiva kulodbhūtavyatiriktaiśśive'rciteevaṃ nityavidho proktaḥ prāyaścitte hyanukramaḥekasandhyārcanāhīne pūjayottamayā yutemadhyayā mūrtihomassyāddhīnayā śāntihomakamupasandhyārcane hīne hīnoktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalaśairnavabhirdaivaṃ saṃsnāpya tadanantaramtrisandhyārcana lope tu snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥprāyaścittaṃ prakartavyamekāhe tu vihīnakedinadvaye vihīne tu dvidinaṃ caitadācaretdināni yāni hīnāni pūjayā nityasaṃjñayāeka māsāvadhiṃ yāvattatassaṃprokṣaṇaṃ nayetdvārapālārcane hīne vighnabādhā dvijottamāḥpañcaśuddhi vihīnā yā sā pūjā tvakṛtā bhavetśivasaṃskārahīne tu narāḥ syurduṣṭacāriṇaḥpīḍyante kramabhaṅgetu sāṅkaryaṃ bhuvijāyateśānti homaṃ tadākṛtvā yathāvatsarvamācarettadaṅge vā bhavelloke tattaddravyavināśanamtadvadācamanāṅge vā mukharogo bhaviṣyatidūrvāpuṣpākṣatairhīne tadaṅge tatphalaṃ dhruvampañcagavya vihīne tu hīne pañcāmṛteṅgakegandhādāne'ṅgavaikalye puṣpādāne tadaṅgakedhūpe'datte tadaṅge vā hīne syādghora rogatāpīḍayante sopasargāśca jāyante tannivāsinaḥāmantraṇa havirlope tadaṅgānāmathāpivātāmbūlānāmabhāve'ṅge hīne vā vaktrarogatābhavediti gururjñātvā prāyaścittaṃ samācaretśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kuryāt snapanaṃ vā gururnayetkartavyassaṃhitāhomaśśatāghora japo'thavāpradatte'ghora mantreṇa dvicatuṣṣaṭśataṃ kramātdravyāṇyetānyamantreṇa dattāni yadi śaṅkare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ārakūṭaṃ tataḥ kāṃsyayuktaṃ lohodakam paramgairikaṃ rocanaṃ cānte dhātūdakamidaṃ matamśyāmāṣṭakaṃ yavo bījo bījodakamihoditamcandanaṃ laghukuṣṭhañca varālośīramustakāḥebhistu cūrṇitairyuktaṃ gandhodakamiti smṛtamgokṣurā sahadevī ca viṣṇukrāntā kṛtāñjalidūrvāṃkurañca kuśāgraṃ gaurasarṣapamtulasībilvapatrañca tamālañca tapasvinīpadmaṃ raktotpalaṃ paścāt pāṭalī campakaṃ tathāśvetārkavakulaiyuktaṃ puṣpatoyamiheritamkarpūrośīrasamyuktaṃ mānyodakamiheritampāśokṣamālāḥhaimāśca tairastrodakaṃ bhavetnāraṃgadvayarambhādyaiḥ uktamasmin phalodakamjambūtvagbhissamāyuktaṃ kaṣāyodakamīritamgandhatrayasamāyuktamāḍhyatoyamiti smṛtamnikuntaḥ pañcabhiryuktaṃkāntodakamiti smṛtamśrīkaṇṭhaśceti pañcabhiryuktammūlodakaṃ smṛtamebhirdravyaissamāyuktaṃ brahmakūrcamiti smṛtamkṛtāṃjaliśca pañcabhiryuktaṃ syādvalkalodakamcatvāriṃśatsumadhyasthakalaśadravyamīritamvibhītā gokṣurādyaṣṭau garbhāvaraṇagā matāḥnadyāvartamapāmārgaṃ dūrvā ca karavīrakamjāti bilvaṃ sitārkañca ekapatrāravindakamvṛttakramamatho vakṣye śivakumbhantu madhyataḥmāṇikkaṃ śivakumbhe tu pañcaratnasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadyādante svamantreṇa dravyaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ samamnitye naimittike kāmye pādyāditrayalopaneyādyādi dviguṇaṃ dadyāttaddravyaṃ kevalaṃ tu vāpravartamāne'bhyaṅge vodvartanirmajjanādikesaṃsthite'bhyaṅga tailādye pūjayā saṃhitāhutiḥvilupte saṃhitāhomaṃ kṛtvā dviguṇamācaretpūrvasaṃkalpite gandhe lupte sadyaḥ śataṃ japetapuṣkale vihīne vā puṣpe datte viparyayātdhūpecārātrike ghoraṃ japtvānte dviguṇaṃ tataḥdīpamālāsthitenātha muṣikādyāhṛtena vāaṇunā mahatā vāpi rājño rogo bhaviṣyatipañcāmṛta samāyuktaṃ nālikerodakānvitamaṇumātro bhavedvahniryadi śāntiṃ samācaretnirdagdhāni tadā kuryāt karma saṃprokṣaṇādikamdahane sadmanaḥ kuryāt sadma saṃprokṣaṇātmakamtaduktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kuryāt sandhānādi samanvitammānuṣaṃ cet parityājyaṃ grāhyaṃ svāyaṃbhuvādikampustako yadi leśena dagdhaḥ śāntiṃ samācaretprāṇyaṅgadhūpādena ca pañcamasya śataṃ japetdīpāni dviguṇaṃ paścāt devadeva pradāpayethaviṣya datte devāya snapanaṃ tu vidhāya caatha kāṇḍapaṭe hīne kavacaṃ dviśataṃ japetkṛmikīṭanarādyasthinakharomādi darśaneśivāya dattadravyeṣu nakharomādi darśaneśliṣmāśrurudhirādyukta dravyaiścet pūjitaḥ śivaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāmānyaprāṇi saṃbhūtamalayukte tathācarethīnaṃ laṅghanaṃ tatra yadi jāyeta doṣadamśataṃ japedviśudhyarthaṃ hīne vā śaṅkhanisvaneprāgeva niścitadravyahīne taddoṣakārakamprāgeva niścitadravyavardhanaṃ dhanavardhanamliṅgaberādayaśśūnyamastakāyadi doṣadāḥpūrvasandhyārcitamlānapuṣpādyaissamavasthiteaghoreṇa śataṃ japtvā punaḥ pūjāṃ samācarettat sthāna vimukhāstāsāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ dviguṇaṃ nayetnitye naimittike kāmye tvakṛte vahnikarmaṇipunastattriguṇaṃ kāryaṃ tanmātraṃ vā dvijottamāḥhomakāryāṇi yāvanti parityaktāni deśikaiḥpramāṇahīnaṃ tatkuṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ vāri vṛddhidamkuṇḍasaṃskārahīne tu śivāgnirnaiva siddhyatianiṣpanne śivāgnau vā tayossaṃskāra pūrvakamaśaivāgnau kṛto homaśśaivo vyādhiprado bhavetvaidikāgni kriyā yā tu neṣyate śivamandireityatra kriyate naiva svamanīṣā pravartitamasti caidvedikaṃ karmetyetatsiddhāntavartmanānocyate vaidikaṃ vātha purāṇasmṛticoditamrakṣite'gnau tu nirvāṇe yajamāna vināśanamsaśive'pi hi nirvāṇe'yutaṃ ghorāṇunāhutimhoma dravya vihīne syāt taddravya dviguṇāgutiḥtadādevaṃ samabhyarcyāghoreṇaiva śataṃ hunetahorātre vihīne tu snapanaṃ kārayecchive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśāhe snapanaṃ śāntihomasaṃyuktamācaretekamāsāntare hīne snapanaṃ ca śatāhutiḥ (diśāhutiḥ)pakṣāntare tatopyūrdhvaṃ yadi niṣkṛti ṛkṣakamnityotsavaśca kartavyo niṣkṛteranudeśikaiḥberaṃ vihāya puṣpādyairliṅgairnirvartite sativṛṣṭipātādibhirvāpi rāṣṭrakṣaubhādihetubhiḥtatkāle dīpavicchede rāṣṭrabhandhatamo bhavetevaṃ syādyadi vādye vā nṛtte vā doṣakārakamsahasraṃ dviguṇaṃ paścānnṛttaṃ vādyaṃ samācaretevaṃ syāt balidāne'pi vādyādīpavilopanekuryādvā saṃhitāhomaṃ sahasraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ japetvighnabādhā japedghoraṃ kuryādvā saṃhitāhutimukta praṭakṣiṇehīne saṃhitāhoma iṣyatetadvatkuryānniṣkṛtiṃ ca annaliṅgādipātanepāduke patite rāṣṭrakalahastannivartayepādukaṃ ca samabhyarcya tatpuraśśāntihomakambhedādāvanukarmoktyā niṣkṛtissyādvijottamāḥpañcaviṃśatibhiḥ kuryātsnapanaṃ kalaśaistadāsaukhyāni yāni hīnāni tatsaukhyaṃ dviguṇaṃ nayetsaukhyāṅge tu vihīne vā dviguṇaṃ tu tadā nayettadā martyāḥ svavṛttisthā na bhavantyatra vāsinaḥsarvābhāve nayecchāntihomaṃ bahudine'pi caaghoreṇa śataṃ japtvā punastaddviguṇaṃ nayetyāvadeva tadā kuryācchānti homaṃ taduktavatsaukhyadīpasya vicchede ghoreṇaika śataṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāyaścittaṃ tadā kāryaṃ tadbhītivinibṛttayesahasraṃ vā japedghoraṃ dviguṇaṃ dāpayettataḥdevaṃ saṃsnāpya gavyena samabhyarcyādarādguruḥśāntihomastu vā kāryo mūrtihomothavā mataḥadatte darpaṇacchatracāmārādau tadā nayetkṛte'pyuṣitapuṣpādyairarcane rāṣṭra vibhramaḥgarbhagehe sanirmālye devānāṃ nātra sannidhiḥaghorākhyaṃ japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ doṣaśāntayetadrāṣṭravāsino martyāḥ pīḍayante śatrubhistadāapasmārādibhirgrastairduṣṭalakṣaṇa lakṣitaiḥrāṣṭrakṣobhāya sā pūjā bhavenniṣkṛtirucyatetadūrdhvaṃ śatavṛddhyā tu kālabhedājjapaṃ nayetṣāṇmāsopari śāntissyānmūrtihomassamoparianyadeśe'nyakāle ca ta evāniṣṭahetavaḥsā ca pañcavidhā proktā śāstre bālādi bhedataḥatibālāti vṛddhābhyāṃ tāssārdha ghaṭikā matāḥatibālā ca bālā ca nāsti grāhyastisṛṣvapitāsveva prārabhetpūjāṃ pūrvāhṇādiṣu sarvadāatibālātivṛddhā ca garhitārambhakarmaṇisandhyārambhe tadanyatra saṃhitāhomamācaretkṛte parārthe doṣāya sakṛtsandhyārcane kṛtepakṣordhvaṃ śāntirityuktā māsordhvaṃ śāntihomakaḥṣāṇmāsordhve vidhātavyaṃ karmasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ dvijāḥadhikāro'nuśaivesti bhṛtyarthaṃ na bavedyadicalaliṅga pratiṣṭhāyāṃ dīkṣāyāṃ sarvadeśakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāntānikasya sarvatra na ca śūdrasya kīrtitākṛte devalakāhvena sthāpanādau gurūttamāḥadhikāravihīnenānuṣṭhitaṃ tadvadācaretaṣṭabandhādi viśleṣe niṣkṛtikrama ucyateripuṇā saṃgṛhīto vā devī vā kevalādvijāḥtatrāpi dhāmni sphuṭite mahatsvalpādi bhedataḥsthale'dhaḥ patite vāpi tadaṅge vākhile'pi vābalipīṭhavihīne tu tajjīrṇe sphoṭane'pivājīrṇepi patite vāpi sphoṭanādisamanviteulūkagṛdhrakākaiśca ṛtustrī cora gardabhaiḥgūḍhajaiḥ pāparogāttairvrātyairvā pratilomajaiḥcatuṣpādairathānyaiśca pakṣibhirvā sarīsṛpaiḥśilpibhiḥ pāṇacaṇḍālarajakādyairathāpi vāpraviṣṭe vātha pūrve tu maṇḍape pratimāhvayemahānase praviṣṭe vā balipīṭheṣu vā dvijāḥparārthaṃ sthāpite liṅge spṛṣṭe garbhe praveśiteuṣite vā ciraṃ madhye aśucikṣepaṇe'thavāviṣṭhākhyaprasravodgāraśleṣma madyādi secaneprāsāde garbhagehe'rdhe pratimā maṇṭapādikebere pīṭhe vṛṣādau vā taddhāmni bilapīṭhakeāsthānamaṇḍape'nyāsmin nṛpaveśmani vā gṛheśithilīsaṃbhave vātha madhupañjara saṃbhaveeteṣāṃ vā samutpattau dvāre vā śayanālayeajagomahīṣādīnāṃ sthāne vā grāma madhyamemaṭhe prapādike vāpi ārāmādāvathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nitye naimittike kāmye lupte snapanakarmaṇikumbhādīnāṃ vilope ca kumbhādau mānavarjitebhedādisahite datte pṛṣṭe vā dvijasattamāḥsnapane kalpite bere sūtraveṣṭanavarjitevidhānakūrca lope vā utkūrcakramalopanegavyādi dravya lope vā puṇyāhe vā vivarjiteāṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu kṛttikānteṣu pañcasukṛttikādīpavicchede rāṣṭrakṣobhādihetubhiḥpuṣpaśūnyaśiroliṅge vṛṣṭipātādisecitepaśubhirbādhite liṅge devatāntarabādhiteaṣṭabandhetu viśliṣṭe rāṣṭre śaithilyamādiśetpurātanaṃ parityajya śāstreṇāstraṃ samuccaranripuṇā saṃgṛhītaṃ celliṅgaṃ vā pratimādikamsarvayatnāt tadāhṛtya tatraiva sthāpanāya caliṅgotpāṭajadoṣasya śāntyarthaṃ ghoramantrataḥmadhuratraya saṃyuktaṃ sahasraṃ dūrvayāhutimlakṣaṇoddhāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭi mocanaṃ jalaveśanaṃalabdhaṃ liṅgaberādyaṃ yadānyat sthāpayennavampratyahaṃ śāntihomaśca kartavyaḥ sthāpanāntakamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena māsatritayamadhyamekairgṛhītaṃ kva corādyāḥ kva liṅgaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tu tatpratyahaṃ caivamanveṣya sthitamanyatraceddhruvamāhṛtya liṅgaberādyaṃ svasthāne sthāpayebhṛśamsaṃvatsaratrayādūrdhvamalabdhaṃ cenmunīśvarāḥsaṃsthāpya mūlaliṅgādyamarcayedarcanoktavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatprāsādānurūpeṇa yajamānānurūpataḥbāṇaliṅgaṃ tu vā tatra sthāpayet sarvasiddhayedevīṃ vihāya devo vā devī vā kevalā yadāsaṃpādya cetaraṃ tasya pratiṣṭhāṃ ca samāpya casthāpanānte tu beramādyamānītaṃ cettadantikepīṭhaṃ cet santyajelliṅge nāthavānyena yojayetāgneyyāmagnidāhaḥ syāddakṣiṇe kalaho bhavetvāyavyāṃ śatruvṛddhisyāduttare putranāśanamuttamādi vibhedena kṛtvā śāntiṃ puroditāmprāsādamanukarmoktyā kārayedvā yathāvidhiprāsādārdhe tripāde vā pāde'ṣṭāṃśe'tha bhagnakeprāyaścittaṃ prakartavyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ bhāvitātmabhiḥsthalādho jalaniḥsrāve jale'dhaḥ patite'pivāśāntihomaṃ tadākuryāt salile patite tryahamprokṣayedvāstratoyena snānārthaṃ pratisandhyakamtatassaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt sthalakarmāvasānakepīḍāribhirbhavet kumbhavardhanyośca śivaṃ śivāmnayettutridinaṃ śāntiṃ mantranyāsapurassaramparivāra vihīnetu bhṛtyavargasyanāśanambalipīṭhe vihīne tu sarvadoṣāvahaṃ bhavettajjīrṇe sphuṭite dāhe patanādau sati dvijāḥprākāre gopure jīrṇe patite sphoṭanādiketatassaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt sandhānaṃ sphoṭanādiṣukapi kukkuṭakādyairvā kapotaissūkaraiḥśvabhiḥpatitaiḥ pretakairvāpi pātakaissūtakairatha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gurvādidroha saṃyuktaidīkṣāhīnairdvijādibhiḥhīnajātibhiranyairvā narairdīkṣāntarasthitaiḥspṛṣṭe pīṭhe'tha liṅge vā berādau tatravāsinaḥmṛtbhāṇḍāṃstu tyajedetaiḥ spṛṣṭānāsannakānapigavyena snapanaṃ kṛtvā saṃprokṣanamathācaretśāntihomādikaṃ kāryaṃ prāguktaṃ rajakairapigarbhagehe praviṣṭe tu snapanaṃ śāntihomayukṛtustrīpātakādyaiścet praviṣṭaṃ garbhagehakamcaṇḍālarajakādyaiścecchānti homasamāyutamśāntikarmadiśāhomaṃ kramātsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ nayetprathame ca dvitīye ca caṇḍālavihitaṃ tu yatpratimā maṇḍapāveśe triprakāraiḥ krameṇa vaidīkṣāhīnān dvijātīṃśca hitvā dīkṣāntarānapikapotakākasarpādi praveśo nātra doṣabhākkṛtaṃ cenmūrtihomassyācchāntihomo dvitīyakeparivārālayoktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ mahānasenirvāṇa dīkṣayā hīnāśśūdrādyāssamayasthitāḥkartavyaṃ snapanaṃ śāntihomo garbha praveśaneantarmaṇḍalasālādau mālikādau ca maṇḍapekṛtaṃ saṃśodhya bhūmiṃ tu kṣālayedgomayādibhiḥgarbhe'rdhamaṇḍape beramaṇḍape bāhyataḥ kramātsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ diśāhomaṃ mūrtyākhyaṃ śāntihomakamāśaucināṃ trivarṇānāmantarmaṇḍalaveśanamtatonyeṣāṃ praveśe tu pañcagavyena secayetmaccinha dhāriṇo vātha śūdrā vā ye'nulominaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣitā mantrahīnā vā rudrakanyāsamā matāḥprāsāde garbhageherdhe pratimā maṇḍapādikebere pīṭhe vṛṣādau vā taddhāmni balipīṭhakeāsthānamaṇḍape'nyasmin nṛpaveśmani vā gṛheśithilī sambhave vātha madhupañjara sambhavesamutthitāścedbhūmyādau sarvadoṣāvaho nṛṇāmrogo bhayaṃ vahnidāho bandhunāśo dhanāgamaḥmadhyādīśānaparyantaṃ valmīkasya ca darśanetadūrdhvaṃ prāṇināśassyādindrabhāge bhayaṃ bhavetrājakṣobhastadūrdhvaṃ syādarthalābho yame bhavetvṛddhirniṛtikāṣṭhāyāmanarthaṃ syāttadūrdhvataḥvāyu diksthā tu kanyāyāḥ some syācchatrubhirbhayamgṛhanāśo bhavedvāre śayanasthānake mṛtiḥdvāranāle bhavedbhāryāmaraṇaṃ bhṛtyahāriṇīdṛṣṭirogo bhavedgrāmamadhyo devālayādikesabhāyāṃ caityavṛkṣe vā mahāvīthyāṃ maṭhe'pi vāliṅgamūle tu jātāścennṛpaterbhayamādiśetvalmīkadarśane'pyevaṃ dvārādāvīritaṃ phalamśuddhamṛtkhaṇḍa sahitairna yathā punarudbhavaḥsaṃsthāpya kalaśairdevaṃ mūrtihomaṃ samācaretgarbhagehe'thavā dvāri saptāhaṃ caivamācaretkuryādanyatra mūrtyākhyaṃ śāntihomamathaikahammadhunīḍaṃ tu cettatsthaṃ madhunīḍaṃ visarjayetdeveśa snapanaṃ kṛtvā diśāhomaṃ tadā nayetnitye naimittike kāmye lupte snapanakarmaṇi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punaśca snapanaṃ kuryādiṣṭakāle puroktavataghoraṃ triśataṃ japtvā saṃpūrṇasnapanaṃ nayethutvā'ghoraṃ sahasraṃ tu yathoktaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ nayetjāyate kalaho rāṣṭre japtvāghoraṃ sahasrakamiti tanmātrakairevaṃ dviguṇadravya saṃyutaiḥdviśataṃ ca śataṃ kumbhe vardhanyāṃ kalaśeṣu casthāpitaśśivakumbho vā vardhanī kalaśo'thavātadā rājño mahiṣyāśca karmiṇāṃ doṣado bhavetjapedaghora mantreṇa sadaiva dviguṇaṃ japetśarāvaśaṅkhahaimādipātre vā brahmavṛkṣajesūtrairaveṣṭitāḥ kumbhapūrvāścecchatruvardhanamtathaiva veṣṭitāssvalpatantunā niṣkṛtirmatākūrce vihīne devānāṃ sannidhirnātra vidyatetadā hṛdā japenmantrī dviśataṃ triśataṃ tu vātathaiva vastralope ca sahasraṃ tu japedhṛdāgavyādi dravya lope tu rāṣṭrekalahamādiśetpuṇyāha prokṣaṇehīna japedghoraśataṃ punaḥśāntihomaṃ tadā kuryānmantranyāse'kṛte yadiāṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu kṛttikānteṣu pañcasutāssarvā niṣphalā eva prāsāde vā gṛhādikeiṣṭamāse tataḥ kuryāt pavitrārohaṇaṃ paramdīpāvalirvihīnā cet pīḍyante śatrubhirnarāḥrāṣṭrakṣobhe'ricorādyaiḥ parasparavirodhataḥbhūmau vā rakṣayettasmin kriyāmenāṃ vidhāya cakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīyuktaṃ kalaśairāvṛtaṃ na vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādyādikaṃ sahasraṃ tu tadbahirvinyaset kramātkṣīrandadhighṛtañcaiva prathamāvaraṇe nyasetcaturviṃśati saṃkhyāte nālikeraphalaṃ bahiḥṣaṭpañcāśat ghaṭe prokto pañcame madhu kīrtitamdvisaptatisamāyukto saptame sarvabījakamnavameṣaṇṇavatyante bhasitantadanantaramcaturyukte śatepañcagavyamekādaśāṃśakedhātu lohodakaṃ paścāt śateṣoḍaśasaṃyutesarvagandhañca sarveṣu kalaśeṣu vinikṣipetghaṭaṃ vā kalaśaṃ vāpi catvāriṃśattu saṃkhyayāpratyekaṃ vinyasetsamyak dravyaṃ vā viniveśayetuktamārgeṣu sarvañcellabdhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitamvidyeśāḥ madhyame devāstvanyatra śiva eva hipaṭhanvāpūjayedīśāṃ śivanāmnātha kevalamsvāhāntaṃ vā namaskāraprāntaṃ praṇavapūrvakamtatrāgneyādikoṇasthañcaturvyūhaṃ samācaretsthāpayeddikṣuhomārthameteṣāmantarālakeanyat sarvaṃ samānaṃ syādaṣṭapañcaśataṃ bhavettatbahiḥ pañcaviṃśacca digvidikṣu prakalpayetaṣṭavyūhantathātvetu ukta saṃkhyānvitaṃ bhavetratnāni svasvarūpeṇa śastāni dvijasattamāḥlohavṛddhayā tu mānaṃ syāttathā pāṣāṇamānakamtāvattaṇḍulamānaṃ syāt sitāmānantathā matamgandhadravyapramāṇantu dhātuvatparikīrtitamtilasarṣapahāridragośakṛtbhasmamānakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyeśvarasamopetaṃ svasvamantraissamarcayetśatamardhaṃ manonmanyā brahmabhistvaṅgasaṃyutaiḥsamidājyānnasaṃyuktamante pūrṇāhutiṃ nayetiṣṭakāracite pīṭhe liṅge vā vinyasenmanumpīṭhasyādyaḥ sthale devī piṇḍikāyāṃ tu vā nyasetetadvidhānaṃ berāṇāṃ bhavetsannidhikāraṇamkṣayaṃ tasyāvahennityaṃ vṛṣṭivātātapādibhiḥpaśubhirbādhitaṃ liṅgaṃ devatāntarabādhitamtasmātprokṣaṇa karmādyamacirātkārayennṛpaḥuttamāṃ madhyamāṃ hīnāṃ kaniṣṭhāmathavā dvijāḥgandhopetaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ syāt sadhūpaṃ tatparaṃ matamsatāmbūlaṃ tataḥśreṣṭhaṃ sabaliśśasyate mataḥsa saukhya tata utkṛṣṭā jñātvaivaṃ pratyahaṃ nayetvṛṣṭyādi bādhite liṅge tasyaprāsādamācaretkavāṭārgalayogādyaistasya rakṣāṃ samācaretbrahmādi beraṃ tattasmādanyatra sthāpayetsudhīḥviṣṇurviriñciśśakraśca buddhastvārhata eva vānasthāpyāḥ sthāpitāṃścāpi dūradeśe niveśayetvyatiriktaṃ śivakṣetrāt sthāpayedvaiṣṇavādikamyogyameveti nirdiṣṭaṃ śivassarvādhipo yataḥsauraṃ vā śākramevaṃ vā vahneḥ sthānaṃ yamasya vāpārvatyā vātha durgāyāḥ kṣetrapasyendumūrtinaḥgaṇapaskandanandīśa vasūnāṃ nāgapasya cakalpitaṃ sthānamīśasya yogyameva na saṃśayaḥsādhāraṇaṃ smarantyenaṃ te yānti narakārṇavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: te tu durmatayaḥ proktāssuciraṃ saṃcarantyalammadaika śaraṇā ye tu taiḥ pūjyohaṃ na cāparaiḥprāyaścittārdhamarhanti striyo vā vyādhi pīḍitāḥsuduṣkaraṃ svayaṃ kartumakṣamo dviguṇonyataḥsuvicārya pradātavyaṃ nopavāso rujānvitetadvibhajya vidhātavyaṃ dviguṇaṃ ca parairjanaiḥprāyaścittaṃ pradātavyaṃ yadi bhaktāssadāśiveprāyaścittaṃ ceradbhrātā pitā vānyat suhṛjjanaḥrājadaṇḍo na caivāsti prāyaścittaṃ na vidyatedeśāśca bahavaśśāstre muktisthānaṃ paraṃ matamhṛtkaṇṭhatālu bhūmadhya brahmarandhraṃ kramādbhavetsakṛtsandhyā vilope tu sadyojātaṃ śataṃ japetkāmatastūpavāsaśca lupte devārcane yadāekāhne'ghora sāhasrajapastu jñānato bhavetbahukālārcakasyāpi dvikālādi vilopanedvidinādi vilope tu bahurūpasahasrataḥayutāghora jāpasyāttadvṛddhyā pratimāsakamsveṣṭaliṅge paribhraṣṭe neṣṭadagdhe hṛte'pi vāliṅgāntaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya bhavecchuddho na saṃśayaḥsahasrāghora vṛddhisyāt sahasrāt prabhṛti kramātdviguṇaṃ tu nirādhāre kalpanīyaṃ gurūttamaiḥjaptvā daśa sahasrādi pañcagavyāmṛtādināavyaṅgatve taduddiṣṭaṃ liṅgādau dvijasattamāḥsaṃskāreṇa viśuddhiḥsyāt pratiṣṭhā vātra saṃmatāprāguktadviguṇaṃ kuryāt kāmato niṣkṛtirnahi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kramājjapedaghorasya śatavṛddhyā narottamaḥpādalagnarajaḥspṛṣṭe bahurūpāyutaṃ japettryayutaṃ dvayayutaṃ kuryāt bahurūpaṃ narottamaḥraktamūtrarajaśśukladūṣite'yutapañcakamviṣṭhāsparśetu lakṣaṃ syāt pādahīnaṃ tadambhasāviṣṭhādigartapāte tu lakṣamardhādhikaṃ japetpratilomādibhiḥ spṛṣṭe lakṣamāvartya śuddhyaticaṇḍālapāṇakādyaiśca spṛṣṭe śuddhiḥ pratiṣṭhayānityahome vilope ca prāyaścittaṃ tu nityavatviṣugrahaṇayornityalope kuryāccaturguṇamprāgukaniṣkṛtiṃ vahni nirmāṇi tāṃ samācaretvratasyānya kriyāyāśca niyamasya ca lopaneavidhāya pavitraṃ tadāṣāḍhādiṣu pañcasupavitrārohaṇatyāge prāyaścittamidaṃ matamjapo'pi lakṣamātraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ matamsahasreṇa vināśe tu tadardhāt parivartitenavasūtrasya vicchede sahasraṃ japamācaretakṣamālāṃ karādbhraṣṭāṃ ālayedgandhavāriṇāghaṇṭādoṣe tu liṅgoktādaṣṭamāṃśācchucirbhavetśatadvayamaghorasya kāmatastvayutaṃ japetkeśāmāṃśāsthikīṭādiduṣṭanaivedyadarśanenitya naivedyamānasya hrāse naimittikasya vāpādenākāmataḥ spṛṣṭvā guruṃ devaṃ śivāgamammaheśaguru caṇḍājñābhaṅge lakṣeṇa śuddhyatinirmālya bhakṣaṇe ghoraṃ pramādādayutaṃ japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athavā bhakṣaṇe'kāmāt prajapetbrahmapañcakamnirmālya laṅghanaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇārdhāyutaṃ japetdevasvaṃ devatādravyaṃ naivedyaṃ ca niveditamgrāmadīśasya devasvaṃ devadravyaṃ paṭādikamcaṇḍadravyaṃ tu taddattaṃ nirmālyaṃ preritaṃ bahiḥkravyādo jāyate dānānmātaṅgastasya bhakṣaṇātsparśane jāyate strītvaṃ nirmālyasya na saṃśayaḥpādonaṃ tatra pūrvoktaṃ sparśalaṅghana bhakṣaṇaiḥdevadevāya tatrādyaṃ devagrāmādi sambhavamkaroti yasya saṃmūḍhā maddhanasteyakṛnmataḥyaḥ prayacchati vā bhuṅkte so'pi steyakṛducyatetathaiveti catuṣkāṣṭhā madbhuktistvati doṣadānivedya mahyaṃ tacchiṣṭaṃ bhuṅkte pratyahamādarātmadbhuktaṃ caṇḍabhuktaṃ vāyo lobhādbhakṣayennaraḥbhakṣayedyo naro bhaktyā pavitramiti śaṃsitamaśuddhātmā śucirlobhānmadbhuktaṃ pāvanaṃ naraḥmaddehadhāriṇo loke deśikā matparāyaṇāḥtasmānmadīyaṃ nirmālyaṃ bhuktvā niṣkṛtimācaretprāyaścittamahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥaghorāyuta jāpaśca gomayāliptamaṇḍalepratirātraṃ caredetadvrataṃ pāpa viśuddhayeetadvrataṃ samākhyātaṃ daśavṛddha manuvratammahāpātakināṃ proktaṃ mahāvratamihāgamebrahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥkāmastvevamākhyātamajñānadardhamiṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadardhaṃ vaiśyajātestu tadardhaṃ śūdra iṣyategūḍhajeṣu ca teṣvardhaṃ tadardhaṃ pratilomeṣuabhiṣiktasya hanane dīkṣitoktaṃ vrataṃ matammādhvī khaṇṭakamṛdvīkamaireyaṃ nālikerajamdvādaśyeva surā paiṣṭissarveṣāmadhamā smṛtāekādaśasurāpāne kuryādvratadaśāṃśakamgomūtrayavakāhāro daśarātreṇa śuddhyatisarveṣāṃ kṣatriyādīnāṃ pūrvoktanyāya īritaḥkṣatriyādiṣu saṃprokto viprasya na vadhaḥ kvacitdaśa lakṣaṃ japāntaṃ tu tadūrdhvaṃ daśavṛddhitaḥśatamardhārdhahrāsena svarṇasteye samīritamsuvarṇe rajate dhānye śatamekādaśottaramgurutalpaṃ vihāyānyastrīyoge naiva pātakampātakaissaha cet kuryāt so'pi tatsama iṣyateanupātakaśuddhyarthamanuvratamudāhṛtamāsāṃ ca gamanaṃ viprāstvanupātakamīritamcaṇḍālapāṇa rajakocchiṣṭa bhoge'nupātakamdveṣeṇotpāṭanam kṛtvā pātakādadhiko bhavetduḥsthānanimnadoṣādau parihartuṃ taduddhṛtamdevakṣetrāpaharaṇaṃ devopaharaṇāhṛtiḥśaivādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ tu daṇḍanirṇaya eva capitṛvyasakhi śiṣyastrī snuṣāśca śaraṇāgatāḥsagotrā mātulānīṃ ca samāna pravarā ca yāparivittiḥ parivettā tayoryājanameva cagurośca pratikūlatvaṃ tathā nikṣipta saṃgrahaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uktitvaṃ patitaśceti taddhīnaṃ vātha tadyutamvāpīkūpataṭākāderharaṇaṃ tūpapātakamupavrataṃ vadhe kuryāttadardhaṃ haraṇe bhavettatpādaṃ syāttadālīḍhasparśādau snānamācarettadromāsthyādi saṃsparśe snānameva vidhīyategoharttā tasya māṃsāśī tatsamānaṃ samācaretgavāmabhāve tanmūlyaṃ dātavyaṃ puṣkalaṃ tathārodhādinā sādayitvā dviguṇaṃ vratamācaretyājane pādahīnaṃ syāccaret sarvaṃ nipātaneatiriktaṃ na dātavyaṃ kāle svalpaṃ tu dāpayetbalābhāvādvipadyeta gauścarantī kathaṃcanaśvabhre vā patitā'kasmācchava pacenāpi bhakṣitāśūnyāgāre tvaṭavyāṃ vā gṛhadāhe'pi pādapātkanyānāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ caiva parabhāryātmavikrayaunīcalomāntyajocchiṣṭa bhojanaṃ copapātakamtasya pānādinā viprāstvetaddviguṇamācaretvaiśyāśauce'rdhabhāgvipraḥ kṣatrāśauce tadardhabhākvaiśyaśūdragṛhe bhuktvā kṣatriyoktārdhamācaretsvotkṛṣṭāśauca bhuktyā tu svagṛhāśauca bhuktitaḥśūdrastvevaṃ tadanyau cet kuryāttāṃ vidhināmunārajasvalāmukhāsvāde tathā caṇḍālayoṣitāmviprapātaka śuddhyarthaṃ vratamatra samīritamvratamātramudakhyāstu śuddhyarthaṃ vipra ācaretpādapādavihīnaṃ tu kṣatrādi tritayaṃ caretviprajopavratārdhaṃ tu sakṛdāgamane caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāvrataṃ samordhvaṃ syāttryabdordhvaṃ patitaiva sāśūdrastrī śūdrasaṃyogāt tadardhaṃ tu samācaretkanyāsaṃgamane kuryāt prāguktaṃ dviguṇaṃ dvijāḥtadardha bhāg dvijaḥ prokto viprādi strīsamāgamepratilomiṣu nirdiṣṭaṃ śūdrokta dviguṇaṃ vratamretassitvā jalevāpi vratamabdaṃ samācaretpatitānyastriyaṃ gatvā caṇḍālasyārdhamācaretgarbhe viniḥsṛte kuryāt dviguṇaṃ prāgudīritamna śayīta samaṃ bhartrā na ca bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥśephaṃ badhvāyasādyaiśca vratametatsamācaretucchiṣṭaṃ tu samānānāṃ bhuktvopoṣya viśuddhyatidvitrirātropavāsaśca savarṇocchiṣṭa bhojanejapopavāsavṛddhiḥ syodekarātrāditaḥ kramātstrīhiṃsauṣadhajīvā ca vārddhuṣyaṃ mūlyakarma casvādhyāyāgni sutānāṃ ca parityāgaśca pātakamniṣpāvāḍhaka śimbānāṃ sarṣapasya yavasya casatvacāṃ vitvacāṃ vāpi haraṇe'rdhaṃ vratasya catrapusīsakatāmrādervastrasya haraṇe kṛtevānaraśvamṛgāṇāṃ ca viṣṭhāśanavarāhayoḥśaśasya śiṃśumārasya śaṅkhasya makarasya vāulūkakaṅka gṛdhrāṇāṃ kākasya jalabarhiṇaḥpiṅgalaratnanetrayośca saraṭāśata patrayoḥpiṅgalyāścakravākasya kauśikasya śukasya canāgaścucundarī matsyaḥ kūrmaḥ karkaṭakāhvayaḥpipīlikā ca bhūnāgo lūtādyā ye ca kīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ kṛtvā vadhaṃ vipro vratapādaṃ samācaretanyenāpi prakāreṇa prāyaścittamihocyatepītvākāmāt surāṃ vāamaṃ śivaharmyejapettadāgurustrīgamane vaktramakāmāttu japedvaneprakāśe kāmatastasmillabha māvartya śuddhyatikāmatassarahasye ca japettatrāyutaṃ dvijāḥgurudrohādṛte śuddhiḥ kāmato'pi bhavedihapunaryāgaḥ prakartavyasśuddhistasyānyathāna himadyapānaṃ yadā śūdre'dīkṣite svalpakaṃ bhavetniyamādghora jāpasya prakartavyaṃ śataṃ trikamgurudrohaḥ śivadrohastasmāttat pātakaṃ bhavetsadyojātajapācchuddhirakāmādiha kathyateghṛtaṃ vāpi gṛhītvā tu lavaṇaṃ śarkarādikamrītiketarakāṃsyādi gṛhītvā taijasaṃ capuṣpaṃ gandhādikaṃ hṛtvā puruṣaṃ striyameva vākṣīraṃ jalaṃ vā śastraṃ vā hutveśaṃ pūrvajjapetakāmāt triśaśaṃ kamājjapenmadyādi varjitāndaśordhvaṃ triśatādarvāka japtvā snānena śuddhyatitadūrdhvamupavāsasyāt trirātramayutordhvataḥācamyādīkṣitenāpi sajātīśaśataṃ japettasminnadīkṣite spṛṣṭe japet snātvā śatadvayamśatatrikaṃ japet sparśāt sopavāsaḥ śucirbhavetsparśanāddīkṣitasyāpi śataṃ pañcāpyupoṣitamtrirātramantyajasparśātsahasrāṇi daśiava tukṛcchro ghora japaḥ kāryo'yutaṃ caṇḍālasaṅgamāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛcchrācchuddhirbhavet bhuktau taptakṛcchraṃ samācaretrajakādi praveśādāvayutārdhamajānataḥhemarupyādipātrāṇāṃ vāriṇā śuddhiriṣyatebhasmanā kāṃsyaśuddhiḥ syāt tāmramāmlena śuddhyatiprokṣya śuddhyatyasandehāducchiṣṭaspṛṣṭabhājanamdāravaṃ lohajotkṛṣṭaṃ vāriṇā tadviśuddhyatiśuddhiścodaka bhāṇḍānāṃ paryagnikaraṇātmikāullekhāt bhūmiśuddhiḥ syāt tathā gomaya gharṣaṇāttadvannirmālyasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ rajasā strī viśuddhyatiśarāvapatra puṭaka prabhṛtīnāṃ ca bhojanesatyan manasaśśuddhirindriyāṇāṃ yamādibhiḥbuddherapi munivyāghrāssaṅgatyāgāt prakīrtitāḥdhyānācchuddhissamuddiṣṭā pradhānasya guṇātmanaḥśvamārjāraravarādīnāṃ vilehe snānamācaretuttamāṅga vidhānena snātvā vidyāṅga pañcakamadīkṣitena saṃspṛṣṭe snānamāgneyamācarettasyaiva devadevasya japassāṅgasya vai śatamvāriṇā tvaśmajātīnāṃ mathitenāśca mastunāsnigdhānāṃ rūkṣaṇācchuddhiḥ pātrāṇāṃ parikīrtitāmadhunaḥ pākataśśuddhistathaivekṣurasasya cakvathitaṃ śuddhyate kṣīraṃ pakvānāṃ prokṣaṇādapiparebhyo duḥkhamāpādya vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥsamayānāṃ pramāde tu śaktijāpaḥ praśasyategurudevāgnikāryeṣu garhitasya nivedanātmlānebhyo vyādhitebhyo vā yatibhyaḥ kiñcidauṣadham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: punaḥ pākena saṃśuddhirlavaṇasya sahāmbhasāyamuddiśya tyajetprāṇān brahmahā satu kītaryateyamuddiśya tyajetprāṇān brahmahā sa ca kīrtyatekṣetradāraharaścaiva ṣaḍete ātatāyinaḥjighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsettu na tena bhrūṇahā bhavetātatāyinamāyāntaṃ hanyādevā vicārataḥtāṃste pretyādhigacchanti ye cātmahananājjānāḥyadā nirvedamāyātaḥ prāptabhogo'thavā punaḥśivāditraya nindāstu śrutvā dehaṃ svakaṃ tyajetśaivaṃ pāśupataṃ kālāmukhaṃ kāpāladhāriṇambrahmaghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca viśuddhāvapi karmataḥtathā cāgamaviplāvī svarṇasteyasamo bhavetnikṣepasya ca sarvaṃ hi svarṇasteyaṃ samaṃ bhavettathaiveha samuddiṣṭamabhiśāpo mahātmaniprāṇināṃ prāṇavṛttyarthaṃ tatradoṣo na vidyateniścitya vartate pūrvamutsavo yairdinaiḥpurātaddinatriguṇe vāpi dviguṇe vātha taddinetatra śāntirvidheyādau prāgvadutsavamācaretdviguṇe taddine vātha mūrtihomaṃ diśāhutimdhvajārohaṇa pūrvettu triguṇāha prakalpiteliṅgaṃ svāyambhuvaṃ cettu vidhānamidamīritammāsabhaṃ tīrthanakṣatramanyathā vā nayetpunaḥrāṣṭrakṣobhe ca durbhikṣe rājacorabhayādiṣuyadi jāyeta tatrāpi śāntiṃ pūrvaṃ vidāya casarva lopāt praśastassyādalpāhai nirmitotsavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣīravatghṛtamardhaṃ vā pādaṃ kṣaudrantathāpalamphalābhāve yathālābhaṃ śeṣamadbhiḥ prapūrayetardhapādantadardhaṃ vā puṣpaṃ hastamitaṃ bhavettathaiva pātramānaṃ tu mūlamānantu gandhavatmṛnmānaṃ pūrvavatproktamanyadapyevamūhyatāmyavo nikhila bījānāṃ dhātūnāṃ haritālakamphalānāṃ kadalījātaṃ patrāṇāṃ bilvapatrakamcandanaṃ sarvagandhānāṃ mṛdasyurdarbhamūlajāḥsitābhāve gulaṃ proktamikṣūgakṣaudrayośca tatdravyāṇyetāni sarvāṇi mūlamantreṇa vinyasetdatvā hṛdayamantreṇa vastrāṇi vividhāni cagandhaṃ svanāmamantreṇa puṣpandhūpantathaiva hikavacenāvakuṇṭhyātha homakarma samārabhetkuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutesamidājyānnalājāṃśca tilaṃ vai homayetkramātśamīravādiramāyūraśrīvṛkṣāḥ pāvakāditaḥpañcapakṣe tu samidhaḥ tyajecchamyādi sambhavāḥśatamardhaṃ tadarghaṃ vā mūlahomaḥ prakīrtitaḥkṛtvā homaṃ praviśyāntardvārapūjāṃ vidhāya casaṃkalpya cāsanaṃ pīṭhe mūrtimāvāhya pūjayetbrahmabhiḥ sakalīkṛtya vidyādehaṃ tato nyasetdīpañca mūlamantreṇa datvātodyasamanvitamvedastotraravopetaṃ ghaṇṭānādasamanvitamuddhṛtya nītvā devāgre tripādopari vinyasetgandhapuṣpaṃ sadhūpañca dīpamarghyaṃ vidhāya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāntiṃ ca śāntihomaṃ ca mūrtihomaṃ tadā nayetvighnādyarutsavo hīnaḥ prārabdhorāṣṭranāśanaḥvṛṣādhivāsane hīne dhvaje vāropite sativṛṣayāgaṃ nayettatra dhvajadaṇḍasya mūlataḥdhvajārope vihīne tu nṛpaterbhaṅgamādiśetdhvajasya bhramaṇehīne grāmādāvaśubhāvahaḥvedī vihīnā vā hīnalakṣaṇā vāśubhapradādaṇḍolakṣaṇahīnaścet pradhānasyāśubhāvahaḥsvalakṣaṇa vihīnaścedupadaṇḍo bhayapradaḥdaṇḍopadaṇḍaskandhāderbheda bhaṅgādi saṃbhavedhvajo lakṣaṇahīnaścedrāṣṭrasyāsya bhayaṃkaraḥśāntikarma nayeddhīmāllakṣaṇadhvajarohaṇamūrdhvavetravihīnaścet dhvajasyeśaṃ śataṃ japetrajjuchede'ribhirbādhā śāntihomaṃ samācaretpatākā patitau bhūmau yadirāṣṭrasya duḥsthitiḥdhvaje bhedādi saṃyukte śāntikarma tadācaretpūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syādalpahāniryādi dvijāḥketāvāruhyamāṇe'sminyaṣṭyādyabhibhevena cadarbhamālā vihīnā cecchāntihomaṃ tadācaretrajjurvā darbhamālā vā pradakṣiṇa vidhānataḥpradakṣiṇakramādagrāddarbhamālādikāṃ nayetdhvajaghaṇṭā vihīnā cenna syādvṛṣabhasannidhiḥghaṇṭāyāḥ patane bhūmau dakṣiṇaṃ triśataṃ japetdhvajārohaṇakāle tu kumbhanyāso na cetkṛtaḥkṛtvānte śāntihomaṃ ca kumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadāvaraṇakumbhāmbho'bhiṣeko na kṛto yadiāropite dhvaje tasmin valayādavalambitetato'dho ravimātrāntaghoraṃ triśataṃ japetāropayet dhvajaṃ paścāt vṛṣabhārcana saṃyutamśāntihomaṃ tadā kṛtvā bherīsaṃtāḍayettataḥdevatāvāhane hīne devādīnāmasannidhiḥīśāmbaskandavighneśabhānucaṇḍeśvarādayaḥpatākāropaṇopete devānāvāhayenna vābherīcarmādi bhedādau koṇacchedādi saṃbhavetathaiva koṇamanyaṃ ca gṛhītvā prāgvadācarettatkāle balikāle vā vādake patite bhuvibherikāpatane bhūmau bhavedrājño bhayaṃ mahatyāgaśālāgnidagdhā vā vihīnā lakṣaṇaistu vākuryādyathāvattatsarvamutsavaṃ tūtsave yadijñātvā cedutsavānte ca yāgaśālāṃ vilakṣaṇāmvidhānametatsāmānyaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca niṣkṛtauutsavāṅge ca vānyasmiñjīrṇoddhāreṣṭakāvidhauyāgopakaraṇe'pyevaṃ kiṃ tu yāgāvasānakepradhānādhamamadhyānāṃ karaṇānāṃ vilopanevihīne sthaṇḍile'ṅge vā śāntihomaṃ tadācaretśivakuṃbheṣuvardhanyāvṛteṣu ghaṭeṣu vābhedo vā suṣuracchedo vailakṣaṇyaṃ krameṇa tuśataṃ triśatamityevaṃ kuryāddoṣāpanuttayevardhanī vātha kumbho vā ghaṭā vidyeśvarādhipāḥkuryuḥ kartusca dāridrayaṃ japtvāghoraṃ sahasrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kumbhādyā vastrahīnāścedvātarogo bhavennṛṇāmpañcaratnādi vaikalye'pyevameva samācarethīne kautukabandhetu tadaṅge vā puroditeśāntihomaṃ tadākuryāt kautukaṃ bandhayettataḥtadvadahnikṛte tasmin kṛtvā sadyo'dhivāsanamānīte maṇṭapādau vā japtvāghoraṃ śatārdhakamtriśataṃ dīpahānau ca dviguṇaṃ dīpamācaretsnapanaṃ śāntihomaṃ ca pratiyānaṃ samācaretgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ neṣṭamiṣṭaṃ dhāmapradakṣiṇamekavāstuni viprendrā vartamāne śivotsavetaddoṣavinivṛtyarthaṃ śāntihomaṃ samācaretaṅgārakabaliścaiva yāmalokto nadoṣadaḥbaliḥ pramādāddattaścecchāntihomaṃ samācaretśūnyagrāmaṃ samāśritya baliyāne prakalpiteālaye baliyāne vā tasyāṃ devālayāvṛtautathaivāsannavāstuśca dūravāstau dvijottamāḥitarasmāt praśastassyādviparīte vipatkaramanukalpo hyaśaktānāmanyatraiva samācarettadvinādhiṣṭhito vāsturhīna ityabhidhīyateekatra baliyāne ca śreṣṭhamityabhidhīyateanukalpapravṛttānāṃ śāntihomo japo'thavādhveja vihīne'pyevaṃ syājjapo'tra śatasaṃkhyayābalidravye vihīne tu kṣudbādhā jāyate nṛṇāmbalidravya samāyuktaṃ dāpayedanyasandhikemūrtihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā yānānte vā baliṃ nayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yassāṃ diśi balirhīno grāmādau saṃhitāhutimvidhāya yānakāle vātadante vā baliṃ nayetśāntihomaṃ tataḥkṛtvā sānnaliṅgaṃ baliṃ nayettalliṅgaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā yajedastraṃ tu tadgatamnayedārabhya talliṅga pātasthānātpradakṣiṇamsamāpya pūrvavadyānaṃ saṃhitāhomamācaretbhedādāvanyadādāya balidravyaṃ tu nikṣipetnirvāṇāni tadā kuryācchānti homaṃ tadā nayettathānyāni samāpādya saṃbhūtānītarāṇi vālohajānyanukarmoktayā nītvānte sthāpanaṃ nayetdhāmādau vā diśāhomaṃ nayedastrārcanānvitamutsavaṃ pūrvavat kuryādanyenāstreṇa vā dvijāḥsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuryādastrarājapratiṣṭhayārājā maraṇamāpnoti sadyaḥ kuryāt pratikriyāmdvikarāt trikarādvāpi tadūrdhvaṃ ca kramānnayetsnapanaṃ ca japet ghoramantreṇa śatasahasrakamaṅgahīne 'nukarmoktyā sandhānādyaṃ ca niṣkṛtimmāsarkṣa tithivārādi prekṣāṃ hitvaiva deśikaḥuttamāṅgādihīne cānukarmoktyā samācaretkārayeddeśiko dhīmān pratyahaṃ śāntihomayukgarbhadvārādimāneṣṭamānayuktena nānyathāpratiṣṭhā ca vidhāyānte cāṅkurārpaṇa pūrvakamliṅge'pyevaṃ samānaṃ darma he śivadīkṣitāḥbere'tinindite doṣo rājño bhavati śāntayekurvāṇaścet kriyāṃbhūmau patito deśikastadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japet pañcaśataṃ mantrī patite'pyevameva hiāyudhāstrānnaliṅgeśavāhane patite bhuvipūjāyāścaiva sandhyādivibhinnāyā vilopaneanirvāṇa pradīpasya naivadyādervilopanevilupte vahnikārye vā homadravyavilopanerathāroho vihīnaścennīcāssyurmanujā bhuviyānakāle rathādīnāṃ bhaṅge bhaṅgo bhuvo bhavettaddeśa dhāmni vā kuryādyānādau doṣaśāntayeānīya śivikādyaṃ vā tatrāropya maheśvaramvinoda darśana kāle jātaścet kalaho mahānvinodadarśane hīne saṃhitāhomamācaretyānāntasnasnapane hīne śāntihomavilopitesnapanaṃ śāntihomaṃ ca nayet sannidhi siddhayepracurasnapanaṃ kuryācchāntihomaṃ mahattaramśāntihomaṃ tadā kṛtvā tailābhyaṅgaṃ samācaretbhavanti pāpinassarve tadarthaṃ śāntimācaretyātrādānasya vicchede sā yātrā niṣphalā bhavetmṛgayāyāstu vaikalye nṛpasyāpajayo bhavethīne kautukatīrthe syānnaiva gaṅgādisannidhiḥniṣkṛtissyāt kramācchāntihomo vā saṃhitāhutiḥanyatrakautuka snānaṃ kalpayedvarjayettuvāśāntihomo bhavedaṅginyaṅge syātsaṃhitāhutiḥcūrṇotsavabhrame hīne saṃhitāhomamācaretśāntiṃ kṛtvā tadarthaṃ tu tīrthakāryaṃ tato nayetkṛte taddoṣa śāntyarthaṃ śāntihomaṃ tadācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsāde manuje jāte mṛte rājo bhayaṃ mahatprokṣayet gomayāmbhobhiryena deśena te gatāḥmṛtaprasūtadeśaṃ tu khānayogyaṃ khanettadāprakṣālyāsannakuḍyādyaṃ gomayālepanaṃ sthaleśaiva saṃbhojanaṃ cānte jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ nayetśāntihomojjhitaṃ kuryādardhamaṇḍapake satiantassālāntare ceddhi jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ nayetgavyena prokṣayettatsthapīṭhānyapi viśuddhayeantassālasya bāhye cet snapanena diśāhutiḥpūrvacchuddhimāpādya paryagnikaraṇaṃ nayetprākāradvaya bāhye cecchāntihomaṃ samācaretparityajyaiva tat kuryānnityanaimittikādikamsūtāvāpi mṛtā dhāmni pakṣiṇaḥ paśavoḥ mṛgāḥgomayālepanaṃ tatra prokṣayet pañyagavyataḥkevalasnapanaṃ cārdhamaṇḍape parikalpayetsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiśśāntihomaṃ ca kārayetuṣṇīṣamuttarīyaṃ vā vasanaṃ yajñasūtrakamjvarabādhā bhavedgrāme taddoṣaśamanāya caevameva bhavet kartṛhotrādīnāṃ munīśvarāḥdaṣṭe vā mūṣikādyaistu kramāt phalamihocyateputrotpattiryaśaścaiva daśapāśāntamadhyamevastraṃ vā triguṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmendrayamavahniṣuevameva narāṇāṃ ca tadā snānaṃ vidhāya canarāṇāṃ śivabhaktānāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ śivāya vākārayet saṃhitāhomaghoraṃ vā japettathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃprokṣyāstrāmbunā ghoraṃ daśavāraṃ japenmanumsaṃhitāhomapūrvaṃ tu śvādīnāṃ ca praveśanegavyasaṃprokṣaṇopetaṃ pratilomāntyajairyadigomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ nayetśvādīnāṃ sparśanepyevaṃ niṣkṛtiḥ parikīrtitāsnapanaṃ kārayecchambhordiśāhomaṃ ca kārayetyāgaśālāgnidagdhaścedbhayaṃ syādrājaveśmanimūrtihomaṃ vidhāyānte pūrvavadyāgamaṇḍapamkumbhasaṃsthāpanopete vidagdhe yāgamaṇḍapevidagdhe śāntihomaṃ tu kṛtvā pūrvavadācaretvidagdhe garbhagehe'rdhamaṇḍape pratimādikesnapanena diśāhomo mūrtihomastathāvidhaḥduṣṭe tu liṅgaberādau taduktāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ nayetutsave'pyanutsavepyetat sāmānyaṃ karma saṃmatammahādāhodbhāve grāme śāntihomaṃ samācaretsoṣṇīṣaṃ deśikadravyaṃ haimapañcāṅgabhūṣaṇamaghoraśatamāvartya dadyāttānyādarādguroḥekācāryeṇa kartavyamekadevālayāsthitamsakalārādhanaṃ yacca parivārārcanādikamutsavādyaṅgakḷptirvā devatāvāhanādikamaneka naranirvatya kathamekaḥ karotyahonitye naimittike kāmye yatkarmaikālaye sthitamdeśikasyāsya putrovā pautro vā tasya bāndhavāḥādiśaiva kulejātā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā viśaḥrudrakanyāśca paddāsyastadājñāpālakā yadi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā rājñā niyuktaistu sāmanta pramukhairapianyathā sati kartavye śānti tatra samācaretkriyā yā vartate pūrvaṃ śāstrasiddhā punaḥ punaḥanyathā sati kartavye rājño dhvaṃsa udāhṛtaḥśāstrasiddhaiva pūrvāpi tato tato vṛddhissukhapradātasmātsarvaprayatnena pūrvamapyadhikaṃ caretrajanyāṃ darśanaṃ bhānoḥ pararāja bhayaṃ bhavetdarśe cābhyudite candre paro rājā bhaviṣyatisaṃbhave bhūmi kaṃpetu nṛpa bhaṅgo bhaved dhruvamtadardhe vā tadardhe vā śataprasthaiḥ tadardhataḥsaptāhaṃ vā dhṛtakṣaudraiḥ śreṣṭha mārgeṇa kārayetnadī taṭāka kūpādi kṣobhe durbhikṣatā bhavetsāṃbaṃ kuṃbhe ca vardhanyāṃ paritoṣṭha ghaṭeṣu capūjayet gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ diśāhomaṃ samācaretpratimārodanesvede nṛpasya mṛtimācaretkṛtvātu pratimā śuddhiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ śāntiṃ samācarettadante cotsavaṃ kuryāt yathā vittaṃ munīśvarāḥprāsāda maṇḍapādīni rudhirāktāni śodhayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu madhvādyaiḥ snapanaṃ nayetsaptāhamevaṃ kuryādvā dvitri saptāha meva vāmṛttailāśmāsṛgādyairvā varṣaścettadvadevahiviśeṣācchivamabhyarcya bhūri naivedya saṃyutamloke mṛdādi vṛṣṭiścet kṣīra snapana samyutamsaṃpūjya gandha pramukhaiḥ vastrayugmena veṣṭayetpara cakrādbhayaṃ jñeyaṃ tadbhītervinivṛttaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāstuṃ saṃpūjayetpaścāt tadante snāpayecchivamakasmātpatitaṃ dhāma mūlādāmastakaṃ yadisnapanaṃ ca śive nṛtyaṃ kuryādvittānu sārataḥprāsāda manukarmoktyā ādyeṣṭakādi yutaṃ nayetkuryāddhāmno'tha sandhānaṃ saptapṛṣṭa pañca vedabhamsthūyādyavayave chīnne'pyeta dekāhamācaretakasmāddhāmabhedādau phalamindrādi digvaśātdhāmāntarastha devānāṃ bhagnādau samupasthitemaṇḍapādi nipāte ca śāntimekāhamācaretnṛpaterādiśedbhaṅgaṃ tena vaideśikottamaḥśaiva saṃbhojanopetāṃ viprabhukti samanvitambāṇaliṃgādikaṃ vātha prāsādena samanvitamanukarmavidhānena pūrvasthāne samaṃ nayetsthānānantara gataṃ liṃgaṃ udak pūrvatra vinyasetvṛkṣe sthānāntaraṃ prāpte sasyanāśo bhaviṣyatisamācared dvisaptāhaṃ śaiva bhojanaṃ saṃyutamsnapanaṃ kārayennityaṃ prabhūta haviṣānvitamtadanya kusume jāte tadanya phala saṃbhavesaptāhaṃ vā navāhaṃ vā pañcāhaṃ śāntimācaretśivaliṅge ca bere vā pīṭhe voṣṇādi saṃbhavegandhodai rnālikerādyaiḥ vinyastaiḥ snapanoktitaḥathavākṣīra madhvājyaiḥ prasthaissaṃsnāpayecchivamcandanāgaru karpūrośīra kuṃkuma saṃyutamdiśāhoaṃ tataḥ kuryāt yāvadauṣṇaṃ nivartatenarā mṛgāśva paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vā sarīsṛpāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bahuśīrṣaka hastāṃghri nāsādehādi saṃyutaḥspaṣṭa varṇāyutā aśvādayo jātāyati dvijāḥśivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat diśāhomaṃ samācaretśivānsaṃbhojaye devaṃ nayedvā saptapañcamamnityaṃ vāstubaliṃ śānti homaṃ kṣetreśvarejyayāśivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat diśā homantu kārayetliṅge bere ca pīṭhe vā svedo rāṣṭra bhayaṃ bhavetliṃge bere vimāne vā maṇḍape gopurādiṣuparivārālaye sāle deveśāsthānamaṇḍapenava prākāra mārgeṇa kramācchāntiṃ samācaretdiśāhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mahā snapana saṃyutampañcagavya samopetaṃ madhukṣīraṃ ghṛtairapisnāpayitvārcaye dviprān bhojayecśānti homayukprāsāde sarvadhābhinne prāgvadevamunīśvarāḥprāyaścittaṃ tathaivāsyāṃ maṇḍapādau śivāgrajāḥprādāde niṣkṛtiḥ proktā yāsānṛpati ketanesaptāhaṃ śāntiḥ kartavyā mahā śānti nipātitetatraiva tat samīpe vā tajjātīyantarunyasetkariṇī madayuktācet vāhanānāṃ kṣayo bhavetmahā vāta prakopetu rāṣṭra kṣobho bhaviṣyatidhūme samudbhave cāgnau karoti svāmino bhayamśuddha mṛdbhiśca pūryātha pañcamṛdbhiścalepayetśāntistatra vidhātavyā nava bheda vibhedinīkṣīra prastha sahasrairvātadardhe snāpayecchivamliṅga bere ca pīṭhādau varṇāntara gate sati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sakūrcapuṣpatoyāḍhyaṃ śivamantraṃ samuccarandeveśīmapi tadvāme devasya viniveśayetpiṇḍikā rūpiṇīṃ devīṃ snāpayettaṃ manusmaranīśānādyaiśca sadyāntaiḥ pañcabhirviniveśayetpañcagavyābhiṣekādau mahāghaṇṭāravānvitamavaśyamāvṛtāntesyādupasthānaṃ sadhūpakamvidyante cet tadātaiśca snāpayet parameśvaramarcanoktaṃ samabhyarcya homopetaṃ samāpayetāsanaṃ saṃprakalpyāsmin kumbhe mūrtimanuṃ smaretbrahmabhissakalīkṛtya tatkalāstatra vinyasetsnapanādyañca pādyādi kṛtvā datvā hṛdā guruḥpradarśya liṃgamudrāntu kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetvarmaṇā cāvakuṇṭhyātha rudrānāvaraṇasthitāngatvā sakalasāmīpyamāsanaṃ mūrtimeva casnapanādyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā datvā pādyādikatrayamprāgvat ghaṭañca karakaṃ nītvā hṛdi manuṃ nyasetsnāpayitvā krameṇaiva pādyādidvitribhāgikampṛthagvā sthāpayitvā tu deveśīmabhiṣecayetcitrādyairdarpaṇādyaiśca snāpayet snapanoktavatdravyeṣu bhedā nāstyatra devatābheda iṣyatedhārikādyā mahādikṣustrīpāṭhavaśamāgatāḥpṛthivyādyāḥ pradhānāntāstatra devāstu vāmataḥatraiva snapanaṃ vakṣye kṣīrādyairdvijasattamāḥsalilaissatphalopetaissadghaṭādiṣu saṃsthitaiḥsalilaissatphalopetaissadghaṭādiṣu saṃsthitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: piṣṭamṛt bilva darbheśca rajanyā malavāribhiḥcandano śīra karpūra kuṃkumā garu saṃyutamsaṃpūjya gandha puṣpādyaḥ prārthayed duritakṣayambheryādīnāṃ svayaṃ ghoṣe mahā mārī pravartateabhyarcya deva deveśaṃ śāntimiṣṭāṃ samācaretjāyate bhūpati stvanyo yatra rāṣṭre bhavedidamrātrāviṃdra dhanurdṛṣṭe para cakrādbhayaṃ bhavetanāvṛṣṭi rdhruvaṃ loke gṛhanakṣatrapātanevāhanānāṃ kṣayaṃ vidhāt tadarthaṃ śāntimācaret !agninakṣatra pāte ca japet ghoraṃ śatatrayamrājño doṣaḥ prajāyeta tadarthaṃ tu diśāhutimsaptāhaṃ vātha pañcāhaṃ tat pāta dina saṃkhyakam !kṣīrādyaiḥ snapanaṃ kuryāt saptāhāśani saṃbhavetanmaṇḍalādhipo rājā śatrubhiścābhibhūyatevahni dāhediśāṃ jāte durbhikṣaṃ bhuvijāyatetadante śānti homaṃ ca pañcāhaṃ hyaiva mācaretsarveṣāmapi varṇānāṃ msūrī roga mādiśetpañcāhaṃ tridinaṃ vāpi prabhūtaṃ tu havirnivetsamūle nṛpatervyādhi mādiśenmṛti sūcanamtaddeśe śānti ca yaddeśe patitistaruḥtacchāravāḥ patitāśceddhi rāṣṭrakṣobho mahānbhavettadeka śākhā patane kalaho bhuvi jāyatedvi saptāhaṃ navāhaṃ vā sapta pañcāgnibhiṃ tathāevamevānyavṛkṣāṇāṃ pradhānānāṃ samācaretmūrti homaṃ trisaptāhaṃ kārayecchaiva bhuktiyuk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
