sanskrit: unmattāśce ttu saptāhaṃ diśāhomaṃ tryahaṃ tu vāativṛṣṭi samutpattau bhuvau durbhikṣatāṃ vadettadardhai rvā tadardhardhai rvā śataprasthai stadardhataḥāloḍhya rajanīṃ paścāt karpūreṇa vimiśritāmberaṃ vā'garu karpura varti dīpāna nekaśaḥevaṃ kuryāttu saptāhaṃ pañcāhaṃ tridinaṃ tu vāguruḥ purohito vātha mṛtaśce nnṛpate rbhayampañcāhaṃ tridinaṃ vātha gajāśva maraṇe nayettoyena secayedrājño mastake taṃ manuṃ smaranpratyahaṃ homarakṣāṃ ca deva deva prasādajamsaptāhāmyantare tāṃ ca varayet matimāmnṛpaḥvājinaṃ vā tadapyevaṃ rājarājāṅga māharetparivārālayordhve vā nṛpasya bhavanoparimārjāra pramukhānāṃ rodanaṃ yadi jāyatetaṃ hatvātha tatastyaktvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥśānti homo'thavā ghora japo mārjārarodaneaśvālaye'gnau saṃjāte saptāhaṃ śāntimācaretrājñī vā tanmahiṣyādau cānyasmin puruṣetha vātaṃ hatvā tāṃśca saṃsnāpya śānti homaṃ samācaretnṛpateśca manuṣyāṇāndehe ghoraṃ japettu vāparivāre'tha jāyerañjantavo vātha makṣikāḥtatsthānaṃ śodhayitvāṣṭa bandhādyairbandhayettathākavāṭodghāṭanevātha pidhāne svayameva cacaranti ketave vyomni nānārūpāssamantataḥdṛśyante śveta raktādi varṇā nakṣatra sannibhāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāntiṃ kuryāttadā śreṣṭha madhyamādhamamārgataḥprāsāde patite bhinne vaktre jīrṇe ca dig bhrametattad dravyairathotkṛṣṭaiḥ mānayuktaṃ tathā nayetmānayuktamadhiṣṭhānādyaṅgaṃyadviparītajamsvāyambhuvādi liṅgeṣu kalpitaṃ pūrvavannayetathavāśmamayaṃ bāhye'bāhye syādiṣṭakāmayamasthānasthā vidhātavyāḥ svasthānasthā viśeṣataḥdrāviḍe ca tathā kāryaṃ varāṭādau tathā matambhavanaṃ jīrṇa manyasmin kurvandikṣucakārayetdvāraṃ pūrvavadiṣṭaṃ syātpaścimadvārameva vānāsikādyaṅgahīnetu punastadvatsamācaretsusthitaṃdusthitaṃ vāpi śivaliṅgaṃ na cālayetjīrṇādidoṣarahitaṃ pūjāhīnantu dusthitamjīrṇādyaṃ pūjitaṃ hanti nihanti tadapūjitamjīrṇaṃ dagdhaṃ kṛśaṃ sthūlaṃ hīnaṃ mānādhikaṃ tathālakṣmojjhitaṃvajrahataṃ saṃpuṭaṃ sphuṭitaṃ tathātyājyāni sarvathaitāni liṅgāni ṣoḍaśaiva tatatyuccanimnādiṅmūḍhamadhyasthaṃ viṣamasthitamajñenasthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ tathāmantrakriyetaramtathaiva sthāpanīyāni yadyetānyavraṇāni hijīrṇaṃ vāpyathavā bhagnaṃ vidhināpi na cālayethriyamāṇaṃ jalena hṛtaṃ tena ca yadbhavetsthāpanaṃ teṣu vānyatra kartavyaṃ pūrvavanmukhamsahasrakārmukāntaṃ vā sthāpayelliṅgaṃ mādarātbere śilāmayemārdepakve vārkṣe'tha ratnaje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅgahīne tu tattyājya mityatraja vicāraṇākarṇadantādibhirhīne tattaddravyardṛḍhaṃ nayetpadbāhuhīnetyājyaṃ vā sandhānaṃ vāsamācaretaṅgaṃ pradhānaśūlaṃ syāt brahmadaṇḍastu kathyateūrusthejānujaṅghe ca upāṅgānyuditāṇi cabrahmadaṇḍavihīne tu śūlasthāpanamārabhetpūrvasaṃsthāpito brahmadaṇḍaścellakṣaṇānvitaḥbhaṅgādīnāṃ samutpattau punassaṃsthāpanaṃ nayetratnajaṃ ca parityājyaṃ grāhyaṃ vā ghaṭanāya calohaṃ dravīkṛtaṃ tatra yojayedberakarmaṇiapratiṣṭhita devaścet tatpīṭhādauniyojayotsalakṣaṇātu pīṭhī cet tadvat brahmaśilāvṛṣaḥśailapīṭhasya coddhāraṃ kṛtvāśailaṃ tu yojayetpaścāt śailaṃ samāyojyamākṛti pūrvavadbhavetmaṇḍape parivāre ca parivārālaye'pyathāantarmaṇḍalasālādyaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayetsapramāṇe yathā śāstraṃ vihitālaṃkṛtānvitepraśastā prāgudag vṛddhiḥ pratīcchyāṃripubhiḥ kṣayaḥtadvāstu paritovṛddhiḥ samāvāviṣamāpi vāgrāmādīnāṃ gṛhādīnāṃ śālānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥsamaṃ vā yojayettasmādadhikaṃ vāpi yojayetgṛhamālikayorbhūmiṃ saṃkhyayāparikalpayetuktānāmapi sarveṣā viśeṣaḥ kaścidiṣyatejīrṇepidhāne dhāmādyamāsanasthādibhiḥ samamliṅgādau ca ghaṭe pūrṇe pīṭhe vā pratyahaṃ yajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadrūpaṃ yat pramāṇañca yanmayaṃ yadanuddhratamtadagre maṇḍapaṃ kuryāddakṣe vai'sānakoṇakesarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktantarbhāmālādi saṃyutammantrasantarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā vahnau kuṇḍādi kalpitevāstvantadik baliṃ samācamya guruttamaḥtato vijñāpayeddevaṃ prabhodoṣāvahaṃ tvidamasyoddhārāyamānta smādadhitiṣṭhassadāśivaḥkṣīrājyamadhudurvābhi śśivenāṣṭasahasrakamvyāpakeśvaraśabdantu caturthyantaṃ prayojayetvyāpakeśvara śabdantuhṛdayādipadaṃ tataḥna bījaṃ yojayettaistu liṅgañja praṇavāsanetatastadāśritaṃ satvaṃ śrāvaye dastra muccaranliṅgantyaktvā śivājñābhiryatheṣṭaṃ tatra gacchatuevamuktvā mahāstreṇa datvārghyantu parāṅmukhamagrasthaṇḍilasaṃyuktesvarṇa vastra samanvitetathā vidhāyāṃ varddhanyāmambikāṃ sthāpayet guruḥpratyahaṃ cārcanaṃ kāryaṃ śāntihomasamanvitamhutvāśāntyaṃ bhasāprokṣyakuśaiḥspṛṣṭvājapet guruḥtadante mūrtimūrtīśān liṅgapiṇḍyādi saṃsthitānśivamastu gṛṇan lokaiḥ prikṣipettujaleguruḥprāsādavāstuśuddhyarthaṃ hotavyantu śataṃ śatamtanmānamaparañcātra sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥgāṇave lohaje caiva nadīprastravaṇādiṣumānuṣāṇāñca liṅgānāṃ ghaṭakāryantaducyatetadūrdhvaṃ kumbhasaṃsthaśceddeveśassarvadoṣakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃsthāpyabālaliṅgādyaṃ tanmadhyevinyasenmanumtasmādādāyadeveśaṃ mūlaliṅgeniveśayetṣaṭtriṃśadabdāparyante mūlaliṅgeniveśayetdviguṇaṃ triguṇantasya caturviśativatsareṣaṭtriṃśadvatsarorddhantu mūlasthānantadevahisakalepyevamevaṃ syādviśeṣaḥ kaścidiṣyatenocettatraiva saṃsthāpyamūla beraṃ viśeṣataḥkintu khaḍge'male mantrān vinyasyāparamārabhetśivaliṅgādiyadvastu yadajñena pratiṣṭhitambhūyopi tasya saṃskāraṃ kuryāt pūrvoktavat guruḥtairapisthāpi taṃ liṅgaṃ punassaṃskṛtya pūjayetlākulāstvaparejñeyāḥ pratyekaṃ trividhāsmṛtāḥśaivāścaturvidhāstvanye mantratantravyavasthitāḥpratyekaṃ tritribhedena pūrvavat saṃvyavasthitāḥyāmalatva paraṃjñeyaṃ taccamiśramihocyatevāmaṃ pāra śivārhaṃ syāt dakṣiṇaṃ bhairavārhakamvyatiriktantu siddhāntādraudraṃ sarvamudīritamlaukikaṃ vaudikañcānya dadhyātmamatimārgakamgāruḍhaṃ bhairavaṃ vāmaṃ bhūtatantrañcayāmalambṛhaspatimataṃ sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃvaikhānasantathāvāstuśāstrantathāsautraṃ ṣaḍaṅgamitihāsakamsarvaṃ raudraṃ samādiṣṭaṃ siddhāntaṃ saumyamiṣyatetatsarvaṃ śaivamāpādya śaivassarvaṃ samarcayettadrūpaṃ pūjitantaiśce drāṣṭaṃ rājāna meva cataistu saṃsthāpitaṃ pūrvamādi śaivena pūjitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amātyaṃ mantriṇaṃ viprān kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyameva catasmādrājā prayatnena vārayedacireṇa tānrājño vijayadañcāyurvṛddhidaṃ paladaṃ sadāābhicārakaliṅgādyaṃ rodraiśca sthāpitañcayattat sthānaṃ saṃpraviśyātha mṛdbhāṇḍāṃśca vivarjayetkuḍyādyaṃ sudhāyālipya sthalaṃ gomayavāriṇāparyagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ puṇyāha mācaretkarṣaṇādi pratiṣṭhānta kriyāyāṃ ye niveśitāḥmahājālaprayogeṇa sarvamantrāśca saṃharettalliṅgādyaṃ ca saṃśodhya kuśabhasmamṛdāmbhasākaṣāyodakasaṃyuktaṃ gomūtreṇodakāntaram !liṅgasthaśambare jñāte pūrvavanmantrasaṃhṛtiḥjantukalpadravārthaṃ tu mantramastraṃ niyojayetsmaran samuddhareddipaṃ talliṅgāṇubhiranvitampunassaṃśoddhyataṃ liṅgaṃ pūrvadravyai śśareṇa casvasvamantrasamopetaṃ svasva homa samanvitamlakṣaṇoddhāraṇanneṣṭaṃ jalecaivādhivāsanamgarbhagehetha tatsarvaṃ maṇḍape vā samācaretsvayaṃ bhūrdaivike bāṇe cārṣe gāṇādhipe tathādiśāhomantataḥ kuryādṛgādyaddhyanantathāśāntihomantataḥ kṛtvā snapanaṃ kārayettataḥprabhūtahaviṣaṃ datvā tāmbūlandāpayettataḥmutgānnaṃ pāyasaṃ gaulaṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutamācāryaṃ pūjayennityaṃ svarṇavastrādibhistataḥsarveraṃgairviśīrṇañjet punassaṃsthāpayennavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyukta malpadoṣantuvā bhavetutsedheravimātrāntaṃkṣantavyañcāṅgulādikamgrāmakheṭapurādautudaṃḍāntaṃ parikīrtitamcaturyavānta marcāsu mātrāntaṃ pīṭhakalpanetadapyakāryaṃ liṅgāgrekṣantavyaṃ mānamīritamkāmyasiddhiśca mantraissyānmantrāśca bahavo matāḥteṣvaghorāṇuratyantadoṣaghnaḥ kiṣṇavarṇabhāksurapiṅgekṣaṇo'tyanta śvetadaṃṣṭrā samanvitaḥmahākāyo mahādaṃṣṭrī kiṅkiṇīkhasaṃyutaḥkhaḍgakheṭadhanurbāṇamuṇḍakaḥ kālaśaktidhṛtdaṃṣṭre dve kīlaniryāte vaktrāgre bhīṣaṇe sitevairiprayuktakarmaghnassarvavyādhinivārakaḥasitāṅgādibhinnityamāvṛto vā nirāvṛtaḥkapālī bhiṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭamassmṛtaḥtriśūlamuṇḍasaṃyuktā hṛdayāñjali saṃyutāḥoṃ juṃsaḥ iti mantro'yaṃ devo mṛtyuñjidāhvayaḥrasādiśuklaparyantadhātu saptākṣarānvitamante ca rakṣa rakṣeti vīpsitaṃ ca padaṃ paṭhetprāṇaṃ ca devadattasya mūlamantraṃ niyojayetmadhye niveśayetkūṭaṃ prāsādaṃ vā navātmakamanena sadṛśo nāsti mantro mṛtyuñjayo dvijāḥcaturbhujastriṇetraśca jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍitaḥtriśūlaṃ cābhyaṃ cordhve sudhākalaśamadhyayoḥkapālaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ vāme yogamudrāṃ karadvayena bhaviṣyati bhūtaśca satyametadudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tenāmṛtaṃ bhavatyāśu svāditaṃ mṛtyujidbhavetśatajaptaṃ pibettoyamamṛtī bhavati dhruvambrahmavṛkṣendhanairdīpte vahnau juhvanna mṛtyubhāknācireṇaiva kālena mṛtyustasya bhaviṣyatipratimāsa prayogeṇa cābdenaikena suvratāḥgacchatyatra na sandehassatyaṃ viprā mayoditamnadījanapadodyāna purādīni na saṃśasyaḥaghorāstramato vakṣye bījamālātmakaṃ dvijāḥbhujāṣṭakasamopetamūrdhvakeśaṃ sudaṃṣṭriṇamkiṅkiṇīmālayā bhrājat pādanūpura saṃyutamśuklayajñopavītaṃ ca raktapuṣpopaśobhitammekhalodarakaṇṭheṣu karṇahṛtkarabāhuṣupaṅkajāsana madhyasthaṃ triṇetraṃ raudrarūpiṇamdadhānaṃ dakṣagairhastairvāmagaiśśūlamadhyamamagrasthavāmapādaṃ ca dhyātvāghorāstramarcayetdhyāyetsūrya sahasrābhamaghorāstramariṃdamamtryakṣaṃ taṭillatājihvaṃ dīptabhrūśmaśrumūrdhajamcaturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ sphuraccandrārghaśekharamdevadānava daityānāṃ darpitānāṃ vimardakamghoraghorataretyetat tacchirassaṃprakīrtitamcaṭapracaṭaśabdaṃ tu vīpsitaṃ kavacaṃ bhavetghātayeti dviruccāryaṃ pañcamāṅgaṃ prakīrtitamnamaskārādi saṃyuktamādau praṇavasaṃyutamśāntike pauṣṭike vaśye prāyaścitte vicinyayetmantreṇānena naśyanti jvaragrahaviṣādayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrāṇi yogayuktāni pāvake śalabhā yathāanenaiva prakāreṇa dhyātvā saṃpūjayed guruḥdakṣiṇe'ghoradevasya madhye devaṃ sadāśivamcaturdikṣu yajedastracatuṣkaṃ śivapūrvakamevamabhyantareṣviṣṭvā tajjātīn parito yajetsaṃgrāmavijayaṃ vātha kṣurikāsthānapamadhyametena nāsādhyamastīha loke tribhuvane dvijāḥpālanīyoviśeṣeṇa sādhakādhipatissadāvāksiddhistena mantreṇa jayotpāde ca śasyateoṃ namo bhagavacchabdaṃ saṃbuddhyantaṃ niyojayetmedhāṃ prayaccha svāheti mūlamantra udāhṛtaḥnamasvāhāvaṣaṭhuṃ ca phaḍityante niyojayetgaṅgācandrasamopetaṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtamūrdhajamśuddhasphaṭikamālāṃ ca jñānamudrāṃ ca dakṣiṇepustakena yutaṃvātha dadhānaṃ nayanatrayamdhyātvaivaṃ deva deveśaṃ sarvakāryāṇi sādhayetcaturdaśasvaropetaṃ bindunādavibhūṣitamūrdhvarephasamāyuktaṃ bhairavaṃ bījamuttamamasyamantra prabhāveṇa trailokyavijayī bhavetrahito mantrarājena naiva sidhyati sādhakaḥkhaṭvāṅga hastamvistārādi catuśśatkīścaturvaktreṣu pūjayetnetraṃ dakṣiṇādigbhāge garbhāvaraṇa īritaḥtadbahirlokapālāsyuḥ krameṇābhyarcayedguruḥvakṣye pratyaṅgiroddhāraṃ samāsād dvijasattamāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṃgādiprabhavaistoyaiḥ pūrvoktena ca vartmanāsarvābhīṣṭa prasiddhyarthaṃ rājñāṃ vijayahetavesarvasampatprasiddhyarthaṃ balārthaṃ kāntihetaverāṣṭrakṣobhe'dbhutaprāptau durnimitte viśeṣataḥteṣāṃ rogavināśārthaṃ rogānutpattihetavebhayārthaṃ parasenāyāḥ kṣayārthaṃ tatbhramārthakamjanmarkṣe dine rājñāmabhiṣeke tathāpi vāayane viṣupe vāpi grahaṇasthāpanādikekṛttikā dīpanakṣatre cānyasmin māsaṛkṣakemārgaśīrṣe ca māsethatvārdrāyāntu viśeṣataḥjanakalyāṇakāle ca narāṇāṃ rakṣaṇārthakedevabhramaṇakāle vā mṛgayāyāṃ viśeṣataḥsandhyādvaye vā caikasyāṃ snapanaṃ kārayecchivekumbhenaikena vā vyomasaṃkhyena kalaśena vāpañcabrahmādhipaiḥ pañcaghaṭairvākalaśaistu vāiṣṭadravyaṃ bhavenmadhye tadvānyatkarakasthitampādyamācamanañcārghyaṃ pañcagavyantu vā bhavetekadravyantu vā hīne dikṣu pādyādikantu vāprāguktatritayañcaitat viśeṣānnityakarmaṇiuttamottamapūjāyāmaṣṭottaraśatāvadhinaimittikaṃ tadūrdhvasthaṃ pūrvoktamapi saṃsthitamantarāvaraṇe kaścit viśeṣastvabhidhīyatesnāpayeddevadeveśamudagaiḥ prāgvadeva hikarma tadvadvidheyaṃ syāt śreṣṭhahīnāṃ kriyāṃ tyajetnityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ snapanaṃ trividhaṃ matam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jvārāpasmāramārīṇāṃ nāśanaṃ kṣayanāśanamcaturaṅga balopeta śatrukṣayakaraṃ paramoṃ hrīṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya tadante kṛṣṇavāsasemahābhairavivarṇeca sarvaśatrupadaṃ tathāchedinītyuddharetpaścātsarvabhūtadamanyapisarva vighnāniti padaṃ chindhichindhītiyatpadamsarvavyādhiṃ nikṛnteti nikṛnteti padaṃ ca yatjvālājihve karāleti padaṃ daṃṣṭre padaṃ punaḥtesvāhetyuddharedeṣa mantraḥ pratyaṃgirātmakaḥādyasaptākṣaraṃ hṛt syāt śiraḥ pañcadaśākṣaramtathaivatasmānnetrāṇuścatustriśatbhirastrakamnamasvāhāvaṣaḍvauṣaṭ huṃpaṭyuktā hṛdādayaḥkṛṣṇāñjana nibhāṃvṛtta raktanetratrayānvitāmvahantīṃ vāmahastābhyāṃ muṇḍaṃ śeṣetu pallavamkṛṣṇāṃbara dharāṃ sāsṛk māṃsāsyāṃ nartaneratāmkṛṣṇājinaghaṭānnāmnā bhairavīmarcitāṃ suraiḥdhvaṃsayet sarvarogāṃśca paramantrānnivārayetathavā nābhikaṃjalkaṃ juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥpriyaṃgu kadalīpuṣpāṇyādṛtojuhuyāt budhaḥkhādirādi samiccaivakṣipramātuṣṭikārikāpāyasaṃ payasāyuktaṃ tatkṣaṇāt kṣaṇikaṃ vrajetkṛṣṇanīlaṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva staṃbhayedabhicārataḥkapilāghṛtasamyuktaṃ kapilākṣīra samyutammahiṣotbhūtamarkañca gardabhaṃ kṣīrameva cajuhuyāt śata sāhasraṃ tatkulotsādhanaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: veṇunābhedanaṃ sadyo bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥarkakṣīra samāyuktaṃ homayedapipāratamghṛtāktena tilenaiva dūrvayā ghṛtasiktayāaudarāṇāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ śuddhīpatthyāmarīcibhiḥakṣirogādi rogāṇāṃ kṣīreṇa ca ghṛtena caviṣamajvara nāśāya cūtapatrāṇi homayetsarvopadrava nāśaya rudra śāntyā khilādibhiḥpittāśāntyai ca juhuyāt candanādyaissuśītalaiḥsahasramayutaṃ vātha lakṣantatriguṇaṃntu vā !!āvartaṃcetyanāvartaṃ punarāvartanantathāmūlabālāgrahāmmūla sthāneyatsthāpanaṃ matampatitaiḥ pātakaispṛṣṭe caṇḍālairanyajaistathāliṅge pīṭhe ca calite anāvartamiti smṛtamtasmātsaṃsthāpanaṃ mūle punarāvartanaṃ smṛtamsphoṭane varṇahīne ca aṅgopāṅgavihīnakeambujāsanahīne ca sthalakarmavihīnakeyātrāhomayugāvartamanye syustadvihīnakāḥliṅgasaṃsthāpanasyokta mārgeṇaiva samācaretkālāpekṣāṃ vinā kuryāccheṣāṇyanyāni suvratāḥlakṣaṇoddhāraṇaṃ toyādhivāsaḥ śayanaṃ tathāsarvamāvarta vatkuryāt kiṃ tu mūladvayānvitamratnanyāsākṣimokṣauca jale caivādhivāsanamnavavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya berasya sakalāṅgakamsnapanaṃ kārayedante cānyatsarvaṃ samānakamevaṃ yaḥ kārayenmartya puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṅgāyāma viśālaṃ tu pīṭhaṃ sarvārtha sādhakampūjāṃśasyodayā prānta pīṭha nirgamanānvitamliṅgāyāmasamaṃ vāpi liṅgāyāmārdhameva vāliṅgāsyatāratriguṇaṃ bhavetpañcaguṇaṃ tu vāliṅgamānavaśātpīṭha vistāraṃ parikīrtitamṣoḍaśāṅgula samyukta viṃśakāṅkulakāvadhiliṅgānāmādhikaḥ vīṭhavistāroneṣyate dvijāḥṣaḍaṃśāt ṣoḍaśāṃśāntaṃ kṛtvā mūlaviśālakamviṣṇvaṃśotsedhatuṅgasya pīṭhasya brahma bhāgakaetayormadhye'ṣṭadhā bhakte navamānamudīritammānuṣe pīṭhamānaṃ syātsvayaṃbhūtādike'pi caliṅgamānasamaṃ vārdha dviguṇaṃ pīṭha mithyatemūlaṃ prokta pramāṇāṃ ca saṃgrāhyaṃ dvijasattamāḥpratyekaṃ saptadhā bhakte mānaṃ saptadaśa dvijāḥpīṭhasya tu na doṣassyājjñātvaivaṃ pīṭhamācaretlohaje ratnaliṅge vā bāṇāliṅge'pi vā matamkalpayetpīṭha vistāraṃ madhyame ṣoḍaśāṃśakamdviguṇāvadhitanmadhye kṛte prāgvattathā matamvistārasamamutsedhastadardho vā tadantepādādhikaṃ tathotsedhaṃ vistarāt parikalpayetbiṃbotsedhacaturbhāgaṃ padmottuṅgaṃ paraṃ matamaṣṭadhā madhyamaṃ bhaktyā navamānaṃ prakalpayetdvādaśāṅgulaparyantaṃ paṅkajasyāgra vistaraḥardhāṅgulādyaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkarajāvadhimānakamdvādaśāṃśa vihīne'tha madhye ṣoḍaśadhākṛte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vistārasadṛśastvāyo dviguṇo vātha madhyametribhāgādruda bhāgāntaṃ tadutsedhe vibhājiteśeṣāṃśaissyādadhaḥ padmaṃ hīnaṃ vordhvadalaistuvāvipulaṃ tuṅgamāyuktaṃ sthānake pīṭhamucyatetribhāgādrudra bhāgāntaṃ dairghyavistārameva vāsaṃsthāpya śeṣabhāgaistu madhye bhadraṃ prakalpayetekapīṭhamanekeṣāṃ yadi śobhāvaśānnayetpadmākṛtiṃ prakartavyā tatrāsīne'rdhacandrakamṣoḍaśāṃśe tu mānena pādukaṃ parikīrtitamvasvaśrapadmamekena vahanyaṃśaḥ karṇa ucyateśarāṃśaṃ padmamānaṃ syād dvibhāgaṃ vṛttamucyateghṛtavāryaṃ śamānaṃ syāt padmapīṭhamadaṃ matampañcabhiḥ paṅkajaṃ kampastvekenordhvaṃ tribhāgataḥdvābhyāṃ paṅktī bhavedūrdhe ghṛtavāyaika bhāgataḥjagatībandha bhāgena guṇārdhaṃ padmatuṅgakamjagatībandha bhāgena guṇārdhaṃ padmatuṅgakamvṛttākārastadūrdhvaitu paṭṭikā bhāgamānataḥśeṣeṇa ghṛtavārītu śrīkaraṃ pīṭhamīrtitampadmamekena bhāge tu vyomāṃśa pādukaṃ bhavetgalamardhaṃtribhāgena padmaṃ dvayaṃśena vṛttakambhāgābhyāṃ karṇa- ityuktassyādekenaiva vājanamekenakaṃpamardhena ghṛtavāryabhidhīyateekaviṃśati bhāgaṃ tu pīṭhottuṅgaṃ vibhajya caekena karṇastvekena padmaṃ syāt guṇabhāgataḥkarṇo dvibhāga bhāgena vājanaṃ padmamaṃśataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṃpassyāt ghṛtavāryūrdhve vijayākhyamidaṃ matamaddhyardhaṃ padmamityuktaṃ kaṃpamekāṃśato bhavetkaṃpamekena karṇasyāt dvibhāgaṃ kaṃpamekataḥarddhena ghṛtavāryukta mumāpīṭha midaṃ matampadmamaṃśa mimaṃbaṃdha bhāgena jagatī bhavetkumudaṃ syāt dvibhāgena padmamarddhena cārdhataḥbhāgārddhena mahāpaṭṭī sārdhenāṃ śenamūrddhanirudrabhāgetu tattuṃge vyomāṃśaṃ pādukaṃ bhavetekāṃśo vājanaṃ prokto mahāpaṭṭī dvibhāgataḥtithyaśaṃ vibhajettuṃga maddhyardhaṃ pādukaṃ bhavetpadmamaṃśena bhāgābhyāṃ kumudaṃ padmamaṃśataḥarddhāṃśa ghṛta vāryuktaṃ svastikañcedamīritampaṃkajantu tribhāgena paṭṭikaikāṃśanirmitāabjaṃ dvibhāgataḥ proktaṃ dvābhyāṃ vājana miṣyatekalāṃśaṃ vibhajettuṃgaṃ vyobhāgena pādukābhāgena kaṃpaṃ syāt dvibhāgena dvibhāgataḥsthaṃṇḍilaṃ pīṭhamevaṃ syāt punaranya mihocyatevyomāṃśaṃ kaṃpamityuktaṃ dvibhāgaṃ padmamucyateekonaviṃśatyaṃśe tu dvibhāgaṃ pādukaṃ bhavetpadmamaṃśena kaṃssyāt śeṣaṃ pūrvavadīritamupapīṭhāni tānyatra yojyānī hāgrajottamāḥdvibhāgenātha kartavyaṃ bhaktyābhīṣṭāśatuṃ gameghṛta vāri vidheyaṃ vā vṛttaṃ vā caturaśrakamkarṇamānañca saṃgrāhya kaṃpādau viniyojayetvṛddhyāṣṭa mātraparyantaṃ vṛddhihāniṃ prayojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: calevāpyacale lohe ratnaje bāṇāliṅgakeniṣkaletu pramāṇaṃ syāt tanmāna madhunocyatetadarddheṇāgra vistāra ssarvaliṃgeṣu yogyakaḥmānaṃ saptadaśaṃ khyātaṃ nālāyāmaṃ dvijottamāḥtathā vibhakte saṃgrāhya mānaṃ saptadaśaiva catripāda marddha pādonaṃ pañcatritytraṃśa mevavāvāri vāhastathā proktā vāgāmbhīryā dvistareṇa vātadūrdhvekaṃpamekadvi vyomabhāgaistathā kramātkarṇārddhamāaṃ tanmānaṃ pīṭhotsedhaṃ vibhajya cadaśabhāgāvasānantu pīṭhanāla ghanaṃ tuvāabhinnapiṇḍikaṃ liṅgaṃ neṣṭaṃ bhuktyarkthināmihaakhaṇḍaśailamiṣṭaṃ syāt tadabhāve sakhaṇḍakampraṇālayuktamiṣṭaṃ syāt tadadhaḥ khaṇḍanepi casakalānāmanālaṃ syāt sanālamathapīṭhakambāṇaliṃgādi liṃgānāṃ caturaśrāya tāśrakambhinnayogikāmnānā puṣpāvalīprotāṃ nānā vahni śikhānvitamsatoraṇaṃ vā vṛttaṃ vā sāyataṃ vā pramāṇataḥevaṃ lakṣaṇa mākhyātaṃ sthāpanaṃ cādhunocyatetayoryaḥ kriyate yogassā pratiṣṭheti gadyateādyaḥ prāgeva kathito liṅgasthāpanakarmaṇitathaiva ca punaḥ kuryādanyathā doṣakārakamcaturaśre'tha vṛtte vā rūpāntarayute'pi vāvṛttaṃ sarvatrakartavyaṃ pūrvākṛtiyutaṃ tu vāliṅgasaṃsthāpanasyoktāvartmanā sakalāṃ kriyām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅkurārpaṇakāryaṃ tu prāguktavidhinā nayetprāguktavidhinā mānaṃ maṇṭape parikīrtitamkuṇḍāni paritaḥ kuryānnavapañcaika saṃkhyayātatpūrve saumyadeśe vā snānārthaṃ snānamaṇḍapamviśeṣayajanaṃ kṛtvā stutvānatvā muhurmuhuḥliṅgāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śivakuṃbhasyavardhanīmsasūtrān sāpidhānāṃśca sakūrcāmbara pallavānpuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu sāsanaṃ mūrti saṃyutampīṭhāddevīṃ samāvāhya vardhanyāṃ madhyamenyasetnaivedyāntaiśca tatpūrve sthaṇḍile homamācarettilenāpi samāyuktaṃ pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ tu vāanyatra sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tatassaṃsthāpayedamūnṭaṅkena haimajātena pīṭhaṃ chitvāstra muccaranśāntihomaḥ prakartavyaḥ pratyahaṃ tu śataṃ tu vāśāṇābhigharṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā pañcamṛtpañcagavyataḥpraṇavenāstramantreṇa snāpayetparameśvaramsthaṇḍilaṃkalpayitvāsmin sthāpayetpiṇḍikāṃ tataḥmadhvājyābhyāṃ tu santarpyamṛtyujinmantrāmuccāransahaimaṃ darśayedvidvān netra mantra manusmaranpracchannapaṭa māvarjya darśayeddeśikottamaḥpradakṣiṇannayet grāmejalatīre niveśya cakalaśāṃ sthāpayedaṣṭau lokapālādhipān kramātnava vastra paricchannāṃ phalakordhvejalāntarepidhānāmbarahaimastān śaktyadhiṣṭhitānsavitānadhvajaṃ darbhamuktā puṣpajamālayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ suvisarjita takṣakampuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvātu vāstu homaṃ ca kārayetpraviśya sadyadvāreṇa saumyāsyordhvasthitasthitiḥgṛhīta khaḍga hastassan pūjitātmasamanvitaḥkṛtakuṇḍāgni saṃskāro jalavāsānmaheśvarīmmṛtkaṣāyodagavyādyaiḥ puṣpapatraphalodakaiḥāchādya vastrayugmena gandhairarcayettu tāmśālibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vasudroṇasamanvitaiḥdarbhai puṣpai paristīrya carmajādyairanu kramātāsanaṃ tatra saṃkalpya piṇḍikāṃ vinyased dhṛdāsūtra vastra paricchannaṃ navaratnasamanvitamtanmadhye sāsanāṃ devīmarcayed gandhasaṃmukhaiḥsahaimāḥ pallavopetāssāpidhānāḥ phalodvahāḥgandhādyairarcayitvā tu piṇḍikāṃ vardhanīmapikarṇasyādho gale karṇādūrdhve tatvatrayaṃ nyasetdhārikā dīptimatyugrā jyotsnā cetā balotkaṭāpañcapakṣe'thavā grāhya tvatrānuktaṃ tu yadbhavetcandanādyai ssamabhyarcya homa karma samārabhetpalāśo dumbarāśvatthanyagodhāḥ pūrvatodiśipalāśaṃ tu pradhānaṃ syātpalāśo vākhilo mataḥdevyā mūlena hotavyaṃ tadaṅgaistaddaśāṃśataḥtatvatatveśvarādyaiśca homayetpratikuṇḍakambhūtidarbhatilai rakṣāṃ kṛtvā tattvavaliṃ tadātataḥ prabhāte vimale mūrtimadbhirguruśśuciḥdvārāṇi tatpatīniṣṭvā samutthāpya maheśvarīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmbūlāntaiśca saṃpūjya piṇḍikāṃ vardhanīmapidatvā mūlena pūrṇāṃ tu sarvadoṣanikṛntanīmdhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ nītvā garbhagehe niveśayetpiṇḍikāsthāpanaṃ bāṇaliṅgasya yadi vartatenava vastraparicchannaṃ śubhāśāsu śiro yathāpīṭhaṃ saṃsthāpayitvātu tatra liṅgaṃ niveśayetsuvarṇaṃ vātha nikṣipya prāgvatsarvaṃ samācaretpuṇyāha prokṣaṇaṃ śāntikumbha toyābhiṣecanampīṭhe kriyākhyaṃ vinyasya guruḥ prāguktavartmanāvāmādi cardhanīyuktāṃ vedikāntarasaṃsthitāmsaṃsthāpya vardhanīṃ vāpi vardhanyaṣṭaka saṃyutaṃjīvanyāsastriṣu sthāneṣvatha kāryo'thavāsanesnapanaṃ kārayedante pañcāmṛtavidhistu vāyāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinīliṅgasaṃsthāpana proktaṃ dakṣiṇārdhaṃ ca dāpayetviśeṣapūjā kartavyā homena ca samanvitācaturthe prathame vātha caṇḍakalpo vidhīyatāmpīṭhasaṃsthāpanasyāpi phalaṃ liṅgapratiṣṭhayāsamānaṃ kathitaṃ yasmāt pratiṣṭhaikobhayatra cabāṇo nāmāsuraḥ proktassa ca siddhyartha mādarātdattavālliṃgakoṭīnāṃ caturdaśāḥ maheśvaraḥliṅgārdrau kālikāgarte śrīnage kanyakāśrameanyatra ca nadīmadhye parvate ca viśeṣataḥpādāṅgula vivṛddhāntu gṛhaṇīyādvā yathecchayārekhābindu kalaṅkādi rahitaṃ yuktameva vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snapane yajane dhūpe gandhapuṣpa nivedaneprāsāda pīṭhikādīnāṃ niyamo na ca neṣyatevimānaṃ bāṇaliṅgasya kalpayet kalpavittamaḥeka varṇaṃ bhavetpīṭhaṃ sarva kāmārtha siddhayevidheyaṃ khātamānantu liṅgārddhamathavā dvijāḥsatit pravāha saṃsthaṃ ca bāṇaliṅga samākṛtiḥparvatādi samut bhūtantadvadeva samīritamsthūlaṃ vātha kṛśaṃ kāntimadrūpa mūrdhvagaḥsahajaṃ vāthabhinnaṃ vā liṅgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sayojitamsarveṣāmapi caiteṣāṃ pratiṣṭhādyaṃ nigadyatecalaliṃga pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pratimādau ca madhyamaḥmāsāyanarkṣavārādi vidhisteṣu ca neṣyatevidhāya vajrabandhādyaṃ tataḥ sthāpana mārabhetratnanyāsantataḥ kuryānnavaḥ pañcaika ratnakamlakṣaṇoddhāraṇa nneṣṭaṃ svākāro lakṣaṇaṃ bhavetjalādhivāsanaṃ kuryānnava pañcaika kuṇḍakamvedikārahitañcait grahādau sthaṇḍilaṃ matambhūparikṣā vidheyantu vāstu pūjāgni tarpaṇamjalamadhyādathānīya śuddhiṃ gavyādibhirnayetśayyāṃ madhye niveśyātha śivakuṃbhaṃ ca vardhanīmsahiraṇyaṃ savastraṃ ca gandhodaparipūritammūrti mūrtiśvarānyastvā saṃpādyaivaṃ śivānalamjuhuyāt mūlamantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yathātatvatatveśvarādīnāṃ pūrvavat homamācaretprātaḥ snātvārcayitvā tu maṇḍapādhipa devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmyārthaṃ kāmyakarmeṣṭanniṣiddhanna samācaretkaraṇebhyudayo jñeyo karaṇe doṣa iṣyatetābhyāmeva niṣiddhe tu sandigdhaṃ tatparityajetkriyāmantrādibhedena tantra bhedo yatastataḥpraśastannoditantatra śāstrāntaramathāśrayetprāyaścittādike'nukte svaśāstre paraśāstrataḥsvaśāstrasiddhaṃ vāgrāhyamatha śāstrāntaroditamso'cireṇa tu kālena sakalādhipatirbhavetsarvantatrabhavettasya śive bhaktiḥ prajāyatesa rājā kṣayamāpnoti nātrakāryā vicāraṇāśaivāgamaparijñānapārageṇa kriyāvatāguro rgurūttamo grāhyaśśivaśāstraviśāradaḥviśeṣapūjātenaiva vartanīyeṣṭasiddhayesaṃsnāpyāmalapiṣṭādyairvirūkṣyeśaṃ saṃvedikamcandanādyaissamālipya paṭṭādyairbhūṣayecchivamkarpūravartisaṃyuktaṃ dīpamārātrikannayetnānopadaṃśasaṃyuktaṃ nānāphalasamanvitamelālavaṃkekarpūrajātītakkolacūrṇayukpraṇamyādhyeṣyalabdhājño homārthaṃ kuṇḍamāśrayetśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā pūrṇāmante samācaretsaṃprārthya vāñchitaṃ karma praṇamecca punaḥ punaḥdviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ catuṣpañcaguṇantu vāpūjāvaiśeṣikīkhyātā pūrvoktaphaladāyinīnityepravartamāne tu yadā naimittikaṃ bhavetsandhyāparārddhakālācet pūrvārdhe vidyate yadi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃprāpta dakṣiṇastuṣṭaḥ prāpta pañcāṅgabhūṣaṇaḥekādyā navaniṣkāntā bhaveddeśika dakṣiṇātajjalaiḥ sthāpayeddevaṃ devīṃ pīṭha svarūpiṇīmyadanuktaṃ bhavedatra liṃga sthāpana vannayetpratyahaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ arcanokta vidyānataḥjīrṇādi doṣa duṣṭaṃ ca vidhināpi na cālayetkuṃbhe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi maṇḍale pīṭhakādikesaṃpūjya devadeveśa mudagdeśe manonmanīmpañcāṅga bhūṣaṇopeto yāvat kṛtyaṃ samāpyateādāvante ca vā homaṃ pratyahaṃ homameva vāliṃgāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kuṃbhasaṃsthāpaṇaṃ nuhineṣyate snapanaṃ hitvā jīrṇoddhāra vidhau dvijāḥkriyānte snapanaṃ kuryāt viśeṣeṇārcayecchivamsthala karmaṇi viśleṣa sudhākarma vihīnakehomādyamapi neṣṭaṃ syāt kartuṃ liṃgaṃ samarcayetmūrtihomaṃ diśāhomaṃ tat karma gurulāghavamtayorabhyantara syāpi dārḍya śaithilya kāraṇātastrāṃbu prokṣaṇaṃ tatra snapanārthaṃ dvijottamāḥmahāhavistathā proktaṃ rājñorāṣṭrasya śāntayekartuḥ kārayituścāpi deśikasya viśeṣataḥsvāyaṃbhuvādi liṃgānā metat sāmānyamīritamanyat sarva samānaṃ syāt karmasāmānyaliṃgakaḥanenaiva prakāreṇa sthāpanaṃ ratnaje matamcalevāpyacalevāpi sthāpanañcaita dīritamcitrādi pratimādīnāṃ pūjārthaṃ tattadagrake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅginaśca yathā pūjā yatkāle śāstra coditāanyatra śuddhanṛttaṃ ca tadvannityotsavādikamtyaktvānyat prāgvaduddiṣṭamātmārthe tadviśiṣyate !kāmyāni siddhayo jñeyāḥ siddhayo bahudhā smṛtāḥpratyekaṃ trividhaṃ prokta muttamādi vibhedataḥkanyasaṃ bhūpatīśatvaṃ madhyamaṃ balasiddhayaḥbhidyate bahudhaikaikaṃ vidyeśatvādi bhadataḥityevamādidaivatvaṃ śreṣṭhamityucyate budhaiḥityevamādikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ siddhīnāṃ munipuṃgavāḥapamṛtyujayoccāya vaśyādya madhamaṃ matamdehāntareṇa vā dṛṣṭaṃ māyākārye paratra caaparaṃ tatparaṃ vidyādanantādi pataṭsthitiḥśivaliṃga manādṛtya siddhi muktayabhilāṣiṇāḥbhavābhīṣṭa phalaṃ prāptāḥ siddhisiddhāḥ surāḥ matāḥtasmāliṃgāśrayātsiddharyukta liṅgasamāśrayetvidhivalliṃgamārādhya phalamiṣṭatamaṃ gatāḥsiddhairvidyādharādyaiśca na mānuṣyaiḥ kadācanayathā śāstraṃ yathā kālaṃ yathā deśaṃ parīkṣya casvayaṃna kartu maśaktānāṃ vṛpatīnāṃ hitāya casvasya vānyasya vākarturhitakṛdbaddeśikottamaḥśilādi dravyamādāya nayet karmānurūpataḥratnakṣaṇika vastūni kathyante tānyaśeṣataḥcaturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ śilā dhātrī ca saṃmatāekā śūdrasya niyamācchilā bhūmyaśca kīrtitāḥphalaṃ liṃgānūrūpeṇa śilānāṃ samudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrī kāmasya suvarṇottha rājyakāmasya rājatamutsāde rītijaṃ jñeyaṃ trapujaṃ putra vṛddhayelohaliṃgaṃ samākhyātaṃ ratnaliṃga mathocyateindra nīlamayālliṃgāt sarvān kāmān samaśrutevaḍūryād vyādhināśaḥ syāt saubhāgyaṃ puṣparāgajānrājāvartamayālliṃgāt mahābhogaṃ samaśruteśūlākṣa maṇijaṃ śatru kṣayāya pulakaṃ tathācandrakāntaṃ mṛtyujite bhūtidaṃ padmarāgajamvaikrāntakaṃ mahāvṛttaraktāyathaskāndajaṃ hitamguṇādaṣṭaphala proktaṃ parāsu maṇijātiṣusāravad vṛkṣajaṃ bhūtyai kṣīradrumajamāyuṣeraktāhvacandanāśokaṃ śiṃśupāśoka bilvajamyadvā sādhaka nakṣatra vaśālliṃga tu dārujamkhadiraḥ kṛṣṇakakubhau śirīṣāśvatthakau tataḥambaṣṭa bilvārjuna kāśśālmalī vakulastathāāmrārkau ca kadambaśca vahni nimbau tathaiva caebhi-ṛkṣairabhiruddhaistarubhiśśāntikādikamśvetārkamūlajaṃ liṅgaṃ jayārthaṃ vijayārthināmsaralaṃ sarvakāmyārthaṃ khadiraṃ roganāśanamviśeṣāt sarva varṇānāṃ sarvakāmārtha sādhanamvaśyāyāśvatthajaṃ liṅgaṃ ārogye khādiraṃ bhavetdārujaṃ liṃgamākhyātaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ liṅgamucyateannamannādya kāmasya paiṣṭaṃ puṣṭi pradāyakamghṛtena kalpitaṃ liṅgaṃ hlāda dṛdduḥkhināmapiviśeṣādbhasmajaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvavyādhi nivāraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bilvādi patrajaṃ liṃgaṃ yattatputra vivardhanamdhānya taṇḍulajaṃ liṃgaṃ tattaddravya phalapradamrogahṛt sāktavaṃ liṅgaṃ tathā lāja vinirmitamliṃgaṃ yaccitritaṃ sadyo vicitraphala dāyakamdravyāṇi kathitānyevaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca vidhīyatemukhya tassiddhaye proktaṃ muktyartha manuṣaṅgataḥbhuktaye cānu ṣaḍgeṇa bhavanti vidhiyogataḥtadantare'ṣṭabhāge tu nava liṃgāni santi hiṣaṭtriṃśanmāna muddiṣṭaṃ garbhamānaṃ dvijottamāḥdvārivāṃśaṃ parityajya sapīṭhāśrā viśeṣataḥekāṅgulaṃ samārabhya sāṅgulāṅgulavṛddhitaḥekahastaṃ samārabhya ṣaḍaṅgulavivṛddhitaḥhastādadhaḥ sthitaṃ śailaṃ prāsādeṣu na śasyateaṅgulādi vitastyantaṃ ratnaliṃgaṃ dvijottamāḥhastādadha sthitaṃ śailaṃ yojya muccāṭa nādiṣukhaṇḍatrayaṃ samaṃ kuryāt siddhi liṅgeṣu sarvasuardhacandra śiroyuktaṃ sthāpayedaindra pīṭhakevajrakāryaṃ samāyojya staṃbhādi parikīrtitamvasvaśraṃ pūrvavat vṛtte saptāśraṃ svāṃ diśaṃ vināliṃgaṃ śakti śiropetaṃ sthāpyaṃ śaktyaṅga piṇḍiketāpadāhaṃ ripoḥ kuryālliṃgamāgneyakaṃ dvijāḥpradhāna bhujayoryāmyaṃ vṛtamagnicyutiḥ kramātliṃgaṃ daṇḍaśiroyuktaṃ sthāpayedvidhināmatamripordeśe sthitaṃ nāśaṃ nagaraddakṣiṇe tataḥdairdhyādvāviṃśadaṃśe tu śarāṃśaiccaturaśrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāpayedrākṣase pīṭhe svadik sādhana siddhayearātikṣayavidveṣaṃ kīlabhedena mohanamkurute nātra sandeho vidhivanmantra saṃyutamcaturaśraṃ tathāṣṭāśraṃ vṛttaṃ bālendu mastakampāśamastaka yuktaṃ tat pāśakāya vidhānataḥvyādhihāniṃ ca saubhāgyamāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥnavabhakte tribhirbhakte madhye ṣaḍ rasa vṛddhayemāpnuyāttena liṃgena mantrajñaḥ proccāṭodvega vibhramānpūrvoktaṃ vāruṇaṃ liṅgaṃ yākṣaṃ cordhvaśiro'nvitamgadā mastaka liṃgaṃ tu gadāṅke sthāpya deśikaḥjayaṃ dhairyaṃ tathā rājya prāptiṃ ca prabhutāmapidairghyārdhaṃ raudravat kṛtvā rasāṅgaiḥ padmasaṃbhavamaṣṭāśraṃ vṛttakaṃ raudraṃ pārśvamadhye trirunnatamsthāpayitvā svadik sāmyaṃ liṃgaṃ śūlaśiroyutamjñānavijñānamokṣārthaṃ yogīśatva pradāyakayakamutsedhe grahabhakte tu vedāśraṃ tu śarāṃśakambrāhyāṃ sthāpayitvā tu svadigīśatvamāpnuyātkhacarī śatvamāpnoti sāmrājya phalasādhanpūrvavanmadhya vṛtte tu mastakaṃ trapuṣopamamcakramastaka saṃyuktaṃ cakrāṅkāyāṃ tu deśikaḥliṅgāyāme navāṃśe tu brahmāṃśo guṇabhāgataḥsiddhiliṃgamidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vicchāyādiṣapiṇḍikamsahasra liṃgaṃ kartavyaṃ tacca prāgukta vannayetarcāṃśe vedabhāge tu nāhe nakṣatra bhājite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āḍhyādi liṃgānyutsedhaiḥ samakhaṇḍāni kalpayetdhārāliṃgaṃ tathaikāśraṃ dvitryaṃśādikaṃ dvijāḥmṛtiruccāṭana dūṣaśāntī puṣṭirvaśī kṛtiḥmohastaṃ bhābhidhātābha yakṣā paiśācarākṣasaiḥdevatvaṃ devarājatvaṃ sarvakāmaphalaṃ ca yatevameva hi pīṭhāni kalpyānyaśca vibhedataḥaṣṭāṃśe tu caturbhakte bhāga bhāga vivardhanāatpuṇḍarīkādyaśo dīptirviśāle vipulāṃ śriyamkukkuṭāṇḍa śirastasya caturthāṃśa vivardhanāttat tribhāgaika bhāgena vartanādiṣu mastakamṣaḍbhāga vardhanād bhūti nimittaṃ trapuṣākṛtiḥsādhāraṇa vidhāvetānyarcayitvā narottamāḥchatrādviśīrṣa mālokyaṃ vajtrādīnāṃ nigadyatetribhāgavartanācchaktirarcāṃśe rudrabhājitekhaḍgamastakamākhyāta maṣṭāṃśe sārdhavardhanātgrāhāṃśe sārdhabhāgena śūlamūrdhni trirunnatamśirolakṣaṇa mākhyātaṃ lakṣaṇoddhāra ucyatelakṣmārdhāt pakṣarekhe dve tasyāgre gajacakṣuṣīvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ tathābrahmaviṣṇvādi devānāṃ padamicchan dvijottamāḥliṃgāśe navadhā bhakte navāṃśa kṛta lakṣmakamdvitīyāccakṣuṣorvedhādakṣirogādikaṃ mṛtiḥgrīvāsūtrāccaturthācca śatrubandhavināśanamṣaṣṭāṃśāttu tathā vedhāt putrapatnī vināśakamnābhideśe tu śatrūṇāṃ bhavetsarvātmakaṃ bhayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kathitaṃ hi tathāpīha tribhāge rasabhāgakevedha doṣa nivṛtyarthaṃ evaṃ lakṣma prakalpayetśiraso vartanaṃ yadvattallakṣaṇa śikhā bhavetśaktyākhyamartha viṣkambha yutamunnata mastakamnaiścācare sajihvāgraṃ kaubere tu gadāśrakamsāmānyeṣu nijākāraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ svārtha sādhanamstaṃbhanādau tu kartavyaṃ lokapālārcitaṃ dvijāḥmaṇi muktā pravālānāṃ na kāryama malārciṇāmlakṣaṇairhīna mapyetadvistārāyāmanāhajaiḥpīṭhapiṇḍikayorvakṣye lakṣaṇaṃ viprasattāmāḥaindramāgneyakaṃ yāmyaṃ rākṣasaṃ vāruṇaṃ tataḥproktāni pīṭhamānāni tripādāḥ piṇḍikā matāḥvedāśraṃ yonikhaṇḍendutryaśraṃ vṛtta ṣaḍaśrakamvedāśre'ṣṭādaśāṃśe tu bhāgatyāgātsanantataḥsabhadraṃ gāruḍaṃ pīṭhaṃ vakṣye teṣāṃ tu bhūṣaṇamyoniścedrasabhāge tu bhavedekaikaśaḥ kramātpīṭhamāgneyakaṃ proktaṃ piṇḍikā ṣoḍaśāṃśataḥpājjatī karṇikā kaṇṭhaṃ tadūrdhve paṭṭikādvayamrākṣase samākhyātaṃ bhakte ekadvitryaṃśakaiḥ kramāttadūrdhve rākṣasī piṇḍī vāruṇe rudrabhājitekarṇikā kaṇṭha eva syānnirgamātpaṭṭikādvayamindutejo'ṅghra rūpākṣi rūpayugmendubhāgakaiḥnirgamatā paṭṭikāststrastadūrdhve vāyavī smṛtāṣoḍaśadvādaśa dalāt kaṇṭhādūrdhve viparyayātaiśa rudrāṃśakaṃ kṛtvā rūparāmaika rāmakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadūrdhve piṇḍikā brāhmī gāruḍaṃ vā tathaiva catadūrdhve paṭṭike dve tu piṇḍīṃ caiśīṃ tadūrdhvataḥkaṇṭhaṃ caikena bhāgābhyāṃ nirgamā tpaṭṭike tataḥāgneyī vaiṣṇavī caindrī piṇḍikā dvimekhalāṣaṇmekhalā ca vāyavyā vāruṇī pañcamekhalāśeṣaḥ pīṭhoccamānaṃ syāt khātabāhye tu mekhalāpīṭhaṃ sahasraliṃgasya sālaṅkārayugāśrayukdāruje dārujā piṇḍī dhātuje dhātu saṃbhavāucchrayaṃ calaliṃgānāṃ pūjāṃśād dviguṇaṃ bhavetkṛśuṣu vardhayeddrudraṃ sthūlaliṃgeṣu hrāsayetpiṇḍikāyāḥ samānārthaṃ hrāsayedvardhayeddvijāḥmudgamātrā parvamātrā piṇḍikā śobhanā yathāsaukṣmye vaiko guṇo yena balīyān sarvadoṣajitmānonmāna pramāṇaṃ ca teṣu grāhyaṃ na vā budhaiḥgandhādi nirmitaṃ vātha na ca siddhau manaśśilāmanyadvāpi bhavelliṃgaṃ nadī prasravaṇodbhavamhastādadhastu raudreṣu dvābhyāṃ piṇḍīti bhājitepiṇḍikā hīnamānā yā śatruhānau tato'dhikāstrīnāśe lakṣaṇāddhīnā kāryā karmānurūpataḥsamaliṃge tu kartavyaṃ caturaṣṭāśra vṛttakampañcamaṃ caivavaktrāṇi caturdikṣu ca madhyamedvivaktraṃ pūrvavatpūrve paścime kalpayettataḥprativaktraṃ jaṭācūḍaṃ candrārdha kṛta śekharambhukti mukti prasiddhyarthaṃ yathā śobhaṃ dvijottamāḥvyaktāvyaktamidaṃ khyātaṃ vyaktaliṅgamathocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcāsyaṃ daśadoryuktaṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanamdeha pañcaka saṃyuktaṃ caramadvaya saṃyutamjāmbūnada pratīkāśaṃ kalpayettu bhujadvayamdakṣamañjanasaṅkāśaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ vivṛtāsyakamtuṅgāgraśmaśru saṃyuktaṃ śūladhaṇḍā karadvayambhūṣaṇa pracuraṃ vaktraṃ yoṣācchavisamāyutambālaveṣa samāyuktaṃ puṇḍarīka nibhekṣaṇāmpañcamaṃ sphaṭika prakhyaṃ praśāntaṃ sasmitānanamitthaṃ vaktrasamāyuktaṃ vaktra varṇānulepanamsarva kāmapradaṃ śāntaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇānvitambhukti mukti prasiddhyarthaṃ mathakarmānu rūpataḥkuryādīśāna dehaṃ tu daśatālottamena tukuryāttadurdhva kāyāni nādhaḥ kāyāni deśikaḥkuryātsadāśivaṃ devaṃ yathā yuktaṃ yathāśubhamkuryādūrdhvasasaumyāsyaṃ daśabāhuṃ trilocanamvyāla yajñopavītaṃ cā śārdūlavasanānvitamśrī kaṇṭhamevamakhyāta manyathāpi ca kathyatejaṭāmakuṭa saṃyuktaṃ mūrdhnidhuttūrapuṣpakamūrdhvasthadakṣapādāḍhyaṃ divyāyudha samanvitamvṛṣaṃ dhjaṃ ca kheṭaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ cāgniṃ ca jharjharīmtriśūlaṃ nāgahastaṃ ca paraśuḥ pāśa eva canāgairābharaṇairyuktaṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmalaṃkṛtamgaurīṃ skandaṃ gṛhītvā tu vāme pārśve tu saṃsthitāmnānāyudha samopeta viṃśaddhastayuto'pi vādakṣiṇaṃ vāmajaṅghānta mudbhutaṃ vāmāpādakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itaro'bhaya hasta syāt parau ṭaṅkānalānvitauagniṃ hitvā mṛgovātha rudro'yaṃ kāla saṃjñitaḥvarābhaya karopetā rudroyaṃ vāma saṃjñakakaḥaghora rudranāmāyaṃ bhīmo bhava vināśanaḥanyo'pi nakra saṃyukto jaṭāmakuṭa saṃyutaḥbhūtottamāṅga vinyasta vāmapādadalānvitaḥvāme gaurī samāyuktaścandrārdha kṛtaśekharaḥtryakṣo dvibhujaśśānto jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍitaḥāsīno vā sthito vāpi varadānodyataḥ svayamtasyāstu dakṣiṇo bāhurīśa skandha sthito'thavāgaurī gaurīśvaraścaiva caturbhuja samanvitautriṇetrau vā dvinetrau vā pralambita padānvitauekasyāścaturāsyā vā pañcāsyā vātha bhairavāḥkālāntakādi saṃyuktau bhaktānāmathavoparidehārdhānvita kānto'yaṃ śrīmānvṛṣabhavāhanaḥmṛgaṭaṅkayuto vātha lalāṭe'pi sulocanaḥardhanārīśvaro nāmnā haryardho hariṇā yadiśūla paṅkaja yukto vā varadābhaya saṃyutaḥnīlarudra ssamākhyāto nāmnā vyāgrogra'ṣṭikaḥpiccha cāmarasaṃyukto bhīmarudra ssamīritaḥvaradābhaya hasto vā śāntarūpaḥ smitānanaḥrudro'yaṃ sarvaśarvassyāt abhīṣṭaphaladāyakaḥkapāla śūla saṃyukto baddhapadmāsanasthitaḥpāśamuṇḍadharo vāpi ṭaṅkapāśadharo'pi vābhavarudra samākhyāta ssarveṣāṃ bhava nāśanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sandhyāmapyalpakālena cāparārdhe samācaretdhūpāntaṃ vātha naivedyaparyantannityakarma canaimittikaṃ mahacceddhi samārabhyasvakālakesandhyānte sarvakalaśaiḥ snāpayeduktavartmanālaghvante sadṛśantaścet kāmacāro vidhīyatāmalpānalpavibhāgena svalpasyādayanādikaḥgrasyamāne ravaukuryānmucyamāne niśākareviṣuve madhyakāle ca snapanādyaṃ samācaretsihme ca vṛścike kumbhe vṛṣeścādau samācaretādau cānte ca gṛhṇīyāt snapanādiṣu karmasuupayuktamihadravyaṃ yāge svarṇāmbarādikamyāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ yat dravyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ maṇḍapasya tutoraṇaṃ sruksruvāvaṣṭamaṃgalannavaratnakamvalayantatprapādīṃśca madanyadupayuktakamniṣkādidaśaniṣkāntā deśike dakṣiṇe matānavadhā dhakṣiṇā kṣudrakrame syāddhīna vṛttikenitye tu kalpayedvṛddhiṃ manassantoṣaṇaṃ tathāśyāmāṣṭakaṃ yavo bījo bījodaka mihoditamcandanaṃ laghukuṣṭaṃ ca varālo śīra mustakāḥebhistu cūrṇitairyuktaṃ gandhodaka miti smṛtamaṣṭabhiśca samāyuktaṃ mṛdaṃbhaḥ parikīrtitamśirīṣendīvaraṃ rātrirebhi rmārjana mucyatetritālaṃ karṇikāmānaṃ sarvasāmānyamīritamtathā dvitālamānena karṇikāmānamīritamśivāgre vātha tadvāme vāme śuddhamahītale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varābhaya karopetā ssadaṃṣṭrā ugradṛṣṭayaḥukṣasthāḥ tridaśāḥ padmasthitā vā gauramūrtayaḥugrā nānāyudhopetāstattaddikpālapālakāḥkimatra bahunoktena ye devā rudra vigrahāḥevaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ teṣāṃ sthāpanamucyatetrayodaśānta yuktena caturthyantākhyayā yujārudrāṇāṃ rudramūrtīṇāṃ śāntānāmīśvaro manuḥkālo'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ ratnavinyāso netramokṣaṇamtatraiva kuṇḍa saṃkḷptirnava pañcaika sakhyayāpuṇyāhaṃ vāstu homaṃ ca beraśuddhiranantaramkuṃbhādīnāṃ saparyā ca naivedyādi nivedanamhomaṃ palāśasadbilva vaṭoduṃbara pippalaiḥpradhāne tu palāśena ghṛtena caruṇātilaiḥmantranyāsaśca vidhivat snapanaṃ puṣkalodanamkartavya ssarva karmāpi liṃga saṃsthāpanaṃ yadikartavyaḥ sarvakarmāpi viśeṣastatra kathyateliṅge vinyasya nakṣatraṃ sveṣṭa karma samārabhetārṣakamṛṣibhissarvaiḥ kauśikādyaiḥ pratiṣṭhitampūjāṃśa dviguṇaṃ pīṭhaṃ triguṇaṃ garbhagehekamvistārād dviguṇaṃ tacca tripādādhikameva vāliṃga vistāramānena triguṇaṃ pīṭha mucyateprāgvadutsedha uttiṣṭa anyathāpi nigadyatepīṭha vistāra mānena sārdhānardha vivardhanātdviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tena caturguṇa mathāpi vāsārdha dvayāṃśa kaikāṃśa samaṃ vā bhitti vistaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṅganāhasya karṇena pīṭha vistāra ucyatedvyaṃśe caikāṃśakaṃ vāpi bhitti vistāra mārabhettasmāccaturguṇaṃ nālīgehaṃ tattraṣaḍaṃśakaiḥliṃga dviguṇa vistāra karṇapīṭha viśālakamekāṃśaṃ taddvistāramanyathā punarucyatepiṇḍikā vipulaṃ nālī taccatuguṇamucyatevistāra dviguṇe karṇa daśāṃśeṃśa vihīnakamtatpañca saptabhāgaikaṃ bhittitārārdhamārabhetbhavanti bahumānāni teṣviṣṭaṃ gṛhyatāṃ varaiḥevamekatale proktaṃ dvitalādiṣu dhāmasuprāgukta vidhinā dhāma nakṣatrād dvitalaṃ nayetpauruṣaṃ bhaktiyuktau manujaiḥ sthāpitaṃ bhavetliṅgamānavaśenātra prāsādaṃ parikalpayettribhāgaṃnāli gehasya tricaturbhāga bhāgataḥliṅgaviṣkambhakarṇasya adhyardhādardhavṛddhitaḥtasmāccaturguṇaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ triguṇameva vāsamaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ vāpi adyardhaṃ pīṭha vistṛtampūjāṃśadviguṇaṃ pīṭhamudayaṃ tu viśālataḥtato'vaśiṣṭaṃ tatsarvaṃ pūrvavat parikalpayetekātsaptayavāntaṃ mātrādeka vivṛddhitaḥpīṭhaṃ garbhe bhavedeva bhavet prāsādavistareantare'ṣṭāṃśamānaṃ vā tatpādaṃ vā samāharettathā tadapi tadgrāma mānaṃ paurāṇapauruṣeupānaṃ jagatīkaṇṭha paṭṭikā kumudādiṣumānuṣe paṭṭikāntaṃ ca vṛtyantaṃ jalanisravam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadi tadvāhya bhāgaṃ ca yugmameva vidhīyatetrivarṇa pūjitaṃ liṅgaṃ pauruṣaṃ vā vidhīyatesvāyaṃ bāṇaliṃgaṃ daivīkaṃ cārṣakaṃ tvititeṣāṃ liṅgavasādvidvān prāsādaṃ parikalpayeteteṣāṃ karṇamānaiśca prasādaṃ parikalpayetpañcaṣaḍguṇitaṃ vāpi dviguṇādyaṃ pragṛhyatāmtattadardhaṃ tadardhaṃ syād dvātriṃśat kathitāni tupīṭha dviguṇamāno vā triguṇo vā caturguṇaḥavāntara pramāṇāni pūrvavatparikalpayetṣaḍguṇāntara paryantān bhāgān kṛtvaikabhāgataḥbhitterantara mānaṃ tu pūrvavatparikalpayetekātsaptayavāntaṃ tu mātrādeka vivṛddhitaḥaṅgulīhasta pūrṇārthaṃ saptamātranta mācaretprāsāda syātha liṃgasya pīṭhasyāśmana eva vāsātvike rājase deśe tāmase vā prakalpayetdharma kāmārtha siddhyarthaṃ sārva kāmikamucyatenāgaraṃ syādyuge kārte trete dvāviḍa miṣyatevarāṭaṃ caiva sāliṃgaṃ sarvatrāpi ca saṃmatamvarāṭākhyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ syātsārvadeśyaṃ munīśvarāḥsvāyaṃbhuvaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca daivikaṃ cārṣakaṃ tathāmānuṣe tveva liṃgādau phala vaiśiṣya miṣyatetantra saṃkara doṣo'pi mantra saṃkara eva vākāla saṃkara doṣaśca yugasaṃkara eva vāsārvadeśika dhāmnastu mānonmānaṃ vidhīyatepañcāśaddhastaparyantaṃ mānaṃ syāt sārvadeśikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāradvibhāge tryaṃśādyāḥ saptāntāḥ śāntikādayaḥeka dvitrikarairyuktamānāddhīnaṃ tu vādhikamvistārādcchrayādvātha vistāra syocchrayeṇa vāprasaṅgena ca kathyante leśādāyā dayo'pi yerudrabhānu śarirhanyāccheṣamāyaṃ vinirdiśetguṇayet kṣapaye dvāpi taccheṣaṃ vyayamādiśetnṛpa kartṛ dinā dvāstu liṃgādyukta dināntakamtuṣṭissampadvipatkṣema pratyaraṃ sādhako vadhaḥdvitīye saṃpadādyāstu pūrvavatsamudāhṛdamvaināśikaṃ ca tyaktvā tu tṛtīye vā viparyayeviyogādyaśubhaṃ yogaṃ gaṇaṃ cāsura mānuṣamsaptarturbhūta vedāgni navabhiḥ kṣapitaṃ tu yatrudra randhraguṇaivṛddhiṃ yonibhiḥ kṣapayedguruḥdakṣiṇādyāstrayo'gnayaḥṣaḍjo vṛṣabhagāndhārau pañcamo madhyamastathāṣaḍja"ca vṛṣabho madhye bhūteṣu pṛthivī jalampṛthvyādyāḥ prathitāḥ pañca dakṣiṇādyāstathāgnayaḥninditā ravisaurārāśśubhayoge śubhapradāḥliṃga berādike caiva māyādyaṃ kalpayedvijāḥdhāmnastryaṃśaṃ catustryaṃśaṃ pañcatryaṃśa dribhāgikamcaturbhirvā tribhāgairvā garbhagehaṃ pakalpayetnavāṃśe tricatuṣpañcaṣaḍ saptāṃśaistu nālikāmtryaṃśaikaṃ tadūdvayāṃśaṃ vā pañcāṃśe tryaṃśameva vācaturaṃśaṃ tu vā madhye ṣaḍaṃśaṃ pañca bhāgikamcaturaṃśena vā bhadraṃ madhyame parikalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhadrasya yugmapārśvastha rudra rūpādireva vāsārva deśika liṃgāni kathyante garbhamānataḥnavāṃśe pañcabhirmadhyaṃ bhavatyardhena kanyasamtattadantaramānena trayastriṃśatpramāṇakamekādaśāṃśairmadhyaṃ syāt bhāgairdvādaśabhirvaramgarbhantu navadhā kṛtvā navaliṃgocchrayastu vāmadhyame'ṣṭa vibhāge tu tattadantabhedataḥathavā garbha gehasya tryaṃśaikamadhamaṃ bhavetpūrvavanmadhyamaṃ kṛtvā trayastriṃśatpramāṇakamekahastaṃ samārabhya cekaikāṅgula vardhanāteka viṃśati bhāgena garbhagehe vibhājitepūrvavanmadhyamaṃ kṛtvā trayastriṃśatpramāṇakamsatribhāgaiśśarairliṃga vistārāḥ parikīrtitaḥathavāṣṭa daśāṃśe ca liṃgocce pañcabhāgikedairdhyaṃ trisaptadhā kṛtvā rasabhūtābdhi bhāgataḥdvāra stambhādibhiścaiva mānaṃ liṃge samūhyatāmāyādi śubhasiddhyarthaṃ aṃśairvā vibhajedyathāśatāṃśaṃ vibhajettatra tvekāṃśa yojayedguruḥsamakhaṇḍaṃ vardhamānaṃ śaivādhikyaṃ trirāśikamiyattayā samuddeśa krameṇaiṣa vidhīyatetadbhāga sadṛśastārassamakhaṇḍo'yamīritaḥpakṣasmṛtyeka viṃśāṃśaṃ gāyatryaṃśe śivāyatetasmāttasmāddharīśayoḥathavānyaprakāreṇa vardhamānaṃ vidhīyatecatuṣpañcakare pañca ṣaḍ saptasu ca saptakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekadvitrikramāddadyādadhike ṛtuvatkṛtesaptasaptāṣṭa bhāgaṃ tu pañca pañca ṣaḍaṃśakamevaṃ śivādhikaṃ liṃgaṃ brāhmādyādiṣvanukramātṣaḍsaptāṣṭa vibhāgaistu nāho rudrādiṣu kramātnavadhā liṃgamānena tricaturbhirajādayaḥtriṃśadbhāge śivāyāme navadigrudrabhāgataḥtrayastriṃśatkṛte liṃge svasthikaṃ śūdrayogyakammukha liṃgaṃ ca pūrvokta vidhinātrāpi bhāvyateliṃgānāmadhikaṃ dadyācchiraso vartanāṃśakamśivaliṃgapratiṣṭhoktavidhinā lakṣaṇaṃ nayetliṃgaviṣkambhamānena triguṇā vātha vistṛtiḥpūjāṃśa dviguṇā vātha triguṇā vā caturguṇānāha dviguṇa mānā vā pīṭha vistṛti rucyategarbhageha tribhāgaikaścaturbhāgaika eva vāviṣṇubhāga samottuṅga pādārdha sahito'thavāpañcāṃśoccaṃ taduccaṃ vā viṣṇvaṃśottuṅgato'dhikaḥliṃga viṣkambhamānena dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vātattadantara mānāni navadhāparikalpayetpīṭha vistāra sadṛśaṃ brahmaśailaṃ prakalpayettatpādaṃ vā samutsedhaṃ brahmaśailasya kalpayetliṃga viṣkaṃbha mānaṃ tu vikārāṃśa samaṃ bhavetbrahmaśailāvaṭaṃ kuryāt utsedhādvistarāt puraḥkaścidasti viśeṣo'smin yāvatpūjāṃśa dairghyakamchāyādoṣo yathā nasyāt liṃgapīṭhikayordvijāḥāvaheduttamāṃ siddhiṃ sarva liṃgeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arcāṃśādadhikaṃ pīṭhaṃ pārśvato nyūnameva vāsiddhyai vigarhitaṃ tatsyāt samaṃ cet siddhidaṃ dvayamgaṇyaṃ tadanu rodhena nādyantamiha kathyatesvayambhu daivike bāṇe gāṇe maune viśeṣataḥtathā brahmādibhirbhāgai śśirolakṣaṇa bhedataḥtribhirbrahmādibhirbhāgairdvābhyāmekena vā yutamprāsāda pīṭhike teṣāṃ garbhamānādikaṃ ca yatprāsāda pīṭhikādīnāṃ jīrṇādau samupasthiteparityakta śilāyoge śilāyogaśca kathyatedarśayet khananādyaiśceccora duḥkhāvahaṃ nṛṇāmtasmādadhaḥ sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ mūlenaiva parīkṣayetsārvadeśikaliṃgānāmitthaṃ lakṣaṇa mīritampratiṣṭhāyā vidhānaṃ yat pūrvokta vidhinocyatepradhānamaṅgamityevaṃ dvidhaṃ liṅgamucyateyasya liṅgasya vidyante tat pradhānamiti smṛtamtadaṅgamiti vikhyātaṃ parivārairvinākṛtampaścimottarapūrvāśāśśubhāśāssaṃprakīrtitāḥtatrasaṃsthāpayelliṅgaṃ pratimāṃ vobhayātmikāmparivārādikaṃ tatra kuryādvā leśamārgataḥaṅgaliṅgādyakaṃ śuddhaśaiva mārgeṇa kārayetna bauddhārhatakāpālapāñcarātrādikairna capramādattaiḥ kṛte tacca śaivaṃ saṃpādayet kṣaṇātata ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ cet sarvadoḍakṛtsvadhāmagarbhamānādvā kuryādaṅgulamānataḥkarṣaṇādikameteṣāṃ kartavyaṃ vā na vā pṛthak
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ liṅga vimānādyaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthāpayet sudhīḥmūrdheṣṭakādikaṃ karma jīrṇoddhārādikaṃ ca yatkriyamāṇe'pi mūlasya pavitrārohaṇādikepṛthagvā karaṇīyaṃ tadyathāśāstraṃ dvijottamāḥāyuḥ śrīkīrtisaubhāgyārogyabhogyabuhuprajāḥekādyekaikavṛddhyā tu rudrasaṃkhyāvasānakamśataṃ vārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā śatordhvamapi puṣkalamevaṃ yaḥ kārayet kartā sa evāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥdravyaiśśilādibhiḥ kuryāt pūrvoktaistaṃ viśeṣṭaḥpiṅgalābhaṃ jaṭācūḍaṃ daśadordaṇḍamaṇḍitamkhaṭvāṅgaṃ dakṣabhāgasthairvahantaṃ karapallavaiḥbījāpūraṃ ca vāmasthairvahantaṃ suprasannakamicchājñānakriyāśaktitrayasaṃkḷptalocanambrahmasūtrādikaṃ kāryaṃ sukheśa pratimoditamitthaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ pratiṣṭhāvidhirucyatetadante ratnavinyāsaṃ dṛṣṭyunmīlanameva cajalādhivāsanaṃ paścānmaṇṭapaṃ pūrvavannayettāni kuṇḍāni vṛttāni taddigaśrāṇi vā bhavetpuṇyāhaṃ vāstuhomaṃ ca bhūparigrahameva capratimāśodhanaṃ kṛtvā kautukaṃ bandhayettataḥśiraḥpradeśe devasya sadāśivaghaṭaṃ nyasetvardhanīmuttare nyasya yajettasyāṃ manonmanīmtattvamūrtyādivinyāsaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ samācaretyavā/lājāṃśca hutvānte siddhārthaṃ ca payāṃstathāśamīravadiramāyūrabilvāsyuḥ vahnikoṇataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratyekaṃ pūrvavaddhutvā dvitīye deśikaśśuciḥdeśikādīṃśca saṃpūjya dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayettataḥkumbhādbījaṃ samādāya sadeśahṛdi vinyasetsahajā yadi sā devī tasyāstu hṛdi vinyasettattadghaṭodakaiścaiva tattaddeśe'bhiṣecayetdevyāśca snapanaṃ kṛtvā kalyāṇaṃ kārayettataḥnityārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ prāgvadeva samācaretihaiva bhogān bhuktveṣṭān so'nte yāyācchivaṃ paramśilādidravyamāpādya taiḥ kuryāt pratimāṃ tataḥgaurīpratiṣṭhā kartavyā iṣṭa deśe manorametasyā dhāma vidhātavyamutsedhādyaṃ tu pūrvavatvalabhyākāramiṣṭaṃ ceccaturdhā vibhajettatimekena bhittiruddiṣṭā tridhā vā vibhajettatimcaturdhā bhājite tāre ṣaḍbhidairghyamathāpi vāpañcadhā bhājite tāre daighyaṃ ṣaḍbhirathāpi vāsaptabhistvaṣṭabhirvātha navabhirdaśabhistathāāyāmaṃ garbhabhityośca pūrvavatparikalpayettattadviguṇamānāntamāyāmaṃ parikalpayetpādena vārdhabhāgena tripādena samantataḥhitvālindaṃ bahirbhāgāddhanaṃ vā sarvamiṣyateśālākāram sabhākāraṃ prāsādākārameva cadigdevatāsu devyāstu rūpabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥsiṃhā vā vṛṣabho vāpi vāhanaṃ parikīrtitampūrvāsyaṃ paścimāsyaṃ vā dakṣiṇāsyaṃ samīritamkṛtā cedgarbhamānena tadvistāro viśiṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhāmni digdevatāḥ sthāpyāstaddevīrūpa vigrahāḥharmya koṇeṣu viṣabhaṃ siṃhaṃ vā parikalpayetprāsādasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pratiṣṭhā parikīrtitāprākāraparivārāṃśca maṇṭapādīṃśca kalpayetśrīrdurgā kṣmā śaśinyā ca gāyatrī cāpyuṣā tathāprajñā medhā śrutiścaiva smṛtiḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ ca vaiathavā jyeṣṭhayopetāssapta mātara - īritāḥmusalī mudgarī devī vardhamānī ca vā matāḥvṛṣo gaṇādhipaḥ skando mahāśāstā dhaneśvaraḥnai -ṛte vāgnideśe vā vighneśaṃ saṃprakalpayetnirmālyadhāriṇīṃ devīmaśanīmīśagocaremahāpiṭhe viśeṣeṇa sarvāścāpasarasaḥ sthitāḥpūjāśasadṛśaṃ vātha dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vāardhaṃ tadantareṣṭaṃśe navamānaṃ ca vā bhavetbhrūdṛgghrāṇāsyakarṇāntaṃ bāhukakṣastanāntakampratimāmānatastasyā mānamevaṃ samīriotamtataśceyaṃ prakartavyā devī proktapramāṇataḥdukūlavasanā devī karanḍamakuṭānvitādvibhujā vā dvinetrā vā pralambitakarānvitāśukotpalakarā vāpi śūlapāśakarāpi vādaṃṣṭrākarālavadanā pañcāsyā daśadoryutādevorusaṃsthitā vāpi sthānakāsanasaṃyutādevena sahitā vāpi kevalā vā prakīrtitāṛjvākārayutā vāpi dvibhaṅga sahitāthavāgulpamadhye sthitaṃ sūtraṃ śivasūtramiti smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prokṣite'streṇa saṃsthāpya pātraṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutamtithyaṃgulaṃ samārabhya vyomāṃgulavivṛddhitaḥvṛttamiṣṭaghanopetaṃ karṇikādalaśobhitamekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṭbhāgaiḥ karṇikā bhavetardhatripādamātraṃ vā dvimātraṃ karṇikocchrayamkuḍupadvayamārabhya kuḍupādāḍhakāvadhimadhvājya miśritaṃ vānnaṃ prakṣipetpātramadhyameekāṃgulaṃ tu dairghyaṃsyādyāvadaṣṭādaśāṃgulamagradvitricatuḥpañcamātraṃ ṣaṇmātrameva vātrikālamannaliṃgaṃ vā prātarmadhyāhnayostu vāpradoṣe'kṣataliṃgaṃsyāttatrapāśupataṃ yajettridhā pāśupato jñeyo miśraśśānto'grahetukaḥsaumyassaumyekṣaṇāpetaḥ dvicaturhasta saṃyutaḥdakṣe'bhayākṣamālāyugitare varapāśayukhitvā'kṣamālāṃ pāśañca padmaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ krameṇa vāśūlamūlābhaye dakṣe śūlāgravarade'nyataḥtriśūlākṣakaraṃ vāpi tridhā raudraṃ smaranyajetdakṣe pāśaṃ mṛgaṃ vāme tvanyathā vā nigadyatedakṣa dvidhā samākhyātaṃ miśraṃ pāśupataṃ tridhāathavā pratimākāro vidheyastatpramāṇataḥannaliṃga pramāṇe tu mūlāgrasamavistaresthalikāmānadaṇḍena sahitaṃ vā samarcayetpāduke tryaṃgule tasmādaṃgulāṃgulavardhanātdairghyānusārataḥ kāryo vistārasyārdha ucchrayaḥtayostu vṛṣabhaḥ pūjyastvananto vā prakīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatsūtraṃ nābhimadhyaṃ yadekāṅgulamiti smṛtamjānusūtrāntaraṃ proktaṃ guṇāṅgulamiti dvijāḥtattribhāgaikabhāgaṃ tu pāṣṇaryorantarakaṃ smṛtamnābhestu maṇibandhaḥ syāt sārdhaviśvāṅgulodvijāḥpralambitakarasyāgrādūrvagraṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulampārśvamadhyamabāhvośca madhyamaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulamsvatantre dvividhaṃ devyā mānaṃ śāstre pracoditamutsavādyaṅgadevīnāṃ mānaṃ yanmūlaberajāmaṅgeṣu mānaṃ sagrāhyaṃ jānūrūsamameva vāmanonmanīti gaurīti lakṣmabhedastu nānayoḥtadā manonmanīsaṃjñāṃ labhate viprasattamāḥkṛtvā salakṣaṇāṃ devīṃ mantraissaṃsthāpayettataḥmanonmanyā manuścāyaṃ hasthāne khāntayugyadivāntarepha mahāmāyā viṣṇvaṃśābhyāṃ yuto manuḥbindunāda śikhāmātraṃ devībījamidaṃ tu vāmantro'yaṃ haṃsasaṃyuktaḥ śrībījaṃ vā manurbhavetevaṃ mūlamanuḥ proktastasmin brahmāṅgakalpanāādiśaktimanurvāpi mūlamantra iti smṛtaḥkālaśca pūrvavadgrāhyastvaṅkurārpaṇameva catatpīṭhe madhyame haimaṃ pūrvataścendranīlakampuṣparāgaṃ ca gomedaṃ tathā marakataṃ dvijāḥakṣimokṣaṃ tu sauvarṇanakhavinyāsamācaretgodvijālokanaṃ dhānyamartyānāṃ caiva pūrvavatgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā jale caivādhivāsayetprasādasya caturdikṣu vahnāvīśe'tha maṇṭapāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatsaumye kalpayet samyak snānavedīṃ ca pūrvavatpuṇyodasecanaṃ vāstudevatānāṃ ca pūjanamjalādānīya tāṃ devīṃ snapanaṃ pūrvavannayetśayane śāyayeddevīṃ prāṅmastaka samanvitamdevyāḥ śiraḥpradeśe tu ghaṭaṃ prādhānikaṃ nyasetparito'ṣṭau ghaṭānnayastvā vāmādibhiradhiṣṭhitānātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ ca jānukaṇṭhaśiro'vadhikriyā jñānaṃ tathecchā ca tritattvādhīśvarī matādhātrī vibhvatī mūrtīśvariyuktā mūrtīstato nyasetgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ paścānnaivodyāntaiḥ kramādyajetgururmūrtidharaissārdhaṃ homa karma samārabhetvedapāṭhaścaturdikṣu koṇe mantrajapo bhavetsamādghṛtānnalājaiśca tilaissarṣapakairyavaiḥśamīkhadiramāyūra śrī vṛkṣā vahnikoṇataḥsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vāmūrtipāhutiruddiṣṭā brahmāṅgairaṣṭadikṣu casarvairdevaissamopetaṃ pradhāne tarpayedguruḥdarbhaissaṃsparśanaṃcaiva pratibhāgaṃ samācaretutthāpya devīṃ kuṃbhāṃśca prāgvadvahniṃ ca tarpayetmānuṣe daivike vāpi prāgvat saṃskṛtya vinyasetprāgvaddhāmnīśvarīṃ nītvā mūlamuccāryavinyasetcalācet snānavedyāṃ tu mantranyāsaṃ samācaretvinyasedanukuṃbhebhyaḥ pīṭhasya parito manūntattatkuṃbhodakaiścaiva tattaddeśe'bhiṣecayetstutvā neka vidhaiḥ stotrairamuṃ ślokaṃ paṭhettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvadatra tvayā devī sthātavyamiha mandireuttamādi vibhinnāṃ tu liṅgasthāpana coditāmdevyāḥ svayaṃ pradhānāyāssahajāyāśca varjayetitthaṃ yaḥ kurute martyassa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyātbhaktveha bhogān svasyeṣṭān so'nte yāyācchivaṃpadamśṛṇu dhvamatha viprendrā devyā nityārcanādikamprāgukta vidhinā kṛtvā praviśedālayaṃ pratisakalīkṛtadehastu samānyarghyaṃ prakalpya cadvārasya pārśvayoścaiva śaṃkha padmanidhī tathācūḍāmakuṭasaṃyuktau ratnaśyāmau vibhīṣaṇauūrdhvodumbaramadhyastha vāṇī mabhyarcya śākhayoḥanyathā vā viśālākṣīṃ jaṭilā mūrdhvagāṃ yajetsarasvatīṃ ca gaṅgāṃ ca śukla varṇa nibhe matekhaḍgakheṭaka dhāriṇyo dvibhujā vā caturbhujāḥkavāṭayossamabhyarcya praviśeddakṣavāmayoḥśaktisthaṃ svaṃ samāyojya bhūtaśuddhiṃ ca pūrvavatkaranyāsaṃ ca tairmantrairdehanyāsaṃ ca kārayetpañcamūrdhāsyayugdevyāḥ pūjāyāṃ saṃprakalpayetśaśinyādaya evoktāḥ kevalāstu kalā itidevī skanda gaṇeśādīn sarvān saṃpūjayettu vāhṛdaye'rcāvidhānaṃ tu nā bhau homaṃ prakalpayetsthānaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā viśeṣārghyaṃ ca kārayetsaṃśodhyātmānamabhyarcya mantraśuddhiṃ samācaretgaṇāmvikāyai vidmahe mahātapāyai dhīmahiiti mantraṃ samuccārya samabhyarcya nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devyastramuccaranmantrī beraśuddhiṃ vidhāya casudhācitrādikaṃ cettu karmārcā śuddhiriṣyatetatraivāmlāna mālā syāda nirvāṇa pradīpakamathavopalamūrtiścet kṣālanaṃ tatra kīrtyateananta dharma pūrvāśca dikṣvanantādi saṃhitamvāmādyaṃ maṇḍalānīkaṃ kriyecchājñāna śaktibhaiḥmūrti tadbrahmabhiḥ kṛtvā tatkalāḥ prāgvadācaretpraṇavāattatra deveśī māviṣkuryāt prasādataḥāvāhyamūlamantreṇa devyāssaṃsthāpayed dhṛdāhṛdādi nyāsataḥ kṛtvā mahāmudrāṃ pradarśayetvaktrecācamanaṃ dadyāt arghya mīśāna mantrataḥgandhapuṣpa samopetaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyād dhṛtāṇunāunmṛjya vāsasā paścādvāsamā pariveṣṭayetdīpaṃ mūlāṇunā datvā naivedyaṃ vinivedayetpūjayedāvṛttiṃ paścād hṛdayaṃ vahnigocareastraṃ dikṣvatha sampūjya vāmādyā vātha pūrvataḥekadvitricaturbhirvāvaraṇaistāṃ samarcayetnaivedyaṃ balihomāśca kṛtvā nityotsavaṃ nayetvaradābhayahastā ca śaṃkha cakra karā parāpuṣpānnākṣata liṅgeṣu medhāṃ prajñāmuṣāṃ yajetpādukārcanayuktaṃ vā praviśedālayaṃ pratitadarthaṃ kalpayetteṣu yatheṣṭaṃ beramuttamamṣaṭsaptavasukālaṃ vā sarvadā tvarcayecchivāmutsavaṃ snapanaṃ caiva damanārohaṇakriyāmsaṃvatsādikhelāṃ ca vasantākhyaṃ tadutsavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśeṣāt pūrakarmāpi prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamāḥkiṃ tūtsave dhvaje siṃhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vā samālikhetśivotsave'pi devyāstu pratyahaṃ cotsavo mataḥcakrāstraṃ vā triśūlaṃ vā devyastra parigṛhyatāmkṛtakautuka devyāstu tadgrāmānnirmago nahianyatrāpi ca yānaṃ vā dhāmni sarvaṃ tu vā matamsarva deveṣu sāmānyaṃ vidhānamidamagrajāḥdigdeva mūrtisaṃyuktaṃ madhye kuṃbha samanvitamasyāḥ pratiṣṭhā sarvatra bālasthānānvitā na vātasmāddevyagrataḥ kuryāt tvabhiṣekaṃ nṛpasyatupurādāvaṣṭadikṣvanta vāntarāle tadālayaḥcaityavṛkṣādi deśeṣu tanmūle vākhilālayeyatheṣṭadiśi vaktraṃ syādvighneśasya hi kīrtitamekādi navabhūmyantabhūmibhāga samanvitamdikṣu vighneśvaropetaḥ koṇe mūṣikasaṃyutaḥpūrvavatkṛtasadgarbhaḥ prathameṣṭakayānvitaḥdhāmnassaṃsthāpanenāpi yuktaḥ prāguktavartmanāmaṇṭapo vālayastasya kūṭādyākāra eva vāviśvarūpaṃ viśālākṣamakṣayaṃ madavibhramamasyāṣṭamūrtīśānvāṣṭapīṭhānidrādyadhiṣṭhitāndvārapau kalpayeddvāri vikaṭaṃ bhīmameva caāmodaśca pramodaśca sumukho durmukhastathāete'ṣṭamūrtipāḥ khyātāstvanyathā ca nigadyatevināyakaikadantau ca bhakṣyapriyo'hi mekhalaḥdvārasthau dvārapau kāryau bhūtarūpau dvibāhukau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ugradaṃṣṭrānvitau siṃhakandharasthaikapādakaudhūmravarṇastathā cākhū raktanetrassudaṃṣtravānkumbhodaraścaturhastaṣṭaṅkaśūlāsidaṇḍadhṛkśvetavarṇā bṛhatkāyā ugrāścirāmbarānvitāḥparivārā iti khyātā gaṇeśābhimukhasthitāḥbalipīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ pūrvavat parikalpayetbhūteśaḥ karṇikāyāṃ ca lokapāstrāṇi bāhyataḥdravyaiśśilādibhiḥ kuryāt pañcatālottamena tutriṃśadbhagāvasānāntaṃ garbhamānamudāhṛtampratimālakṣaṇaproktamānaṃ liṅgādijaṃ tu vāuṣṇīṣamekamātreṇa tatkeśaṃ dvayaṅgulena tutato hṛdayaparyantaṃ rudrāṅgulamiti smṛtamtathaiva tasmājjānvantaṃ jānvāyāmaṃ guṇāṅgulamkeśāntādakṣisūtrāntaṃ caturaṅgulamiṣyate / mucyatedantāyāmācaturmātraṃ mūlanāhaṃ tathaiva camastake kumbhavistāraṃ pratyekaṃ tu guṇāṅgulamkarṇau ca daśamātrau syāt tattāraṃ nandamānakamkakṣāttu cordhvabāhvantaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulamiti smṛtamhṛdayānnābhisīmāntaṃ daśāṅgulamihocyateaṣṭāṅgulaṃ dvayorūrvorjānunī cāṅgulatrayejagavaktro gaṇādhīśo bhūtarūpo mahodaraḥnīlanīraruhābhastu caturdordaṇḍamaṇḍitaḥsvadantaṃ paraśuṃ kuryāt svadakṣiṇakaradvayeraktavastradharaṃ vātha śyāmābhaṃ kanakaprabhamśuklayajñopavītaṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthānakaṃ vāsanaṃ vātha gaṇeśaṃ kārayettataḥpadmasthaṃ vāpi pīṭhasthaṃ mūṣikasthamathāpi vāevaṃ syāt kevalo vighnarājaśśaktyānvito'thavāśaktyaikayā yuto devo yadi tallakṣma kathyateśyāmavarṇāṃ tathā śaktiṃ dhārayantaṃ digambaramdigambarāṃ suvadanāṃ bhujadvaya samanvitāmpāśahastāṃ tathā guhyaṃ dakṣiṇena kareṇa tucaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ prabhumspṛśantaṃ puṣkareṇāpi khaṇḍamikṣostu he dvijāḥdvitīyasya tṛtīyaṃ yadādyasvarasamanvitamtrayodaśāntasaṃpannamathavā parikalpayethṛllekhāsaṃpuṭopetaṃ bījaṃ syāt tryakṣaraṃ dvijāḥpañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgāni mūlamantravaśānnayetnamaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭkāra huṃ vauṣaḍbhirhṛdādayaḥdvitīyasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhavargāntameva catasya dvitīyamādyaṃ ca sacaturdaśavarṇakamdvitīyasya tṛtīyaṃ tu brahmāṇyaṅgāni coddharetvaradaṃ tu samuccārya varadadvitayaṃ vadetsvāhāpadaṃ tatastviṣṭaṃ mantraḥ śaktyanvitasya hihṛllekhāsaṃpuṭo mantrastvatha kāraṇakāryayukikṣūdadhistataḥ svarṇadvīpaṃ kalpadrumastataḥdakṣahastasya mūlaṃ tu nāsāyāmūrdhni vinyasetaparā mūlamudrākhyā madhyamāṃ tu prasārayetaṅguṣṭhaṃ śṛṅgavatkṛtvā mudraiṣā mūlasaṃjñitātataḥ pratiṣṭhā kartavyā cāṅkurārpaṇapūrvikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañca tatsaṃkhyahemnātha haimasūci samanvitamkṛtvā padmasya saṃghātaṃ netramokṣaṇamācaretsuvarṇanakhadhānyaudhapracchannapaṭakādibhiḥberaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā grāmādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇamparito'ṣṭau nyaset kumbhānāśeśairapyadhiṣṭhitānyamāpyenduṣu vā padmanibhakuṇḍādimaṇḍitamtāni vṛttāni cāśrāṇi digaśrāṇi munīśvarāḥmaṇḍapaṃ kalpayitvaivaṃ prāguktena ca vartmanāpuṇyāhaprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā vāstuhomaṃ tu kārayetjalādānīya vighneśaṃ snānavedyāṃ tu vinyasetkautukaṃ bandhayitvānte mantraṃ sarvātmakaṃ paṭhanavastrairvā pañcabhiśśuddhaistasmiṃstaṃ śāyayeddhṛdāvināyakaśirodeśe sūtrakūrcasamanvitampañcaratnodakaṃ vātha hemamāṣodakaṃ tu vāvastrahemādi samyuktān pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥkumbhamiṣṭva tu pūrvoktadhyānayuggandhapuṣpakaiḥāmodapramukhānvāpi naivedyāntairguruttamāḥsaikā ceduttare nyasya tatra tāmarcayet punaḥnyasya gandhādibhiśceṣṭvā tadīśāṃśca kramādyajetuktvā tenaiva mārgeṇa śivavidyeśvarānnyasetindrādyā hastivaktrādyā āmodādyāstu vādhipāḥmūrtibrahmaṣaḍaṅgāni vidyādehaṃ ca mūlakampūrvokta bhūṣaṇopetaśśivavipra kulodbhavaḥvedapāṭhaścaturdikṣu koṇe mūlajapo bhavetdikṣu tatpuruṣādīṃśca koṇeṣu hṛdayādyaṇūn
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āvāhyābhyarcya gandhādyairdravyairebhiśca tarpayettattvatattveśahomaṃ ca mūrtimūrtīśvarairnayetdarbhasaṃsparśanaṃ cetthaṃ pratibhāgaṃ samācaretuddhṛtya vighnarājānaṃ kumbhānagniṃ ca tarpayetdatvā pūrṇāhutiṃ paścāt praviśedbhavanaṃ guruḥkaśilāṃ pūrvamantreṇa ratnauṣadhyādigarbhitāmprāgvannyasya gaṇeśānaṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccarancalaṃ cet snapanavedyāṃ mantranyāso bhaveddvijāḥvinyasedanyakumbhebhyaḥ pīṭhasya parito manūntattvamūrtyādivinyāsaṃ pūrvavat kārayettataḥgaṇeśo bhāratī śrībhyāṃ yuto yadi munīśvarāḥvighneśvarīyutaśceddhi tannāmnā sthāpayettu tāmtāsāṃ hṛdi viśeṣeṇa tataḥ sthāpanamācaretāyuṣkāmo labhedārdhanārthi ceddhanāni caputrān saubhāgyamārogyaṃ yaśovīryaṃ śriyaṃ śubhabhaṃtasyārcanaṃ ca saṃkṣopāchṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥsandhyāyā vandanaṃ mantratarpaṇaṃ prāgvadeva tuācāntassakalīkṛtya sāmānyārghyakaro guruḥdevoktānvā subāhuṃ ca vimalaṃ talpayoryajetvāstvīśaṃ ca samabhyarcya svāsanastha udṅmukhaḥtadudbhūtāmṛtenādrīṃkṛtakāya samanvitaḥīśāsyaghoravāmājān karajeṣu tale dṛśāmjyeṣṭhādiṣu karāgreṣu punarmūlaṃ ca bhāvayetekatriṃśatkalānyāsaṃ devavat parikalpayetgaṇeśānavadātmānaṃ dhyātvāntaryajanaṃ nayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iṣṭvā hutvā gaṇeśānaṃ dhyātvā hṛnnābhibinduṣugandhapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ pūrvadravyayutaṃ na vāsaṃprokṣyārghyajalenaiva pratyekaṃ dravyasaṃhitammantraśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā beraśuddhiṃ tato nayetityuktvā hastivaktrāya dhīmahīti padaṃ tataḥityuccaraṃstato'rghyeṇa sāmānyārghyeṇa vārcayettyajedvāberasaṃśuddhiṃ kārayeduktavartamanācitrādikaṃ cet karmārcāśuddhyā śuddhirmatā dvijāḥkṛtvetthamātmabhūdravyamantrabimbaviśodhanamadharmādīnadhaścordhvacchadane padmamantarāśaktyanvitaścettasyoktamārgeṇāsanamācaretmūrtimāvāhya tāṃ prāgvaddehaṃ saṃklpya mantrakaiḥhṛdayānugatenaiva puṣpāpūritasatkaraḥhṛdādyaṇubhirastrāntairmahāmudrāṃ pradarśayetarghyamīśaṃ smarandatvā gandhapuṣpaṃ sadhūpakamunmṛjya vāsasā paścādvāsasā paridhāpayetpiṣṭvā karpūrasaṃyuktān kevalaṃ candanaṃ tu vālaghucandananiryāsakarpūrairdhūpameva vātatkṣaṇapratibuddhāni prāgvat puṣpāṇi dāpayetnaivedyaṃ dāpayetpaścānmudgānnādiyutaṃ na vāpūjayedāvṛtiṃ paścāddhūpadānāvasānaketadbāhye hastivaktrādīnāmodapramukhānathaekena vā yajeddvābhyāṃ tribhirvāvaraṇairgaṇamnaivedyabalihomāṃśca kārayet pūrvavartmanāmūlena śatapañcāśaddaśasaṃkhyena vā guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navānnaliṃgasaṃyuktamatha nityotsavaṃ nayetdvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhiḥ vā pūrvāh ṇe ca pradoṣakeraṃge vā śibikāyāṃ vā paricārakamūrdhasuchatracāmarasaṃyuktaṃ nānādhvajasamanvitamdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ samācaretvṛṣasya brahmatālaṃ syādagnestālantu bhṛṃgiṇīṣaṇmukhasyodghaṭañcaiva jyeṣṭhāyāḥ kuñcitatālakamgrāme vā nagare vāpi tathā prākāra eva vāekaṃ vāpi dvayaṃ vāpi trayaṃ syācchabarīyutamgaṇatālena saṃyuktaṃ dvayaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇamgopure vādyahīnaṃ vā śaṃkhadhvanisamanvitambaddhāvaṇaṃ bhavedagneḥ kolligānasamanvitammallatālaṃ samākhyātaṃ naiṛtyāṃ naṭṭabhāṣayāvāyavyāṃ balitālantu takkeśīsvarasaṃyutamśālā pāṇisamāyuktaṃ śāṃkare ḍhakkarī matāpakṣālitāṃghrayassarve praviśeyuśśivālayampādyādyairupacāraistu pūjayitvā praveśayetśivasya pādau pūjyau pāduke vāmadakṣiṇaurūpāntaraṃ vā svādhyāya siddhannityotsavārthakamtadastramannaliṃgādau pūjanīyaṃ svavāhanampādukā dvitaye pūjyamanyatsarvaṃ samānakamdhvajārohāvarohāntā kriyā utsava ucyatetīrtharkṣamādau niścitya tatpūrve triguṇepi vāmāsabhaṃ tīrthanakṣatramārdrakṣaṃ sarvamāsakemāghamāse tu ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ parvāntaṃ sarvamāsake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryādgaṇabereṇa vartmanāpuṣpānnākṣataliṅgeṣu gaṇāstraṃ hetinā yajetpūrvoktavidhinā kṛtvā prāsādasya pradakṣiṇamekakālaṃ dvikālam vā tricatuṣpañcakālakamjñātvaivaṃ pūjayennityamarcanāṅgairgaṇeśvaramviśeṣayajanaṃ kuryāccaturthyāmiṣṭasiddhayesnapanaṃ pūrvavat kiṃ tu madhyakumbhe gaṇeśvaramaṣṭau ca navasaṃkhye syuḥ pañcaviṃ'satisaṃkhyakelokapāstrān vasūnādyānaṣṭakaṃ vāstu saṃsthitoekonapañcāśatsaṃkhyakalaśe devatā matāḥaṣṭādhikasahasre tu sarvadevāḥ prakīrtitāḥvākśrīyuto gaṇeśaścedvardhanīdvitayaṃ nyasetanuktaṃ snapaneyattu prāgvadeva samācaretdīpāvali vasantejyā māse māsotsavaṃ tu vājīrṇānāmuddhṛtiṃ cānyat pūrvavat parikalpayetśivotsvae'pi nityaṃ tu vighneśasyotsavaṃ tu vācakrāstraṃ vā triśūlāstraṃ vighneśāstraṃ pragṛhyatāmutsave tu balidravyahomadravyādayo'pi yevaśyoccāṭanavidhveṣamāraṇāni ca pauṣṭikamsarvavyādhisamutpattau mantreṇānena śāntayetvighneśaṃ sthāpayedvādau śivadhāmaprakalpanātcaturbhujāstriṇetraśca saṃvikīrṇa jaṭāyutaḥpṛṣṭhagāḥ pārśvagāstāssyuḥ pañcādyaikakavṛddhitaḥdhuttūrāragvadhārkādi puṣpayuktāssapiṅgalāḥvālacandreṇa saṃyukto vāmapārśvasthitena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyāghrājināmbaro dīptassarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥdivyāmbarānvito vāpi mṛgājinayutopi vādhṛta vārāhadantāgra śārdūlanakhakacchapaiḥsthito dakṣiṇapādena vāmenoparivartināambikāmukhabiṃbābja bhramarīkṛtalocanaḥvāmadakṣiṇakarṇāḍhya patrikā nakrakuṇḍalaḥvāmāparakarasthena vahninā dakṣakena tugokṣīradhavalaprakhya ādityāṅgulabhaṅgayukmūrdhno lalāṭadakṣasthaṃ nāsādakṣapuṭasthitamlalāṭa madhya sūtrāttu dvimātramitikīrtitamśroṇīvāmorusaṃspṛṣṭaṃ tatsūtramihasaṃmatamsūtrāddhi natajānvantaṃ bhānudignandamātrakamtatsūtrādvāmajānvake catvāriṃśaddaśāṅgulamsūtrāttu savyakukṣistu ravyaṅgula udāhṛtaḥsūtrāttadvāmabhāgetu navamātramudīritamsūtrāttu dakṣiṇaḥ kaṇṭho bhāga ityabhidhīyateathavānyaprakāreṇa sūtrapātobhidhīyatenābheśca dakṣamātrāntaṃ sthitāṅghrergulphamadhyamamsūtrādvāme mukhaṃ pañcamātraṃ kaṇṭha trimātrakammadhyodare'ṣṭamātraṃ syācchroṇī viśvāṅgulena canavamātraṃ tadūruḥsyāt rpāṣṇyantaṃ vedatuṅgakambāhvante tu trimātraṃ syāt kakṣānte viśvamātrakamkaṭyāṃ ca vedamātra syājjānuraṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavetsthitajānusamaṃ vidyāt vartitāṅghre samucchrayaḥśroṇīsamuccharayaṃ vāmājānoruddharaṇaṃ matam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tajjānordaṇḍahastasya maṇi bandhāntaraṃ manuḥtasya cāṅguṣṭhamūlāntāt stanākṣāddvyantaraṃ mukhamsaptadaśāṅgulaṃ vidyāddaṇḍahastasya korparamvistāraḥ kolakastasya śikhābhistisṛbhiryutaḥdhāturḍamarukāyāmo bhūtaistu mukhavistṛtiḥeka jihvāsamāyukto gambhīra dhvani saṃyutaḥapasmārocchrayaṃ bhānurudra nandāṣṭa mātrakamvaktradvayaṃ samārabhya pañcavaktrāvasānakamcatustālena kartavyamapasmāro dvijottamāḥuṣṇīṣāt keśaparyantaṃ kolakaṃ ceti kīrtitamgalamardhāṅgulaṃ prokta madhyardhaṃ karṇa ucyatetathaiva tasmānnābhyantaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulamiti smṛtamūrvāyāmaṃ tu saptāṃśaṃ jānūtsedho dvimātrakaḥdvibhujaśca dvinetraśca ūrdhvakāyastvadhomukhaḥāvṛtālaṃkṛtābhaṅgī savyapārśvaśiroyutaḥdvibhujāca triṇetrā ca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitāūrdhvabhāgādadhobhāgaṃ toyakāreṇa kārayetprabhāvakāśavistāro daśādhikataśatāṅgulamekādi daśaparyanta mātrairūṇādhi kāpi vātadvaśāt pārśvagāṃ devīṃ kalpayettadvidhānataḥbhujaṅgātrāsa ākhyāto bhujaṅgalalitastataḥuddhṛtasya talaṃ kuryāt sthitajānurdhvataḥ kramātbhujaṅgalalitaḥ khyātastadbhairava ihocyateuddhṛtaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu vā nayetcaturbhujo'ṣṭahasto vā nānādivyāstrabhūṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itthaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ pratiṣṭhā tata ucyateratnanyāsākṣimokṣau ca pūrvavatsamyagācaretjalādhivāsanaṃ paścānmaṇḍapaṃ pūrvavannayetcaturaśrāṇi vṛttāni taddigaśrāṇi vā nayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayetpaścanmaṇḍāpasya viśuddhayevāstuhomaṃ vinā vāpi bhūparigrahamācaretśayanaṃ kalpayedūrdhve pratimāṃ śodhayattataḥśirapradeśe devasya śivāsyaṃ tu dhaṭaṃ nyasetlakṣaṇodita rūpaṃ tu dhyātvā gandhādibhiryajetarcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ naivedyāntaṃ guruttamaḥhomaṃ samārabhet kāle mūrtipaissaha deśikaḥsamidājya carūn lājān sarṣapaṃ ca yavaṃ tilamūduṃbaravaṭāśvattha plakṣāḥpūrvādidikṣu capradhānasya palāśastu samidhaścaivamīrtitāḥgeyanṛttayutaistotra vedaghoṣairvyapohya casamūrtipoguruḥsnāto mantrasaṃśuddhadehayukvyapohya vastrakūrcādīn pūjayet gandhapuṣpakaiḥpūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt vauṣaḍanta śivena tudakṣiṇā pūrvavatproktā tataḥ sthāpanamārabhetcalaṃ prāsādamadhye tu sthāpayedacalaṃ guruḥharmya pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā pratimāgraṃ nayedbudhaḥvardhanyā bījamādāya tatpīṭhābje tu vinyasetdevīyāgoktamārgeṇa devīṃ ca sthāpayed guruḥutsavaṃ kārayetpaścāt tathā vitānusārataḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ bhāvanāyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa yāyāt padamaiśānaṃ bhuktvā bhogānihaiva tutallakṣaṇa samāyuktaṃ taccedānīṃ prakathyatesarvābharaṇa saṃyukto varadābhayahastakaḥasavyasavyakarṇastha patrikānakrakuṇḍalaḥsālambadakṣapādena vāmegauryā ca saṃyutaḥlalāṭa nāsikānābhimendrapādgulpamadhyamemukhāntāt pippalīmūlāt grīvāpārśvāttathaiva cauṣṇīṣāttukakudvaṃśa kaṇṭhasphik madhyamādgatamhitvāpārśvadvayoścaiva tatassyā dūrudairghyakamsūtrāttuvāmajanvāntaṃ mūrdhvakāyārdhamānakamtalāgrādūrumadhyācca dvayantarantu guṇāṃgulamkaṭakānmaṇibandhādhodeśe kaṭayagrasīmagamvaradaṃ cettu tatpṛṣṭhānnābhyantasamamiṣyatesasomassoma eva syāt somāskanta vidhirbhavettrivedabhāgairvā kuryāt skandaṃ tanmadhyame guruḥkarṇayornakrapiṇḍau tu sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥdvihastapaṅkajo vātha vṛttarūpayuto'thavāāsīno vā sthito vāpi skandastvevaṃ prakīrtitaḥsome ca somāskande ca sukheśe lakṣaṇaṃ matamratnanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddevadevyośca vai guhetattatpratiṣṭhādhyāyoktamantrairapi samanvitamdṛśāmunmokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā beraśuddhiṃ pradakṣiṇamdiga"rāṇyābhavṛttāni vedāśrāṇi ca vānayetśilpinaṃ ca visṛjyātha viprān saṃbhojayettataḥśayanaṃ kalpayenmadhye snapanaṃ kārayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vastraiśca pṛthagāveṣṭya kumbhān saṃsthāpayettataḥvinyasya vardhanīṃ somāskandaśceddakṣiṇeghaṭamlakṣaṇoditarūpābhidhyānādhikṛtadhīrguruḥtattadadhyāyamārgeṇa tattvamūrtyādikaṃ nayettilasasyendramudgaiśca homaṃ ca vidhinā nayetśamīkhadiramāyūra śrīvṛkṣotthā iheritāḥṣaṇmukhaṃ ca devīṃ pradhāne tarpayedguruḥdvitīye devakumbhāgnīṃstarpayet pūrvavartmanāvastrahemāṅgulīyādipūjito gururādarātvardhanyāstata uddhṛtya tasya pīṭhe tu vinyasetguhakumbhādguhārṇaṃ taṃ guhasya hṛdi vinyasetete vibhinnapīṭhāścet pṛthaṅmaṇṭapamācaretanuktamatra yat kuryātsāmānyasthāpanoktavatsa yāsyati vivenaikyamiha siddhiṃ ca so'śruteāpādya ca śilādīni taiḥ kuryāt pratimāṃ guruḥvarābhaya samāyuktaḥ pūrvastha kara pallavaḥvaradaṃ yadi taṃ kuryāt athānyaḥ siṃhakarṇakaḥmṛgaṭaṅka karāvanyau dossīmāntaṃ vyavasthitauparāṅkukhau saṃmukhau cā mṛgaṭaṅkau samīritauhikkāyāḥ kartarī madhyameka triṃśadthāṅgulamśroṇyantāt kūrparā darvāgantaraṃ pūrvahastayoḥstanāntamabhayāntoccaṃ nābhyūrdhve puṣkarodayaḥstanāntā dabhayāgrāntaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamiṣyateūrumūle kaṭakāntaṃ spṛṣtaṃ vātha guṇāntaramūrvādi madhya mātrāṇāṃ jānvorapyantaraṃ kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athavā jānumadhyāttu sārdhāṅgulamiti smṛtamaṅguṣṭheyordvayormadhyaṃ vidyeśaṅgula mīrittamtatpār'svayostrisūtrāṇi mukhakarṇa bhujāvadhipralambaphalakāmūdhni sthāpayitvā valambayetsūtraṃ purasthitaṃ nāsākukṣisparśaṃ yathā bhavetkarṇa kaṇṭha stanānāṃ tu bāhye śroṇispṛgeva caevaṃ pārśve trisūtrāṇi lambayet deśikottamaḥmastakāllambanīyaṃ syādyathā pṛṣṭakakudgatamuṣṇīṣa bhūṣaṇaṃ kuryāt trimātreṇa viśeṣataḥmadhye makarakūṭaṃ syāt saptakoṭara saṃyutamagre daśāṃgulaṃ tasya mūle tu mukhavistaramvāme mahāphaṇiṃ tasya sarvālaṃkāra bhūṣitamekadhā tu tridhāvṛtyā śeṣābhiḥ pārśvalambanamratna patrikayā vāpi śaṅkha patrikayāpi vāsavyaṃ makara siṃhākhya patra kuṇḍalakairyutampārśvayobāgumūlānta jaṭāgrāṇāṃ vilambanamvakṣasthalaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhujāḥ keyūra saṃyutāḥmuktā dāma vilambāśca tadagre maṇibhūṣaṇamchannavīrottarīyopavītaissodara bandhanaḥsaṃyuktakaṭisūtro'ntaḥ pādajālaka saṃyutaḥsāpīṭha bhinnapīṭhā vā devenāliṅgitāthavāāliṃgana yuto vā syānnirābhaṅgo'thavā matraḥkālo'pi prāgvaduddiṣṭa stadvadevāṅkurārpaṇamjalādhivāsanaṃ paścāt maṇḍapaṃ pūrvavannayettaddigastrāṇi vṛttāni kuṇḍānyaśrāṇi vā nayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samarīcapade vāstu homaḥ kāryo dvijottamāḥsnapanaṃ kautukaṃ śayyārohaṇaṃ pṛthagācaretlakṣaṇodita rūpaṃ ca smarannabhyarcayettayoḥnyasyaiva tatvamūrtyādīn prāgvaddhomaṃ samācaretlājasasyendrakaiścaiva vaṭoduṃbara saṃjñakauśamyapāmārga śrīvṛkṣa māyūrā vahnikoṇataḥprabhāte devakuṃbhāgnīn abhyarcya gururādarātsaṃprāpta dakṣiṇaḥ prāgvat mantranyāsaṃ samācaretdevasya hṛdi tatpīṭhe vardhanyāstu manuṃ nyasetanyebhyo vinyasedbījaṃ pīṭhasya paritastataḥkalyāṇaṃ kārayedante snapanaṃ cotsatvaṃ tathāatrānuktaṃ tu saṃgrāhyaṃ sāmānyasthāpanoditambabdhveha sarva kāmāṃstu sa cānte mokṣamāpnuyātcaturbhujastriṇeśca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutaḥsavyakarṇasthamakarakuṇḍalena samanvitaḥdhanurbāṇayutopeta vāmetarakarānvitaḥnābhestumaṇibandhāntaṃ mātramekonaviṃśatiḥdormūlātparahastāntaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgula īritaḥśirasovāmadṛk kṛṣṇa maṇḍalasya ca dakṣiṇedakṣiṇasthitapāde ca purastānmuni puṃgavāḥsavyegnibhāgā devaṃ syāt sama bhāge sthirānatiḥkuryāt salakṣaṇāṃ vātha vāmabhāge tu pārvatīmsumuhūrte sulagne ca kṛttvaivāṃkura karma catoyādhivāsanaṃ paścāt snapanaṃ kotukaṃ nayetkuṇḍāṇyaśrāṇi vṛttāni taddigaśrāṇi tāni vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deveśasya śirodeśe śivakuṃbhaṃ ca vardhanīmabhitoṣṭaghaṭānyasvā vidyeśāṃstatra pūjayettatvamūrtyādi vinyāsaṃ kṛtvāhomaṃ samācaretpalāśoduṃbarāśvattha vaṭāḥ prāgādi dikṣu capradhānasya palāśasyāt sa ca sarvatra vāmataḥtato dvitīya divase devakuṃbhāgnitarpaṇamsumuhūrte tataḥ prāpte manunyāsaṃ samācaretvardhanyābījamādāya tat pīṭhe vinyaset guruḥvibhinnapīṭhā cettasyāḥ pṛthak maṇḍapamācaretutsavaṃ bhūrinaivedyaṃ kārayedvā na vā guruḥpratiṣṭhaivaṃ samākhyātā purāreriṣṭadāyinīsoneka bhogān bhuktveha yāyādante śivaṃ padamgarbhamānavaśālliṃgaṃ prāgvat samyak prakalpayettatsamaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tyaktvā cordhve tadantareliṃgādho śarvajānvanta bhāganneṃdriya gocarambiṃbasyānana mānena kārayet haṃsamādarāttalliṃgarasabhāgaika dvitrivedaśarairnayettiryaggata supādau tau sarvāvayavasundaraubrahmaviṣṇūvihīno vā haṃsa sūkara saṃyutaḥkālaśca pūrvavat grāhyaḥ tadvadevāṃkurārpaṇamkuṇdāni paritośrāṇi nava pañcaika saṃkhyayānayanonmīlanaṃ paścāt beraśuddhimanantarambhūṣaṇaṃ maṇḍapasyaiva vāstuhomamataḥ paramvedyūrdhve sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śayanaṃ kalpayettataḥkṛtvā kautuka bandhantu śāyayecchayanopari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe caiva viṣṇuṃ vāme tu śāyayetpradhānakuṃbhaṃ teṣāṃ tu śiro bhāge tu vinyasetabhitaścaghaṭānaṣṭau nyasyavidyeśvarātmakānrūpasaṃsthāna bhāvaistu pūjayitvā yathāvidhiprāgvat devasya tatvādyāḥ kaviṣṇostu yathoditamsamidannājyalājaiśca tilasarṣapavaiṇavaiḥśamyapāmārgaśrīvṛkṣa māyūrāvahni koṇataḥdravyairebhiḥ kramāt hutvā brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumeva carātriśeṣaṃ vyapohyātha prabhāte vimale tataḥbiṃbānuddhṛtya saṃpūjya kubhān kuṇḍeṣu pāvakānvedyāḥ kuṃbhān samuddhṛtya tadagresthaṇḍile nyasetvardhanyābījamādāya pādadeśobhiṣecayetbrahmaviṣṇvossvabījantu tadvannyasyābhiṣecayetbiṃbān saṃsthāpayet paścāt brahmāṇandakṣiṇe guruḥanuktamatra sāmānya pratimāsthāpanoktavatihaiva dhanavān dhīmān sonte sāyujyamāpnuyātvyākyāna geya yogeṣu niṣṭhasya trividhasya cadvābhyāṃ virahito yogī sa nānākāra bhedataḥśvetavidrumahemābhaśśyāmābho vā prakīrtitāḥuttarīya samopetaḥ śukla yajñopavītakaḥpaṭṭikābandhano vāpi satkaroṭikayāyutaḥpañcamudrāsamopeto gaṃgā kiṃkiṇi saṃyutaḥvyāghracarmopariṣṭāttu sthito vīrāsano'thavāvāmāṃghrinālakaṃ kuryāt savyahastantumudrayādvātriṃnnṛttamātrāntaṃ dairghyaṃ syāt satu pustakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtāṣṭamyantamanyeṣāṃ svasvatīrthāvasānakamadhivāsanapūrvantu dhvajamāropayet guruḥmānametat samākhyātaṃ śiraḥ pucchāntare dvijāḥbhāgaṃ kṛtvaikabhāgena paṭavistāra ucyatevistārārdhaṃ śiro jñeyaṃ pucchadvayasamanvitamāyādi śubhasaṃyuktaṃ sthitaṃ vā śayanānvitamraktaśṛṃgasamāyuktaṃ tadvat khurasamanvitamviśvāmitrādi ṣaṭtriṃśanmātrotsadhasamanvitamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ svarṇamālāsamanvitampadmāsanasamāyuktaṃ pārśve dīpadvayānvitampūrṇakumbhayutaṃ vāpi triśūlena yutannavāastra toyena saṃprokṣya śivāgre maṇṭapepi vāsthālikordhve nyasetpātraṃ tripādyuparisaṃsthitamsāpidhānaṃ sasūtrañca madhyame vṛṣabhādhipamsalokapaissakūrcaistu vṛtaṃ vṛṣabhapūrvakamvṛṣāsanapadañcoktvā caturthyantaṃ hṛdānvitamvṛkāraṃ hṛtpuṭaṃ kṛtvā vṛṣamūrtiṃ prakalpayetsaṃkalpitahṛdādīṃśca krameṇa viniveśayetāvāhanādikaṃ pūrvaṃ pramukhaṃ vṛṣamūlataḥmadhyakumbhe'pi saṃpūjya lokapān parito yajetnirīkṣaṇādi saṃskāraiśśivāgniṃ saṃprakalpayetsāmidājyena caruṇā śatenāṣṭottareṇa capūrṇāndatvā samūlena sarvakāmaprapūraṇīmpaṭasthāya ghaṭasthāya vṛṣāyāsana rūpiṇemukhavāsanatāmbūlaṃ vṛṣabhāya nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varadantaṃ vijānīyājjānustha maṇibandhakamvikasat padmasaṃkāśaḥ adhastādvistṛtāṃguliḥpadmaṃ vā cotpalaṃ vāpi vyālaṃ vā metu kalpayetnāsāgradṛṣṭiyuk vāmahasto vā syātsupustakaḥsūtraṃ vāme ca hṛdayaṃ nābhermeḍhrāt krameṇa tulaṃbapādasthitaṃ madhya sūtrādardhāṃgulāntaresadaśāṃguṣṭha mūlocca stanāgrāvadhireva tunābhestu maṇibandhāntaḥ dhṛtyaṃgulamudāhṛtaḥnābhestumaṇibandhāntaṃ sasyādekonaviṃśatiḥparasyamaṇibandhācca bhujamadhyādbhavāṃgulamhikkāsūtra dvimātrātha kaṭakāgra samucchrayātatat kalāsamopetā śśukla yajñopavītinaḥkauśikaḥ kāśyapaśśyāma itaraḥ pīta varṇakaḥeṣāmekadvayaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vā pārśvayornyasetūrdhvādvomadhya kaṭakau savyāsavyakarāvubhaudakṣiṇekaṭakañcorū sthitāyāṃ viniveśayetbhāgamagrantadāvāmo bhāgādhika caturmukhaḥkalāvakrāsya vistārā yāmaṃ vāpi ṣaḍaṃgulamhastasyamaṇibandhāntaṃ hikkāsūtrāditaḥ kramātānābherantaraṃnālaṃ śeṣaṃ sarvantu pūrvavattatrākṣipāta yegena sadākuñcita locanaḥathakuñcitavāmāṃghri yugmasphiggatapārṣṇikaḥsaṃdarśadṛṣṭipātaśca ābhaṃgañcaiva pūrvavatnānāmunigaṇaissārdhaṃ siddhavidyā dharairapiśailaṃkuryāttutatpārśve vaṭavṛkṣastu śādvalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
