sanskrit: tanmūle dakṣiṇe chāyā niṣṇṇaḥ kṛpayāyutaḥāsīnomunibhiḥ samyak kauśikādibhirādarātāgamāhita cetobhiḥ parameśena dīkṣitaiḥvyākhyāyuk jñānataḥ prokto geyayuk bhuktidomataḥāsīno vā sthito vāpi ṛṣibhiḥ ssaṃvṛto na vābhūtasthalaṃba vā dakṣiṇeśassamīritaḥvārādyaṃ pūrvavat grāhyamaṃkurārpaṇameva cakuṇḍāni parito śrāṇi taddigaśrāṇi vā bhavetgrāmapradakṣiṇañcaiva jale caivādhivāsanampuṇyāhaṃ vāstu homañca bhūparigrahameva vāvedyūrdhvesthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śayanaṃ kalpayet pṛthakśayyāyāṃ śāyayeddevaṃ kauśikādi ṛṣīnathaśāyayedvastrakūrcādi bhūṣitāṃstān pṛthak pṛthaksvāṃstukuṃbhān śirodeśe nyasedvastrādi bhūṣitānabhitovasukuṃbhāṃstu vidyeśādhiṣṭhitānnyasettatvamūrtyādi vinyāsaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ samācaretkṛtvāgnikuṇḍasaṃskāra mutpādyaśivapāvakamjuhuyāttu mahāśāsu pradhānepi palāśakamdravyairebhiḥ kramāt hutvā pūrṇāhutyavasānakamsamūrtipairguruḥsnātaḥ kṛtamantrādhivigrahaḥdeśikādīṃśca saṃpūjya dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayet pṛthakkuṃbhān biṃbapuronyasya sthaṇḍile pūrvavat kṛtevardhanyābījamādāya tasyapīṭhe tu vinyasettattat kuṃbha jalaiścaiva tattaddeśobhiṣecayettattat kuṃbhādakaiścaiva teṣāṃ ca snapanannayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinyaset kāmikādyantu sopabhedaṃ guruttamaḥsnapanaṃ cotsavaṃ bhūri naivedyaṃ kārayennavāevaṃ yo dakṣiṇāmūrteḥ sthāpanaṃ kurute naraḥdehānte parameśānaṃ kartā yāyādasaṃśayaḥpratiṣṭhātu dvijaśreṣṭhāśṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥsa yajñasūtraṃ śāntaṃ ca gamanonmukhamīśvaramkṣaumāṃbaraṃ sitaṃ kuryāt sundaraṃ taṃ vibhūṣaṇamdakṣiṇaṃ kuñcitaṃ pādaṃ vāmapādantu susthitamprahāraṃ dakṣiṇe haste ḍhakkāṃ vāme tu pūrvayoḥvāmakare'parepiñca daṇḍakaṃ kāla daṇḍakamnānāgaṇasamāyuktaṃ nānābhūtasamākulamnānārūpadharairbhūtaiḥ anekaiḥ parivāritamyoṣitaścānavadyāṅgā matprekṣāvaśya mohitāḥkāścidāliṃganonmukhāḥsavyanāsāpuṭāgrāttu sthitārṅghyaṅguṣṭhamūlataḥnābhermeḍhrāttu vāme tu bhāgaṃ saptāṃgulaṃ bhavetpārṣṇayośca munimātraṃssyājjānvormadhyaṃ mukhena tuprahāra hasteyovakraḥ kaṭakonābhisīmakaḥpārśvamadhyamabāhyośca madhyamaṃ bhūtamātrakamūrumadhyācca tasyāgraṃ ekaviṃśati mātrakampārśvamadhyamabāhyośca madhyaṃ pātāla mātrakambhujāntā maṇibandhātā dvyayantaraṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulamtatsamaṃ piñcchadairghyaṃ syāt devanāsāgramātrakamdaṃḍāgrekārayet dhīmān kaṃkālaṃ hi munīśvarāḥbhūtarūpāṇi sarvāṇi trimukhenecchayā tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vikīrṇobhaya pār'svastha jaṭālakavibhūṣitaḥsatkapālañcavaradaṃ vāmahastantu kalpayetśikhipiñchadharaṃ kuryāt savyasthamaparaṃ karamsavyaṃ koṇa samāyuktaṃ athavā parikalpayetnābhestaṃ maṇibandhāntaṃ ṣoḍaśāgula īritaḥkarṇāntaṃ ṣoḍaśairmātraiḥ śeṣaṃ kaṃkālavadbhavetsthāpanaṃ ca samāsena vakṣye'haṃ munipuṃgavāḥratnanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā deve bhūte yathākramātathavā ratnavinyāsaṃ kṛṣṇādīnāṃ visarjayetjalādhivāsanaṃ grāmapradakṣiṇa purassaramtaddigaśrāṇi vṛttābha navapañcaikakuṇḍakampuṇyāhaṃ vāstuhomaṃ ca sthaṇḍilaṃ śayanaṃ pṛthakmadhye devaṃ ca taddakṣe jāyā bhūtāni vāmakepṛthak kaṃkāla daṇḍaścet śirodeśetu śāyayetanyeṣāṃ ca śirodeśe ghaṭaṃ jāyā suvardhanīmvīreśāya namaśceti bhūtakuṃbhe yajet guruḥkaṃkālakuṃbhe kaṃkālaṃ nyastvā tatvādikānnyasetmūrtayaḥ prāgvadevasyuḥ pramukhodurmukhastathāviṣnūktavat syāt kaṃkāle tathāhomaṃ samācarettilaiḥ sasyendrakaissārdhaṃ sākṣatairhomamācaretśamī ca vaṭaśrīvṛkṣa māyūrāvahni koṇataḥdeśikendraḥ pradhāne tu devānāvāhya tarpayetpūjito vastra hemādyaiḥ mūrtipaiḥ prāpta dakṣiṇāḥkuṃbhāmmanuṃ samādāya devasya hṛdi vinyasetanyebhyo bījamādāya teṣāṃ ca hṛdi vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naivedyaṃ ca pratiṣṭhānte deśikendrastu kārayetevaṃ yaḥ kurutemartyaḥ sa puṇyāṃgatimāpnuyātaṃgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ teṣāṃ vai sanniveśanammudrāśvetādi varṇaṃ ca devānāṃ saṃsthiti sthitāḥbhavet sāmānyametat hi sarvadeveṣu ca dvijāḥbhikṣāṭane ca kaṃkāle pratiṣṭhaivaṃ samīritānityotsave tu kathitaṃ sūtrādyañcendumalivatnityotsavepi tat śreḍhantanmantraiśca viśeṣataḥkāloṃkurakriyāratnanyāso vai dṛṣṭimocanampūrvamevoditaṃ yasmāt tadvat sarva samācaretkuṇḍāni vṛttānyaśrāṇi taddigaśrāṇi vā bhavetpaścāt śilpinaṃ udvāsya brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayetjalāduttīrya biṃbantu mṛdādyaisnapanaṃ nayetśayanaṃ kalpayet paścāt tasyāṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ pūrvakampūrvavat shāpayet kuṃbhān paritaśśivakuṃbhakamśivaṃkuṃbhe yajedastrandevaṃ pāśupatāhvayamhuṃ phaṭ iti mantreṇa caturthyantena nāmataḥmantreṇa vātha saṃpūrṇandevaṃ pāśupatāhvayamoṃkārādyāphaḍantāśca mantrāssyuhṛdayādayaḥhṛdayādi samopetā huṃphaḍantāḥ namontakāḥhuṃkārakalpitenaiva hradāsaṃpuritena catattva tattveśvarānyastvā nyasenmūrtīśca pūrvavatkṛtvā kuṇḍeṣu saṃskāraṃ saṃpādya ca śivānalampūrvoktamūlabrahmāṃgairhomaṃ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayāpalāśoduṃbarāśvattha vaṭā indrāpi dikṣu ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradhāne'pi palāśasyāt dvitīyehvayemācaretpratimāgreghaṭānyasvā tat kuṃbhāttumanuṃ hṛdisnapanaṃ cotsavaṃ bhūrinaivedyaṃ kārayennavāevamastrapratiṣṭhāntu yaḥ kuryādastramūrtinaḥyāttyeva ca sukhaṃ mokṣamihāpi ca paratra capakṣyākāraṃ suvarṇābhaṃ pakṣadvaya samanvitampādaissiṃhapadākāraiścacuturbhiśca samanvitamdivyalāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ suvikīrṇa jaṭānvitamsiṃhāsyaṃ bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃca bhīmavikramasaṃyutamkṛtāñjalipuṭopetaṃ niśceṣṭita mahātanumpādābhyāmaṃbarasthābhyāṃ kukṣisthābhyāñca tasya tuevaṃ lakṣaṇamādiṣṭantasya mantraśca kathyateṣaṣṭhasvarasamopetaṃ bindunāda samanvitamtato hariharastvevaṃ caturthyantaṃ padadvayamyojayeccharabheśārthaṃ pūjādiṣviṣṭasiddhayevajradeho bhavedādyaḥ khādakaśca viyojakaḥbalipriyeṇa cāṣṭausyuḥ prāgdigārabhya saṃsthitāḥsvanāmādyakṣareṇaiṣāṃ mantrāṇāmudhdṛtirbhavetpratiṣṭhāṃ ca tataḥ kuryāt śubhalagnodaye'haninetrāṇāamapiratnānāmmokṣaṇaṃ nyāsamācaretjalādhivāsanaṃ prāgvat pṛthak kuryāt hareharaupañcāgnyāyatanopeta mekāgnyāyatanena vāviprabhuktintaducchiṣṭodvāsanaṃ mārjanaṃ punaḥśayanaṃ snapanaṃ prāgvat bandhanaṃ kautukasya caukak pādaṃ yathādevaṃ pūrvadiṅmastakaṃ yathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya kuṃbhasthāpanamārabhetsa sūtrasāpidhānañca savastrādyaṃ śirontikesasūtrān sodakānvajradehādyairapyadhiṣṭitānhṛtpuṭājātamūrtyātānāvāhya sakalīkṛtamśarabheśamanunyastvā yajet viṣṇau saduktavatmūrtayo vajradehādyāstadīśānā iti smṛtaḥsamidbhirapipālāśaiḥ ghṛtena caruṇāpi capūrṇāṃhutvā dvitīyehni vahnikuṃbhāmarārcanammūrtipādyaryathāyogyaṃ mantranyāsaṃ samārabhetkuṃbhāt bījaṃ samādāya śarabheśa hṛdi nyasetanyebhyo bījamādāya pīṭhābje parito nyasetsnapanaṃ kārayitvā tu naivedyaṃ cotsavaṃ nayetarcanaṃ prāgvadeva syat kintu mantraistu śārabhaḥdeśikaścāsya mantraistānnāśayet śatru varginaḥvaśyākarṣaṇa vidveṣamanena vidhinā nayetkuryādevaṃ sthāpanaṃ tu yonaraśśarabheśvareiyattā puṇya saṃghasya bhogān bhuktveha janmanipratiṣṭhāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tallakṣaṇa purassaramvāme vā dakṣiṇe vāpi kārayeddeśikottamaḥsukhāsīnaṃ sthitaṃvāpi kṛtāñjali puṭānvitamsarvāṃgasundaraṃ kuryāt kaniṣṭhadaśatālataḥdevaśśirasi caṇḍasya mālayā pariveṣṭayetdvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ kṛtāñjali puṭānvitamābhaṃgasahitaṃ kuryādāgama śavaṇonmukhamnandīśvarānugrahastvevaṃ tadvadviṣṇuprasādakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sacakrāñjali hastañca śaṃkhābjāparahastakamkārayedeva mevānya prasādābhimukhaṃ śivamvārādyaṃmaṃkuraṃ ratnavinyāsamubhayatra catomādhivāsanaṃ yāgamaṇḍapasya prakalpanamnavapañcaika saṃkhyānāṃ lakṣaṇaiḥ pūrvavat dvijāḥvāstuhomantu vedyāntu sthaṇḍilaṃ śayanaṃ pṛthakārohaṇaṃ ca śayyāyāḥ tasyāñca śayanaṃ nayetdeveśa pādamūletu teṣāṃ ca śayanaṃ nayetanugrahītadevānāṃ tattanmūrtyaṣṭakaṃ matamkṛtvākuṇḍāgnisaṃskāraṃ dravyairhomaṃ samārabhetsat palāśavaṭaplakṣo duṃbarāḥ pūrvato bhavetpradhānasya palāśassyāt sa ca sarvatra vāmataḥniṣkṛtau pūrṇayopetaṃ homakarma pṛthak nayetsaṃpūjyoddhṛtya devāṃstu kuṃbhān kuṇḍeṣu pāvakānvastrahomāgulīyādi pūjitomūrtipādibhiḥkṛtasthaṇḍilakā dhārā biṃbāgretu ghaṭā nyasetvardhanyāmanumādāya tat pīṭhopari vinyasetanyebhyo bījamādāya pīṭhasyaparito nyasettattat ghaṭodakaḥ stattat ddevamapyabhiṣiñcayetdevī vibhinnapīṭhā cet kalyāṇaṃ kārayedguruḥevaṃ ca kurutemartyaḥ sonte mokṣamavāpnuyātsthāpanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥta evānugraparāḥ bhaktānugrāhakāmatāḥpipīlikā gajādyantāḥ jaṃgamāsthāvarāścayedīkṣā vyākhyānaṃ saṃsparśā'valokokti mukhodvijāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sanaraśśiva eva syāt sarvapāpa bahiṣkṛtaḥprāṇamokṣaṃ ca kuryādyaḥ sa śivonā'tra saṃśayaḥāsīnāṃ vā sthitāṃ vāpi śayitāṃ śubhalakṣaṇāmdravyaissadāśivādyāntu kṛtvā saṃsthāpayetsudhīḥbhaktānugraha devasya lakṣaṇaṃ tvevamīrtitamkālaḥ prāgvat samuddiṣṭa stathaivāṃkurakarma cagrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ madhyame tvadhivāsanamkuṇḍānikārayettatra navapañcaika sakhyayātakṣakodvāsanaṃ viprabhuktiṃ puṇyoda secanamśayanārohaṇaṃ kuṃbhasthāpanaṃ pūrvavannayetātmamantra samopetaṃ vidyeśvara ghaṭānvitamagnikuṇḍādisaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā homaṃ samācaretpalāśoduṃbarāśvattha nyagrodhāḥ prāgdigāditaḥpradhānetu palāśasyāt yasyā bhāvassa eva hipūjitovastrahemādyairmūrtipādyaissamanvitāḥmantranyāsantataḥ kuryāt nyastvābiṃbapuroghaṭāndevyā devassamāyukto yadi devī manuṃ guruḥtataḥ kuṃbhājalenātha'tha tau ca saṃsnāpayet sadāādāyabījānyanyebhyaḥ pīṭhasya parito nyasetsnapanaṃ kārayedante naivedyandāpayet tataḥviśeṣastripuraghnādi pratiṣṭhāvidhi coditaḥevaṃ yaḥ martyaḥ sa puṇyāṃgatimāpnuyātdevārthī devamāpnoti mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnuyātmṛtamuddīśya yaḥ kuryāt tat putraḥ pautra eva vājīvannevāthavā kuryāt ātmānaṃ śivasaṃjñitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturbhujastriṇetraśca kapardamakuṭānvitaḥtatoddhṛta sadakṣāṃghristīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrogranāsikaḥdakṣahastastha paraśurnāgapāśo'tha vāmagaḥśūlaṃhyadhomukhaṃ proktaṃ kālakuṇḍasthameva vātaddhastamaṇibandhācca pārśvamadhyaṃ kalāṃgulamkarṇāgraṃtadvitālaṃ syāt dossamaṃ parahastakammūrdhnodakṣakarīnityaṃ vāmanāsāpuṭādayaḥtat sūtrānmedramūlasya vāmabhāgontaromataḥadhoddhṛtāṃghri jānūccaṃ kaṭyagra samameva hidakṣapādasya pārṣṇāgraṃ tithissyāt sūtradakṣiṇetat sūtrandakṣiṇenābhi vidyeśvara yavaṃ bhavetuddhṛtasya talasyāgra jaṃghāyāsmṛti mātrakamudgiradraktavastraṃ ca tathālohitamūrdhajamdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ raktabhrūraktalocanamkṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ vāpi kārayet kālamādarātkālāntaliṃgamānādyaṃ liṃgodbhūtoktavannayetbaddhapuṣpāñjaliḥ pārśve mārkaṇḍeyasthitovaraḥmārkaṇḍeyonumānena yukto vā varjitastuvākālāgnirevamākhyāto manmathāntaka ucyatekuryāttu patitaṃ dṛṣṭipātādeva ca tatkṣaṇātmanmathotsedhamuddiṣṭaṃ sa tu hema vibhūṣitaḥmīnaketustathaivekṣu kārmukā kṛtisaṃyutaḥlaṃbhinī tāpinī caiva vedinī drāviṇī tathāmanmatho mitrayukto vā'yutovaika śareṇa tuvārādyaṃ aṃkuraṃ yāgamaṇṭapaṃ pūrvavannayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvātodya samāyuktannṛttavādyasamanvitamtriśūlena samāyuktandeveśena yutannavādaṇḍaṃ saṃsthāpayetpaścāt sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamdhāmoccastārasadṛśaḥ dviguṇastriguṇopi vāṣaṭsaptavasuhastena daṇḍasyādadhamatrayeekāditalaparyantaṃ gopurāntamathāpi vāmadhyekanīyase cettu khātaṃ cettadbahiṣkṛtamsarvaśśūloktavṛkṣo vā tvaksārakramukādikaḥpalāśakhadirāśvatthavaṭacandana dāravaḥvaiṇavaṃ jāti vṛkṣai vā śamībilvamathāpi vāsvabhāvanāhasaṃyuktastvaksāradrumarnimitaḥdvibhāgādi navāṃśāntandaṇḍa dairghyaṃ vidhāya capañcāṃgulaṃ samārabhya cāṃgulātṣoḍaśāṃgulampañcāṃśāt dvādaśāṃśāntaṃ mūlanāhaṃ vidhāya cadaṇḍokto veṇuvṛkṣo vā dhvajayaṣṭimahīruhaḥskandhaṃ dvayaṃ tanmānadvādaśāṃgulamānataḥsaptāṃgulaṃ samārabhya gāyatryarṇāṃgulāvadhiardhena vā tripādena darvyākāro yathā tathācatustridvayaṃgulaṃ vāpi mānameṣāṃ prakīrtitamardhachidramadhaskandha prānte yaṣṭyagradeśakemūlāgrasuṣiropeta daṇḍayaṣṭyanurūpataḥardhachidramadhaskandha prānte yaṣṭyagradeśakebṛhatskandha tribhāgārthaṃ tripādaguṇamānataḥdaṇḍakhātapramāṇāntandaṇdāgrā dvalaya sthitaḥbhū praviṣṭa pramāṇaṃ yaddaṇḍāgre yaṣṭidairghyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: diggatāśrāṇi vṛttāni caturaśrāṇi vā dvijāḥgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ toyādhivāsaṃ pūrvavat guruḥvedyūrdhve sthaṇḍile caiva śayanaṃ snapanaṃ pṛthakkautukaṃ śayanārohaṃ pūrvavat pṛthāgācaretkālakuṃbhaṃ ca tanmūrdhnaḥ pradeśe tanmanuṃsmaranmitrābhyāṃ saṃyutaścettu tayoścakalaśadvayamdevabhāga vasantākhya yuktayormitrayorguruḥvidyeśvarātmakānyasya yajet gaṃdhādibhistataḥtatvādyāḥ pūrvavaddeva kāmetasya yathoditamātmavidyāśivākhyānāṃ tatvānāṃ vyāptiriṣyatemūrtayaḥ prāgvaduddiṣṭā vasantogrīṣma sajñakaḥkṛtvā kuṇḍāgni saṃskāraṃ samit ghṛta carūṃstilānpalāśo ḍhuṃbarāśvattha vaṭāḥ prāgādi dikṣu capalāśastu pradhāne syāt sa ca sarvatravāmataḥnītvevaṃ rātriśeṣantu prabhāte vimale tataḥkuṃbhān kuṇḍasthavahniñca mantra nyāsaṃ gurūttamaḥsaṃprāpta dakṣiṇaḥ paścāt sumuhūrte sulagnakeśivasya cādarānyasya tat pīṭhe karakanyasetanyebhyo manumādāya teṣānteṣāṃ hṛdi nyasetanuktamatra sāmānya sthāpanoktavadācaretdehānte punarīśānaṃ prāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥjaṭāmakuṭa saṃyuktaścandrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥsamabhaṃgayuto deva sthānakastha prakīrtitaḥinduśekharahastābha parahasta dvayānvitaḥsvadakṣiṇagrahīto vā dakṣahastaprasannadhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nābhimadhyāttu vāme ca dakṣiṇe bahireva cavarahastasya pṛṣṭhoccaṃ tannāha maṇibandhayoḥpārśvāntaṃ rasa mātraṃ syāt antaraṃ munipuṃgavāḥnābhestaṃ maṇibandhāntaṃ smṛtyaṃgulamitīritampādāṃguṣṭhadvayormadhyaṃ mukhapārṣṇidvayāntaramardhendumalivaścānya hastayerantaraṃ matamdevīdṛgāsya cibuka kakṣa cūcukamānatāyuktādevīkaṭispṛṣṭa karābhyāmapi saṃyutāpādāṃguṣṭhadvayormadhyaṃ bhavedaṣṭadaśāṃgulamdevoccadaśabhāgaika bhāgādekādaśāvadhigṛhīta śaṃkha cakraśca hastābhyāṃ dhṛtayāpi canāsāgrāt sthitapādyasya cāṃguṣṭhāntaṃ vilaṃbayetkuṇḍikotsedhavistāro tālasūtrāṃgulau matauāsyaṃpañcāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ nāsikoccantu kolakamekāṃgulaṃ tat padoccaṃ tanmūlāgratatistribhiḥtadūrdhve dakṣiṇaṃhastandhārāpātāya kalpayetnābhestumaṇibandhāntaṃ dhātumātramitismṛtamvaradaḥ kaṭakau syātāṃ vāmetara karāvubhaucaturmukhaścaturbāhuḥ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitammauñjīmekhalayopetaṃ sopavītottarīyakamvarābhayakarau pūrvausyātāntau dakṣiṇetarausūtraṃlalaṭanāsāgra madhyame nābhigulphayoḥtatpādāṃguṣṭha mūlāntānnābhervasudaśāṃgulamtanmadhye viśvamātrasyāt bāhupārśvāntakaṃ rasaiḥbrahmarūpamitikhyāta ntathāpadmāsanasthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agnikuṇḍasyaviṣkaṃbhastrimekhala yutasya cadvādaśāṃgulavistāra dairghyā sā saptajihvakaḥśivādihastasūtrāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃdvyantarantu yateṣāmevanatiścāpi saṃkoco nirgamo'pi vāastrāṇānniyamaścāpi sarvaśāstra pracoditaḥbhūṣaṇānāñca sarveṣāṃ vāṃ dakṣiṇa bhedataḥdevīnāmevamevasyānnarādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥsaṃbhāvya pūrvavat kālaṃ prāgvat kṛtvāṃkurārpaṇamgauryā ca dakṣiṇe lakṣmīṃ vinseddeśikottamaḥśiṣṭānāṃ brahmagaurī śrīdevīnāṃ kanakanyasetberaśuddhipuragrāma prabhṛtīnāṃ pradakṣiṇambrahmaviṣṇu kṛtau brahma pārśvayoraṃbikāṃ śriyampūrvāśottara kāṣṭhāsu snānavedi trayānvitamyonyābhanavapañcaika kuṇḍairapi samanvitaḥdevasyamaṇḍape cāpi kuṇḍāni nava saṃkhyayādigaśrānyatha vṛttāni kalpayet kalpavittamaḥpuṇyāhaṃ vāstohomaśca sthaṇḍilaṃ śayanaṃ tathāśayane śāyayeddevantasya vāme ca dakṣiṇedevyāstu maṇḍape devīṃ śāyayeddakṣiṇe śriyamraktena vāsamā devaṃ deviṃ pītena keśavamācāryā ssaṃgrahītavyāḥ pratimaṇṭapamuttamāḥdevottamāṃga deśetu śivakuṃbhañca vardhanīmparitoṭau ghaṭānyasva vidyeśādhiṣṭhitā nyasetvāmādyādhiṣṭhitānaṣṭa kuṃbhāśca parito nyasetyajet gaṃdhādibhirdevā naivedyāntaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyeṣāṃ stattadadhyāya proktāṃstatvādikānyasetsamidājyānnalājaiśca tilasarṣapamudrakaiḥśamyapāmārga śrīvṛkṣa māyūrāvahnikoṇataḥpratyehaṃ pūrvavat hutvā pūrṇānte deśikottamaḥprabhāte kṛtanityantu kartā saṃpūjayet gurumtadante dakṣiṇāndatvā pañcaniṣkādi sammitāmvardhanyābījamādāya devīhṛdaya madhyamebhinnapīṭhāthavā devī tadgataṃ vā manuṃ nyasetsaṃpūjya snapanaṃ kuryādarcanoktavadarcayetkaścidasminviśeṣosti śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥtathā vidhyeyā sā devī svatantre deva padmaniteṣāṃ hastādivinyāsa svasvapūrvādi deśataḥteṣāṃ devyaśvatatpārśve kartavyā vā na vāmatāḥdakṣiṇeśādi devānāndevyo nakvāpisammatāḥevaṃ martyo'pi yaḥ kuryāt vāñcitaṃ phalamāpnuyātpūrvokte sumuhūrte tu taddine vā pare dineprapāyāṃ maṇḍape veṣṭadeśe gomayalepitestāpayettatra deveśaṃ bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇārhakaiḥaneka dhūpaiḥ saddipaiḥ ānītaṃ śibikādibhiḥdevasthaṇḍilayormadhye sthāpayedvahni mūrtinamviṣṇuṃ tatsavya bhāge tu vastrābharaṇa bhūṣitamācchādanottarīyārthaṃ gururdadyāt prabhorhradāsaṣaḍaṅgaṃ śivaṃ ceṣṭvā samidājyānakaissahagaurī mīśvara savye tu hṛda saṃsthāpya deśikaḥdevyāmaṅgala sūtraṃ tu dadyād dhṛdayamantrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atha pārśvenyasellakṣmīṃ devyāssarvāṅga sundarīmśivādvija kulodbhūta ssamadhīta śivāgamaḥanena guruṇā diṣṭo gururanyaḥ prasannadhīḥdhyātvodakaṃ hṛdā dadyāt karābhyāṃ karakeṇa capuṇyāhaṃ vācayetpaścāt sūkta vedadhanīnapiguḍadugdhājya saṃmiśraṃ madhuparkaṃ hṛdā prabhoḥhutvā ṣoḍaśa saṃkhyātaṃ tatastvājyena ṣoḍaśatāmbūlamapi tenaiva stutvā paramakāraṇamśivahastamiti dhyātvā gauryā hṛdi hṛdā nyasettato vāme'śma saṃsthāpya śālisthaṇḍilakoparisaṃgṛhya vinyaset tasminnaśmanyeva hṛdā guruḥprāgvaddarbhasya hastasya kṛtvaivātha catuṣṭayamtata śivāgniṃ prajvālya hastaistaistu vinikṣipetdeśikasya tathānyasya saṅgulīya kareṇa caagneḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃspṛsyāśma tato guruḥkṛtvaiva maparaṃ cāpi vyahṛtiṃ juhuyāttataḥvisṛjya pāvakasthaṃ taṃ śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ tu pūrvavatsaṃpūjya puṣkalaiḥ gandhapuṣpa sragādibhiḥtaddine vāpare vāpi divākāle'rdharātrakeśivenaiva śataṃ śāṅgaiḥ pratyekaṃ daśakaṃ hunetśayanaṃ carmajādyairvā pañca vastrastu vānayetdampatī tatra vinyasya cāpūpādyaistu toṣayetcalaṃ cedacalaṃ cettu sthāpayettu sahāsanevahnervāme'pya vāme'jaṃ hariṃ vā viparītataḥbhinnapīṭhāmbikānāṃ tu mūlaliṃgasya ca dvijāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhādyaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra tānabhyarcaiva kārayetvinyasya sthaṇḍile devīṃ karmavaivāhikaṃ nayetihaloke sukhaṃ prāpya nṛpaṇāmapi durlabhamyatdagvā nivartante mama bhaktā dvijottamāḥdravyaiśśilādibhiḥ kuryāt pratimāṃ tu viśeṣataḥumārdhaṃ dakṣa śaśyardhāṅkitamagrajāḥlalāṭa dakṣiṇe bhāge nayanārdhena saṃyutamsanakra kuṇḍalaṃ taṃ vināvātha kārayetdevyadhyāyodi tāstraṃ vā darpaṇāsakta locanamtatpucchaṃ mukulākāraṃ pāde śobhāvirājitamvyāghrājināṃbaraṃ savyapādaṃ kuñcitamiṣyateābhaṅga sahitaṃ tacca kolakāṅgulakairnatiḥnābhihṛnmeḍhradeśobhyo vāme dakṣe ca vāmakesūtramutpala hastoccaṃ cūcukāṃ tadanantarampārśvamadhyama bāhvostu madhyamaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulamcandraśekhara vaccheṣaṃ kartavyaṃ hiṃ munīśvarāḥprāgvatkṛtvā maheśārdhaṃ viṣṇvardhamitaratra capītāṃbara samopetaṃ sarvābharaṇa saṃyutamharyardhamevaṃ brahmādi bhāgaṃ caivaṃ samācarettāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca viprendrāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ hi samāsataḥratnanyāsākṣimokṣau ca mṛdādyairberaśodhanamsāmānyasthāpana prokta mārgeṇaiva samācaretmukha vāsa graheṣveka kuṇḍaṃ tu parikalpayetśilpinaṃ tu visṛjyātha viprān saṃbhojayettataḥśayanaṃ kalpayettasmin snapanaṃ kautukaṃ pṛthak
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śayanārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā śāyayeddevamādarātumottamāṅgedeśe tu vardhanīṃ vinyaset guruḥtattat kāyārdhabhāgaṃ tu tatra dhyātvā yajet guruḥgandhastragdhūpa naivedya pramukhairdeśikottamaḥkṣmāmūrtyaṣṭakaṃ nyastvā mūrtīśanapi vinyasetśarvaṃ ca paśupatyugrarudrāṃścetāṃbalotkaṭānviṣṇvardha sthāpane śarva paśupatyugrarudrakānpañcamūrtyātmakenyāse mūrtayaḥ pūrvavartmanānyased gauryardha pakṣe tu brahmāviṣṇū ca rudrakamnyaset viṣṇvardha pakṣe tu pañcamūrtīśvarānapiīśādi saṃhitā mantrān devasyārdhe tu vinyasetevamevānya mantrāṃśca yuktyā jñātvaiva vinyasetavāhya mūrtimūrtīśāṃstattaddikṣu vyavasthitānhomayet sarvamantraiśca pradhāne pūrvavad guruḥśamyapāmārga śrīvṛkṣamāyūrā vahnikoṇataḥviṣṇvardha pakṣe tulasī palāśaśca pradhānakeyajed gandhādibhiścaivaṃ vastra hemāṅgulīyakaiḥśubhe mahūrte saṃprāpte mantranyāsaṃ samācaretviṣṇvardhapakṣe vardhanyā manuṃ pīṭhe tu vinyasetanyebhyo bījamādāya tatpīṭhe parito nyasetanuktamatra saṃgrāhyaṃ taddeva sthāpanoditamviṣṇūmārdha pratiṣṭhā tu kathitā bhukti muktitadāraktavarṇastriṇetraśca varadābhaya hastakaḥṛjvāgatastathaikena pādenāpi samanvitaḥkaṭi pradeśādūrdhve tu brahmaviṣṇvardha kāyayuk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtāñjalipuṭau ekapādayuktau ca vā matauathavā tau pṛthak sthāpyā vekaviṣṭaramasthitautasyasavyepi asavye ca brahma viṣṇū tathā matausaṃśliṣṭa dhāmayuktā vā brahmaviṣṇuśivā matābhinnaprakāragā vāpi eka prākārasaṃsthitāḥevaṃ lakṣaṇamādiṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhā vidhirucyatetattadadhyāya saṃsiddhāḥ kartavyā muni puṅgavāḥpūrvavat kāla ityukta stadvedevāṅkurārpaṇamprakṣiṇaṃ jalāvāsaṃ maṇḍapaṃ pūrvannayetdigaśrāṇyatha vṛttāni caturaśrāṇi tāni vāsthaṇḍilaṃ śayanaṃ snānaṃ kautukānāṃ ca bandhanamśayanārohaṃ kuṃbha sthāpanaṃ pūrvannayetnyastvā tu śivakuṃbhasya uttare vardhanīṃ nyasettatvamūrtyādi vinyāsaṃ teṣāṃ kuryādyathoditamtilasarṣapa mudgāṃśca māṣaśiṃbāda vaiṇavaiḥśamyamāmārga śrīvṛkṣa plakṣā śvāgneyakoṇataḥtato dvitīya divase deva kuṃbhāgni tarpaṇamsaṃprāpta daśaniṣkādi dakṣiṇastuṣṭadhīrguruḥkuṃbhānmanuṃ samādāya devasya hṛdi vinyasetbrahma viṣṇu ghaṭādbījaṃ taddhṛdi vinyasettattat kuṃbhajalaiścaiva tattaddeśe'bhiṣecayetanukta matra saṃgrāhyaṃ tatta dadhyāya coditamiha loke sukhaṃ prāpte yāti so'nte paraṃ śivamcaturbhujastriṇetraśca jaṭāmakuṭa saṃyutaḥpūrvadakṣiṇa hastastu kaṭako vakradaṇḍayuk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa hasto haṃsa pakṣo vā patākādhomukhastu vātadagrānnābhisūtrāntaṃ pañcādhika daśāṅgulamprakoṣṭhamūlād dhṛnmadhyāt pañcāṅgulaṃ bhavetekona viṃśanmātraṃ syāt pārśvato maṇi bandhakamsamabhaṅgayuto devaḥ sthānakenāpi saṃyutaḥgulphamadhye sthitaṃ sūtraṃ śivasūtrimiti smṛtamsūtraṃ nābhyantaraṃ mātraṃ caturbhirmeḍhra sūtrayoḥśarāṅgulo'ntare pārṣṇyordakṣpādasya vakratāḥtasyaiva dakṣiṇe devīṃ kārayellakṣaṇānvitāmāyudhavyatiriktaiḥsvai raṅgaistu viparītakaiḥpṛṣṭhastho vṛṣabho devajānūrukocchrayaḥevaṃ devaṃ samāpādya śilādyaiḥ sthāpanaṃ nayetvṛṣasya netramokṣaṃ tu śuddhiṃ grāmapradakṣiṇamkuṇḍāni navapañcaika saṃkhyayā tatra kārayetpaścācchilpinamudvāsya tasminviprāṃstu bhojayetsnapanaṃ kautuṃ kuryāt vṛṣe'pi ca yathoditamśivasya ca śirodeśe śivakuṃbhaṃ ca vardhanīmdakṣa mastaka saṃyuktāṃ śayyāṃ saṃkalpya va pṛthakparitoṣṭa ghaṭānnyastvā vidyeśāṃstatra pūjayettatvamūrtyādi vinyāsaṃ kṛtvā deve vṛṣe'pi casamidājyānnalājādi tilasarṣapa māṣakaiḥśamyapāmārga śrī vṛkṣa māyurotthā bhavanti hitato dvitīye saṃtarpya devān kuṃbhāṃśca pāvakānsaṃprāpta dakṣiṇaḥ paścānmantranyāsaṃ samācaretkuṃbhādbījaṃ samādāya devasya hṛdi vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahajā yadi sā devī tasyāstu hṛdi vinyasetanyebhyo bījamādāya pīṭhasya parito nyasetkalyāṇaṃ kārayetpaścāt tadvidhānena deśikaḥanuktamatra saṃgrāhyaṃ sāmānya sthāpanoditamghano vāpya ghano vāpi vṛṣabhasya ca saṃmataḥlabhete sa padaṃ śaivaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathecchayācaturbhujastriṇetraśca jaṭāmakuṭa maṇḍitaḥtena hastne dhṛtvaikāṃ jaṭāṃ gaṅgāsamanvitāmjaṭāyukta karoccaṃ tu karṇasyordhva samaṃ bhavetsthānakastu taduṣṇīṣa nāsāpād dakṣamadhyamehikkā sūtrāccaturmātraṃ savyajānorguṇāṅgulamvāma pādasya vaktraṃ tu sūtrādvāme guṇāṅgulamdevasya vāmabhāge tu devīṃ kuryātsalakṣaṇāmgalāntaṃ vāṣṭatālena vilaṃbitaṃ jaṭānvitamdvinetraṃ ca dvibāhuṃ tamevaṃ gaṅgādadharo bhavetratnanyāso na gaṅgāyāḥ karavyo netramokṣaṇampratimāśodhanaṃ grāma purādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇamcaturaśrāṇi kuṇḍāni navapañcaika saṃkhyayāpuṇyāhodena saṃsicya vāstu homaṃ tato nayetbhagīrathasya gaṅgāyāḥ devasyāpi nayet guruḥdevasya pādadeśe tu śayanaṃ tatra kalpayetbhagīratha śirodeśe ghaṭaṃ vastrādi bhūṣitamparitoṣṭau ghaṭānnyastavā vidyeśastaisadhiṣṭitāngandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sarvāndevān abhyarcayet kramātbhagīrathasya mūrtīśaiḥ pañcabhiśca samanvitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṇḍāgrāvadhi saṃsthāpyo valayaskandha eva cadviguṇāntaṃ vidheyaṃ vā bhūmānaṃ bhūgatadvijāḥtrimātrānto vidheyaṃ syādvalayaḥ kīlasaṃyutaḥrajjurvalayamadhyesyājjyeṣṭhādyaṃgulanāhayuktantu jastripradiṣṭaṃ syādaśaktau bandhanāhakamsaṃveṣṭya darbhamālābhirūrdhvātsarvaṃ krameṇa tuastramantreṇa saṃprokṣya śivatatvādikanyasetskandhatraye ca tānyeva valaye ravimarcayetgandhādyairarcayeddevantatassthāpanamārabhetkūrmaṃ vā vṛṣabhaṃ vā'pi daṇḍamūle niveśayethaimaguñjādi niṣkāntaṃ mānandevālayānanamtadūrdhve sthāpayeddaṇḍaṃ yaṣṭiragre yathā bhavettathaiva gopurasyāpi mahāpīṭhāntikepi vānavapañcaikadaṇḍo vā vasudikṣu catasṛṣuaṣṭadikṣu ca vidyeśāścaturdikṣu narādikāḥdaṇḍamūle tu kartavyā vedikā sā tvanekadhādvihastamānaparyantaṃ vedikā vistaro mataḥcatustryaṃśārdhatuṃgaṃ vā vedikā parikīrtitādvitryaṃgulakṣayādvāpi mekhalā mānamīritamdvayaṃgulāt pādavṛddhayā tu ṣaḍaṃgulasamāvidhivedyurdhvebjaṃ prakartavyaṃ caturaṃgulamānataḥpadmotsedhassamākhyāto vistāro vedikā samaḥpadmaveśassamākhyātaḥ padmaṃ syāt karṇikāyutamguṇāṃgulāvadhiḥ kāryaḥ tadutsedhanamucyatevṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā vidheyandalaveṣṭanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrtīśāsyurbhakāro tthāssadyo jātādayo'ṇavācaturthyantaṃ svanāmānte ceti mūlāṇureṣa vaigaṅgāyāstadvidhānokta mārgeṇaiva samācarettilaiśca juhuyātpaścāt vastra hemāṅgulīyakaiḥtattaddeva purastattat kuṃbhān nyastvā gurūttamaḥvardhanyā manumādāya tasya pīṭhe tu vinyasetgaṅgāyā bījamādāya tasyāstu hṛdi vinyasettattat kuṃbha jalenaiva snāpayettat pradeśakevibhinna pīṭhā devī ced pratiṣṭhāṃ pṛthagācaretkārayed bhūminaivedyaṃ karturicchāvaśena tubhagīratha yuto vāyaṃ viyukto vā maheśvaraḥihaloke sukhaṃ prāpya svabandhujana saṃyutaḥyāyāt svadeha pādānte śaivaṃ snānaṃ tu durlabham !purāde rmadhyame vāgnau yame vā madhyame tayoantarāle'thavā teṣāṃ śivadhāmni evameva vāparvatasyāntike vāpi nadyudyānādike'thavāprāsāda maṇḍapādīnāṃ deśe puṇyataruṣvathaathaikādi trayastriṃśaddhasta vistāra saṃyutaḥdiṅnyasta skandarūpāḍhyaḥ kevalo vā tadālayaḥgaṇakoṇo'thavā sasyāt kevalo vā guhālayaḥśivokta mārga saṃkḷpta garbhādyeṣṭa kayānvitaḥdiṅnyasta deva vinyasta madhyakuṃbha yutena caprāgukta maṇḍapādyaiśca prākārādyaiśca maṇḍitaḥparivārāmarairyuktaḥ kathyante te prasaṅgataḥgandharvaḥ kinnaro daitya nāyako dānavādhipaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varadābhaya saṃyuktāḥ khaḍga kheṭa samanvitāḥbhīmarūpāssuśāntā vā baddha keśāstu vā matāḥvaktramaṇḍī śakārī ca niśāntā meṣadevatāskando mayūra vāhassyāt senānī śaktihastavānvajra padmadharāssarve skandoktākṣara saṃyutāḥete vā paritaḥ sthāpyāḥ kramāt pūrvādi yogataḥvighneśaṃ kṣetrapaṃ bhānuṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ prakalpayetbalipīṭha daleṣvindra pūrvānmadhye graheśvarāḥdakṣa vāma gatau dvāre dvibhujau vā caturbhujauśyāmābhau raktavarṇau vā sitakṛṣṇau bhayaṃkarauīśāne kalpayet skanda caṇḍaṃ vedakaraṃ varamśākalya saṃjñayā khyātaṃ tadarthaṃ pīṭhameva vādravyaiśśilādibhiḥ kuryāt pratimālakṣaṇoditaiḥyojanīyaṃ dvijāḥ garbhadvārastambhādisaṃyutampadma dhṛk savyasatpāṇi rlambitetarasatkaraḥdvihasto yajñasūtrāḍhyaḥ saśivakhassa trimekhalaḥsthāpyo'yaṃ jñānadaḥ skandaḥ parvateṣu vanādiṣunakra kuṇḍala yukto vā hyakṣaśaktikaradvayaḥśattayaikayā yuto vā syāt tayorlakṣaṇamucyateśyāmaraktanibhe savya vāmapārśve vyavasthitegajeti gajavallīti nāmnākhyāte'ti sundareṣaḍānanaśca ṣaḍbāhurarka śrotre kṣaṇānvitaḥsa śaktissābhayassāsissākṣamālassakukkuṭaḥraktāmbara samāyukto bālacandra samaprabhaḥśaktiṃ ca masulaṃ khaḍgaṃ cakraṃ pāśābhaye vahan
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samayūradhvajaṃ caivamaṅkuśaṃ varadaṃ vahangrāmādau sthāpanīyo'yaṃ prāsādādai ca siddhayedvāpare syānnavānyatra sarve sarvatra vā matāḥśavarvasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhasvara samanvitamsubrahmaṇyaṃ caturthyantaṃ namo'ntaṃ praṇavādikamśāntāntaṃ dīrghahrasvārṇairjātyantairvā namontakaiḥmahāsenāya saṃyuktaṃ vidmahe pada saṃyutamtannaḥ skanda padopetamante yuktaṃ pracodayāthṛtpuṭājātamūlāṇū mūrtividyāmanū smṛtautataḥ pratiṣṭhā kartavyā prāgvatkṛtvāṅkurārpaṇamdevyośca hṛdayenaiva pañcahemābjameva vāmadhvājyābhyāṃ sahemābhyāṃ pātrasthābhyāṃ prakalpayetkuryāt pracchanna vastreṇa saha sarvātmanā guruḥprāgvacchuddhiṃ prakalpyāsmai grāmādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇamparitaḥ kalaśānmantrī nyasedindrādyadhiṣṭitānpadmābhanavapañcaika saṃkhyā kuṇḍa prakalpanamtakṣakodvāsanaṃ vipra bhuktiṃ gomayālepanamsthaṇḍilaṃ śayanaṃ prāgvaccarma jādyaistu vāmbaraiḥgandhāpiṣpādinābhyarcya bandhayet kautukaṃ hṛdāvastrairāveṣṭya saṃpūjya sāsanaṃ mūrtiḥ saṃyutamśiraḥ pradeśe sūtrāḍhyaṃ kuṃbhaṃ vastrādibhiryutamdeviyutaṃ cet vinyasya vardhanīṃ tatra tāṃ yajetsūtra vastra suvarṇādi yuktāssarve ghaṭā matāḥnyastvā tatvatrayaṃ seśaṃ mūrtimūrtīṃśvarānysetprāguktā vā tadīśānāstao homaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: soṣṇīṣassāmbarassnātaḥ śśivaḥ dvijakulodbhavaḥpradhāne skandamāvāhya sabrahmāṅgaṃ salocanamgajāṃ ca gajavallīṃ ca tarpayetsaṃbhave tayoḥbrahmāṃgānāṃ daśāṃśaḥ syānmūlārdhaṃ mūrtipahūtiḥtattadiṅmūrtimūrtīśānapi śānti ghaṭānvitampalāśo dumbarāśvatthavaṭā dikṣu vidikṣvathapalāśassyāt pradhāne'pi sa ca sarvatra vā bhavetśāntyambhaḥ prokṣaṇaṃ svasva mantrāṇāṃ ca japakriyāmtataḥ prabhāte saṃśuddho mūrtipaissaha deśikaḥprāyaścitta nimittaṃ tu dakṣiṇena śatāhutimmānuṣe davike vāpi prāgvat saṃskāra saṃyutāmvinyasya sthāpayettasyāṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ mūlamuccaranatha brahmaśilopetaṃ sthāpayedvā ṣaḍānanamkuṃbhādbījaṃ samādāya ṣaṇmukhasya hṛdinyasetpīṭhasya paritaścānya kumbhebhyo vinyasenmanūntatvamūrtyādi vinyāsaṃ kārayetpūrvavattataḥguruṃ ca mūrtipādīṃśca vastrādyairdakṣiṇāyutamsanātana pratiṣṭhoktaṃ yadanuktaṃ samācaretāyuḥ labdhvā paratrāpi mokṣaṃ ca labhate naraḥśubhaṃ labdhvā paratrāpi mokṣaṃ ca labhate naraḥatha prātaḥ kṛtā vaśyaśśaucasnāne vidhāya cagatvā dhāma praviśyāntarnirṇiktāṅghrikaradvayaḥsanātanaṃ vidhāyārdhyamastra mantreṇa tajjalaiḥsvanāmno dumbare heti praviśyāntassamarcayetśaktisthaṃ svaṃ samāyojya rakṣāyai dhvaṃsita sthitiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: astramantraṃ susaṃśuddhaṃ candanārpita satkaraḥtaladvayaniviṣṭākṣi dehamūlāṇu saṃyutaḥbhūyastala kṛtanyāsa mūlamantra parānvitaḥsaikatriṃśat kalā mantranyāsaṃ prāgvannayennavāiṣṭvā hutvā vibhāvya antarguhaṃ hṛnnābhibinduṣuavakuṇṭhanadigbandha prākāraiḥ sthānaśodhanamarcanāṅgoditairvātha pādyamācamanaṃ tathāhṛdābhimantrya svaṃ ceṣṭvā śudhyai mantrān samuccarandatvā murdhni hṛdā tāṃ ca dadyānnirmālya dhāriṇelohajaṃ yadi tadberaṃ snānaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇiitthamātmadhārādravya mantrabiṃba viśodhanampraṇavaṃ madhyame dharmādharmādīn kalpayetpunaḥsaṃklpya cāsanaṃ mūrtimāvāhyāsmin hṛdādyaṇūnvidyādehaṃ ca saṃklpya tasminmūlena ṣaṇmukhamāvāhya bimbe tadbindro rānīya sthāpayeddhṛdāhṛdādi netra paryantaṃ mantranyāso'vakuṇṭhanampādyaṃ pāde hṛdāccānti mukherghyaṃ śirasi kramātgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ datvā pañcāmṛtādibhiḥvāsasonmṛjya vaktreṇa datvā cāntiṃ guhasya tupiṣṭavālipya hṛdā skandaṃ kevalaṃ candanaṃ tu vālaghu candana niryāsaṃ bhasmajaṃ vā purohitamtatkṣaṇa prati buddhāni prāgvat puṣpāṇi dāpayetāmantraṇa habirdadyāt prāgukta vidhinā na vāpūjayedāvṛtiṃ paścāt dhūpadānā vasānaketadbahirvasumūrtīśca bahirindrādi devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvābhyāṃ vaikena bhūyo'pi dhūpadīpaṃ pradāpayetnaivedyaṃ ca baliṃ datvā kuṇḍe śaive'nale guhammūlena śatapañcāśat pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyayādatvā pūrṇāhutiṃ paścāt nityotsavamathācaretekā hādi navāhāntaṃ kuryātsaṃvatsarotsavamtaddina triguṇe vātha dviguṇe vātha taddinedhvajārohaṇapūrvaṃ vā kārayedutsavaṃ budhaḥvaktramaṇḍī tataḥ proktā niśāntāmeṣadevatāṣaṭ kumārāstu vijñeyāsteṣāṃ nāmāni ca dvijāḥsubrahmaṇyaḥ kumāraśca ṣaṭkumārāḥ prakīrtitāḥvajraṃ rūpaṃ bhavedastraṃ puṣpe vā taṇḍule yajettīkṣṇa vajradharaṃ savye vāmahaste tu citrakeśukunyādi kumārāntā dinānāmadhipā matāḥparasvatantra bhedena dvividhaṃ tacca saṃmatamvāmeśāne'tha saumye vā someśendrāntare'thavāathaikādi trastriṃśaddhasta vistāra saṃyutaḥekādi saptabhūmyantaṃ bhūmibhāga samanvitaḥiṣṭadevānvito vā syāt kevalo vā vṛṣānvitaḥmūrdheṣṭakā samāyuktaḥ sthūpisthāpana saṃyutaḥsvatantra sthāpane dakṣa pūrva paścimādiṅkukhaḥdhāma saṃsthāpane nāḍhyaḥ prāgukta vidhinā sahaprākāra maṇḍapopetaḥ paritaḥ parivāraḥ yukmahābalastathā viprāṣṭaṅka pāṇīśa sevakauete śvetā mahākāyā kṛtāñjalipuṭānvitāḥkṛttivāso'nvitā vātha caṇḍarūpadharāstu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: balipīṭhādi pīṭhāntaṃ pūrvavat kalpayettu vācaṇḍānugaḥ caṇḍamānyo neṣṭau vā deśikāgrajāḥdevokta parivārānvā vighnakṣetreś bhānubhiḥmadhyena daśatālena daśatālādhamena vābaddha padmāsanaścaṇḍanātho durdarśa bhīṣaṇaḥkarālakajjalābhāso jaṭilaścandraśekharaḥṭaṅkaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ vāme bhānuraktārka locanaḥcandrārdha maṇḍitaḥ kṛttivāsā vīrāsanasthitaḥvarābhaya pradānābhyāmanyatra parimaṇḍitaḥjaṭāmakuṭa yukto vā dhavalī kṛta mūrdhajaḥsalamba savya pādastu vāmahasta bhujānugaḥvāmetarakaraṣṭaṅka yukto'ñjali puṭo'thavāutkuṭā sana yuk śānto jaṭilaṣṭaṃ dhṛkkaraḥathavā bhayaṭaṅkābhyāṃ pāśaśūladvayena tuviśeṣassiṃhale deśe kaścidatrābhidhīyatedvāpare ca caturhastaḥ kalautu dvikaro mataḥathavā caṇḍanāthastu devyā tu sahito na vādharmanītyākhyayā khyātā dhṛtanīlotpalā varācaṇḍāsanaṃ caturthyantaṃ natyantaṃ manurāsanecaturthyantamidaṃ mūrti mantramityabhidhīyatemūlamantrassamādiṣṭastadagre dīpasaṃyutaḥoṃ caṇḍa pūrvako huphaṇṇamontaḥ syād dhṛdādikāḥathavānya prakāreṇa mantraścaṇḍāya kalpatecaṇḍāyeti padopetaiścaṇḍamantro'yamīritaḥtataḥ pratiṣṭhā kartavyā cāṅkurārpaṇa pūrvikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sauvarṇabere ratnādi vinyāso nātra kathyatemadhvājayābhyāṃ sahemābhyāṃ pātrasthāpyāṃ hṛdāṇunābera śuddhiṃ purādeśca pradakṣiṇamathācaretyāgārtha maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt dhāmno'gre tasya pārśvayoḥnavapañcaika saṃkhyāni vṛttānyaśrāṇi vā dvijāḥudvāsya śilpinaṃ paścāt śaivān bhaktāṃśca bhojayetjalādānīya caṇḍeśaṃ prāgvat snapanamācaretkalpayecchayanaṃ vedyamaṇḍajādyairanukrātvāsobhyāṃ veṣṭayitvā tu kuṃbhanyāsaṃ samācaretsahaimaṭaṅkatoyaḍhyaṃ vinyasettu sapallavamcaṇḍeśo deviyuktaścet vardhanīmūttare nyasetkuṃbhamiṣṭvā tu pūrvokta dhyāna yuk candanādibhiḥghaṭeṣu pūjayenmantrī īśānāduttarā vadhigandha puṣpādibhiśceṣṭvā tatvamūrtyādikaṃ nyasetkṣmāmūrtitadī'sānān lokapānapi vinyasetsāsanaṃ mūrtiyuk caṇḍaṃ brahmāṅga sahitaṃ yajetsaṃskṛtya vahniṃ kuṇḍaṃ ca dikṣu tatpuruṣādyaṇūnpradhāne tarpayenmantrī samidājyānnasattilaiḥplakṣaśca samidho dikṣu pradhāne'pi palāśakaḥtatvamūrti tadīśāṃśca kramaśastarpayet pṛthakdarbha saṃsparśanaṃ caiva pratibhāgaṃ samācaretuddhṛtya caṇḍa biṃbaṃ tu kuṃbhānagnīṃśca tarpayetvastrasvarṇāṅgulīyādyaiḥ pūjitaḥ prāpta dakṣiṇaḥtriguṇā cottamā proktā cānyeṣāṃ pūrvavad bhavetsumuhūrte pratiṣṭāpya dhāmni mantrāṃstu vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattat kuṃbhagataistoyaiḥ snāpayeccaṇḍa vigrahamkārayeddeviyuktaṃ tasyāśca sthāpanaṃ nayetcaṇḍeśa sthāpanaṃ hyevaṃ yaḥ kuryānnara puṅgavaḥvidyākāmo'malāṃ vidyāṃ ptrārthiṃ cetsutaṃ labhetcaṇḍeśvaraṃ prapannā yena teṣāṃ bhavakāraṇamsnānādyaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā sakalīkṛta vigrahaḥdvārapau tena gandhādyai riṣṭvāstra dvaramadhyamesakalīkṛta dehastu kṛtvāntaścaṇḍa pūjanampādyamācamanaṃ datvā hṛdārghyaṃ saṃhitaṇubhiḥsvasvamiṣṭvā hṛdā mantrānuccarenmaṃtraśuddhayeityuktvā ṭaṅkahastāya dhīmahīti padaṃ tataḥdatvā sāmānyamarghyaṃ ca nirmālyamapanīya cacaṇḍāsanaṃ ca mūrtiṃ ca saṃklpyeśādyaṇūn kramātbindorāvāhya saṃsthāpya hṛdā sannidhirodhanampādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ datvā hṛdaya mantrataḥiṣṭvā caṇḍeśvaraṃ śaktau vastraṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpayukhṛdādīn rudrabhaktādīn sāstrānāśāpatīnapinaivedyaḥ tadvidhānoktaṃ datvā tāṃbūla saṃyutamjapaṃ kṛtvā nivedyāsmai parivāre baliṃ nayetmūlena taddaśāṃśena tadaṅgairhomamācaretpuṣpānnākṣata liṅgaiśca caṇḍeśāstreṇa pūjitaiḥpādukārādhanopetaṃ praviśedālayaṃ pratikāleṣviṣṭeṣu caṇḍeśaṃ yajetpratyahamādarātādau paryuṣitāṃ pūjāṃ pīṭhakādau hṛdāṇunānaivedyādyaṃ ca pūjānte caṇḍeśasyārcakottamāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃpūjya śivanirmālyamapi paścānnivedayetnityejyaivaṃ samādiṣṭā bhikti mukti phalapradāanyañca labhate nityaṃ caṇḍeśasyārcanena tusnapanaṃ pūrvavat kiṃtu madhye caṇḍeśvaraṃ ghaṭeaṣṭamūrtiṣu pūrvādi diksthāḥ pañca prakalpaneindrādyā vajrapūrvāḥ syustadbāhye pañca viṃśatauśatasthāne tu tadbāhye hṛdayaṃ kevalaṃ yajetdīpāvalīṃ vasantejyāṃ māse māsotsavakriyāmkiṃ tūtsave dhvaje ṭaṅkaṃ vṛṣaṃ vā kevalaṃ likhetdhajahoma baliṃ hitvā kevalaṃ yānameva vāpratiṣṭotsava karmādāvanuktaṃ karma yad dvijāḥtatsarvaṃ pūrvavat grāhyaṃ caṇḍeśāṇu samanvitam !brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrā vā hyantarālajāḥśivabhakti samopetā jīvānto vā mṛtāstu vāśaivāḥ pāśupatāścaiva mahāvrata dharāśrayeteṣāṃ tenaiva mārgeṇa sthāpanādyaṃ vidhīyatāmsvapradhānaṃ parāṅgaṃ ca dvividhaṃ sthāpanaṃ matamvane copavane vāpi parvate vā manoramedevālayāntassālādau tatra kalpita mandiredevālayādau sarvatra mālikā maṇḍapādiṣutrihastaṃ tu samārabhya dvidvihasta vivardhanātāyāmotsedha garbhādyaṃ maṇḍapādyaṃ tathāparamādyeṣṭakā vidhānaṃ ca garbha saṃsthāpanaṃ tathātadarthaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ vā pratimā vā śivasya tukuryādāyādi saṃyuktaṃ śilādyairukta vastubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ saṃpādya pīṭhantu kārayechśilpitoṣaṇamdarbhaiḥ daṇḍaṃ samāveṣṭya vṛṣakumbhañca tatpaṭamdhāmnaḥ pradakṣiṇavaśānnītvā daṇḍasya sannidhimkoṇamadhye ca dharmādīn adharmādīn prakalpayetdaṇḍe sadāśivañceṣṭvā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāttrivargasahitā sā ca snapanoktavidhānataḥkṣudra ghaṇṭāṃ samāyojya śastramantramanusmaranvṛṣendrahṛdaye nyastvā gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetādau spṛṣṭvā svayañcānyaṃprerayedrohaṇāyavāpaṭordhvage vṛṣerājño jayo devāditṛptayekṣemārogyajayāḥ puṣṭiḥ krameṇa phalamīritamvāyau bhayaṃ vijānīyāt pucchepyevaṃ phalaṃ bhavetdoṣaśāntiṃ tadā kuryāt bahurūpamanusmaranvṛṣakumbhasthatoyena prokṣyeddaṇḍamūlakamtattoyairdalānaṣṭau krameṇa prokṣayet guruḥpuṇyāhantatsamārabhya yāvannaivedyadānakamcaturdiṅnartanaṃ kuryādviśeṣācchuddhanartanamekakālaṃdvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ pūjayedvṛṣamnākālamṛtyustatrāsti nālakṣmīḥ pāpakṛtsvapiviparītā na matayo rogiṇāmapibhūyasāśāntāni sarvapāpāni payasvinyaḥ payobhṛtaḥprāpnoti pāpanirmokṣaṃ makhakartuḥ kuladvayamsthaṇḍiladvitayaṃ kuryāddevadevasya sannidhauekatra vinyasecchūlaṃ bherīṃ tatsannidhau nyasetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvādau triśūle devatāṃ nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ardha citramathā bhāsaṃ paṭādi parikalpitammānaṃ tayośca saṃgrāhyā harmyād garbhagṛhādathaṣaḍyavādi prabhedena karturmātrāṅgulena vātryaṅgulāḍhvdyaṅgula ddharyātu ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulāntakamvasunanda guṇārddhyā tu bhānu nāḍyaṣṭabhirhatamnavavedahṛdaṃ sapta navasaṃkhyāhṛtaṃ tu yatmṛtanāmākṣareṇānukūlitaṃ ca vidhīyatāmtadukta tālabhedena kartavyaṃ syād dvijottamāḥāsīnaṃ snānakaṃ vāpi vāhanārūḍhameva vāadhastāt kalpayedvidvānubhayaṃ vā vidhīyatāmāsanonmāna vistārāyāmaṃ tadvadalaṃkṛtimśikhī vā baddhakeśī vā muṇḍito jaṭilothavāyatheṣṭāyudhayukto vā namaskārayuto'thavāgāyakāḥ nṛttayuktā vā pūjakā vā yatheṣṭakamevaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ pratiṣṭhādyaṃ nigadyatetato'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt pratiṣṭhārthaṃ tataḥ purāsthaṇḍilaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā tadūrdhvaṃ vinyasetpaṭamhema sūci prahārābhiḥ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamālikhetnetra mantraṃ samucārya kriyāmetāṃ samācaretmadhvājya pūritaṃ pātradvayaṃ tasya pradarśayetdhānyāni gāṃ savatsāṃ ca kanyakāṃ brahmaṇanāpisarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ grāmādau bhramaṇaṃ nayetyāgārthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt nāmenāgre'sya pārśvayoḥudvāsya śilpinaṃ paścāt viprabhojanamācaretprāgvad śuddhiṃ prakalpyātha grāmādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śālyādi sthaṇḍilaṃ pañcaśayanaṃ carmajādikamsaṃkalpya mānuṣaṃ pīṭhaṃ praṇavena prakalpayetpīṭhe saṃsthāpya beraṃ tu prāgukta vidhinā guruḥbaddha pratisaraṃ beraṃ śayanopari vinyasetśirasaścottare bhāge kuṃbhaṃ prādhānikaṃ nyasetcandanodaka saṃpūrṇān phā pallava saṃyutānsāntamādyasvaropetaṃ binduyuktaṃ yathā bhavetsāntenaiva varṇe brahmāṅgāni prakalpayethrīṃkāraḥ strīpratiṣṭhāyāṃ tena brahmāṅga kalpanāpradhanaghaṭa saumye tadbhāryārthaṃ karakaṃ nyasetvahvyaścet karakā grāhyā bahavaḥ pārśvayorvayoḥpṛthivyādīni bhūtāni mano'haṅkāra buddhyaḥstrīṇāṃ diśastu pūrvasmāddevatāḥ praikīrtitāḥsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ tatvatatveśvarānyasetātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva castrīṇāmapyeva mevaṃ syāt kṣmādayo mūrtayo matāḥindrādyā mūrtipāḥ pakṣe nivṛtyādyāstu mūrtipāḥakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ nyastvā mūrdhādiṣu kramātsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ vastreṇācchādya varmaṇāprāgvacca kuṇḍa saṃskāraṃ śivāgnyādhānameva vāsamidājya carūllājāṃ tilairdravyaistu mūrtipaiḥśamīkhādira māyūra śrīvṛkṣastvagni koṇataḥhutvā pūrṇāṃ tato datvā tatvatatveśvarān pratikṛtvā ghorāṇunā homaṃ niśchidrārthaṃ śataṃ dvijāḥtataścāntarbaliṃ bāhya baliṃ datvā śucirguruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snātvā samāpya sandhyāṃ tu kṛtakṛtyo gurūttamaḥpañcāṅga bhūṣaṇopeto dakṣiṇātuṣṭamānasaḥadhyetrṛbhiśca daivajñaiśśilpibhistoṣitairyutaḥsaṃpūjya vahniṃ kuṇḍasthaṃ pūrṇāṃ datvā yathā kramātprasādādau nayedbimbaṃ snānaśvabhre'thavā nayetāsanaṃ praṇavaṃ kṛtvā mūrtisthāṇu prakalpitāmsaṃsnāpya kuṃbhapānīyaiḥ paritaḥ sthāpitairapiupacāraistathā cānyaiḥ śivabhaktaṃ samarcayettataḥ prabhṛti taṃ bhaktaṃ pratyahaṃ pūjayennaraḥāvaśyakaṃ tathā śaucasnāna sandhyādi vandanampuruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva saṃpūjya dvārapārśvayoḥvāstu madhye samabhyarcya bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya caparikalpya viśeṣārghyaṃ kusumākṣata toyayukpraṇavādyān paṭhenmantrān namontānmantra śuddhayeṣaḍutthamāsanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktena vidhānataḥtattadrūpaṃ samopetaṃ tattanmūlāṇunā budhaḥpādyācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ hṛdayena nivedayetsaṃmṛjya vāsasā vastraṃ gandhaṃ sa dhūmakamtāmbūlaṃ ca trisandhyāsu dadyātsaṃdhyādvaye'pi vādīpāntaṃ vā nivedyāntaṃ yajecchaktyanurūpataḥsnapanaṃ vidhinā kāryaṃ prāguktena krameṇa tusvarāṣṣoḍaśa tadbāhye tad bāhye kādayo matāḥekāvaraṇa saṃyuktamadhamaṃ tviti kīrtitambhakta janmadine vāpi karturjanmadine'pi vānavāhaṃ vātha saptāhaṃ pañcāhaṃ tridinaṃ tu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhvajārohaṇa pūrvādi kartavyaṃ karturicchayāsvasva jāti vaśenokta maṅgalāṣṭaka saṃyutamindrādīnāṃ baliṃ dadyāt gandhaṃ puṣpādi saṃyutamyāgaśālāṃ vidhānena kṛtvā vedi samanvitāmsarvamaṅgala saṃyuktaṃ maṅgalāṅkuramācaretalpāṃ ca mahatīṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānataḥsthaṇḍilaṃ śāli pūrvaiśca kṛtvā saṃsthāpayetghaṭānpratyahaṃ pūjayeddevān sāyaṃ prārgurūttamaḥdravyāṇyatrāpi vipredāḥ pratiṣṭhokta prakārataḥbalyante cotsavaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṃkāra saṃyutamante cūrṇocsavaṃ kṛtvā tīrtha karma samācaretśuddhasnapanamante ca mūle berādike nayetkevalaṃ tūtsavaṃ kuryādaśaktaścenmunmunīśvarāḥāyurārogya vijaya śrīkīrtiphalamāpnuyātante sāyujyamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicaraṇāsā vidyā dvividhā proktā saṃskṛtānyātmiketi cabhaktokta sthānake vāpi vidyāsthānaṃ prakalpayetpañca viṃśti mātrāntaṃ bhavet pustaka dairghyakampramā'ṃ tu viśāle syāt pañcapaṭṭīyutaṃ tu vātālasaṃbhūtapatraṃ vā suvarṇādi vinirmitammaṣyā vā kuṅkumādyai rvā puṣpādyairnirmitena vāśubhavārarkṣayogādāvārabhedanukūlabhena samīpe paśūnāṃ tu kuryādadhyayanaṃ budhaḥlekhayedṛjupaṅkyā taṃ patraprānte na lekhayetvastrādyairdeśikaśceṣṭvā patrikāmapi pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prakīrṇa puṣpa prakare sadhupena ca dhūpitelikhedvā śruṇuyādvāpi paṭhedvādau śucirnaraḥśivajñānasya kālena praṇaṣṭasya pramāṇataḥpramādīkṛta pāṭhasya nāśitasyālpa buddhibhiḥvyarthaiḥ padairupetasya punaruktatasya cārthataḥchandasātīva naṣṭasya śabdārtha rahitasya cayaḥ karoti pumān samyak saṃskāraṃ deśikaḥ sudhīḥadhyāpayecchanaiśśiṣyāḥ śivabhaktānsaṃskṛtairdrāmiḍairvākyairdeśabhāṣā prakārakaiḥatra laukika śabdaiśca yaśśiṣya manurūpataḥpradeśavartibhissarva deśathaṃ bodhayedyathātathā vidyāpradhānasya nāntassarva guṇātmanaḥihakīrtiḥ śriyo brāhmī prajñā kāntirdhanaṃ sukhamsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ pāpīyāñjñāna nāśakaḥpratyahaṃ lekhayodvidvān yathā śakti subuddhimāntāvadyutasahasrāṇi dātā śivapure naraḥmātṛḥ pitṛndharmapatnīstaissvargaṃ samavāpya caapi ślokaṃ tadardhaṃ vā śivajñānasya yaḥ paṭhetśruṇuyādekacittastu tadarthaṃ ca vicārayetśivajñānābhiyuktasya bhojanācchādanādibhiḥmūlyena kārayedvātha tadeva phalamaśnutesa rājā vardhate sa rājādhipa ūrjitaḥpurohitatve sarveṣāṃ rājakārye'nyadarśaneyatsiddhāntā virodhena vedaṃ vedāṅgameva caniścinoti ca śāstrārthaṃ sa dharmaṃ vetti netaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: buddhisyāttāmasītsya sa ca dharma bahiṣkṛtaḥśāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ karma jñeyaṃ rājñā viśeṣataḥvidheyaṃ dharmaniṣṭena sāntānika vareṇa tuevaṃ vidyā prabhāvasyāt sthāpanaṃ vakṣyate'dhunāvidyāśālā viśālasyāt prasādo vātha maṇḍapaḥvidyāpīṭhasya vistāra saptāṅgula viśālataḥtenāyāmassamākhyātaḥ pañcāśatkarajāntakaḥanyadāsana vidhyukta mārgeṇa sakalaṃ nayetmaṇḍape sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vastrordhve tāṃ niveśayetśivabhede śivaḥ pūjyo rudrabhede sa eva hidvayorekaiva pūjāsyāt vidyeśān bahirāvṛtānsamidājyatilopetaṃ haviṣā ca samanvitamsaṃprāpta dakṣitaṇaḥ kuryānmantranyāsaṃ gurūttamaḥmadhyametu śivaṃ nyastvā devīṃ paṭṭikayornyasetvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṅkuśameka vaktraṃ dvinetraṃ ca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitampratimālakṣaṇa proktamānenaiva samācaretśeṣāḥ pumāṃso vijñeyāstvaṣṭatālavinirmitāḥtālāṣṭāṃśa vivṛddhyā tu catustālāvasanakamteṣāṃ rmūdhnyāyudhaṃ kāryamathavā makuṭopariparityajyāṅkuśaṃ yadvā tatsthāne kalpayedhvajamratnanyāsaṃ purā kuryānnetra mokṣaṇakaṃ tataḥgavyābhiṣecitaṃ śastra malaṃkṛtya nayettataḥprāgukta maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā caturdvāra samanvitammaṇḍapaṃ daśasaṃkhyātaṃ prapā kuṇḍasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekasmin maṇḍape tvaṣṭadikkuṇḍaṃ parito bhavetvṛtta kuṇḍaṃ bhavedevaṃ kuṇḍāni daśa saṃkhyayāpuṇyāha prokṣaṇānte tu sthaṇḍilaṃ lakṣaṇānvitamāsanaṃ praṇavaṃ kṛtvā darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaretśayane śāyayed biṃbaṃ pradakṣiṇa śironvitamparitoṣṭa ghaṭānvāpi kalaśān prāgdigāditaḥmadhya kuṃbhe ca mūlāṇuṃ dikṣu brahmāṇi pūjayetsmṛtvā homaṃ svamantraiśca samidājyatilānvitampalāśodumbarāśvattha vaṭā dikṣu vidikṣu capalāśo brahmaṇo viṣṇośśrīvṛkṣasamidhomatāḥsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ navedya sahitaṃ yathāevaṃ yaḥ kārayenmartyaḥ sarvāriṣṭairvimucyatehaimarājata tāmrairvāyasenāśmādibhistu vāmahatāmeka bhāgaṃ tu śūlānāṃ mānamiṣyatedvārastambho dayā deva mānaṃ vā paribhāvyatāmjātyaṃśaṃ pūrvavannītvā kalpayeddeśikottamaḥbhāmekaṃ prayuñjīyācchubhāyādi prasiddhayeyajamānanṛpagrāmānukūlaṃ laukikaṃ matamaṃgulairnirmitaṃ yattu yaugikaṃ śūlamiṣyateyugikaṃ cānyanagara sthānakartṛnurūpi yatutsedhaṃ daśadhā kṛtvā vyomadvitribhreva vāpādamāna yutaṃ vātha tanmānaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthakrasasaptāṣṭanavabhiḥ madhyapatrasya vistaraḥpatramānaṃ visṛjyātha pārśvayorubhayorapimadhyapatra tatiryadvat pārśva patratatistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyapatrād bahiścāntarmadhyasūra samāśrayātpatramūlabalārdhaṃ ca mūlādhāraṃ vivardhayetpatratāreṇa cāgre tu tadardhe nātha pādataḥpatrāgra madhyamaṃ tadvadvaśiṣṭaṃ vā prakalpayetpatratāraṃ catuṣpañcarasa saptāṣṭa bhāgataḥyavārdhaṃ tu samārabhya yavapāda vivardhanātmadhya patrasya madhyāttu hīnaṃ tatpatraṃ pārśvakameka dvitriyavairvāpi nirgataṃ mukulaṃ nayetpādāyāmastu mūle syāttadardhaṃ pārśvapatrayoḥdviguṇo madhyapādasya vistāraḥ pārśvapādataḥtasyādhaḥ pālikā kāryā patrāyāmārdha bhāgataḥphalakā vistṛtiṃ bhaktvā navadhaikena vārdhataḥekena karṇa vistāra iṣṭāśena mato dvijāḥtadardhaṃ ca galaṃ prāgvat kartavyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥghaṭavannāḍikāmānaṃ yughadhā vibhajetta tathīrikādhaḥ prakartavyo daṇḍastu vidhinā dvijāḥtadardhaṃ lohadaṇḍaśced yathā śobhāṃśato'thavātadardhaṃ vāntare'ṣṭāṃśe navadhā mānameva vāpādaṃ vāntara mānaṃ vā taducce daśadhā kṛtevṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā dvimiśraṃ vā prakalpayetmadhyapatrasya madhyetu likhedvābjaṃ tu tanmukhampatroccanavabhāgaikadvitrivedaśaroccakamdevāntaraṃ vā lokeśānastrānveṣṭa pramāṇataḥmālā catuṣṭayaṃ kuryād tadvihīnaṃ tu vā dvijāḥpālikopari koṇeṣu kārayedvā vṛṣeśvaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyapatra samāyātaṃ tripādenārdhato'pi vāvistārocc samaṃ tadvadvistāra samameva vāpādabhūṣaṇa maṇḍyādi patrādho vā prakalpayettriśūlāparabhāge tu vṛṣabhaṃ vā samālikhetpūrvabhāge pare daṇḍaṃ tadūrdhve śūlamācaretsudṛḍhaṃ sthāpayecchūlaṃ tatpratiṣṭhā nigadyateproktakālarkṣa vārādyaṃ tadvadevāṅkurārpaṇampadmasaṃghāta mārgeṇa cordhvādhaḥ khaṇḍayorapiacala sthāpanaṃ cettu ratnanyāsaṃ tu kārayetśuddhiṃ kṛtvā mṛdādyaistu purādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇampūrvoktamānaṃ bhūtekagrahakuṇḍa samanvitamvāstu homasamāyuktaṃ vedyāṃ sthaṇḍila saṃyutamtato biṃbaṃ samānīya snāpayetpūrvavartmanābere ca vṛṣabhe caiva bandhayet kautukaṃ guruḥācchādya śveta raktābhyāṃ vāsobhyāmastramuccaranśivāstraṃ saṃyajettatra caturbāhvindu bhūṣitamsvāsye daṃṣṭrānvitaṃ śakti śūlābhayavarānvitamdviraṣṭa varṣeṇopetaṃ subhāsaṃ svastikānvitamvṛṣo yadyasti tatkuṃbhaṃ teṣu tānarcayetkramāttatva tatveśvaropetaṃ mūrtimūrtīśvarānnyasetdaṇḍamadhyāgra patrāntaṃ tatvatatveśvarānyasetnyastvaivaṃ mūrti mūrtīśāñchivāstraṃ vinyased guruḥmadhya patre nyasedrudaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dakṣapatrakeṣaṇmukhaṃ kuṃbhadeśe tu kuṃbhasyāsye vināyakamtanmūle caṇḍārājaṃ ca lakṣmīṃ pūrvadalāgrake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: durgā vai saumyadeśe tu rudrānarkānvasūnapihomaṃ kuryattadante tu kṛtvā kuṇḍāgni saṃskṛtimpalāśodumbarāśvattha vaṭāḥ prāgādi dikṣu capradhāne tarpayeddhīmān śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ guruttamaḥsenānīṃ paścime kuṇḍe ravīnagnidiśi sthitauīśāna kuṇḍe pūrvasmin lakṣmīṃ dakṣe tu mātaraḥtaddiṅmūrtyādi saṃyuktaṃ pūrva saṃkhyā samanvitamekaikāhuti dānena tarpyāḥ kuṇḍe pradhānakevajrādīn paṃkaje sarvān devān prāgvanniveśayetsnapanaṃ bhūri naivedyamutsavaṃ kārayeccaletriśūla sthāpanaṃ hyevaṃ kuryādyo nara sattamaḥbhuktvā bhogānihaivānte mokṣaṃ caiva samāpnuyātdevādīnāṃ jṛpādīnāṃ martyānāṃ ca mahātmanāmcakravartī bhavedādyastvadhirājo dvitīyakaḥcatuḥsamudraparyantaṃ pṛghvīṃ yaḥ paripālayetadhirājssamākhyātastrirājyaṃ yastu pālayetpārṇeya pramukhāsteṣāṃ āsanāni bahūnyapivdyantaraṃ tvaṣṭadhā kṛtvā navotsedhāḥ prakīrtitāḥnarendra sadṛśaṃ tasya bāhūrunābhidaghnajamtithyaṅgulaṃ samārabhya dvivdyaṅgula vivardhanātutsedha sadṛśo vātha tripādo'rdhastu vā mataḥhīnānāṃ hīnamānaṃ syācchreṣṭhānaṃ sarvamiṣyatecaturaśraṃ samaṃ vṛttaṃ dyusadāṃ cakravartināmsiṃhāsanāyataṃ kuryād aṅgulaivathakārayetdviguṇāntaṃvidheyaṃ syādāyāme'pyevamīrtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāme viṣṇuṃ samāvāhya pālikāyāṃ tu pārvatīdaṇḍāgre madane jñeyo bhāskaro daṇḍamadhyamemātarassaptadakṣe tu jyeṣṭhāpaścimadikdalerudrārkavasavośvinyāvaṣṭādaśagaṇāścayebherīṃ vastreṇa saṃveṣṭaya madhye rudraṃ samarcayetvalaye dakṣiṇe sūryamitare candramarcayetrudrāṃstatsaṃkhyake nyastvā carmasūtreṣu vāsukīmgandhapuṣpādibhirdravyaiḥ naivedyāntaiḥ pṛthak hṛdāekaprahārataḥ pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ dviprahārataḥsantāḍya vādakaṃ prokṣya mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ smarantaddhaste kusumaṃ dadyāttanmantraṃ samanusmaranbherīṃ skande samāropya vādayet sarvatālavitgītanṛttasamāyuktamannaliṃgasamāyutamsaṃgrahītvāstrarājānaṃ vitānacchatrasaṃyutampraviśya nagarādyantu brahmāsthānāditaḥ kramātbalidānāvasāne tu tālasvarasamāyutambrahmāṇi brahmatālaṃ syāt megharāgasvarānvitambhṛṃgiṇī kauśikannaṭṭa bhāṣayā mallatālakamkoṭikantarkarāgeṇa śālāpāṇyātu ḍakkarīdhvajārohaṇa pūrvaṃ syādutsave triguṇe dinedevasya sannidhau kṛtvā sthaṇḍilānāñcatuṣṭayamtadagre vṛṣakuṃbhaṃsyāt vṛṣavidyeśvarānvitamkrameṇaitān samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātprāgukta vidhinā ceṣṭvā tatvādīn viniveśayetbherīṃ santāḍya saṃgrāhya triśūlaṃ vṛṣabhānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ pādāntaṃ mānamiṣyatesārdhāṅgulaṃ samārabhya vardhayedardha mātrataḥyathā balaṃ yathā śobhaṃ bhittistatra vidhīyatāmdairghyairnavādhikāḥ proktāḥ pūrvoktāḥ bhaktayo dvijāḥpāde pādāntare'nyatra siṃharūpāṇi kārayetsiṃhāsana tribhāgena caturbhāge na vā tvadhaḥupapīṭhaṃ vidheyaṃ syāt tadrūpamiha kathyatemṛtpāṣāṇa kujairdantaillohairvā sudhayātha vādanta vṛkṣa kṛtaṃ yacca svarṇa ratnairvicitritamtrinavāṃśe tadutsedhe kṣepaṇaṃ paṅkajaṃ lagalamvetraṃ karṇaṃ ca vetraṃ ca kampaṃ patraṃ kapotakamsaptaikārdhāṃśakārdhairvā vyoma vedāṃśakārdhakaḥardhenaikonaviṃśāṃ'saṃ bhadrakaṃ parikīrtitamsārdhārddhāṃśa vibhāgārdhairekārdhāṣṭāṃśa sārdhakaiḥpadmaṃ kampaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca kampaṃ ca vājanamaṅghriruttara paṭṭī ca nidrā padmaṃ kapotakametatsaumyaṃ samākhyātaṃ trisaptāṅgai ssamāyutampārśvayorbhadrayugmaṃ cecchrīvahaṃ parikīrtitamāsana vyāsatuṅgāḍhyā masūrādhāra veśinītadvistāra vibhāgena madhye makara toraṇamtoraṇāṅghriḥ svavistāra nirgatā nakrapaṭṭikākampa kṣepakapotādyairbahubhirbhūṣayet dvijāḥayomayāṃstu nārācān kīlān paṭṭāṃśca yojayetkuryāttoraṇa pṛṣṭe tu kalpa vṛkṣaṃ suvarṇajamvijiṃ hi tvāthavā kuryāt kalpavṛkṣaṃ tu kevalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcāṅgamupapīṭhaṃ yat padmakādho niyojayetupapīṭha daśāṃśe tu vedāṃśaiḥ kaṇṭha ucyatemahākampau vidhātavyau pañcāṅgamupapīṭhakamardhārdhakairdvicandraiśca ardhārdhābhyāmanukramātvetrābja vājanaṃ padmaṃ kampaṃ vetramanukramātcatuḥsaptāṃśake tuṅge jagatī paṅkajam galamvetraṃ galaṃ ca vetraṃ ca kampaṃ nidrā kapotakamūrdhve masūrakādhāra paṭṭikā mūlataḥ kramātdvyardhārdhārdhaka saptāṃśaiḥ ardhārdhārdhatribhāgataḥeta deva galādhastānnetrārdhaikārdha bhāgataḥyojayed vṛttakāntaṃ syād dvātriṃśadbhāganirmitamtribhāgārdhārdha vedārdhairardhadvyardhārdha kāṃśakaiḥvājanaṃ padmavetraṃ ca paṅkajaṃ vājanaṃ kajamśrīkāntādi caturṇāṃ syād aṣṭāṅgamupapīṭhakampādukaṃ paṅkajaṃ vetraṃ padmavetraṃ ca vājanamaṣṭāṅgamupapīṭhaṃ syāt sarva sarvatra vā matamadhiṣṭāni sarvāṇi sopapīṭhāni yāni caavalambita pādasyād devādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥsiṃhāsana viśālocca caturthāṃśa pramāṇataḥyathā śobhāṃśamānena saptāṅgairvṛtta sannibhamāsanāni ca sarvāṇi sabhadrāṇyathavā nayetpraveśaṃ ca tathā kuryāccho bhābalavaśena vāparidhiṃ vipulaṃ dairghyaṃ tuṅgaṃ sakalameva casaptabhūtarkṣamūrtyabdhi saṃkhyairbhāgān hared guruḥśākassālaśca panasaḥ śiṃśupaścandanāsane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: likucassahakāraśca kuṭajaḥ kaṭphalastathājambūścaiva madhūkaśca vaikaṅkata samāhvayaḥevaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ kṛtvā saṃskuryāt tadanaramśilpinaṃ ca visṛjyātha puṇyāhaprokṣaṇāntaramaṣṭamṛtsalile naiva kṣālayet kuśa vāriṇāpunargandhodakenaiva snāpayettadanantaramgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca tanmatreṇa samarcayetnamaskāra samopetaṃ svabījena samanvitamtasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā juhuyātsamidādibhiḥśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā tanmantraṃ samudīrayansiṃhāsanaṃ samubhyukṣya gandhādyaiḥ pūjayetpunaḥsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ chatra cāmara saṃyutamnarendrāsana saṃskārastvevaṃ deve viśiṣyatetaddeva homa saṃyuktamāsanāṇubhiranvitamaṣṭadikvaṣṭa kuṃbhāṃśca madhyame śakraśarvayoḥśivāsanāṇu madhye ca lokapān parito yajetsaṃtarpyāsana mantrāstu pūrṇānte deśikottamaḥśivāsanāṇuṃ tanmadhye kuṃbhasthaṃ viniveśayetsaṃpūjya gandha puṣpādyaistairmantraiśca gurūttamaḥsumuhūrte sulagne tu deveśamadhiropayetdakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti dāpayed gurumūrtayesuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmramārakūṭaṃ ca kāṃsyakamdantajaṃ kṣudrasiddhyarthaṃ trapusīsāyasādikamdvitryaṅgulaṃ samārabhya caikāṅgula vivardhanātsapādaṃ sārdhamaṣṭāṃśādhikaṃ pādatrayādikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyāme mānamuddiṣṭaṃ pādānaṃ mānamucyatepañcāśatkarajāntaṃ tu pādāyāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥvistāre viśvamātrāntaḥ pādāyāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥbhūtābhāḥ kharapādābhāssacakrā sshajā na vāte ca siṃhāsanāḥ kāryāḥ padmapīṭhopari sthitāḥantarvaktrā bahirvaktrāḥ pādabhūṣāyutā na vāpatraiḥ padmadalaiścaiva ratnādyairūpaśobhitāḥtatpādaiścheda saṃyuktairurdhvādhaḥ sthoccasaṃyutaiḥyavādyavārdha vṛddhyā tu rudramātra samāvadhivājanaiḥ padmapatraśca kṣepaṇairhīrikādibhiḥphalakāṃ bhūṣayedvātha kevalā phalakāthavānānā nāṭaka saṃyuktānayaḥ kīlasamanvitāncaturaśraṃ suvṛttaṃ vā tatdāyatameva vāāsanaṃ suvidheyaṃ syāt tatpādāścāpi tādṛśaḥcatuṣpādaśiraḥ pucchayukta kūrmo yathā bhavetsvarṇaiśśārdūla carmādyaiḥ samantācchādayenna vāphalakāntaṃ bhavenmānaṃ parityaktordhvakarmaṇāmeteṣāmāsanānāṃ tu saṃskāraḥ prāgudīritaḥpūrvokta vidhinā kuryāt āyādīnāṃ ca lakṣaṇamratho'nekavidhaḥ proktassaca cakra vibhedataḥnavāṣṭa cakra yukto vā dvicakraśśakaṭāhvayaḥbhāravāhya viśālaṃ syāt tadāyāmaśca kathyatepotikākaravat khyātaṃ bhāratāraghanānvitampādahinopayuktaṃvā tadantarmāna ṣaṭkayukyatra yatra ca bhārākṣaṃ saṃyogastatra kathyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bandhayet sva sva rakṣārthaṃ yathā dṛḍhataraṃ bhavetsvasvatārasamāḥ kāryā śikhāstārārdha vāhalāḥpraticakraṃ vidheyāssyussamā vā viṣamāstu vāakṣordha saṃpraveśārtha mupādhānantu vā nayetbhārabāhya viśālantu ṣaṣṭibhāgaṃ vibhājayetpādona dviguṇaṃ dairghyaṃ mūla metadudāhṛtambhāgaikena tripādārdhamāyāme parikalpayettayorapi pramāṇantu pādokta vidhināmatamkevalaṃ bhadramiṣṭaṃvā bhadrāgreṣviṣṭamānataḥbhadropabhadrayormānaṃ samaṃ vāpyadhikantuvātatsarvaṃ bhāradairghyaṃ syāt bhāre sandhirnakārayetdvitriveda mahābhūta bhāga vistāra saṃyutāḥtricatuḥpañcaṣaṭsapta vistārānardhanīvrakānbhāreṣuyojayedviṣṭānagre pṛṣṭhe'ntare yadicaturbhāgaṃ samārabhya bhāgasyāṣṭa daśāvadhicakrenemyantaraṃ vyoma bhāgāt bhāga vivṛddhitaḥtata bahiśca śikhāmānaṃ bhāranemyantaraṃ samamvṛttānyaśrāṇivākuryā dakṣāṇi gurusattamāḥpañcāṅgamiti kāryāṇi dāruṇā vāyasādibhiḥcakrāṇāntu pramāṇantu bāhyaṃ bhārāntaraṃ matamdvigābhādvasubhāgāntañcakrāṇāṃ dhanamīrtitamtathaiva bāhyenamyāśca tayormadhye'rakāni catriraṣṭabhyoṣṭa vṛdhyātu catuṣṣaṣṭyantakāni cabrahmā rathāṃga pāṇirvā śakro vā munipuṅgavāḥekabhāgā dvikārānta mekabhāga vivardhanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhārabāhya vivṛdhyātu rasabhāgāvasānakāḥguṇa candra mahābhūta vyomananda viyadguṇaiḥupāna padmakaṃpāni kaṃpaṃ karṇañca kapakampādonārdhena bhāgena tribhāgena dvibhāgataḥeṣāṃ praveśo niṣkrāntiḥ śobhābalavaśāt bhavetcatuṣkoṇeṣu madhyeṣu tathā bhadropa bhadrayoḥupapīṭhocchrayāntam vā kartavyamupa bhadrakamphalakā bhāra madhyantu pādādyaiḥ paribhūṣayetsanālannālamānantu dvisaptatryaṅgulordhvataḥvasvaṃ śānta dhanopetaṃ vṛttāvāṣṭāśramevavākuṃbha maṇḍi saṃyuktaṃ yuktaṃ vā gaṇḍikādvayoḥtacca vedāṃśamārabhya vyomabhāga vivṛddhitaḥtatripāda viśālaṃ vā tadantassamamānakambahiḥ karaṇamevaṃ syādatrāntaṃ karaṇaṃ dvijāḥyatheṣṭabahulopetaṃ tadūrdhve vājanāntaramdvābhyāmekena vā kuryāddārubhyāndāruṇādvijāḥpañcagrāhi nibandhedve vidhātavye vicakṣaṇaiḥbharamūle tadagre ca samabhade tathānayettatrapādā vidheyāssyuḥ upapīṭhāvasānaketatra sannaddha viṣṭe dve pañcagrāhī gate ca teupapīṭhordhvataḥ kuryādadhiṣṭhānantaducyatetamadhye ṣaṭkamānaṃ yat pūrvavat parigṛhyatāmpaṃkitnetraika saptaika vyoma dvyekaika locanaiḥsadanta galakaṃpauca mahā vājana mācaretpraveśa nirgamauvāpi tadvadeva samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhiṣṭhānordhvataḥ kāryaḥ pādavargo dvijottamāḥtadantarnavamānevā pādāṣṭāṃśonvitothavāsiṃha bhūta gajaiḥ pādairvargaṃ sarvatra bhūṣayetprastaraḥ pādavargordhve mānañcāsyanigadyatenavabhāgāvasānaṃ syādalaṅgāraśca kathyatevyomaika candra candrāṃśairuttaraṃ vājinantataḥpraveśo nirgamañcaiṣāṃ dhāmoktanyāyato bhavetpādāntaṃ vātha bhadrāntaṃ hrāsa yuktaṃ ca mūlataḥpraveśa rahitaṃ vā syāt eva mevopa bhadrakamṣaḍādi triṃśadaṃśāntaṃ samaṃ vā mūlapādataḥanenaiva prakāreṇa kārayet tritalādikamekāṅgula ghanairiṣṭa ghanairvā sudṛḍhaṃ yathānyāyenānena kartavyaḥ praveśo nirgamopivāpraveśa nirgamau hitvā kuryādvārajju sūtrakamrathasyārohaṇārthantu sopānākṛti sannibhampratibhaumaṇ praveśasyāt bhadrasya munipuṅgavāḥupabhadra vihīnaṃ vā bhadraṃ bhārāntameva vābhāropari vidhātavyaṃ tadūrdhve devasaṃsthitiḥbahiḥ karaṇamevasyā dantaratra nigadyateūrdhvakampa nibaddhāśca vidhātavyā vicakṣaṇaiḥviṣṭarābahavaḥ kāryāsthalaṃ pratyekamācaretayantyasyustadūrdhvetu tadūrdhvecchādanaṃ matamnānā kīlaka paṭṭaiśca pañcagrāhibhireva cakoṭikairvakrapaṭṭaiśva bandhayet sudṛḍhaṃ yathāpādākūṭayutaṃ taccedrathastanmāna mucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāvadaṣṭasavaṃ pādadairghyamagnyaṅgulādikampāda vistāra ākhāto dhāma pādā kṛtiryathābahunīvra samāyuktāḥ phalakāsu niveśitāḥtathaivāyasanālaiśca dhārassudṛdhaṃ yathāśikhākaraṇamārgeṇa lupārohaṇa kriyānvitāchādayedanya deśañca ojastūpi samanvitamkathyate sacaleśena vistārādāyatopivāvardhayet dvitrivedaiśca guṇitekramaśohṛtetithissyāt triguṇaṃ triṃśaddhstametadrathematamrathasya sthāpanaṃ yaśca kathyate viprapuṅgavāḥgomūtra gomayāṃbhobhiḥ kuśodaistajjalairapiastrodenāpi saṃprokṣaya gandha puṣpādibhiḥ yajetvastreṇācchādya dhāmoktyā tatvatatveśvarānvitamdakṣiṇottara saṃstheṣu kramaśaḥ parikalpayetupapīṭhe vṛṣaṃ yaṣṭvā dhāre'nantaṃ prapūjayetadhaścordhvacchadevidvān krameṇa viniveśayetkarṇikānnavaśaktīṃśca śivāsanaṃ anusmaretśikhareca sadeśānaśśivasyāt stūpināyakaḥtadagre sthaṃḍilaṃ kṛtvā tasmin sūtrāṃbarānvitāntatra madhye śivaṃ pūrvebhānuṃ induṃ tathānalevāruṇe vṛṣabhaṃ vāyāvanantaṃ viniveśayetgandhādyairarcayitvātu homakarma samācaretnavavā pañcakuṇḍāni ekaṃ vā pūrvatasthitamśivaṃ sāṅgaṃ pradhānetu tarpayecchata saṃkhyayāeka kalpe gurusvasmin kuṇḍe sarvañca tarpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatvamūrti tadīśaiśca gururhomaṃ mācaretśamyāpāmarga śrīvṛkṣa pippalāsyurvidaggatāḥpūrṇāndatvā dvitīyehni kṛta kuṃbhāgni pūjanaḥmuhūrte samanuprāpte mantranyāsaṃ samācaretanuktamatra sāmānya sthāpanoktavadācaretihaiva dhanavāṃcchrīmān vāṃchitaṃ phalamāpnuyātpaiṭhīca śekharīmaṇḍī trividhā parikīrtitāṣaṇṇavatyaṃśa kāntastu śibikā vistaromataḥekon dviśataṃ yāva dāyāmaṃ parikalpayetpādabāhyantu devānāṃ rājñāmapi viśiṣyateeva meveṣikā bāhyā madhyamaṃ parikīrtitamtricaturbhūta ṣaṭ sapta navabhirvatsaro bhavetvitstiraṅgulirvāpi jñeya māyādi śobhanamaṣṭatritrivasughnañca sūryaiśca manubhirbhajettriṃśadbhiḥ munibhiḥ viprāḥ kramādāyādayomatāḥvistāreṇāthavāyasyādāyāmenavyayo bhavetvistārāyāma saṃyogāttithirvārastu tuṅgatāḥhastāntantuṅgamānaṃ syādalaṅkārastu kathyatetriṣaḍaṅgula paryantamiṣikāvistaro mataḥsapta mātrāntamuddiṣṭamiṣikā bahulaṃ dvijāḥhastamānaṃ sumuddiṣṭaṃ vṛttaṃ vācaturaśrakamaṣṭāṃśādaṃśa vṛdhyātu svannyāsa dviguṇāvadhikintu haste viśeṣoyaṃ svavyāsāṣṭa guṇāvadhipaṭṭikā ghana vistāro yathāyogyaṃ vidhīyategulikā pāda pādaiśca paṭṭairhīnaiśca vājanaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā śobhāṃśamānaiśca kapota prativājanaiḥsvarṇāditāra tāmrorthaiḥ jantajairvṛkṣajaistu vāeṣā paiṭhī samākhyātā śekharī śikharānvitāśūkaḥ kālaśca timiraḥ panaso niṃbakārjunauvṛkṣeretaiḥ prakartavyā śibikā lakṣaṇānvitāvakṣye paryaṅkamānaśca śibikā vistaro yathācatuṣpadādi saṃyuktaṃ pādamānañca kathyatepāda dairghyaṃ samākhyātaṃ dvayaṃgulāt pādavṛddhitaḥaneka gaṇdikopetannānā hīra samanvitamtat pārśve tviṣikāṃ kuryāt phalakāṃ vā dvijottamāḥnānāpaṭṭa samāyuktannānāvetra samāyutamlohajandantajaṃ vātha dārujaṃ miśramevavāparyaṅkame tat kathitaṃ bāla paryaṅkamapyathakhaṭvā pāda samāyuktaṃ paṭṭikāṃ eka saṃyutamnimbādi taru saṃsiddhaṃ bāla paryaṅgamīritamyājñīyavṛkṣajāśśastāssamidhodvādaśaṅgulāḥtriṃśaddarbhadalairgādhaṃ grathitā bāhumātrakāḥtanmānā ṛjavassāgrāstatkuṇḍasamidudbhavāḥcatvāro viṣṭarāstadvanmatāḥ paridhayo'pi caṣaṭtriṃśaddarbhaparyantaṃ kūrcārthaṃ darbhamāharetgranthirardhāṅgulātpādavṛddhayā syād dyaṅgugāvadhivṛddhyaikamātrayā proktaṃ navamātrāvasānakambrahmaviṣṇvīśvarāḥ kūrcamūlamadhyagragā matāḥutkūrcaśśāntidaḥ proktastvadhaḥ kūrcastu puṣṭidaḥdvitrivedaśarairdarbhairmūlāgrasahitaistu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: grāmapradakṣiṇa kṛtvā devatāvāhanānvitamdhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kuryāt prāguktavidhinā guruḥdhvajasya bhramaṇañcāhniṃ kuryādvā saṃskṛtasya catatoṃkurārpaṇaṃ rātrau yāgārambhadine matamgrāmapradakṣiṇantīrthāṃkurasyāvaśyakammatamaṃkurārpaṇa pūrve tu sāyāhnasamayemṛdamtaddinecaitadiṣṭaṃsyāt bherītāḍanapūrvakamtadrātrāvaivakartavyaḥ yāgārambhaśśivasya tuketvaṃkuro navāhe syāt sptāhe cotsavāṃkuramyāgaśālāntataḥ kuryādagre vā tvagrapārśvayoḥmadhyāgāre viśeṣeṇa pañcahastapramāṇataḥpaṅktitrayasamāyuktaṃ pañcapaṅktisamanvitamnavāṃgulāntamānena tvadhikāḥ pañcapaṅktayaḥekadvārayutāṃ vāpi maṇḍapākārasaṃsthitāmekāgnisahitāṃ vāpi vitānadhvajasaṃyutāmnālikeraphalopetāṃ sarvamaṇḍanamaṇḍitāmekāṃgulavivṛddhayāṣṭāviṃśatyaṃgulakāvadhiathavā paṅktimānena copadevī samanvitamyugāśraṃ vartulaṃ vāpi trimekhalasamanvitamevaṃ sarvañca saṃpādya śilpimocanamācaretbhūparigrahakaṃ vāpi sarvādhvara śiroyutamdroṇāt droṇavivṛddhayātu navadroṇāvasānakamtadvallājasamopetaṃ tadardhatilasaṃyutamtilalājādirekhāḍhyandarbhaveṣṭanasaṃyutamtanmadhye sthāpayetkumbhaṃ śivākhyaṃ vardhanīyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anāmikāṅgulīyogayogyarandhra samanvitamīśvarādhiṣṭhitaṃ prāgvaddakṣiṇe cobhayatra caaṅgulīyakamiṣṭaṃ syāttadarthaṃ svarṇanirmitamarkamātrādiṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāvanatena cadarbhamālā vidheyā syāt kaniṣṭhāṅgulināhayāārabhya hastatritayaṃ trṅgulena vivardhanātsadṛśe vāntare'ṣṭāṃśe navamānaṃ prakīrtitamstambhayorviṣṭarasyāpi pramāṇaṃ trṅgulāditaḥyājñikaistarubhiḥ kuryāt pratiṣṭhādau ca toraṇamiṣṭamānena khātaṃ syācchikhāmānaṃ tathaiva casaptāṅgulaṃ samārabhya vyomamātravivṛddhitaḥvistārāt pādavṛddhyā tu dvyaṅgulādarkamātrakamevaṃ toraṇamākhyātaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakamucyateṣaṭtriśanmātraparyantaṃ dairghyaṃ teṣu prakalpayetantareṣṭavibhāge tu navamānamudāhṛtamyājñīyavṛkṣailohairvā maṅgalāṣṭakamācaretśrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṃkho dīpaśśaivāṣṭamaṅgalamvṛṣaṃ tyaktvā tadarthaṃ tu svasvavāhanamācaretgrāmādau svagṛhe vāpi yajamānānurūpataḥpañcāṅgulaṃ samārabhya vyomāṅgula vivṛddhitaḥvistārastadvaśājjñeyassapādaṃ vātha darpaṇamtathaiva pūrṇakumbhe tu pādamānaṃ prakīrtitamtathiva pādamukṣe syāt sthito vā śayito'thavāśrīvatsastu yathoddiṣṭaḥ svastiko grāmaveśaneśrīvatse pādapadmaṃ ca chatraṃ ca viniveśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: darpaṇe pūjayetsūryaṃ pūrṇakumbhe jaleśvaramśaṅkhe tu vimalaṃ dīpe pūjayeddhavyavāhanampūrvasmin paścime bhāge cāmaradvitayaṃ nyasethitvāṣṭamaṅglaṃ vātha tatsthāne tān prapūjayetdhvajaṃ vātha gadāṃ padmaṃ cakraṃ ca kārayetlohairvā yājñikairvṛkṣairlohaśced beramānataḥjāye śakti gade jñeya śeṣāḥ puruṣalakṣaṇāḥtanmūrdhnikuṭordhve vā haste vajrādikānnyasetṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmamaṣṭāṅgulasuvistarammātrairekonapañcāśat paryantairdīrdhamucyateiṣṭamānena caiteṣāṃ vistāra iha kathyatetatpārśve vāntare vāpi tadbilaṃ vidhinācaretdairghyaṃ tasya rasāṅgeṣuvedikāṅguṣṭhakarṇikāsaptāṅgulārdhavicchinnacatussaṃvartitānanākalaśodgataṣaṇṇāhadaṇḍāgraśrutivedikānānāvājanavetraiśca padmapatrairvicitritākarṇapārśvaikamātronaśarāvādāmukhāvadhaḥathavā triṃśadāyāmamaṣṭāṅgula suvistaramāsyaṃ trikoṇavatkāryaṃ madhye bilasamanvitamtadadho gaṇḍikā kāryā mātrārdhādardhavṛddhitaḥmuṣṭyaṣ.āṅgulamānena tannāho'ṣṭāṅgulena cadvātriṃśadaṅgulāyāmaṃ saptāṅgulasuvistaramkarṇaḥ pakṣāṅgulāyāmo vistāraśśaramātrakaḥgaṇḍikaikāṅgulā proktā tannāhaścābdhimātrakaḥtanmūle kalaśākāro vdyaṅgulo daśanāhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmamaṣṭāṅgulasuvistaramvistāreṇa ca dairghyeṇa sūkarānanasannibhamkarṇadairghyaṃ dvimātraṃ syādvistāraṃ caturaṅgulamtrimātraṃ vā caturmātraṃ tanmadhye bilamucyateardhārdhāṅgulavṛddhyā tu kartavyaṃ caturaṅgulamsruk syāt sruve'pi tadyonistanmānaṃ tastato bhavetṣaḍaṅgulapaśīṇāho daṇḍamūle ca puṣkaregopurākāravat kāryamājyasthānaṃ tadagrakenūtanaṃ karaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ purāṇaṃ tadabhāvataḥtadājñāpūrvakaṃ sa syāttadbhogyakaraṇaṃ tataḥyena śāstreṇa yatsthāne kriyā pūrvaṃ pravartateanuktamanyato gāhyamutsavādiṣu karmasuśreṣṭhastaddhāmasaṃsiddho na grāhyo'nyālayasthitaḥtalliṅgādyanukūlaṃ cedberādyaṃ yat pratiṣṭhitamsthānāt sthānāntaraprāptidoṣaśuddhyarthamācarethrasvaprāsādamantreṇa prabhūtayajanānvitampañcaṣaṭsaptahastāni kanyasānāṃ samucchrayaḥteṣu hastāt paraḥ khyātaḥ svavṛddhyarhopalakṣitaḥśalyavasvaṅgulānvātha pareṣāṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamudayārdhapramāṇaṃ vā yādādau paripaṭhyatesaukhyakarma prakartavyaṃ yathāvacchṛṇuta dvijāḥsasarjāpsaraso rudraḥ kauśika prītikāraṇātaspṛśyaṃ pratilomādyaiḥ ajāyata sanātanamdevatāruvane pūrva vinodārthaṃ mayā purātatrasthā munipatnyo māṃ dṛṣṭvā sādaramakṣamāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathā vidhāśca tāssarvā dṛṣṭāḥ khalumayādarāttattadgarbhabhavā yāśca tā rudragaṇikā matāḥevaṃ pṛṣṭo bravīmyevaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ yanmayoditamtadeva śuddha nṛttaṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ bharatoditamstrībhistadvaṃśa jātābhiḥ pañcācārya samanvitammayā tuṣṭena tāssarvā dīkṣitā dīkṣayā khaluḥvetraṃ tasmācchirāṃsyāsāṃ spṛṣṭāni dvijasattamāḥyato daṇḍena saṃspṛṣṭaṃ śiro daṇḍinya ityapinartako mardakaścaiva gāyako vāṃśikastathācaturvarṇānulomātthā nāṭyaveda kṛtaśramāḥnava nāṭya rasajñāśca madbhaktā vīta kalmaṣāḥnartane ca svayaṃ śakto mātrāgaṇana tatparaḥpravṛtte śuddhanṛtte tu tadaṅgekṣaṇa tatparaḥsapta svara vibhedena gāyako gāna nāyakaḥsaukhye tu vādayedvaṃśa mudāttādi vibhedataḥnartako mardako'nyaśca dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitauagre mauravikassaukhye vādayenmukhaṃ tathāpunardīkṣā vidhyeyā syāt sā ca leśānnigadyatepañcāśadvatsarāntāstā yogyā naivetarāḥ kvacittrastriṃśat karād dvidvi hastābhyāṃ hvāsayed dvijāḥpratyekaṃ tritrimānāni teṣviṣṭaṃ parigṛhyatāmathavā sarva sāmānyā maṇḍapāḥ prāgvinirmitāḥsarve ca maṇḍapāḥ kāryāḥ nivṛttyādi kalāmayāḥnaṭeśaṃ maṇḍapebhyarcya sāṅgaṃ gandhādibhistataḥpañcākṣarādi japtena dvāgre lepite punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣālitaṃ vetramādāya hetito yena deśikaḥnandinaṃ tatra saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādibhrguruḥśvetacandana liptāṅgaḥ ādiśaivo'ṅgulīyakaiḥtacchiṣyo vā tadādāya mūrdhādi kramaśo nyasetgandhādinā samabhyarcya prāgvad vetraṃ punarnyasetnāmāntaraṃ ca dāsyāmi daṇḍinyastaṃ mahattaramevaṃ praśāsya taddhaste prakṣipet puṣpasaṃhatimpunarādāya puṣpāṇi śivāya vinivedayetśiva prītikaram saukhyaṃ kārayecchiva sannidhaudeśikasya gṛhe vātha svagṛhe vā manoramevinyasya tatpuraḥ kuṃbhaṃ svarṇavastrādi saṃyutampañcācāryān kṛtasnātāñśuklavastādibhiryutānpañcākṣara samopetaṃ tadā karmādhi kāritānirdiṣṭa divasāt pūrvaṃ maṅgalāṃkura mācaretvidhāya maṇḍape pīṭhaṃ balipīṭha vaśānnayetniṣpādya devadeveśaṃ pūrvedyussaṃprapūjayetdhautadantāśca susnātāssarvāvayava śobhitāḥkṛtaśarvanatāḥ śāntā baddhapratisarānvitāḥsaṃsthāpya deva deveśaṃ sahasrakalaśādibhiḥmaṇḍapācchilpinaṃ samyag visṛjyālipya gomayaiḥmadhyapīṭhasya madhye tu yajeddevaṃ sadāśivamsāṅgaṃ cāvaraṇopeta māvṛtistvadhunocyateskandaṃ ca paścime deśe viṣṇuṃ saumye samarcayetpūrvāsyāṃ rudramabhyarcya gaurīdevyā samanvitamsarasvatyā samopetaṃ lokapālādi saṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udg viṣṇuṃ yajet dhīmān lokapālāvṛtiṃ bahiḥāvāhyābhyarcya gandhāyairnāḍī sandhāna pūrvakamsamidājyānna lājaiśca tilaiḥ pūrṇāṃ samācaretprāgukta vidhinā pūrvaṃ saṃskṛtāśced dvijottamāḥnṛttārambhe ca pūjā syād deśikasya viśeṣataḥbhṛtiṃ dadyāttatastāsāṃ yathā syāt prema tudvijāḥkṛtasnānāṅga bhūṣāḍhya śuklamālyādi yuktayāsamabhyarcya tadagretu nava nāṭya rasānvitambrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sandhyātrayādhipāḥ smṛtāḥkamalāsanāyaāmoda mattaralibhirrikūjat puṣpāṃjalisyāt puruṣottamāyapuṣpāñjalirbhavatu me parameśvarāyautsave snapane māsapūjāyāṃ homakarmaṇidhajārohaṇa kalādau kāmyādau ca viśiṣyateācāryaḥ sādhakonyaśca putraka ssamayīti casaṃskāreṇa viśeṣo'yaṃjātyā vaiśi.ya mucyateprāgvadeva guṇotkṛṣṭā jātyā vaiśiṣya mīrtitamyogena kriyayā vātha caryayāpi viśiṣyatetaputrā mantrīṇaścaite viśiṣyante krameṇa tudaivajñaśca krameṇaiṣāṃ vaiśiṣyaṃ śivadhāmanimadbhaktā naiṣṭhikā paścāt bhautikā bhṛti varjitāḥsvatantragāna kṛdviṇā mantra gānādi tatparāḥkrameṇaiṣāṃ ca vaiśiṣyaṃ svasvakarmabhirīritambrāhmaṇādi kraṇeṇāpi jñātvā vaiśiṣyamādarātsarveṣāmuditaṃ teṣāṃ mukhyantaṃ deśikājñayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deśikājñā mamājñā sā mayaivoktā śivāgamesanmārgādi krameṇāpi vaiśiṣyamiha saṃatamdāsamārgī caturdhaiṣāṃ kramāt vaiśiṣya miṣyateputramārgī bhavet sarva śaivāgamaviśāradaḥputrī kṛta janaścaivācārya ssāntānikaśca saḥpraveśaka śśivajñānī tvaupa deśika eva vāśaiva nṛtta nati stotra gān kṛddrohimardakaḥevaṃ guṇa samāyuktaiḥ viśiṣyaṃ parikalpayetsarveṣāmapi martyānāṃ bhūpatīnāṃ viśeṣataḥjvaramārigrahā veśāpasmāreṣu viśeṣataḥvāta pittakaphodreke dāhamoha vaṇokaṭeevamanyamahāvyādhau śirodṛgdantakarṇajepālakādi samutpattau gajādīnāṃ dvijottamāḥpuṣṭyarthaṃ ca balārthaṃ ca vidhirgeśānnigadyateanyasmin puṇyadeśe tu tattatsthāne svamandireliṃge vā maṇḍale kumbhe sthaṇḍile phalakādiṣugandha puṣpaissadhūpaiśca dīpaiśca haviṣānvitamsaṃpūjyeṣṭamaṃ devaṃ japaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vāmantramuccārya he deva vyādhiṃ nāśaya nāśayaevaṃ japaṃ vidhāyaita diṣṭadeve nivedayetstutvā praṇamya deveśaṃ homasthānaṃ samāśrayetkuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vātha śivāgniṃ vidhinā nayetgandhādyaissamidājyānnatilaḥ kalpoditaistu vākṛtvā pūrṇāṃ samādāya tasmādbhasma visarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: homa karma nivedyāsmai devaṃ stutvā praṇamya catadbhasmālepanaṃ kuryāttanmantra dhyāna saṃyutamhomānte vā baliṃ dadyādanyathāpi nigadyategandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya tathā balyantameva caśuddhānnaṃ vājya saṃyuktaṃ dadhyapūpādi saṃyutamcature caitya vṛkṣasya mūle rathyāmathāpi vāyassatvo devadattaṃ tu samāśrityeha vartateekāhādi daśāhāntaṃ māsātsaṃvatsarāntakambalireṣa samākhyāto dhūpadīpasamanvitaḥathavānya prakāreṇa vyādhimocanamucyatesauvarṇāṃ rājatāṃ vātha śataniṣka vinirmitāmdaśaniṣkamimāṃ vātha pañcaniṣka vinirmitāmkuryāt pratikṛtiṃ vidvān vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayetkālarūpaṃ tu vā nemirūpaṃ rūpāntaraṃ tu vāanena vidhinā rogī arogī syānna saṃśayaḥpañcaṣaṇmāsaparyantaṃ yāvat vyādhi vināśanamaṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ parvaṇyāpi ca pakṣayoḥsvajanmarkṣe'nu janmarkṣe śuddhadeśe manoramesthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kṛtvānte sādhayet kalaśānnavāeko vā madhyame teṣāṃ ghaṭassyāddroṇapūritaḥsarvauṣadhi samāyuktānnānābīja samanvitāngandhatoya samāyuktāṃstattanmantra samanvitāntattanmantraśatālabdhāṃ statpūrve vā caturṣvapiśivāgnau juhuyāddhīmān samidājyānna saṃyutamgomayāliptadeśe tu phalakopari saṃshtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirmṛjya paiṣṭikaivāpi yavādyairgomayodbhavaiḥprokṣayedvātha mantreṇa tadbhasmālepanaṃ tataḥrājñāṃ paṭṭabhṛtāṃ vātha sāmantānāṃ mahātmanāmpañcāśat saṃkhyayā tebhyo na hīnān sādhayetguruḥmadhyame ca viśeṣeṇa taistān saṃsnāpayed guruḥādityodayamārabhya jale sthitvā manuṃ japetśatamaṣṭottaraṃ vāpi pratyahaṃ japamācarethomena samasakhyāṃ vā japa tulyaṃ paraṃ matamanenāpi prakāreṇa bhūrjapatra tvagādikekuṅkumena likhedvarṇāṃ taddevejyāpurassaramvidhāya japamātraṃ vā gorocanayutaṃ tu vāsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ rgulikāṃ kārayettataḥlākṣayā vātha sā dhāryā yāvat vyādhi vimocanamkarṇe vā kaṇṭhadeśe vā śikhāyāṃ vā kare'pi vāpratyahaṃ pūjanīyo vā mantrassarvaphalapradaḥpūjāṃ homaṃ ca vā nityaṃ japatarpaṇa saṃyutambalavān priyadarśaśca rājā dhārmādhiko bhavettanniyukto vāthavā nānyo viśeṣādrāja karmaṇisarvatra sarvadhā so'yamādiśaivaḥ prakrīrtitaḥmadhye vā gajaśālāyāṃ śūlasthāne manoramevighnarājasya śāstuśca mātṛṇāmālaye'pi vāgomayenopalipyātha prokṣayedastra vāriṇālājadarbha samāyuktaṃ droṇatoya prapūritamelā kuṅkuma karpūra phalatraya samanvitamtatra sāṅga maghorāstraṃ sāsanaṃ samyagarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ pūrṇa candra samaprabhamūrdhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇampūrvoktā kṛtisaṃyuktaṃ śvetavarṇamathāpi vānaivedyamupapadaṃśādyaṃ satāmbūlaṃ nivedayetpratyahaṃ tu japaṃ kuryādastrarājena deśikaḥkuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi śivāgnau homamācaretkṣīravṛkṣa samudbhūtā bilvajā brahma vṛkṣajāḥsaṃhasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vātadbhasma saṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ kuṃbhe visarjayetgrahā rogāśca naśyanti teṣāṃ puṣṭiśca jāyatesyātteṣāṃ vijayī svāmī yatraiṣa kriyate vidhiḥbalibhirlokapālebhyaḥ kṛtagomaya maṇḍaleeṣa eva vidhiḥ prokto hayādīnāṃ tu rakṣaṇegaja yūthaṃ hayājaṃ vā gomahiṣyādikaṃ tu vātatsarvaṃ vyādhinirmuktaṃ hṛṣṭa puṣṭaṃ vicintayetekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vā viśiṣyatesādhakaṃ pūjayet kartā santuṣṭasya yathā bhavettarpaṇaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā jalena tadanantaramaṣṭadroṇaistadardhaivā khāribhiḥ droṇanirmitaiḥvrīhibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tattadardhaiśca taṇḍulaiḥtanmadhye droṇa saṃpūrṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ vinyasya deśikaḥpūrvokta dravya saṃyuktaṃ gandhatoyaprapūritamcandanaṃ ca laghūpetaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpakamtāmbūlena samopetaṃ homaṃ paścāt samāpayetkṣīravṛkṣasamutpanna samidbhirdūrvayāthavā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarve sasūtravastrāḍhyāhemapaṃkajabhūṣitāḥsnapanāddhyāyasaṃsiddhapramāṇena samanvitāḥlokeśādiṣu hemāni kṣipelbāhyaghaṭeṣvapitoraṇadvārakumbhāṃśca lokapālaghaṭānapimaṅgalāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ daśāstraṃ viniveśayetsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ sūtraṃ yadvā kārpāsanirmitamsvalpādhikapramāṇāḍhya nāgarājaphaṇānvitamanantastvadhi devasyāt sauvarṇe rājate'pi vāgrathitaṃ śreṣṭhamityuktaṃ valayagrāhakānvitamśāntyarthaṃ vijayārthantatkalātmakamitismṛtamṣaḍaṃgamūrtipāṃgañcet putrāyuṣyaphalapradamsaṃśoddhya vāriṇā caivañcandanenopalipya capratyekaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tadūrdhve yantrikoparidviprasthāntairnataddhīnaiḥ droṇādyai rhṛdayaṃ smaranabhinnayugmasuślakṣṇapūgasārasamanvitamtāmbūlaṃ sūtrasahitaṃ sthaṇḍilopari vinyasetsthaṇḍile pūjayecchaktiṃ yaṃtrikāyāṃ tritatvakambhasmādhāre umākhyāsyāt bhasite lakulīśvarampātramācchādya paṭṭādyaiḥ mālāntaduparinyasetgrāmadakṣiṇaṃ vātha prāsādasya pradakṣiṇamaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyantu grahītvā vāmahastakemantreṇānuṣṭubhānetraṃsmaran sarvaprakoṣṭhakesarvātmanātha devīnāṃ vāme vā dakṣiṇetha vātāmbūlañca phalāpūpanālikeraphalānvitamskando mā sahite skandahīne vā candraśekhare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcāśatsaṃkhyayā vātha pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyayāaghorāstraṃ tatsakhyaṃ bhaktādya cottarāmukhaḥpūrṇāhuti pradhānena manunā tarpayennavāsājyenānnena madhye tu dikvaṣṭāsu baliṃ nayetkuṇḍasyaiśāna digbhāge balimenaṃ tadācaretpūjitastarpito yena balituṣṭo'dhunā tataḥsvāhānte baliriṣṭaḥ syāt tarpaṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥmahābaliścet kartavyo madhyarātre samācaretkadalīphala saṃyukta mapūpaiśca samanvitamdīpahīna baliṃ dadyāt grāmādau nityameva caaghorāstra dhvajopetaṃ maunavrata samanvitamtadante kumbhatoyena vyādhitān prokṣayettataḥtanmantramantritaṃ bhasma dadyānmantradvayaṃ smaranguruṃ santoṣayet kartā bhojanādyaśca deśikamālayādāvaghoraṃ tu kṛtvā saṃsthāpya deśikaḥkṛtvādau ghaṭasaṃsthaṃ tu nyasya pūjādikaṃ nayetkevalaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vātha pūjāṃ havana saṃyutāmmartyānāmapi sarveṣāṃ etatsāmānyamucyatekevalaṃ vā japaṃ kuryāt sarvopadrava śāntayeśuddhadeśamanuprāpya gomayenānulepayettantunā veṣṭayitvā tu droṇa brīhi vinirmitetilārdha lājasaṃyukte sthaṇḍile snāpayet budhaḥvinyaset kumbhamadhye tu dravyāṇyetāni candanamelālavaṅga saṃyuktaṃ cūrṇitāni vinikṣipetādhārākhyamanantaṃ ca dharmādyaṃ ca catuṣṭayam
