source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmadhye saṃsmaret padmaṃ bījanāladalāni camūrti bhūtaṃ smaret kumbhaṃ pūrvoktadhyāna saṃyutamaghorāṇum samucārya yajet pādyādibhirguruḥelālavaṅga saṃyuktaṃ phalatraya samanvitamāpaḥ kṣīra kuśāgrāṇi taṇḍulāssumanāsthilāḥcandana laghu kuṣṭaṃ ca gandhādyaṃ trayamucyatetatpadmadalamūle tu dakṣiṇe'straṃ samuccarandatvā svāvaraṇopetaṃ nirāvaraṇameva vāasitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krota unmatta bhairavaḥtadbāhye lokapāniṣṭvā tadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥgandhādyai rāvṛtāniṣṭvā dīpamājya samudbhavamaghorāya tadastraya pānīyaṃ ca nivedayetaghorāya tadastrāya saṃnivedya japaṃ guruḥprāgvat kuṇḍasya saṃskāraṃ pañcasaṃskāra saṃskṛtekṣīra vṛkṣa samidbhiśca ghṛtena caruṇā punaḥtāmbūlaṃ juhuyādante svadevāyāstra rūpiṇeaghoreṇa ca tadbhasma saṃgrāhyāstreṇa rakṣayethomakarma nivedyātha kumbhasthe'ghora rūpiṇedatvā parāṅmukhārghyaṃ tu bhogāṅgānyupasaṃharethṛtsaroruha madhye tu svsyānyānapi śambarānprokṣayedvātha tattoyaiḥ pratyahaṃ tvevamācarethitvāghoramaghorāstraṃ kumbhamadhye'thavārcayetpakṣāhaṃ vātha māsaṃ vā dvitrimāsamathāpi vāyatraitat kriyate śāntirnaṣṭarogā gajādayaḥtadvajjagatpatiḥ puṣṭo nīrogī ca bhaveddhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahiṣāja gavāmevaṃ kārayedvijasattamāḥpratyahaṃ bhojanādīni dadyādājya samanvitamevaṃ vāhni ca rātrau vā karma nityaṃ samācaretgajānāṃ vā hayānāṃ vā śālāyamaṅkaṇe'pi vāśuddhe manorame deśe gomayenopalepayetvajrādi cakra paryantaṃ śastrāvaraṇa saṃyutamvāyu vāruṇa digbhāge kṣetreśasya baliṃ kṣipetastrāvaraṇa saṃyuktaṃ rudrādibhyo yathā baliḥnopa sargabhayaṃ tatra rogapīḍā na vidyatekartuḥ kārayituścāpi deśikasya viśeṣataḥvartate bali saṃyutaṃ yasya rāṣṭreṣu tasya tuanena sadṛśo yogo durikṣayahetukaḥnāsti loke yatastasmāt yatnādevaṃ samācaretbhasma kalpādijaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mantra saṃskṛtamlalāṭa mukha hṛnnābhi bāhumūladvaye manummadhyamasthaistribhiḥ kuryādaṅgulaidaivatātmakaiḥdadyādvānābhikāṅgulyā taddevātmikayā śuciḥsvānukūlena mantreṇa tattat kartranurūpiṇāpraṇavādi namo'ntaṃ tu brāhmaṇasya prayojayetvauṣaḍaṃtaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ taddeva dhyāna samyutamdadyādyajñopavītaṃ tu sva sva jātīśa mantritamyajñopavītadvitayaṃ svottarīyaṃ nṛpe matamlokābhicāra pūrvaṃ tu śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥmūlanakṣatra saṃyuktā sā mahānavamī smṛtāsā mahānavamī nāmnā tryailokye'ti sudurlabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayitvāśvayuṅmāsi viśoko jagati dviṣaḥtasyāye'pyupayujyante prāṇino mahiṣādayaḥbhavānī prāṅgaṇe prāṇān ye ca muccanti dehinaḥpūjanīyā janairdhīrāḥ sthāne sthāne pure pureprāgudak pravaṇe deśe rudrāṣṭābdhikarairguruḥmekhalātraya saṃyuktaṃ yoniraśvattha patravatpūjayedvedikordhve tu sarvatraivādhivāsayettanmantraireva homasyād durgāyāśca viśeṣataḥhutaśeṣaṃ turaṅgānāṃ gajānāmupahārayetbhrāmayennagare nityaṃ nānāghoṣa purassarampūjayedvājacihnāni phalamālya vilepanaiḥhutaśeṣaṃ pradātavyamaupanāyanike gajepūjāmantrān pravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃ viprasattamāḥbrahmāṇaḥ satyāvākyena somasya varuṇasya catejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasā tathāsmaratvaṃ rājaputro'pi kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ smaranmūlye'rthe'nṛtavādī ca kṣatriyaśca parāṅmukhaḥvrajestvaṃ tāṃ gatiṃ kṣipraṃ tajjavoyaṃ bhavettavaripūnvijitya samare saha bhartrā sukhī bhavapatatrirāḍ vainateyastathā nārāyaṇadhvajaḥaprameyo durādharṣo raṇe vai ripu sūdanaḥsāśvadharma yutān yodhān rakṣatvaṃ ripusūdanasupratīko'ñjano nīla etaṣṭau devayonayaḥbhadro mandro mṛgaścaiva gajasaṅkīrṇa eva capāntutvāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityāssamarudgaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avāpnuhi jayaṃ yuddhe gamane svastino vrajasyathirya merorjayaṃ rudrād yaśodevātpurandarātaśvinau saha gandharvai pāntu tvāṃ sarvatassadānāgākinnarā gandharva yakṣa bhūtagaṇā grahāḥgaṇassenāpatiḥ skando varuṇaścāśritāstvayiśvānaḥ prayuktānyaribhiḥ dūṣaṇāni samantataḥkālanemivadhe yadvadyāvat tripuradhātiniśobhitāsi tathaivādya śobhayā samayaṃ smaravyādhibhirvividhai ghoraiśśāstraiśca yudhinirjitāḥpūtanā revatī nāma kālarātrīti yāḥ smṛtāḥdahitvāśu ripun sarvān patāke tvaṃ mayāśritāasirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇa dharmā durāsadaḥityaṣṭau tava nāmāni svayamuktāni vedhasāhiraṇyaṃ ca śarīraṃ te dhātā devo janārdanaḥśamapradastvaṃ samare varma sarvāpado hyasighoṣāddhṛdayakampanaḥyathā jīmūtaghoṣeṇa hṛṣyanti paravāraṇāḥyathā jīmūtaśabdena śtrīṇāṃ trāso hi jāyatesarvāyudha mahāmātra sarvāyudha niṣūdanapuṇyastvaṃ puṇyaśaṅkhānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalaḥśaśāṃkākāra saṃkāśa himapiṇḍita pāṇḍarasarvāyudhānāṃ prathame nirmitāsi pinākinācaṇḍikāyāḥ pradattāsi sarva duṣṭa nibarhiṇīsarvatatvāṅga bhūtāsi sarvāśubha nivāraṇīprotsāraṇāya duṣṭānāṃ sādhūnāṃ grahaṇāya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaśo dehi sukhaṃ dehi devo hi bhava bhūpateḥvijayī bhava devo'si ripudhātī priyaṃkaraḥete'ṣṭau sannidhau yasmāt tavaṃ siṃhā mahābalāḥtvayisthitaśśivassākṣāt tvayi śakrassureśvaraḥnamaste sarvatobhadra bhadraṃ te bhava bhūpateḥlokabhicārakaṃ kuryāt karmedaṃ mantrapūrvakamaṣṭamyāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ durgākhyāṃ svarṇa nirmitāmpratimāṃ citrasaṃyuktāṃ kṛtvā śaktyanusārataḥrājā snātvā vibhūṣyāṅgaṃ sakalīkṛta vigrahaḥkarpūra sahitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ bahubhirgandha saṃyutaiḥnaivedyaiḥ phala saṃyuktaiḥ nṛttagānādibhissahaaṣṭadorbhisamāyuktāṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīmdhanurbāṇa samāyuktāṃ khaḍgakheṣṭaka dhārīṇīmvarākṣamālāḥ makharāṃ mahiṣāsura saṃsthitāmcaturbhujāṃ vā saṃpūjya varadābhaya saṃyutāmnānā vidhaiśca gānaiśca nṛttairnānāvidhairapighātayenmahiṣānmeṣān agrato mṛdukandharāntato'parāhnasamaye navamyāṃ syandanesthitāmkaścidvā preṣito vīro vibhūtena ca hetinādigvidikṣu baliṃ dadyānmantreṇānena buddhimānmaruto vāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagāḥ grahāḥḍākinyaḥ kṣetravetālāḥ yoginyaḥ pūtanāśśivāḥdigpālā lokapālāśca ye ca vighnavināyakāḥmama vighnaṃ mā carantu mā santu paripanthinaḥnarayānena vā devīṃ sarvavighnavināśinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuryādāśva yuje māsi pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kurudvādaśyāṃ vā tathā kuryācchuklaṃ pakṣe viśeṣataḥanyasmin vā prakartavyā tadvidhāna mihocyateviṃśaddhasta samāyāmāyāgaśāleya mīritātadardhaṃ śirṣakaṃ caiva sā rājñāṃ vedikā matāhastamātra pramāṇe mekhalātraya saṃyutamapāṃ samīpaṃ nītvātu so'śvaṃ satstrībhirāvṛtamkuṇḍaṃ tadūrdhve kartavyaṃ homārthaṃ pūrvamānataḥprabuddhe'gnau tata imāṃ juhuyād brahmaṇe haviḥtataścācala devāya senānyai dhanadāya cajuhuyādāhutīretā baliṃ caiteṣu vinyasetsnāpayet sthāpayeccaiva yathoktairoṣadhīgaṇaiḥvimārditān vītamalān pītasnātānvagāhitānbaddhauṣadhāni vīryāni rakṣārthaṃ teṣu bandhayetkuśaissaṃśodhayitvājyaṃ kuśairājyaṃ samarpayetājyaṃ strucā tṛtīyaṃ tu lihitāśvamupāharetbrāhme muhūrte pratyūṣe brahma dhoṣābhināditetathā teṣāṃ pracāra syāt snānaṃ prātaḥ praśasyatepuṇyāhaṃ vācayennityaṃ svastyāśīrmaṅgalānvitamnavamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya nagarādvāsayet bahiḥpradakṣiṇodake saumye viśāle drumasaṃkaṭevistāratoṣṭaratnīkaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ mālyaśobhaitamsarvamaṅgala saṃyukto rājā pauranarairvṛtaḥpraviśya śānti gehaṃ tu vidhānamida mācaretvacāṃ dantīṃ gulūcīṃ ca priyaṅgvarjuna saṃjñimam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa kauśaṃ giri karṇiṃ ca hīyamāṇaṃ kaṭambharāmśatāvarīṃ somavalliṃ nikṣipet kalaśeṣu cagandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpanaivedyakairapijuhuyāt pūrvavat kuṇḍe pūrvadravyairyathā kramamveda vidvāji vaidyābhyāṃ sahitaḥ pūrvadiṅmukhaṃāruhya turagaśreṣṭhaṃ prāpayettoraṇāntikamśvetacandanamālāḍhyaṃ śveta vastra samanvitamkadalī phala saṃyuktaṃ dadyādvāji varāya cakevalasthaistadā toyai śśākhayo duṃbaro tthayārājānaṃ hastinaṃ paścāccamūṃ saṃprokṣya ttadāābhicārakamantraistu tīkṣṇa kṛṣnamayena carājā vijaya siddhyarthaṃ gacchenmaṅgala saṃyutamkiṃ tu tat kṛttikāmāse turaṅgarkṣe'samācaretgajayāne viśeṣo'yaṃ caturaśraṃ ca kūṭakamśatahastamitaṃ kuryāccaturaśraṃ samāhitaḥpañcāśat pañca viṃśādvā samantātsamidho havet !vedyāṃ toraṇa mālābhī ramye śrīcāturantakevardhamānatarūtthābhiḥ dīpikābhirhutāśanamsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ bhavaṃ nīrājayetpurāvighneśaṃ caṇḍikāṃ sūryaṃ yakṣānmātṛgaṇāṃstathānīrājanaṃ gavāṃ kuryānmahiṣyādeśca bhrāmayetnīrājayedviśeṣeṇa rājānaṃ deśikottamaḥsiṃhāsanasthaṃ rājānaṃ sāmanta pramukhāvṛtamrūpayauvana saṃpanna veśyābhirvātha kārayetteṣāṃ rājā sukhaṃ yāti subhikṣaṃ jāyate tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ rogotpattāvapīṣyatesarvotpāta vināśārthaṃ śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥkūṭaṃ kuryācchubhaṃ bhaktyā madhyapādaṃ yathā bhavetdarpaṇodarasaṃkāśaṃ maṇḍanairupaśobhitamvedikā dvitayaṃ kāryaṃ pañcaṣaḍḍhastamānataḥpārśve sopāna saṃyuktaṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ taddvayaṃ tathāpuṣyamāse tu puṣyarkṣe tīrtheṣvāyataneṣu cakuberandreśakāṣṭāsu gururmantra samanvitaḥdadhilājākṣatopetaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sahadiśo nāgā dvijāścaiva ye cāpyanyeśa bhāginaḥpūrvaṃ svapūjāṃ saṃprāpya datvā śāntiṃ mahīpateḥśubhaṃ cedārabhet prātaraśubhe śānti saṃyutammaṅgalāṅkura karmātra pūrvaprokta mathācaretpañca ṣaṇmātra mārabhya pañcāśat karajāntakamsopānaṃ dvaya saṃyuktaṃ magre pṛṣṭhe viśeṣataḥsopāna sahitaṃ kuryādiṣṭamāna samanvitamkuryāt pratisaraṃ rātrau sarvālaṃkarā saṃyutamcaturhastaṃ samārabhya ṣaḍaṅgula vivardhanātśata bhāgaṃ tu tatkṛtvā dakṣiṇādi tataḥ kramātbhāgadvayena himavān śvetavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥsvarṇa varṇaṃ tu tatproktaṃ hemakūṭo dvibhāgataḥsvarṇa varṇaṃ samākhyātaṃ dvābhyānniṣadha maśravatuttarāṃśāt samārabhya navāṃśaṃ kuru varṣakammayūra varṇo vijñeyassuvarṇa varṇa saṃyutaḥśvetācalo dvibhāgena svarṇayuk śvetavarṇakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlācalo dvibhāgena vaiḍūryadyuti saṃyuktaḥpūrvāṃ diśaṃ samārabhya dvātriṃśadbhāga saṃyutammālyavān paścime bhāge nirmitaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇa yukdvātriṃśatpadakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nāmnaitadgandhamādanamekena śvetavarṇaṃ syāt caturaśraṃ tu madhyamevāyavyāgneya paryantaṃ vṛtte sūtraṃ prasārya caśvetavarṇaṃ tu pūrve syāt dakṣiṇe hemavarṇakamavaśiśṭastu yo deśassarvaḥ pītaḥ prakīrtitaḥjambūdīpasamaḥ prokto lavaṇābdhistato bahiḥbahissamudrā dīpāśca saptasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥtadbāhye tat pramāṇena kṣārodaḥ parīkīrtitāḥdadhnastu dviguṇaṃ sarpistasmāttu dviguṇo rasaḥjambū dvīpāttathā śākaśśākācca kuśa saṃjñakaḥtasmād gobheda saṃñaśca gobhedāt puṣkalaṃ punaḥantare rakta varṇa syād bāhye kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥtasmāccādrivaro jñeyo lokā loka iti dvijāḥhimā cale piśācāḥsyusteṣāṃ nāmānyamūnivaivaḍavāmukho dvipādaḥ kārakaḥ smṛtaḥpratundikopa vīrau ca pravīro lūkhala smṛtaḥcakra ṣaṇḍī pāṇipatraḥ pāṇipatrī ca vāsukaḥnipuṇā balibhug jñeyā paścāduccheṣaṣā matāmāṃsenānnena saṃpūjya madyaiḥ pratisarādibhiḥhiraṇya kaśipurnāmnā hiraṇyākṣo dvitīyakaḥdvimūrdhā śambaraścaiva tataśśaṅkuśirā matāḥgaveṣṭirmeṣa vaktraśca makhavān kapilomataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: umā maheśvare vāme sukhāsīne maheśvaraḥekadvitriṣu sarvatra vāñchayā kautukaṃ matamyāgārambhadinetvetat vidhānaṃ parikīrtitamkautukaṃ vāñchite bimbetaddināt pūrvarātriketriśūle madhyapatre vā tatstha devakarepi vāyāgārambhasya pūrvedyuḥ taddine vā samācaretdeśiko mūrtipaissārdhaṃ sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥbrahmeṣṭiṃ bhūtaśuddhiñca sakalīkaraṇaṃ punaḥvedikāyāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sthaṇḍile tu śivāsanampañcabrahmāṇi vinyasya kalpayettatkalāmayamhṛdayādīni vinyasya pādyadyairarcayettataḥvidyeśān paritaśceṣṭvā lokapālān prapūjayettāni vā vedikā bāhye sthaṇḍilordhve sthalepi vātadante cāstrarājānamaṣṭadik sthaṇḍilesthitamsaṃskṛtya vidhinā kuṇḍaṃ śivāgniṃ vidhinā nayetnyastvā'vāhya śivaṃ sāṃgaṃ sabrahmāṃgañca tarpayetsvasvamantrapradhāne tu sarvairmantraiśca tarpayettilasarṣapamudgā vā homakarmaṇisaṃsthitāḥtilasarṣapamudgāśca saktuveṇurgulaṃ madhusamidājyānnalājāṃstu caturvargeṣu homayetpradhānetvanya kuṇḍeṣu kalārthañjuhuyuḥ kramāttatra bhedena mantrāṇāṃ bhedo nātra vidhīyatetadante balidānaṃ syāt tadvidhānamihocyatetatreṣṭvā cāstrarājantu triśūlena samanvitamghaṇṭāravasamopetaṃ balidravyasamāyugam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāgo'bhāgastathā jñeyaśśālāgraha iti smṛtāmantrajiccāśvajit proktastathā rajirudāhṛdaḥvaiśvānarassulobhāca draviṇaśca mahāśirāḥcandratāpana saṃjñaśca sūkṣmo niścandra eva hiābhilokaḥ sukeśaśca malayo malakastathāpramodaḥ kumudaścāścagrīvo vaiśrava saṃjñakaḥhiraṇya yuk śatamakhaśśaṃbaraśśarabho mayaḥcatuṣṣaṣṭiśca saṃjñānāṃ pūjāścaiṣāṃ ca pūrvavatsubhāsvarāmṛtāścāgniṣvāttā upahutā matāḥkravyādā ājyapāścaiva pṛthak traya udāhṛtāḥagniṣvāttā bahirṣadassomāśca tato matāḥagnyanagnirhavyavāhā havissaumyā daśaiva hinīlācale ca ṛṣayaḥ saṃpūjyā kāśyapādayaḥviśvāmitro jamadagni rmarīciśca tato mataḥsanatkumārassanakaḥ sanandaśca sanātanaḥdvitastrito'tha jābālī durvāsā durvanītakaḥśunaśśepho vidurathassādhvaṃ ssaṃvarta ityapiyavakrītadevarātau devarājo'jakastathāṛgyajussāma mantrairvā pūjyā vā svasvanāmabhiḥananto vāsukiścaiva takṣaḥ kārkoṭakaḥ smṛtaḥgulikaśca yajedaṣṭa vimiśrairgandha puṣpakaiḥdevā pūjyāḥ mahāmerau trastriṃśacca te matāḥpratyuṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭā vime matāḥharaśca bahurūpaśca tryambako nāma rudrakaḥrudrā ekādaśa proktā indro dhātā bhago'ryamā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: savitā pūṣāṃśumān viṣṇu rdvādaśārkā udāhṛtāḥyaṣṭvā praṇāmadhūpaiśca ghṛtāhutibhireva cagandharvāpsarasaḥ pūjyāḥ citra senāgnisenakaḥsūryavarcā yugaputro suśirāmara nandinauurvīśaśca kaliścaiva parvato nāradastathākṛtavīryo brahmacārī suparṇo mīna ityapiakṛtayaścodayantyo gandhavatyastataḥ paramstavāścaivāmṛtā modāḥ suśivāstu tataḥ parammenakā sahajanyā ca tatpūrvā puñjikasthalāpramlocantyunumlocantī mocayantya nugā tataḥdāsyariṣṭā manovartī sukeśāca tilottamācaurviṃśati saṃkhyātāḥ sugandhaiśc sumālyakaiḥyakṣānsaṃpūjyette ca mahāvaiśravaṇastathāvidhṛtaḥ pūrṇabhadro'ṭha virūpākṣo'ṣṭayakṣarāṭtato nīlācale siddhā mantrajño mantravittamaḥsiddhi matparamassiddhastathā kesarabhadrakaḥdadyāt pratisarādyaṃ tu merau navagrahānvitambrahma viṣṇu mahādeva viśākhāṃścaiva lokapaiḥsaṃyajed balibhissārdhaṃ varṇakaiḥ kramaśastathāādityaścaiva somaśca akṅaraka budhau tataḥete navagrahāḥ proktāḥ kṛttikā vai tataḥ parāḥdhaniṣṭā śatabhiṣak caiva pūrvābhādrapadā punaḥbharaṇyā cottarasyāṃ tu brāmhī māheśvarī tataḥmāhendrī caiva cāmuṇḍī vīrabhadra gaṇādhipauindrānalayamāścaiva nir-ṛti rvaruṇastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śacī bhājīvanaskandā dhūmrā maṇḍala vartinīāyatā vyayanī caiva prajñā menā balā tataḥnāsatyā vaśvinau dastrau kramaśassaṃyajet budhaḥyajñopavītaṃ sarvebhyaḥ pradadyācca gurūttamaḥtataḥ paścimavedyāṃ tu ghṛtenā pūritān ghaṭānaṣṭāviṃśatimaṣṭau vā aṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vāsūtravastrādi saṃyuktāṃsteṣu dravyāṇi vinyasetjīvā viśveśvarī vārā samāṅgā vijayā tathāariṣṭā ca śivā bhadrā kuṃbheṣvetāni vinyasetmaṅgalāni yathālābhaṃ sarvauṣadhi rasāṃstathāpraśasta nāmnyaścauṣadhyo hiraṇyaṃ maṅgalāni capraśasta lakṣaṇaṃ bhūtaṃ prācīnagrīva mastakamsiṃhasyāpi tṛtīyaṃ ca vyāghrasya ca tataḥ parampūjayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ mṛtyujinmantramuccaransauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmra nirmitaṃ kṣīra vṛkṣajamsārvabhaumasya tacchreṣṭaṃ maṇḍalīkasya kanyasamśreṣṭhamadhyādi bhedena sarvaṃ vaikasya saṃmatamkṛtasnānaṃ viliptāṅgaṃ sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktamdaivajñaṃ mantrisāmantaiḥ purohita mukhai rvṛtamgeyamaṅgala śabdaiśca śaivasthāpana pūrvakaiḥkambalena samācchādyābhiṣiñceduttarā mukhaḥājayaṃ surāṇāmāhāra ājye lokāḥ pratiṣṭitāsarvaṃ tadājya saṃsparśātpraṇāśamupagaccha tuvividhaiḥ phalapuṣpaiśca khādubhiśca sugandhakaiḥsurāsvāmabhiṣiñcantu ye ca siddhāḥ purātanāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādityā vasavo rudrāścāśvinau ca bhiṣagvaraukīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtiḥ śrīśca sinīvālī kuhustathāsaṃvatsarā dineśāśca kalāḥ kāṣṭāḥ kṣaṇālavāḥaditissurasā caiva vinatā kadrureva casarvāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu śubhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥsaritaśca mahābhāgāḥ kinnarāḥ puruṣāstathāsaptarṣayassadārāśca dhruvasthānāni yani cabhṛgussanatkumāraśca sanako'tha sanantanaḥekataśca dvitaścaiva trito jābāli kāśyapaumārkaṇḍeyo dīrghatamāśsunaśśepho vidūrataḥdvaipāyano yavakrīto devarātassahānujaḥtoyaistvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvotpāta nibarhaṇaiḥmahārauhiṇa kūśmāṇḍaiḥ kuberahṛdayaissahajaptvā śivamaghoraṃ vā mṛtyuñjayamathāpi vākārpāsa vastra yugalaṃ dadhānaḥ kṣatriyādhipaḥācāmyābhyarcayeddevān svaguruṃ brāhmaṇānapianyonyaṃ ca tadaṅgāni pūjayetpūrvamantrataḥsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ homavedīṃ praviśya casiṃhasya vyāghra saṃjñasya carmāṇyāstīrya tatra cahomaṃkuryāt samidbhiśca sarpibhiśca śataṃ śatamhomānte prāñjalirbhūtvā brūyāddevaṃ gurūttamaḥsiddhiṃ datvā tu vipulāṃ punarāgamanāya canṛpendro brāhmaṇebhyaśca dadyāddānaṃ viśeṣataḥpraṇamya devaṃ deveśaṃ tasmai grāmādi kāñcanamtato mātaṅgamāruhya praviśedbhavanaṃ prati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sārvabhauma prasiddhyarthaṃ āyurārogyasiddhayepuṣyābhiṣekaṃ pratyabdaṃ puṇyasthāne samācaretsarvaduḥkhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ grahacārādyato bhavetpūjayitvā tu juhuyāt deśiko dīkṣitaissaharāhū ketū navaiva syūḥ pūjayet svasvanāmataḥtacca vṛttaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ bāṇa saṃyutamdhvajābhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ grahāṇāṃ varṇa ucyatesomaputro guruścaiva tābubhau pītajau smṛtaudhyā tvaivaṃ pūjayedvidvān gandhaiḥ puṣpairanu kramātdīpaḥ proktatastu naivedyaṃ śali saṃbhava mucyatekuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi pūjāsthānaṃ prakalpayetarka palāśaḥ khadirastvapāmārgo yathākramampalāśaḥ khadiro vātha svasmit kuśa saṃbhavesruk sruvau lakṣaṇopetau palāśa dala jāvathahotrṛṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tadante phalasiddhayenirdiṣṭa divasātpūrva rātre kautuka bandhanamsthaṇḍilaṃ śālinā kṛtvā tadūrdhve sthālikāṃ nyasetyajña sūtraṃ ca valayaṃ aṅgulīyakameva caprakṣālyastreṇa cārghyeṇa taṇḍulordhve vinikṣipetīśānena śiraḥ puṣpaṃ varmaṇā brahmasūtrakambahurūpeṇa vā sarvaṃ mantrayeddeśikottamaḥcandanena vimiśraṃ tadaiśānyāṃ sthāpayed guruḥtāmbūlaṃ dāpayedvātha puruṣākhya manuṃ smaranāgneye nai-ṛte nyastvā hṛdayenābhi mantrayetsarvālaṅkāra saṃyuktaṃ mātaṅkopari saṃsthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: purohitamukhairviprairanvitassarva maṅgalaḥsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkāra saṃyutampuṇyāha prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā puṣpādyaṃ pūrvamantrataḥbadhvā dakṣiṇa haste tu kautukaṃ saumyadiṅmukhaḥīśānādyauryathā nyāyamathavā parikalpayetnālikera phalānyatra lājapuṣpādibhiḥ sahadeśikaṃ pūjayetkartā daivajñaṃ ca purohitamanena vidhinā kuryāddevadevasya śūlinaḥbrāhmaṇādi caturṇāṃ tu bhūmīndrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥhastaviṃśati mānena aṣṭāṃśena dviraṣṭabhiḥnavaṣṭsaptahasteva dvihastādyārdhahastataḥtadbāhye nava kuṇḍāni caturaśrāṇi tāni cadarbhamālāsamāyuktaṃ digdhvajaiśca samanvitamsāmānyametadākhyātaṃ tulābhārādike dvijāḥpanasāmrasamudbhūtāḥ khādiro vā praśasyatesaptaṣaṭ pañcahastaiśca pārśvastambhocchrabhau matauaṅgulatrya hānyā tu navadhā mānamīritampādādhikastripādo vā utsedhaḥ parikīrtitaḥtulādaṇḍasya dīrghaṃ syādviṣkambhastu daśāṅgulaḥṣaṭtriṃśanmātra saṃyuktamāyāmaṃ vātha dairghyakamṣaṭtriṃśanmātranāhastu madhyame tu vidhīyatetulādaṇḍe prakartavyamavalambanakatrayammadhye cordhve mukhaṃ kāryaṃ tvavalambassuśobhanaḥuttarasya tu madhye tu ayaśśaṅku dṛḍhaṃ nayetsaptāṣṭaṣaṭśatenātha tāmreṇādhārako prabhoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuṣkuṇḍala saṃyuktau hastapramāṇa saṃmitauyathā tathā vidheyau tau prākpaścimagatāvṛtaukumbhamadhyādi saṃyuktāvathavā parikalpayettadūrdhve sthāpayitvādau vālukābhirdṛḍhaṃ nayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu maṇḍape samalaṃkṛtemaṇḍalaṃ kārayeddhīmān sarvatobhadra saṃjñaṃkamśūlasya vāmadeśe cakraṃ padmaṃ dakṣiṇesaṃpūjya gandha puṣpādyaiḥ brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe yajetsūryaṃ madhye'gni deśe tu bhārakaraṃnai-ṛte'thavāuṣāṃ prabhāṃ tathā prajñāṃ saṃndhyāṃ sāvitrimarcayetvistārāṃ madhyame deśe sutarāṃ vahni gocareuttarāntaṃ ca saṃpūjya sukhaṃ madhye prajūjayetraviṃ ca madhyame deśe pūjayeddeśikottamaḥsomādi ketuparyantaṃ grahānaṣṭau prapūjayetpradhāna home deveśaṃ lokapānaṣṭa dikṣu casvāhāntaṃ praṇvavopetaṃ svasvanāmnādvijotamāḥlokeśa sahitaṃ devaṃ samāvāhya samarcayetsamiccaru ghṛtopetaṃ sahasraṃ vā tadarghakamśuddha pāyasamugjannai śvarubhistribhirantitammṛtyuñjayaṃ samuccārya vāstu homamathā caretmaṇḍale pujitānsarvān devānabhyarcya homayetsahasra kalaśārdyeśca saṃsnāpya parameśvarampañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ kṣīrādyaiḥ snapanaṃ tu vāāhūya nṛpatiṃ snātaṃ śuklavastrānulepanamkṛtapratisaraṃ śāntaṃ khaḍga kheṭaka dhāriṇām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṇyāhaprokṣaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūtaśuddhi purassaramrudragāyatri saṃjñaṃtu yajamānastadā japetapūrvadika sthāna madhyastha paścimāli mukhoya thāvedātodya samāyuktaṃ nṛttagīta samanvutamsvakāyena tadāyena tulārohaḥ kṛtobhavetdevendraṃ vāthakartāraṃ tulārohaṇamācarethotṛṃśca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ pradadyādvidhipūrvakamṛtitvigbhyaścaiva sarvebhyo daśaniṣkāḥ prakīrtitāḥśivārcakasya pūjā ca prāgva deva samīritātulādhi rohitaṃ vittaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāpayetdeśikebhyo viśeṣeṇa dadyānchraddhā samanvitaḥyatra karma karāsteṣāṃ pṛthaṅniṣkaṃ pratāpayetetat sāmānya muddiṣṭaṃ dānānāṃ dvijayattamāḥkuryātsahasraniṣkeṇa tvadhaḥ pātraṃ hiraṇyataḥtripādaṃ vārdha mānaṃ vā sapādaṃ sārdhameva vāvṛkṣajaṃ vātha tatkṛtvā svarṇapaṭṭaiśca veṣṭayetekona triṃśamātraṃ tu mūlavistāra iṣyatepañcasaptatrimātrāntaṃ tadutsedhaḥ prakīrtitaḥardhādhikaṃ tu vistārā dāsya vistāra iṣyatetrimātrānnavamātrāntaṃ nirgame mānamiṣyatetripādaṃ vā samaṃ vāpi phalakādhanamiṣyatemāyāntā vā prakṛtyantā phelāvyāptirihāgameātmānaṃ bhāvayedvidvāṃstadvidhāna mihocyatekṛtvātu pūtvavattasya madhye śāliṃ vinikṣipetnīrandhraṃ māṣakalpena kṛtvā gavyena pūrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmabhiḥ pūrayedvidvānīśānādyairgurūttamaḥpūrvavatkārayetpūjāṃ sāmānyaṃ dvijasattamāḥchādayettaṃ pdhānena guruśśivamanuṃ smarankuryādanantaraṃ vātha tadviśeṣastu kathyateānīya kuryāttasyaiva garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥekaviṃśati saṃkhyātānudumbara phalānvitāntriṃśanniṣkamitāṃ kanyāṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitāmbhojayetpāyasairviprānannaprāśānakarmaṇianuktamatra yatkarma tulāroha vadācaretevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ so'nanta phalamaśnutepūrvavanmaṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā vedikārahitaṃ yathāpañcagavyena saṃprikṣya maṇḍalaṃ madhyakalpitampuṇyāha prokṣaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ śatamātrasamucchritamtilāṃśca nikṣipettatra vyomavyāpinamuccarankartavyamadhikaṃ sadbhiścaturaṅgulameva vāvastraśca veṣṭayet sarvāṃstilān sadyādimantrataḥnikṣipet parvataprānte mūrtipān mūrtisaṃyutāntatrasthamarcayeddevaṃ tilaparvatamadhyagamdarśayet tilamadhyasthaṃ devadevamupāpatimasmārcane kṛte sarvaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavati kalpanamsnapanaṃ deva devasya sahasrakalaśādibhiḥvisṛjya devadeveśaṃ śivāya śivadharmiṇeasmātparataraṃ dānaṃ nāstīha bhuvanatrayesarvadā sarvakāle ca kartavyamiha kathyatetilaṃ bhāragrayaṃ tatra nikṣipeddaśabījataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśaniṣkoṇa kṛtvātha tadūrdhvenārdhamānataḥtaduttare tadardhena kārayettu manonmanīmaṣṭau vidyeśvarān bāhye tadvatsvarṇamayena vādāpayecchivabhaktebhyastatkartrā deśikottamaḥkāñcanena sahasreṇa caturaśrādimedinīsamudraparvatopetā sarvatīrthasamanvitāanekamunisaṃyuktāṃ navakhaṇḍāṃ tu bhāvayetmervādīn pūjayet svasva bījenaiva gurūttamaḥpūrvavattasya pūjā ca vidheyā dvijasattamāḥśivādibhyo pradātavyā medinī svarṇanirmitāpādapaṃ śataniṣkeṇa suvarṇe samācaretnānāphalasamāyuktaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitamchadanāni vicitrāṇi kuryānmaratakairdvijāḥphalāni padmarāgaiśca vividhāni samācaretvaiḍūryena prakartavyaṃ drumāgraṃ puṣyarāgataḥskandhaṃ vai kārayedvidvān sūryakāntena suvratāḥvitastimātramāyāmaṃ vṛkṣasya parikīrtitamsthāpayed vṛkṣamūle tu liṅgaṃ lokapasaṃvṛtampūrvavat tadvinā kṛtvā tanmadhye sthāpya pādapamīśvarāya drumaṃ dadyāt tadīyebhyo dvijottamāḥatrānuktaṃ tu yatsarvaṃ tulābhāravadācaretpūrvavanmaṇṭapaṃ kuryādvedikāmaṇḍalānvitamtadbāhye pūjayedṣṭau vidyeśānaṣṭadikṣu catṛtīyāvaraṇopetān gandhapuṣpādibhirguruḥīśānādiṣu saṃsthāpya saptaviprān samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praviśya nagarādyantu deśikaśśiṣya eva vālaḍḍukaṃ modakaṃ maudgaṃ gulaṃ saktuṃ gaṇeśvarebrahmapriyamidaṃ deyaṃ dvitīyehanikīrtitamtṛtīyehani dātavyaṃ bhūtānāṃ prītikāraṇamcaturthehanidātavyaṃ gandharvapriyameva capañcamehani dātavyaṃ indrapriyakaraṃ bhavetṣaṣṭhehani pradātavyaṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ prītisiddhayesaptamehani dātavyaṃ śriyaḥ prītikaraṃ bhavetaṣṭamehani dātavyaṃ rākṣasaḥ prītisiddhayenavamehanidātavyaṃ śivaprītikaraṃ bhavetśuddhānnandadhisaṃyuktaṃ laḍḍukāpūpasaṃyutamphalaiśca rajanīcūrṇaṃ ghṛtānnaṃ dadhisaktukambhūtebhyaḥ kṛsaraḥ proktaḥ tena tebhyo balirbhavetkadalīphalasaṃyuktaṃ ṛṣibhyo balimācaretcaturthe'hani dātavyaṃ śakrasyāsya tu tṛptayepañcamehani dātavyaṃ brahmaprītikaraṃ bhavetṣaṣṭhehanipradātavyaṃ viṣṇuprītivivṛddhayesaptamehanidātavyaṃ śivaprītikaraṃ bhavetaṣṭamehaninidātavyamīśvaraprītisiddhayenavamehani dātavyaṃ caṇḍeśaprītihetavekathitānyata ūrdhvantu kathyate dvādaśāhakeprathamehani dātavyaṃ vighnamantramanusmaranghṛtamatsyasamāyuktaṃ japākusumasaṃyutampāyasaṃ saktupuṣpañca padmapuṣpasamanvitamkṛsarānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ saktu laḍḍukaiśca samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tebhyaḥ padadyādvidyeśān svasvamantrairanukramātatrānuktaṃ tu yat kiñcit tulārohavadācaretsarva pāpa haraṃ sarva bhaya durbhikṣa nāśanamtasyāpyardhena vā kuryācchataniṣkeṇa vā dvijāḥpadmarāgaṃ tu śṛṅge syāt khurāgre vajramiṣyatepuṣparāgaṃ tu dantarthaṃ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥvatsaṃ tadvat samāpādya pūrvavanmaṭapaṃ nayetsavatsāṃ vastra yugmena veṣṭayeddeśikottamaḥarcanaṃ pūrvavatkuryāt homaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥkṣīrādyaḥ pūjayeddevaṃ sahasra kalaśādibhiḥanuktaṃ yadbhavet kiñcittulārohavadācaretkāñcanena sahasreṇa tadardhena tadardhataḥaṣṭottara śatenātha niṣkeṇaināṃ prakalpayetmaṇḍale vinyasellakṣmīṃ viṣṇvorvāme yathā bhavetviṣṇuṃ ca viṣṇugāyatryā gandha puṣpādinārcayeteka homaṃ tu vā kuryāt pragukta vidhinā guruḥpūrvavat vidhinā kuryāt anuktamiha yadbhavetpūrvavanmaṇḍalaṃ kuryāt vedikā maṇḍalānvitamaṣṭadroṇena kartavyaṃ yadvā bhāreṇa kārayettriṃśanniṣkeṇa cārdhena tadardhenāthavā bhavettasyaivottaradigbhāge brāhmaṇān rudra saṃkhyayāviprān dvādaśa pūrve tu dvādaśādityamantrataḥṣauḍaśaiva tu gandhādyaiścacurdikṣu ca bhāvayetpañcāṅga bhūṣaṇopetāṃ stvāstīrya ca tadaśraketilānnikṣipya kāṃsye tu pātre navaphalena tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hemaśṛṅgāmarogāṃ tu dadyādraupyakhurāmathapūrvavanmaṇḍapaṃ kuryāt vedikā maṇḍalānvitamkevalaṃ rudradānaṃ vā sūryadāna mathāpi vāpañcāṅga bhūṣaṇaṃ pañca niṣkeṇātra prakalpayetdakṣiṇāṃ pūrvavaddadyāddadyādanuktaṃ pūrvavadbhavetsavatsassaguṇā eva saṃgrāhyā guṇavattarāḥśṛṅgaṃ kṛtvā tu badhnīyād rājataṃ khurameva vāmaṇḍapaṃ vedikopetaṃ maṇḍalena samanvitamsnapanaṃ ca śivasyātha sahasra kalaśādibhiḥdaśaniṣkaṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ niṣkameva vāgāvo mamāgratonityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva meanuktamatra yatkarma tulābhāravaśānnayetayutasyāśvamedhasya phalācchreṣṭhamidaṃ matamaṣṭottara śatenātha kṛtvāśvaṃ lakṣaṇānvitamsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ kalādyaiśca samanvitamtanmadhye vinyasedvāji muccaiḥ śravasanāmataḥsurendra buddhyā saṃpūjya pañca niṣkaṃ pradāya camaṇḍalābhyarcanaṃ homaṃ kalaśasnapanaṃ tathāsarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannāṃ doṣa vivarjitāmdatvā dhanādikaṃ pitrostatsaṃvāda purassaramsaṃsnāpya gandhamālābhi rbhūṣaṇairvastra saṃyutaiḥpūrvavanmaṇḍapaṃ kuryāt vedikā maṇḍalānvitamnaimittikoditaṃ śāntaṃ śivabhakti samanvitampañcāṅga bhūṣaṇaścaiva vāsobhūmidhanānvitamdadyādvarāya saṃsmṛtya śivaṃ śraddhā purassaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kanyāromāṇi yāvanti tāvadvarṣaśataṃ dvijāḥkāñcanena sahasreṇa kuryāanniṣkeṇa vārdhataḥvṛṣaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt aṣṭottara śatena vākarṇaṃ ca padmarāgeṇa gomedena kakudbhavetvṛṣāṅgaṃ kārayed vidvān kiṃkiṇī mālayāvṛtamtanmadhye vinyasedukṣaṃ paścimāsyaṃ dvijottamāḥpūrvavacchivapūjā ca homaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥsamidājya carūpetaṃ śānti homamathāpi vācaredanuktamiha yat tattulābhāravad guruḥgajaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tu vāaṣṭottara śatenātha kārayeddeśikottamaḥgajendraṃ vinyasenmadhye gandhapuṣpādinārcayetśivāya śivabhaktebhyo dadyācchraddhā samanvitamanyatsarvamanuddiṣṭaṃ tulābhāravadācaretprāguktadeśakāle tu vedikāmaṇḍalānviteśaivānaṣṭau samāhūya sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutāmarcayedgandhapuṣpādyairmantrairlokeśavācakaiḥdakṣiṇā daśaniṣkā syād bhūṣaṇaiśca samanvitāatrānuktaṃ tu yat kiṃcit tulābhāravadācaretparacakrapramathanaṃ gajavājivivardhanammaṇḍapaṃ vidhinā kuryāt vedikā kuṇḍa saṃyutammadhyame devadeveśaṃ brahmaviṣṇu samanvitambrahman brāhmaṇa bhedāya brahmaṇe dhana dāyinecaturveda vido grāhyā japtārastraya eva hiśatamaṣṭottaraṃ teṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthaganuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atrānuktaṃ tu yat sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0)

sanskrit: indravallī haridrānnaṃ saghṛtaṃ lājasaṃyutamgulānnaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ nālikeraphalānvitamkuśāgraṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ śuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyutamkṣīrānnaṃ śālipiṣṭañca ikṣukhaṇḍasamanvitamdadhikānnaṃ gulopetammātulaṃgaphalantathāgulānnamājyasaṃyuktaṃ kadalīpanasamanvitamraktānnaṃ māṃsasaṃyuktaṃ apūpaṃ tilacūrṇayukśālyannaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ gulakhaṇḍasamanvitamsaptāhe vātha pañcāhe tridine vyomarātrikedinadravyabalidravyaṃ kathitaṃ munisattamāḥdinādhipati tṛptyarthaṃ śuddhānnaṃ dadhisaṃyutamvṛṣādi parivāreṣu dhvaje brahmādiṣu kramātdhvajādi balipīṭhāntaṃ athavā balirīritaḥtattat dinādhi devānāṃ balipīṭhe balistu vālokeśebhyo balirvāpi dinadeveṣu vāmataḥdinānāmapi sarveṣāṃ dinaṃ pratibalidvayamsāyaṃ prātarbalindadyāt tatkāle vā tadantakeprathame vṛṣayantraṃ syāt dvitīye bhramaṇārhakamsihmayantraṃ tataḥ proktaṃ dīpayantraṃ tato bhavetanyonyañcārurūpāṇi kāryāṇi dvijasattamāḥtadante balidānaṃ syāt balipīṭhasamanvitamdaśāyudhasamāyuktaṃ golakāliṃgasaṃyutamrathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutamtadante vṛṣabhaṃ paścāt vṛttārthaṃ mukharaṃgakamrathāgrobhayasaṃsthābhyāṃ bhūṣitābhyāṃ viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navaratnojvalacchaveta chatreṇoparigāmināmmatpṛṣṭhabhāgasaṃsthena matkarmaniratena capadmakuḍmalasannaddhapāśa saṃbandhahastayāmaddāsyāvātha sarvāṃgasundaryāssyandanasya catadante caṇḍanāthasyāt prathagvānyasamanvitamśivabhaktāśca ye khyātāsteṣāṃ raṃgānyanekadhāeṣāmiṣṭantu yatgrāhyaṃ balyaṃgaṃ kautukaṃ vināvīthisammārjanopetaṃ jalasekasamanvitammaṃgulāṃkurasadvīpavardhanīkumbhavāriyukdarbhamālā samāyuktaṃ muktādāmavibhūṣitamvinyaseddīpadaṇḍāṃśca rātrau ceddīpamālayānānādhvajasamopetaṃ nānāvādyasamanvitamnānācchatrasamopetaṃ picchacāmarasaṃyutampratidinaṃ kuryādahnirātrau mahotsaveyānakāle tu tāmbūlaṃ deyaṃ nānāphalāni cayogyāyogya vibhāgena dagdhārdra viṣayaḥ kramātvitvak satvak kṛtaṃ yuktayā vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitampracchannapaṭamāvarjya nirmālyāpanaye kṛteāgantukebhya stvanyebhyaḥ tattat bhaktyanusārataḥdatvā pādyādikaṃ nityaṃ snapanaṃ śāntihomayukcaṇḍālapāṇadṛkdoṣanivṛtyarthaṃ viśeṣataḥśāntihomaṃ vināvātha aśaktau snapanaṃ nayetvidhāya snapanaṃ vātha pañcakhārisamanvitepādena vātha tanyūnaisnāpayeddevamādarātsvakālavihitañcaitadiṣṭadaṃ parikīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rathādyārohaṇaṃ yānantato madhyāhnapūjanamyātrārthasnapanaṃ paścāttato naimittikārcanampunarhomaniveśaśca tato grāmapradakṣiṇamtato dhāma niveśaśca devyā saha niveśanamkṛtasara prati sarasyaitā devatāḥ vihitaḥ kriyāḥpūrvapūrvagrahe'puṣṭiḥ pṛṣṭhapṛṣṭhagrahe'śubhaḥsvakālepi ca doṣassyāt pṛṣṭhakāle samācaretparivāroktamārgeṇa balipīṭhe samācaretyāgamaṇḍapaveśañca hitvāntarveśanantu vāuktakāle parityāge śāntihomañca kārayetprabhūtantu havirdadyādyānakālāvasānakegrāmādau tatbahiḥ vāpi kalpite maṇḍapādikepraviśya dhāma vā no nayet grāmaṃ samastakambhaviṣyadvṛṣṭiśaṃkāyāndhakāre mahatyapiyāgārambhadine vātha tīrthadānadinepi cagrāmapradakṣiṇe hīne diśāhomantu kārayetberayātrā prakartavyā balinnityaṃ samācarettailābhyaṃgañca tadvāre rātricūrṇayutantu vāanyatrāpi ca kartavyaṃ dhvajārohepi vāmatamastramantreṇa saṃprokṣya saṃhitā manunā labhetkavacenāva kuṇṭhyātha yajedgandhādhibhiḥ hṛdāsapuṣpannikṣipenmūrdhni rātricūrṇamanukramāttatra vanyatra vā snānaṃ kṛtvā maudgannivedayetnaṭeśabhramaṇaṃ kuryāttadardhaṃ pūrvarātrikesarvābharaṇayuktāya pūjitāya viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā dhāmapradakṣiṇamvinodadarśanañcāpi kārayedvijasattamāḥnānāgarusugandhañca karpūreṇa vimiśritamdhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sarvātodyasamanvitamsaṃprokṣyārghyāmbhasāstreṇa mantrayet śarvaśambaraiḥsamidājyena caruṇā tilalājagulaistu vāpañcāgni saṃskṛtiryukto homassarvārthasādhakaḥsadyojātena saṃspṛśya gandhaṃmūlena dāpayettilamājyamathānyadvā dadyādācārya tṛptayeathānyadvā haridrāñca lavaṇantilasarṣapauśivadānamiti khyātaṃ karturiṣṭa pradāyakamtatpūjādānamiṣṭaṃ syāt sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapipratidānaṃ tu deyaṃ syājjalopetaṃ tu tadbhavetācāryaśśiva evasyādanayorantarannahisarvāgamajñaṃ śāntañca śivaliṃgārcanāratamgrahabalyādisaṃyuktaṃ bhikṣā pradamaninditamtṛpto yatra tadātasya puruṣārthagatirdvijāḥtadvittamāhṛtaṃ yena trijagaccora ucyatetasmāt pāpaṃ parijñāya bahudhā deśikasya cayātrādāna midaṃ kāryānnaivedyādi nivedayetanyatrāpi ca kartavyaṃ rājñāṃ vijayahetavesarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ mukheṇasamanvitampañcaprākāramadhye vā tatbāhye vā pradakṣiṇamrājaveṣadharaiḥ puṃbhirnānānṛttasamanvitaiḥagrataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi kṛtasevā samanvitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praveśya bhavanaṃ paścāt sthāpayet pūrvavartmanātadante berayātrādi tatpūrve vā prakīrtitampūrvayānakrameṇaiva grāmādīnāṃ gradakṣiṇamanyeṣvapi ca bereṣu vidhānaṃ sadṛśaṃ matamyuddhārambhakriyopetaṃ mṛgayātrāvasānakamviśeṣeṇa snapanantasya vidheyaṃ pūrvavartmanātīrthārthaṃ sādhayedrātrau kalaśānnavasaṃkhyayāsavastrānvā vivastrānvā pradhāne vastrameva vāprātaḥ prāgudayāt pūrvantīrthakāryaṃ samācaretsthaṇḍiladvitayaṃ kuryāt śūlārthaṃ kalaśārthakampuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu devānāhūyapūrvakammadhye manonmanīyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajettīrthasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt gaṃgādyāvāhanena casindho gotāvaritvañca kāveryatrajalāśayekherastamanaṃ yāvat tīrthānāṃ pāpaśuddhayetriśūlaṃ snāpayedapsu śivamantramanusmarantīrthasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ devālayepi vāsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ praviśedālayaṃ praticūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt devasyāsthānamaṇṭapetriśūlaṃ paścimenyatrolūkhalaṃ viniveśayetvastrāṇāveṣṭya tanmadhye rātricūrṇantu vā kṣipetsaṃklpyolūkhaleśaktimmādhārākhyaṃ prakalpayetdūrvā puṣpasamopetaiḥ vrīhitaṇḍulakādibhiḥtadvanmusalamuddiṣṭaṃ tathaivolūkhanaṃ bhavetmusalaṃ pūrvamabhyarcyolūkhanaṃ tadanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dūrvāpradānaṃ kartavyaṃ guruṇā vā niyogināpurohitamukhairdeyaṃ tato māheśvarairjanaiḥno cetrājaniyuktābhirudrakanyābhireva vādūrvādānaṃ prakartavyaṃ viddhairdeśikājñayātadādau snānakālādau kartavyammaṃgalārthakamdūrvādānaṃ krameṇaiva cūrṇayedrātrimādarātnānāvidheṣu pātreṣu liṃgārthakaṃ pratimārthakamparivārārthamekañca bhāgaṃ saṃkalpayet kramātkevalaṃ gandhatailaṃ vā pṛthak pātreṣu kalpayetsaṃprokṣya hetinā paścāt hṛṇmantreṇa samarcayetrātricūrṇaṃ ca deyaṃ syāt prāguktavidhinā dvijāḥkārayet śīghragatyā tu samarthaiḥ paricārakaiḥnālpodake vidhātavyaṃ tacca kautukatīrthavatkalaśasthāpanopetaṃ devatāhvānasaṃyutamtīrthasaṃgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ na kṛte tu jalāntarevimocya kautukaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktebhyo viniveśya catriśūlasahitaṃ vāpi nānādevālayāgataiḥathavā padmacakrābhyāṃ sahitaṃ vā samācaretahnitīrthaṃ prakartavyaṃ madhyāhne tīrthamuttamamhitvendu grahaṇaṃ tīrthaṃ rātrau vā varamiṣyetetithipradhānaṃ sāmudrayamanyaddakṣapradhānakampūrvāhne vā parāhnevā tithiṛkṣasamanvitamnakṣatramadhikaṃ tvahnisaṃgrāhyaṃ tithireva vātīrtharkṣadvayasaṃprāptāvekamāse paraṃ varamyasmin māse tu yadṛkṣaṃ pūrvaṃ tīrthamanuṣṭhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṃge svāyambhuve cettu daivike cārṣikepi vānakṣatre vā tithau vāpi tīrthakāryaṃ dvijottamāḥdvidhāvagāhanaṃ proktaṃ berayogaviyogataḥkārayet pūjayet paścāt gandhādyairupacārakaiḥārāmādau ca deveśaṃ toṣayet sarvamaṃgalaiḥsarverbhaktajanopetaṃ tairvihīnantu vā bhavetdhāmapradakṣiṇopetaṃ viśuddhaiḥ paricārakaiḥgarbhagehe susaṃsthāpya liṃge pīṭhehyanukramāttattat toyaiśca saṃprokṣya śuddhodaisnāpayedvibhumdhvajāvarohaṇaṃ tasyāṃ rātrau śreṣṭhamudāhṛtamekādaśāhe viśvarkṣe kuryātpañcadaśāhakekuryāt saptadaśāhe vaikona viṃśatyahe'pi cadhvajādi tīrthaparyantaṃ dinasaṃkhyāsthitā yadidhvajāvarohaṛkṣetu śuddhākhyaṃ snapanaṃ nayetarcanoktaṃ samabhyarcya malābhirdhāmabhūṣayetkālāgarūdbhavai rdhūpairdhūpayeddevamandiramcaṇḍapūjāntataḥ kuryāt homena sahitannavātriśūlena samāyuktaṃ caṇḍanāthayutantu vāśrīkhaṇṭa śaṃkhasaṃyuktaṃ balikāle tu ghoṣaṇamdhvajevādau balindadyāttadante ca dhvajaṃ punaḥdhvajāvarohaṇasyādau cānte vā baliriṣyateaṃkurārpaṇakāle ca dhvajārohaṇakālakeathavā caikasandhyāyāḥ prārambhevāvasānakedakṣiṇāndāpayetpaścāt trividhā sā ca sammatātriguṇā cottamā jñeyā deśikasya tu dakṣiṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śreṣṭhaṃ tu dviguṇā proktā tvanyathā vā nigadyatebhaktotsavantataḥ kuryāt pakṣāhāt pūrva eva vāsaṃvatsarodbhavekāle yadā māsotsavo bhavetvarjayedvānayetbera yātrāmātramathāpi vāmāsotsavamihaproktastvekāhotsavat dvijāḥaṃkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ vā tadviyuktamathācaretsthaṇḍiladvitayaṃ kṛtvā śūlamekatra vinyasetastraṃ bherīñca saṃpūjya bherīṃ santāḍayet kramātdhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā yāgaśālāṃ praviśya cavinyaset śivakumbhañca vardhanī sahitaṃ guruḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu prokṣayedastravāriṇāubhayañca vidhātavyaṃ sūtrakūrcapidhānayukvardhanyāmaṣṭavidyeśān kalaśeṣu samarcayetsthaṇḍiletān samabhyarcya toraṇairaṣṭamaṃgalaiḥkuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vāpi homakarmasamācarettato grāmabaliṃ dadyāt bimbena sahitantu vākṛtvā homaṃ baliṃ kuryādbereṇa ca samanvitamtatastīrthaṃ prakartavyamatrānuktantu pūrvavatsadyodhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā prāgvatsarvaṃ samācaretālaye baliyāne ca syātāṃ tīrthaṃ vihāya vātīrthordhvañcet bhavet yātrā balikāle'nyaberataḥbalihomādikaṃ hitvā bhramaṇaṃ kevalantu vādevasya kautukaṃ kuryāddineṣvetadapīritamkartṛjanmāvasānarkṣe cārdrā nakṣatra eva vāayane viṣuve rāhu darśanedamanotsave
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃvatsarādilekhāyānnavatoyāgatāvapianyasmin maṃgale kārye kuryādekotsavaṃ budhaḥvārapūjādi kartavyā ravivārāditaḥ kramātpuṣpakalairgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayet parameśvaramgokṣurā bilvapatrañca viṣṇukrāntiḥ krameṇa tumāṇikkamarkavāresyāt candra vāre tu mauktikamsureḍhye puṣparāgaṃ syāt śukre vajramiti smṛtamsarvavāreṣu yogyāni bhūṣaṇānāṃ vidhirmataḥtadvarṇābhāni ca puṣpāṇi vastrāṇi ca niyojayetvārapūjāvasāne tu vārotsavamathācaretgrahapīḍāvināśārthamārogyārthaṃ viśeṣataḥtadvārapūjā kartavyā tadvārotsavasaṃyutāsaṃvatsarotsavaḥ proktaḥ tathā māsotsavopi capūrvāhne brāhmaṇānāntu madhyāhne kṣatriyasya tudhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kuryāt dhvajārohaṇa pūrvakambrāhmaṇādi trayāṇāṃ vā śūdre vāṃkurapūrvakampattaneṃkurapūrvaṃ vā tadvachśūdre prakīrtitampurādau saṃkaronoktaḥ utsavānāṃ dvijottamāḥdhvajasya vedikāṃ kuryāt śūdrādīnāṃ vilomataḥutsave cotsavanneṣṭamiṣṭaṃ śaivotsavaṃ dvijāḥśvetaṃ raktañca pītañca brāhmaṇyādi traye mataḥārambhastu paṭe mūrdhā pucchasyādavasānayukgāndhāraṃ pūrvabhāge tu dakṣiṇo kauśiko bhavetevañca dikvibhāgena svarāstu parikalpayetdhvajārohādi tīrthāntaṃ rotrau grāmabalistu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityotsavayutasthāne cotsavenyatravāpi vāpradakṣiṇakramādvāpi kuryādekāgnikalpaneātmānañcaṇḍavat dhyātvā chindyādvādhvajadaṇḍakamketvaṃkurannavāhe syāt saptāhecotsavāṃkurammadhyāhne dhvajapūjāṃ vā somakumbhe jalasya cakṛtakautukaberasya tatgrāmānnirgamopi vāsauraścāndro dvidhāproktā vatsaraḥ kāmikāgamesāvanastvadhamaḥ proktastena kāryantu neṣyatevidhāya śāntihomantu pratiṣṭhādyantu vā nayetdhvajamekaṃ samāropya dhvajārohaṇapūrvakamśrāvayettīrthadivasaṃ gajādyārohitena catadrātrāveva kartavyaṃ bherītāḍanapūrvakamāśrāvya tīrthadivasaṃ grāmādibalivarjitamsthaṇḍiladvitayaṃ kṛtvā jalatīre gurūttamāḥnavakaisnāpayecchūlaṃ tacchūlamavagāhayetyāgārambhaṃ punaḥ kuryādaṃkurārpaṇapūrvakamberayātrā samāyuktaṃ divasaṃ pratyaharniśamvikiret sadanaṃ sarvamantarbāhya vikalpitamtīrthāthaṃ tanniśāyāntu dhāmnastvaṣṭādiśāsvapitadastrākān vṛṣāṅgānvā mūrtipaiśca samanvitaḥtadante balidānaṃ syāt berayātrāsamanvitamdhvajānāmaṣṭasaṃkhyānāṃ tadrātrāvavarohaṇamnānāgānasamāyuktaṃ nānānṛttasamanvitamsaptāhamevaṃ kṛtvānte tasmādgatvā jalāśayamekatra sthāpayecchūlamanyatra kalaśānnyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praviśya devatāsthānaṃ sarvātodyaṃ vivarjya cacaṇḍeśvaraṃ puro nītvā berayātrāmanantaramcaṇḍapūjā samāyuktaṃ homaṃsnapanasaṃyutamdhvajāvarohaṇaṃ kuryāt tadrātrau pūrvavartmanānavānnaliṃgaṃ kṛtvā vā dikpālāstrārthameva vānityotsavānnaliṃgāni daśa vā parikalpayetjīrṇādi doṣe taṃ tyaktvā dhvajamanyaṃ niveśayetpradoṣādau vidheyo vā dhūpadīpāvasānaketadarthaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryāt maṇḍalaṃ vā samācaretmahānasevācānyasmin prokṣayedastramantrataḥpātrāṇi ca vidheyāni balipātroktavartmanāpādāṃgulavivṛddhyātu navāṃgulasamāvidhivasudhā madhyame bhakte navadhāmānamīritampātramāna ghanaṃ cārdhaṃ madhye suṣirasaṃyutamdhurtūrakusumākāraṃ śaravākārameva vāekapātre bhavedekadīpādhārantu pañca vāpiṣṭenānnena vā dīpādhārāndevārthameva vāekatra tilamanyatra sarṣapaṃ lavaṇantathāvarṇabhakta haviṣyaṃ ca vaṭāśvadakānimadhyame dīpapātrantu pañca vā parikalpayetsarvatra dīpānvā kuryānnavasaṃkhyān samujvalānlokapālā viriñcena mūrtayomūrtipāstu vākalābhūtāni devāṃśca brahmādyāḥ kāraṇeśvarāḥprasthapādādi tadvṛddhyātu cāḍhakāntamudāhratamsaṃskāraissarvasāmānyaiḥ saṃskṛtyokta krameṇa ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvātodyasamāyuktaṃ śaṃkhadhvani samanvitamstrībhirvāvāhayeddīpānathavā paricārakaiḥdatvā pādyamajātena dadyādācamanaṃ hṛdātrivāramekavāraṃ vā bhrāmayecchivamūrdhaniātmatatvādibhirmantraiḥ dadyācchiṣya karāmbujesitaṃ pūtaṃ sugandhañca nirvālukamanantaramtrivārandīpamadhye tu nikṣipya tadanantaramlalāṭeṣu kramāt kuryāddhṛdi bāhvoranukramātdevī vyaktasvarūpācettilakañca puro bhavetbere lalāṭahṛtbāhupradeśe tilakannayetbhakteṣvanyeṣu lohādi kṛtabereṣu dāpayetsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ pātrāṇyāhṛtyapūrvavatpīṭhāgre vṛṣabhāge vā gopurasyāntikepi vādravyāṇi gurave dadyāddahedvātena vahninārājñāmapi ca kartavyaṃ kintvagnistatra devatādeśikasyābhiṣekepi kintu dīpavivarjitamtaṇḍulā vihitāstatra rātrauceddīpasaṃyutammāse tu kārtikākhye tu nakṣatre kṛttikāhvayeravyastamaya velāyāndīpārohaṇamācaretvṛṣṭivaināśikarkṣādi prekṣaṇantatra sammatamkālastadūrdhvaṃ yāmārdhaparyantaḥ kāla eva vādīpārādhanapūvedyuradhivāsanamārabhetaṣṭadikṣu caturdikṣu triṣvekatra ca vā dvayoḥsa daṇḍo nālikero vā tālaḥ kramukaveṇujaudvādaśāṃgulamārabhya vyomāṃgulavivṛddhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvimātrāt pādavṛddhyātu ṣaḍaṃgulasamāvadhidaṇḍaproktā bhaveyurvā lagnā vā kīlapādapāḥsaptaviṃśatikīlāntaṃ diśyekasyāṃ niyojayettrikīlaṃ vā catuṣkīlamiṣṭamānasamanvitamdārūdbhavāni cakrāṇi pratikīlantu yojayetyojayedvā bahiśśuṣkaiḥ nālikeradalādibhiḥekahastaviśālantu dviguṇāyatasaṃyutamkalpametatsamākhyātamanukalpamathocyateyojayedupakalpaṃ syāddhomakūṭavivarjitamdīpakūṭānnayeddikṣu vidikṣvapi tadantaresthāpayet dīpadaṇḍāṃśca mālākāreṇa vā bahūnprabhākārāṃśca vā kṛtvā tatra dīpāṃśca yojayetmaṇṭape balipīṭhādau kūpe vātha gṛhepi vābahirvā kalpayeddīpān grāmādiṣvapi sarvataḥastreṇa śodhayeddaṇḍaṃ praṇavena tu pūjayetsthāpayitvā tu pūrvedyuḥ stanmūle vedikāṃ nayetśilpinaṃ mocayitvānte puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥbadhvā pratisarañcāntaḥ praviśyedaṃ samācaretmanorame śubhenyatra gomayenopalepitenavavā pañcapātrāṇi vaikaṃ vā tatra vinyasetpātre praṇava ityuktaścandanādyaissamarcayetśivāgniṃ tatra saṃpādya śivaṃ sāṃgañca tarpayetkṣīreṇa śatamardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā samācaretśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā pūrṇāmante vidhāya catailājyenavāpūrya pātraṃ sarvātmakaṃ smaran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpādibhiśceṣṭvā śivāgniñca visarjayetsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ taruṇākhyantu dīpakamhomānte dīpadaṇḍasya kautukaṃ vā samācaretcatustoraṇasaṃyuktañcatuṣkūṭasamanvitampūrvasyāmathavāgneyyāṃ kūṭamekantu vā nayetsarvatra toraṇaṃ kūṭandarbhamālādiśobhitamevaṃ saṃpādya sarvantu mandībhūte divākarevastrayugmena caikena veṣṭayeddaṇḍamūlakamkārpāsa bījasārābhyāṃ yuktantailājyasaṃyutamadhivāsana homena samaṃ homaṃ samācaretbrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥpalāśavaṭaśamyarkān sarve vahnerathāpi vāpūrṇāhutipradānānte sarvādīpādvijottamāḥsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ maṃgalāṃkura śobhitamnānāvādyasamāyuktannānānṛttasamanvitamgrahasthe brahmacārī vā dīpaṃ saṃgrāhya pāṇinādīpayedūrdhvapātre tu tasmāt sopyavatārya tumūrdhādi pādaparyantandīpānāropyayettataḥvastrādyairdeśiko dhīmānuttarābhi mukhasthitaḥathavā kūṭadāhañca hitvānyat sarvamācaretkārayitvā trayaṃ grāmaṃ nayeddīpasamanvitamprāsādādiṣu sarvatra dīpānāropayettadāsnapanaṃ kārayenno vā beraliṃgaṃ taduktitaḥpṛthukandāpayeddeve nālikeraphalānvitamaṃkurārpaṇahīnaṃ vā kriyāmenāṃ samācaret

sanskrit: atropayogiyat dravyaṃ homakūṭādi daṇḍakamidaṃ karma vidheyaṃ syāt rājñāmāvāsakepi caanyeṣāmapi martyānāṃ vāhanānāṃ kṣayepi cayāntithiṃ samanuprāpya udayaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥsā tithissakalā jñeyā śukle kṛṣṇe dvijottamāḥtaduktaṃ sakalaṃ jñeyaṃ nakṣatrepyevameva tuevaṃ jñātvā prayoktavyaṃ sarvakarmadvijottamāḥghṛtasnānasamopetaṃ prāguktavidhinā sahagandhādyairarcayeddevaṃ nānāgānaiśca toṣayetathavā balihomābhyāṃ yuktaṃ rātrau divāvapicūrṇotsava samāyuktaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā''layaṃ viśetḍolārohantataḥ kuryāt sāyāhna samaye dvijāḥstambhalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ tayoryaṣṭinniveśayetcaturbāhu samāyuktāmūrdhvapracchādanānvitāmekahaṃsāsanopetāṃ puṇyāha prokṣaṇānvitāmphalakāyāṃ yajeddhaṃsaṃ hṛdā haṃsāsane yajetviṣṭare rudramiṣṭvā tu phalakordhve śivaṃ yajetgandhādyairathavā devīmarcayet phalakoparinānāvādyasamopetaṃ tadā santoṣayeddharampratyahaṃ vā vidheyaṃ syāt sarvakāmārthasiddhayeasmin māse sapitrarkṣe viśeṣājyasamanvitampāyasaṃ dāpayeccambhordevyā api ca sammatammahāhavirnivedyānte berayātrāṃ prakalpayetpūrvoktavidhinā kartā phalamiṣṭamavāpnuyātkāpilaṃ kevalañcājyaṃ kṛmi kīṭādivarjitam

sanskrit: śastreṇa nikṣipet toye vāruṇaṃ bījamuccaranharidrācūrṇakarpūra cūrṇābhyāmapi saṃskṛtampañcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgaiśca śivena tadanantaramviśeṣapūjāṃ kṛtvānte sthaṇḍile sthāpayet ghṛtamtatpūrve sthaṇḍile dhīmān tarpayecchivapāvakamśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā pūrṇāmante vidhāya cakṛtvā saṃsthāpayetpūrvaṃ sthaṇḍile sāpidhānakamsaṃpūjya pūrvavaddevaṃ snapanādi samanvitamdhāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śivamantraṃ samuccarangandhādyairarcayitvā tu kambalena ca veṣṭayetdadyādevaṃ haviśśambhostāmbūlena samanvitampūrvavat pūjayeddevaṃ guruṃ saṃpūjayettadāaṃkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ vā rahitaṃ vaitadācaretśruṇvantu saṃyatāyūyaṃ vratānāmuttamottammayā saha mudā sārdhaṃ ramantīpsitamāyayuḥyamañcāpi na paśyanti narakāṇi ca no yayuḥmāghamāsyāsite pakṣe vidyate yā caturdaśītasyāmeva śivapūjā śivaliṃge śivālayesādhakenopacāreṇa kartavyā śraddhayā sahaśivāsanaṃ prakalpyātra mūrtiṃ vidyātanuṃ tataḥabhyarcya gandhatailena piṣṭenodvartya śodhayetgandhodakena vidhinā ghṛtādyairabhiṣecayetpiṣṭena punarapyevamudvartyāmalakena tuastreṇa śodhitenaiva śodhayedudakena cagandhodakena mūlāṃgabrahmabhiścābhiṣecayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṃgamācchādya devāṃgādyena śuddhena vāsasācandanāgarukarpūra kuṃkumādyaiḥ krameṇa tudūrvākṣatatilaiścāpi saṃyuktaṃ samyagarcayetdīpayet susitenaiva vartinājyaplutena cagaulamannantṛtīyena śuddhānnañca caturthakesaghṛtaṃ gulasaṃyuktantāmbūlañca nivedayethomaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍilethavāśivāgniṃ kalpayitvāgnau hṛdi kalpya śivāsanamsamādājya havirlāja tilairmūlāṃgabrahmābhiḥdaśādidaśavṛddhyātu yāvatpañcadaśāhutiḥvandayitvātha tambhasmadeveśamabhivandya casvayaṃ kartṛmaśaktaścet svārthamanyeva kārayetkṛtanityakriyaḥ paścāt snapanaṃ vidhipūrvakamdakṣiṇāñca tato dadyāt vittaśāṭhya vivarjitaḥpūjayecchaktito bhaktyā pūjāṃ samyak samāpya capādau hastau ca saṃkṣālya pāraṇantu samācaretviśeṣasnapanopetaṃ viśeṣayajanānvitampramāṇañcandanasyoktantadardhamagarurbhavetpādamaṣṭāṃśakaṃ veṣṭantadardhaṃ pādameva vāvāsitaṃ gandhapuṣpaiśca sarvamantraiśca mantritamgandhairālipya liṃgantu sapīṭhaṃ śivamantrataḥkambalena vinā sarvaṃ ghṛtakambalavannayetābhicārakṛte doṣe vidhānamidamācaretharakopāt purājātaḥ bairavo damanāhvayaḥprītenātha śivenokto viṭapo bhavabhūtale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayiṣyanti yemartyā devantvatpallavādibhiḥye punarnukariṣyanti dāmanaṃ parvamānavāḥsaptāmyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ gatvā damanakāntikamatha saṃbodhayeddāmaṃ śivavākyena mantravitśivakāryaṃ samuddiśyanetavyosi śivājñayāyadidūraṃ samānīya samūlammṛttikānvitamgrahepyāmantraṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā budhaḥāhṛtya yāgavastūni kṛtasnānādi satkriyaḥpaścime devadevasya tasya mūlammṛdāyutamvāmena śirasā vāpi nālandhātrīmathottarepuṃsā vā varmaṇā prācyāṃ sapuṣpaṃ dantadhāvanampañcāṃgamañjalau kṛtvā dāmaṃ puṣpākṣatānvitamāmantritosi deveśa prātaḥ kāle mayā prabhoiti vijñāpya devasya mastake kusumāñjalimśeṣaṃ pātre vinikṣipya dvitīyena pidhāya tatevaṃ surakṣitaṃ kṛtvā śivāya vinivedayetśivāgre jāgaraṃ kṛtvā dhyānagānajapādibhiḥnityānnaimittikīñcaiva kṛtvā pūjāṃ viśeṣataḥśeṣamañjalinādāya dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitamātmavidyāśivaistatvaiśśivādyairīśvarāntakaiḥpūrvoktairātmatatvādyaiḥ dvicatuṣṣaṭsvarānvitaiḥcaturthāñjalimantrastu praṇavaṃ śivamantrakamśūlapāṇiñcaturthyantannamaskārāntamācaretvijñāpayet śivaṃ paścāt vāñchitārthaphalapradamsarvantadastu saṃpūrṇaṃparva dāmanakaṃ mama
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paritoṣakaraṃ paścāt dīkṣitānapi tarpayetpūjā japādikantasya sa phalañcaitramāsajampūrvedyuḥ kautukaṃ baddhvā nānāvṛkṣasamākulenānāgānasamopete nānāvādyasamanviteprakīrṇapuṣpaprakāre nānāgandhasamāyuteāsthānamaṇṭapopete jalakriḍāsamanvitegrāmapradakṣiṇopetaṃ mandībhūte divākarepūjayedupacāraistu gandhadhūpasṛgādibhiḥdevasya dakṣiṇe vāme nānāgandhādibhiḥ kramātsthaṇḍiladvitaye vāpi nānāpuṣpasamanvitetāmbūlandāpayedante toṣayettau viśaṣataḥevaṃ kāle tu deveśannayeddevālayaṃ punaḥevaṃ devaṃ viśeṣaṇābhyarcayecchivamādarātevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyassarvān kāmānavāpnuyātviśākharkṣe tu vaiśākhe'vagrahe vā vidhīyateprāyaścittādike kārye grāmadāhādike nayetśītakumbhavidhiḥ kāryastattaṃddoṣāpanuttayevastvaṃgulaṃ samārabhyāṃgulavṛddhyākarāntakamvastreṇācchādya pādāṃśca brahmāṇandakṣiṇe yajetmahāmāyānnayasedūrdhvaṃ phalākāyāṃ samantataḥmaṇḍape sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vasudroṇādiśālibhiḥcaturdroṇena saṃpūrṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ droṇatrayeṇa tupakvabimbaphalākāraṃ savastraṃ kūrcasaṃyutampṛṣṭhe suṣirasaṃyuktaṃ hemanālasamanvitamyugāṃgulasadairghyeṇa sūcyagrasuṣireṇa tu

sanskrit: upakumbhantadagre vastrahemādi saṃyutamāsanañca tataḥ kṛtvā mūrtimāvāhayetghaṭepraṇavaṃ śivamāvāhya gandhādyaissamyagarcayetgandhodaṃ vā madhupayassarvārthaṃ viniyojayetpañcagavyaṃ vinikṣipya śuddhodakamathāpi vāathavācamanīyārthaṃ kalpito gandha eva vāhṛdā saṃpūjya gandhādyaistato homaṃ samācarettilalājasamāyuktaṃ madhusasyendrasaṃyutamāpyenāmṛtabījena saṃpuṭena śivena caśatamaṣṭottaraṃ vāpi pratidravyantu homayetjaptavyā vāruṇā mantrā mantrajāpibhiriṣṭibhiḥkṛtasnānairbinītaiśca haviṣyānnāśanairdvijaiḥśivadīkṣāsamopetaiḥ sarvervṛṣṭyabhikāṃkṣibhiḥtatkāle pātayet kṣīraṃ gostanebhyaḥ viśeṣataḥśatasaṃkhyāśca pātāścet puṣṭāvṛṣṭirbhaviṣyatipūjāyāñcātha pūrṇāyāṃ vāruṇīndhāraṇāṃ dvijāḥkuryācchaṃkhasvanopetaṃ pratyahaṃ caivamācaretnaimittikaṃ mahaccettu mahadādau samācaretsaṃsthāpya devadeveśamamṛtāplāvanaṃ smarangandhapuṣpairanekaiśca tatkṣaṇaṃ pratibodhitaiḥkarpūravartibhirdīpaiḥ pāyasaiḥ pracūraiḥ kṣaṇātpānīyaiśśītalairgandhaiḥ mṛṣṭairnūtanabhāṇḍakaiḥmukhavāsasamopetaiḥ gānairvādyaiśca nartanaiḥjāpibhirjayaśabdaiśca namaskārairanekaśaḥtadante homakarmeṣṭaṃ pratyahaṃ vidhirītitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃgrāhayitvādosthañca śirasthaṃ vā pradakṣiṇamācāryasyānukūlarkṣe yajamānasya caivahighaṭaṃ sasuṣirantasmin navakumbhasthitañjalamnikṣipeduttarāsyastu tripādyuparimadhyagamsaptāhaṃ vā dvisaptāhaṃ trisaptāhantu māsakamācāryaṃ pūjayedādau vastraiḥ pañcāṃgabhūṣaṇaiḥante ca dviguṇāṃ pūjāṃ dakṣiṇāmapi mānavāḥniṣkaikandakṣiṇopetāṃ dadyācchraddhāsamanvitamtāmbūlañca nṛpastebhyaḥ dadyācchraddhāsamanvitamdīnānātha janānāñca pratyahaṃ bhojanaṃ bhavetsnapanaṃ kārayedante pracurandāpayeddhaviḥviśeṣasnapanopetaṃ pañcāmṛta samanvitamviśeṣahoma saṃyuktaṃ samidājyānnakaissahapīṭhādi liṅgamūrdhāntaṃ phalairmūlena pūrayetvastrābhyāṃ veṣṭayelliṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ kavacanamantrataḥkriyānte pūjayet kartā deśikaṃ vastrakāñcanaiḥyadyadiṣṭaphalaṃ kartustattacchīghraṃ bhaviṣyatiāśvayujyatha vā māse kriyāmenāṃ samācaretdevadevyauśca vā prātaḥ kanyābhyaḥ kāñcanādikamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkāra saṃyutamgrāmapradakṣiṇātpūrvaṃ naivedyaṃ dāpayenna vārātricūrṇaṃ ca tailaṃ ca cūrṇotsavavidhānataḥtāmbūlasahitaṃ nānāvyañjanaṃ taṇḍulānvitamtriśūlena samāyuktaṃ devīṃ nadyādikaṃ nayetekatra śūlaṃ saṃsthāpya devyāḥ pūrvaṃ tadagrake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saktubhiśca phalopetaistān saṃpūjya hradā guruḥtīrthamadhye janaissārdhaṃ praviśedālayaṃ prātiāsmindine vā nirvāṇadīpamamlānamālayāathavā balihomābhyāṃ yutaṃ rātrau divāpi vānānābhaktajanaissārdhaṃ nānāsvāduphalāni canānāpūpa samāyuktaṃ nānāphala samanvitamvimocya devadevāgre tatastīrthaṃ navodakenītvālayaṃ tataḥ kuryāt snapanaṃ pūjayā sahatāmbūlena tadante tu pūjayedgurumādarātsarvapāpavināśārthaṃ sarvāriṣṭanivṛttayevidhānametat kartavyaṃ devyāssantuṣṭikāraṇampavitrakamahaṃ vakṣye trūyatāṃ muni puṅgavāḥsiddhi bhraṃśamavāpnoti deśiko roga bhāg bhavetsamayī samayastho'pi naiva yasmāt pavitrakampratyahaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyavyāpārajanitādalamāṣāḍhādi trayomāsāḥ jyeṣṭha madhyamakanyasāḥpūrva pakṣe caturdaśyāmāṣāḍhe tu pavitrakamcaturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ pavitraṃ vidhinācaretśuklapakṣe gṛhasthasya yaterubhaya pakṣayoḥkṣaumakārpāsajaṃ sūtraṃ mauñjaṃ vā tadasaṃbhavetriguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya śodhayedastramantrataḥśuṣkaṃ kṛtvā hṛdā tena pavitraṃ kārayedguruḥdiguṇāstantavo haste daśavṛddhyā tataḥ kramātdvādaśottarayā vṛddhyā dvādaśābhyastadantikāḥyavīyasāṃ kalāsaṃkhyā madhyānā varṇa lakṣitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svāyaṃ bhuvādiliṅgeṣu bāṇe vā ratnaje'pi vāsaṃkhyāssarvāśca saṃgrāhyāssamā vā viṣamāśca vātathaivahīna vitteṣu liṅgādiṣu munīśvarāḥgranthayastantu saṃkhyātāḥ snigdha garbhā navā matāḥekāditryaṃgulaṃ vāpi granthimānamihāgamerakta candana kāśmīra gairikāgarucandanaiḥrañjayeddhṛdayenaiva raktasūtrādibhistu vāpiṇḍikāspṛk caturthaṃ tu pavitraṃ sarva tātvikammukhaliṅge vidheyāsyāt sakale'pyathavā matāḥyantraliṅga pramāṇaṃ vā puṣpaliṅgamitaṃ tu vāāśṛṅgamekaṃ vṛṣabhe kakudaḥ khuragaṃ paramekaika meva dātavyaṃ caṇḍeśa kṣetra pālayoḥyāgadhāmavṛṣasthāna prāsādālaya saṃśrayānevaṃ niścitya pūrvedyuradhivāsanamārabhetmaṇḍape pañcahastādi caturviṃśatkarāntakemadhyame vedikāyukte sarvalakṣaṇa samyutemaṇḍape pūrva kḷpte vā dviguṇāyatavediketatsaṃkhye sthaṇḍilevāpivedikārohite'pivākṛtaśauca vidhasnāna sandhyāvandana tarpaṇaḥavisṛjya raviṃ śuddho mantrasannaddha dehayuklakṣmī yāgeśavardhanyau lokapān gaṇapaṃ gurūnsaṃpūjya vidhivaddeva samīpe svāsanesthitaḥkarma pañacāmṛtopetaṃ viśeṣasnapanānvitampūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ kṛtvā gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ guruḥsamidājyacarullājāṃ stilasasyendra saṃyutān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śamīkhādiraśrīvṛkṣaplakṣāḥ syuḥvahnikoṇataḥśivāddaśāṃśato'ṅgānāṃ kuṇḍe prādhānike matesthālīpākahaviḥ kṛtvā taddhṛtā vibhajet tridhākuryādātmīya bhāgaṃ tu kevalena ghṛtena cagatvā saṃpūjya deveśaṃ vratāṅgāni nivedayetbhasmadakṣiṇataśśuddhapātre 'ghoreṇa mantravitdhātrīphala mudak pūrve pañca bhakṣyaṃ nivedayetdaṇḍākṣamālākaupīna bhikṣāpātrāṇi dakṣiṇedarpaṇaṃ kartrikāṃ danta nakhaśodhana mañjanamtāṃbulaṃ bhasma saṃmiśraṃ dadyāttatpuruṣaṃ smaransthaṇḍile sūtranikaṭe paritaśicādhivāsya vādhenu mudrāmṛtī bhūtaṃ śivāṃśaṃ vinivedayetsthaṇḍilaṃ vedikordhve syāt aṣṭadroṇena śālinātatra saṃsthāpayet pātre pavitrāṇya'tha deśikaḥsaṃsthāpyārghyodakenaiva prokṣya saṃhitayālabhetsaṃvatsarātmakaṃ sarvakṛtya sākṣiṇamavyayamanusmaran śivaṃ brahma ṣaḍaṅgaṃ śivamantrataḥdatvā gandhapavitraṃ tu bhānorācamya deśikaḥkārakān pañca sūtreṇa varmaṇā pariveṣṭayetpraviśya pūrvavaccāntaḥ brahmaṇe ca pavitrakamarpayāmi ghaṭasthāya śivāyādhyeṣaye ditiādau vā kuṃbhavardhanyordatvāyāyācchivāntikameka granthi samāyuktamalpa tantu vinirmitamāmantraṇapavitraṃ tat sudhāmudrā prarocitamāmantraṇātmakaṃ mantraṃ paṭheddeveśa sannidhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prabho vāmantrayāmi tvāṃ tvadicchāvāptikārakaḥsarvathā sarvadā śambho namaste'stu prasīda medadyādāśādhipālānāṃ tadastrāṇāṃ pavitrakamāmantraṇa pavitraṃ ca dadyāttasyaiva pūrvavatanyeṣāṃ caiva mūrtinā/ kramāddadyāt bahirbalimprāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā pūrṇāṃ datvā tato guruḥagnaye tvatha somāya tābhyāṃ sviṣṭakṛdā hutimmaṇḍalastha śivenaiva pāvakasthaṃ śivaṃ tataḥsiddhānta pustake datvā svagurau ca pavitrakampañcagavyaṃ caruṃ danta dhāvanaṃ ca kramādbhavetatha prātaḥ kṛtāvaśyasnāna sandhyāṇutarpaṇaḥtānīśa maṇḍale pātre caṇḍeśārthaṃ prakalpayetsamācamya kṛtanyāsassāmānyārghyakaro guruḥdvāradvārādhipāniṣṭvā praviśyāstrāṇi kuṃbhayoḥsvāsane dīpasaṃkḷpte saimyāsyordhva sthita sthitiḥśivahastaṃ ca saṃkalpya pañcagavyaṃ ca pūrvavatpañcagavya samāyuktaṃ viśeṣeṇa śivaṃ yajetkuṇḍamastreṇa saṃprokṣya mekhalāparidhisthitāndatvā pūrṇāhutiṃ devamāvāhyābhyarcya tarpayetdatvā bhānoḥ pavitraṃ tu samācamyāṇudehayukbrahmaṇe kumbhavardhanyoḥ kramāddadyāt pavitrakamkṛtvā viśeṣa pūjāṃ ca vibhavasyānusārataḥvarṣartumāsa pakṣāharnāḍī prāṇādi vigrahamkṛtākṛta samutsṛṣṭakliṣṭa karmaika sākṣiṇamprabrūyādīśvarāśāsyassapavitrakaro vibhum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtaṃ kliṣṭaṃ samutsṛṣṭaṃ hṛtaṃ guptaṃ ca matkṛtamsarvātmanāmunā śambho pavitreṇa tvadicchayāniyameśvarāyeti padaṃ svāhetyantaṃ samuccarantatvavidyāśivākhyaṃ ca muktikāmapadaṃ paṭhetśivāṇumādāvuccārya śivavidyātmakaṃ punaḥpuṣpāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktyā vijñāpayetprabhumantaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ draṣṭātvaṃ parameśvaramantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ dravya hīnaṃ ca yatkṛtamakṛtaṃ vākyahīnaṃ ca tatpūraya maheśvaratvayā pavitritaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaḍagamamekī bhavatu tatsarvaṃ tavājñāsūtraguṃbhitamgṛh ṇīyātpraṇato bhaktyācatustridvyekamāsakamathavaikāha mārabdha karmāntaṃ niyamaṃ nayetvrataṃ gṛhītvā kartavyaṃ yāvatsūtrā varohaṇamśive pavitraṃ turyaṃ tu datvā vyāhṛtibhirguruḥdevaṃ sampūjya gurave saiddhānte pustake'pi caprāyaścitaṃ tato datvā pūrṇāṃ vai chidra pūraṇīmtadante bhojanācchāda mātropakaraṇādibhiḥliṅgātpavitramudvārasya nirmālyāpanaye kṛtebratānte prāgvadābhyarcya cātītadinavacchivambhuktikāmo vratī kāmekarmabandhaka ityapibhasitaṃ vandayitvātha vahnisthaṃ yojayecchivehṛdaye saṃniveśyāgniṃ visṛtyodvārasya viṣṭarātśivakuṃbhāstravardhanyormanūn saṃhṛtya yojayetdikpālānastra saṃyuktān dvārapān dvārasaṃsthitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādāya sati caṇḍeśe tasmai dadyātpavitrakamlakṣaṃ tvaghoramāvṛtyā daśāṃśaṃ homamācaretdatte nityapavitre vā sāṃvatsarikamācaretmārgaśīrṣamathāṣāḍhaṃ māghamāsaṃ vivarjya caniścitya śubhanakṣatraṃ tatpūrve'ṅkuramācaretśaṅkhadundubhinādaiśca gītanṛttādimaṅgalaiḥmama bhaktajanaissārdhaṃ triśūlena samanvitamcaṇḍeśāstraṃ vinā vāpi kṣetraṃ gatvā vicakṣaṇaḥpūrvādyaṣṭadiśāsvevaṃ gandhapuṣpādi saṃyutamprāṅmukhodaṅmukho bhūtvā śastramantramanusmarantacchūkena samāyuktaṃ navavrīhi samāyutamnālikeraphalopetaṃ navapūgaphalānvitamnānāśākasamāyuktaṃ nānāvyañjanasaṃyutamāścaryakārakairanyaissarvātodya samanvitamnānāchatrasamāyuktaṃ praviśya nagarādikampūrṇakumbhasamāyuktaṃ nānadīpa samanvitamvimocya vrīhiṃ śūkebhyaśśoṣayedātapena vaigomayālepite piṣṭacitrite dīpasaṃyutamtuṣādīna taṇḍulāñśudhdān saṅgrāhya kṣālayettataḥmarīcajīrakopetaṃ gulasārasamanvitamsnapanaṃ kārayeddevaṃ bhūṣayedbhūṣaṇārhakaiḥpaṭaṃ tadūrdhve vinyasya rambhāpatrāṇi vinyasettaṇḍulaṃ tatra nikṣipya gulatoyena secitamdhenvākhyayāmṛtīkṛtya brahmabhiḥ puruṣeṇa vātairmantrairdevadevāya tāmbūlaṃ vinivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvebhyassakalebhyaśca prāguktavidhinā guruḥvṛṣādiparivārebhyo homakarma samāpayetbalidānasamopetamatithīnāṃ samarpaṇamtadante cotsavaṃ kuryāttaṃ vinā vā samācaretsarvamanyatsamānaṃ syāt tadante pūjayedgurumevaṃ yaḥ kurutemartyassa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyātācārya kṛtanityastu kṛtamantrādi tarpaṇaḥsāmānyārghyakaro bhūtvā praviśedyāgamaṇṭapamādau śāntikalā śabdadvārāya nama ityapivāruṇaṃ ca nivṛtyākhyaṃ pratiṣṭhākhyamudāhṛtampaścime tu vṛṣaskandau devīcaṇḍāvudagdiśitoraṇasthān ghaṭasthān vābhittisthānapi pūjayetastreṇa pārṣṇiṃghātasya trayaṃ kṛtvātha bhūgatānchoṭikātrayato vighnāt dhāmnaḥ protsārayedbahiḥastreṇodumbare puṣpaṃ kṣiptvā dhāmnaśca madhyamesaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairastraprākārakalpanātupaviṣṭa udagvaktro bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācaretviśeṣārghyaṃ tataḥ kuryādyavasiddhārthakākṣataiḥtadambhasā tu saṃprokṣya svaśirodravya saṃhitamhṛdābhimantrya pratyekaṃ tilakaṃ candanaṃ nayetjñānāsiṃ tatvasaṃkhyātaiścaturūnairathāpi vākalpayet pañcagavyaṃ tu tadvidhānamihocyatepañcatatvākṛtanyāse pañcapātrāṇi vinyasetsupratiṣṭhaṃ suśāntaṃ ca tejovadabhṛtātmakamgomayaṃ caiva gomūtramīśānādyaistu mantritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amṛtīkṛtya saṃpūjya śivenaikatvamācaretlājacandanasiddhārtha bhasmapuṣpakuśākṣatāḥnaiṛtyāṃ maṇḍapesthitvā saṃskṛtī maṇḍapasya tukuṇḍasyevaṃ purāsyāpi gururaṣṭādaśātratuvedyāṃ vā maṇṭape vāpi īśāne vāpi paścimepūritaṃ pallavopetaṃ svarṇavastrādi saṃyutamsaṃkalpya mūrtimantreṇa mūrtībhūtaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyasetvinyasedastrabhūtāṃtāṃ pratyaṅganālasamanvitāmindramagniṃ yamaṃ caiva niṛtiṃ varuṇaṃ tathāviriñcimīśadakṣasthaṃ viṣṇuṃ niṛtivāmagamtathaiva vajraśaktyādidaśāstrāṇyapi pūjayetsāvadhānena yāgāntaṃ sthātavyaṃ tu śivājñayāśivājñāṃ śrāvayet kubhbhaṃ bhrāmayedagrato'strakamsthirāsanaṃ ca saṃpūjya devamastraṃ ca pūjayetpūjayitvā tayoraikyaṃ kalpayedbhagamudrayābhūtaye kalaśaṃ spṛṣṭvāḥ pūrvamaṅguṣṭhaparvaṇāmuktaye ca puraspṛṣṭvā vardhanīṃ muṣṭhinaiva tuumāyai bhagarūpiṇyai liṅga rūpadharāya cayajñasyāsya patistvaṃ hi mūrtireṣā tavācalāmayā pravartitaścāyaṃ yajvanā bhavatuḥ kratuḥyajñarakṣādhuraṃ tasminnevamāropya deśikaḥnirodhanāya tatpātraṃ tathaiva sthāpayedguruḥapasāritavighnaṃ tu bhāvayed bhūparigrahamviśeṣapūjayopetaṃ pāvake śivamarcayetkartavyo'nugrahasteṣāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanāṃ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantritaṃ mūlamantreṇa saptakṛtvaḥ sitaṃ śubhamsarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣī maṇḍale samupasthitaḥhomādhi karaṇatvena pāvakasthassadāśivaḥanugrahakaro devo mama dehe vyavasthitaḥapṛthagbhūtamātmanāṃ tatsamānaguṇaṃ smaretsvātantryameva saṃbhāvya śivaṃ vijñāpayeditita-ime paśavaśśāntā dvāri tiṣṭhanti vāritāḥbhavadīyakarairjñātvā ciraṃ yuṣmatpracoditaiḥsitavastrottarīyā stvatpādapadmadidṛkṣavaḥpraveśayāmi tānetān bhavatpādāmbujāntikamuktaśśivena saṃbhāvya tataśśiṣyān praveśayetśiṣyaṃ tatraivaṃ saṃsthāpya sthitvā svayamudaṅkukhaḥnakhāgraccūlikāṃ yāvat tatvajñānadṛśā guruḥpatiśaktyā niveśāya pāśavrātaśca madvaśaḥsparśavedhimaṇiprakhyaṃ codito'haṃ ca śambhunākaromi guṇasaṃpannaṃ satāṃ mastakabhūṣaṇamdarbhamūlāgrabhāgābhyāṃ hṛtpradeśādadhordhvayoḥsakalīkṛtya taṃ śiṣyaṃ netrabandhaṃ vidhāya casaṃstutenaiva mūlena sitavastreṇa deśikaḥśivamaṇḍaladakṣasthe maṇḍale pūrvavannayetdhāraṇādyaiśca saṃśodhya sakalīkṛtya tantanumśāsanena sadehena śivena samadhiṣṭhitamhṛddeśādbhrūpradeśāntaṃ nītvā vai cūlikāntakamrudreśvaraspadāvāptidāyakaṃ śirasi nyasettatastasyāñjalau puṣpagandhadhūpādhi vāsitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apanīya dṛgālokācchādanaṃ vasanam kramātyāttamaṅgamuñceti prasūnaṃ śivasaṃmukhamtatpātasūcite sthāne pūrvaṃ śivapadottaramkṣatraviṭchūdrajātīnāṃ strīṇāṃ śaktyanta saṃjñakamsapradakṣiṇamaṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇāmaṃ copadiśyacasaṃsthāpya śiṣyaṃ taddhaste datvā darbhasya mūlakampiṅgalāmadhya dehasthāṃ viniḥsṛtya śiśoḥ svataḥdatvāhutitrayaṃ nāḍīsandhānārthatayā guruḥśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā śivamaṅgāni vai daśaśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā tenaiva śivamantrataḥśūdrādijātimuddhṛtya svāhāntenaiva mūlataḥāhārabhāvadoṣābhyāṃ yoni bījaśarīrataḥrudrāṃśāpādane'pyevamāhutrayamācaretityevaṃ prārthanāṃ kṛtvā kuryātprokṣaṇatāḍanevidhāyāstreṇa viśleṣacchedanaṃ cāṅkuśākhyayāsamānīya dhruveṇaiva saṃpūjya śiśumastakātpraviśya kumbhakenaiva smṛtvā samarasaṃ śiśoḥnītvātmānaṃ samāvartya dvādaśānte tataśśivamdadyādyajñopavītaṃ tu mūlamantrābhimantritamevaṃ samayasaṃskārayukto yaśśivapūjaneyogyassyānmunayo raudraṃ padaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥśūdraṃ hi dīkṣayitvā tu vidhānevāgrajanmanaḥso'pi śudratvamāpnoti dīkṣādānānna saṃśayaḥsthālīṃ tāmramayīṃ vātha mṛṇmayīṃ lakṣaṇānvitāmnirīkṣya prokṣya cābhyukṣya saṃtāḍyālipya gandhataḥ

sanskrit: maṇḍale gomayālipte prokṣite śastravāriṇāṣaḍutthamāsanaṃ ceṣṭvā tāṃ nyasenmūrtirūpiṇīmpuṣpādyamājyenābhyajya vastrapūtaṃ payo nyasetsaṃmṛjya copalipyātha dharmādharmadvayaṃ yajetāsanaṃ praṇavaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ tasyāmadhiropayetcaturthaṃ kalpayeddhīmān śālītaṇḍulakādikamvipacetpūrvavaktrassan madhyapakvaṃ yathā bhavetsvāntayā mantrasaṃhatyā śivahavyavahe purātaptābhighāra evaṃ syāt dvitīye maṇḍale tataḥsuśītale bhavetyevaṃ vauṣaṭpallavayā tathāsaṃmṛjya ca mṛdambhobhyāṃ sthālīṃ surabhimudrayāpūjite hṛdayeneṣṭvā cāṅgairekaikaśaḥ kramātevaṃ saṃpāditenaiva caruṇā homa-iṣyatehaviṣyacaturaṃśena homakarmāthavā matampañcagocara saṃsthāya samastāgamavedineśeṣahīne carorhome sahomaḥ syādaniṣṭadaḥādyāṃśo daivikaḥ prokto dvitīyo homakarmaṇipṛthak caruścennaivedyaṃ sarvamīśe nivedayeteteṣāmanyathābhāve sarvaṃ bhavati cānyathādīkṣāpūrve ca kāmye vā lakṣayet svapnamuttamamlakṣayedātmanaḥ kāle phalabhāktvaṃ dvijottamāḥṣaṇmāsenatu siddhisyāt tṛtīye yāmake yadiśīghrameva phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥpradīptamagnihotrañca pradīpamati bhāsvaramyadi paśyennaraḥ svapne vipulāṃ śriyamāpnuyāt

sanskrit: bhakṣaṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ rājyaṃ saṃprāpnuyānnaraḥsauvarṇānāṃ khagānāṃ ca darśanāllabhate śriyamdarśanātprāpaṇātsvapne vipulāṃ śriyamāpnuyātcūtādi puṇyavṛkṣāṇāṃ saphalanāṃ tu darśanamteṣāṃ ca bhakṣaṇaṃ śastaṃ śailaharmyāśvahastināmsiṃhāsana caturdanti śibikārohaṇaṃ śubhamtaraṇaṃ nimnagāmbhodhi kānanānāṃ jalasya casiṃhīnāṃ hastinīnāṃ ca bāndhavānāṃ svaveśmanipayasaḥ pāṭalāyā goḥ pānaṃ yadvatsalīlayāeteṣāmapi lābhaśca praśasto munipuṅgavāḥeteṣāṃ vīkṣaṇāṃ vāpi snānaṃ vā rudhireṇa yatcandraśrutena vā rājyābhiṣekaśśubhamiṣyateadhyāpanaṃ ca śāstrāṇāmannalepanameva cabahirśīrṣakarhastatvaṃ sitamālyānulepanamśvetābhasya phalasyāpi vyajanasya dhvajasya cadīpasya cāmarasyāpi śastrasyakamalasya carājñaśca darśanaṃ tena bhāṣaṇaṃ śubhadaṃ matamsāgaraṃ sarito vāpi toyayuktā śriyaṃ labhetśaṅkhamābharaṇaṃ śvetavastraṃ puruṣameva cauttamāṃ śriyamāpnoti svapne dṛṣṭvā tu mānavaḥtṛṇaṃ ca vipulaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhamagniyutaṃ tathābhūmyambu vairigrasanaṃ śatrūṇāṃ ca vadhakriyāmkṛtvā tu śriyamāpnoti bhūmau candra niveśanamdṛṣṭvāgniṃ saṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā labdhvā vairājacihnakamtayorullaṅghanaṃ caiva rodanaṃ ca śubhāvaham

sanskrit: nigalairbandhanaṃ dhānyaṃ svadehadahanaṃ tathāsvāgatenorageṇātha siṃhenaivātha bhakṣaṇampātre maṇimaye vātha rājate vātha bhojanamlābhovāhayaśabdasya jaya bhukṣveti śabdayoḥpiṇyāko gośakṛt śastā cocchritaṃ svātmano gṛhamśivāṅkurāṇi bījāni tathā vidyādharāgamamaiśvarya śīghramāpnoti putrāṃśca labhate bahūnputraṃ ca labhate śīghramāyuṣmantaṃ yaśasvinamlabhate kṣipramārogyaṃ dhanaṃ cāsya vivardhatedhanadhānyamavāpnoti sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥvṛddhiṃ tasya vijānīyādāyuścāsya vivardhatesomapānaṃ tathā prāśya labhate vācchitaṃ phalamguruprājñāgamaścāpi śubho vṛścika darśanamtāmbūlamañjanaṃ bilvapatraṃ kuṅkumamaṇḍaleudyānārāmakaraṇaṃ śubhapradamihocyatebandhubhirgharṣaṇaṃ dhanyaṃ kanyāyāḥ patisaṃgrahaḥgaṇānāṃ vibudhānāṃ ca sudhāpānaṃ nabhogatiḥbhūvastralābha paryaṅkaśayyā dāhoṃbarasya canavaśuklāṃbaratvaṃ ca tathā śuddhodanāśanamśaṃkhapadma nidherllābhaḥ śubhasvapnoyamīritaḥaprāptirapahāraśca svapne'niṣṭārthasūcakaḥpiṇḍikāyā mahiṣyāstu dhāmno rāṣṭrasya vibhramaḥhastadhvastaphalaṃ bhasma gulaśākastvaniṣṭadaḥuddantatā vināśaśca malinatvamaśodhanamcūrṇānāṃ mūrdhni kāṃsyānāṃ nagnatā malināmbaraḥ

sanskrit: raktapuṣpadrumāṇāṃ ca caṇḍāla vyādha darśanamnartanaṃ grasanaṃ caiva vivāho gītameva castrotonimajjanaṃ yacca snānaṃ gomayavāriṇācitāyāṃ rohaṇaṃ śakradhvajasya patanaṃ tu vādivyāntarikṣa bhaumānāmutpātānāṃ ca darśanamāliṅganaṃ kumārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca maithunamdakṣiṇāśābhigamanaṃ vyādhinābhi bhavastathāpīḍāpiśāca kravyādaiḥ vānaraiśca narairapikāṣāyavastra dhāritvaṃ tadvatstrīkrīḍanaṃ dvijāḥkrīḍanaṃ ca lihā sphoṭaḥ kṣut pipāsā pariśramaḥrajjucchedaḥ pratāpetu vapanaṃ śmaśru keśayoḥvirūpeṇa nareṇāṅgamardanaṃ cotsave'pivāplavanaṃ bhagnayānatvamaśubhāya bhaviṣyatidravyasya nāśaḥ suhṛdo viyogaḥ śyāmavastratāprāsāda veśma śṛṅgānāmavatārastu neṣyatekārpāsatila mūlādi lohāni labhate ca yaḥbhagna dhvajādhikaṃ bhagnaṃ chatraṃdṛṣṭvā'śubhaṃ labhettathaivahasanaṃ bhuktirodanasya tilaiḥ sahakuñcarasya pṛthivyāśca jvalanaṃ jātavedasāsaṃsthānaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇatvaṃ rathe khara samanvitehīnanṛttasamajaśca nābheranya pradeśakekhareṇa kapinoṣṭreṇa bhogo vyālena raudrakaiḥsnehena gomayenāpi paṅkaiḥkaluṣavāribhiḥvyālasyārohaṇaṃ neṣṭaṃ tadāghrāṇaṃ na saṃmatamsaca duḥkhamavāpnoti paṅkamagrastathaiva ca

sanskrit: antāvasāyibhiryovā kṛṣyate yamadūtakaiḥpuṣpāḍhyaṃ ko vadāraṃ vā yodhyārohatimānavaḥharidrābhojanaṃ cāpi yadbhavetpāṇḍurogiṇaḥbhagnayānā varohaṃśca svapne'lakṣmī prado bhavetpadmaṃ havyaṃ kanyā vā bhaktyākāśato yadidarśanaṃ cāśubhānāṃ vā tairevāliṅganaṃ tu yatpatantīṃ pratimāṃ vāpi dṛṣṭvā vyasanamāpnuyātgṛhaṃ mahattaraṃ kuḍyaṃ pradhānamaraṇaṃ bhavetmlecchaṃ dṛṣṭvāntyajaṃ vāpi kṛṣṇadantaṃ ca durmukhamkṛṣṇāṃ saśūlāṃ svapnānte sadyomaraṇamaśruteaśvamuṣṭraṃ kharaṃ vāpi mahiṣaṃ śvānameva cavṛṣaṃ varāhaṃ mārjāramulūkaṃ kṛṣṇa sarpakameteṣāṃ sparśane vāpi grahaṇe rohaṇe tathāvahniyāna rathādīnāṃ chatrādīnāṃ ca bhagnatādhūmāyamānamātmānaṃ śiromuṇḍanameva cayavāgū māranālaṃ vā pipeddhana vināśanammudgaṃ māṣaṃ marīcaṃ ca sarṣapaṃ paśyato'śubhamvartitailatilādīnāmañjanālepanaṃ tathāsaṃnyāsi pretakaiḥ sārdhaṃ kuṇḍakādiṣu veśanamraktavarṇaṃ tu yaddravyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā na praśasyateanyatra śoṇitān padmāt palāśādrakta candanātpaśyetpāṣaṇḍino vāpi naśubhaṃ tasya jāyatebhūtānāṃ rodanaṃ neṣṭaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ patanaṃ kṣaṇātyadvadanti naraṃ svapne tattathaiva bhaviṣyatiliṃgaṃ svapnovidhitasya na kvaciddhātu doṣajaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadvikāraṃ nanu svapne pratyakṣāniva paśyatitaccintā santatiḥ svapne pratyakṣevāvabhāsatedṛṣṭākṣadūra vijñeya vyabhicāri prakāśavatpraṇidhānavinirmukta statsatyaṃ nāviśeṣataḥdvijāti prakrameṇaiva vayasā vā dhanenavāśreṣṭhatvaṃ vidyate viprāḥ sarvādau nivedayetācāryānujñayā vātha jyeṣṭhatvaṃ teṣu kīrtitamnirvāṇa dīkṣayā yuktaḥ śūdro dvāvekabhāginauādau samānadīkṣāyāṃ satyāmapi ca yatra tujātyādi sāmye saṃskāra sāmye satyapi yatra tuparaspara namaskāre'pyevameva kramomataḥna saṃmānyo namaskāra pramukhaiḥ kāraṇādguroḥkimatra bahunoktena yaduktaṃ deśikena tutadeva sarvadā kāryaṃ śiṣyaiḥ śroyobhikāṃkṣibhiḥācāryaḥ kṛtanityastu kṛtamantrādi tarpaṇaḥsāmānyārghyakaro dvāra dvārapārcana saṃyutaḥkṛta brahmārcanaḥ (śuddhaḥ) kṣetre rakṣāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥkṛtvā jñānākhya khṛḍgaṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ vidhāya canikṣipya vikirāṃstāṃśca kuśairīśe samāharetlokapālānathābhyarcya teṣāṃ ājñāṃ tu śrāvayetmaṇḍale deva deveśaṃ iṣṭvā'gnau tarpayenmanūnanugrahastvayā kāryaḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanāmsarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣī maṇḍalasthaḥ sadāśivaḥśiṣyetu pāśanāśāya maddehe pāśamocakaḥmantrāḥ kāraṇabhūtā ye śivasya hṛdayādayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃbhāvyādhyeṣayeddevaṃ prāṇairantarbahisthitaiḥutkṛṣṭa jātirīśāṃśaḥ samayeṣu vyavasthitaḥpūrṇasaṃkalpitārthaḥ san śivaśāstropabṛṃhitaḥātmanaḥ savyabhāge tu kṛtvā śiṣyasya veśanamkṛtvā śivādimantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ samyagocaretkuṭilabhrū samāyuktaṃ sarālavadanānvitamkanyā vinirmitaṃ sūtraṃ triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtamsaṃpūjya cordhvakāyasya śikhāyāṃ bandhayetśiśoḥsūtraṃ suṣumnārūpaṃ tu dhyātvāśiṣyasya dehataḥsaṃpūjyagaṃdha puṣpādyaiḥ varmaṇācāva kuṇṭhayetśiṣyasya hṛtpradeśaṃ tu saṃprokṣyāstreṇa puṣpataḥhuṃkāraṃ uccaraṃstasya caitanyaṃ tārakākṛtimdvādaśānte nyaset śiṣya jīvaṃ hṛdaya saṃpuṭamsūtre niyojayet varma mantreṇaiva avakuṇṭhayetmalaṃ ca karmamāyeyaṃ bhoktṛ bholaśarīrajamśāntyatītāṃ caturthyantāṃ huphaṭkārāṃ śivādikāmsaṃhāramudrayākṛṣya śivaṃ praṇava pūrvakamuccārya yojayetsūtre bhrūmadhyāntopalakṣitekalācatuṣṭaye kuryāttāḍanagrahayojanamvyāpyavyāpakabhāvaṃ tu kuryāttatravicakṣaṇaḥvyāpyāni vyāpakāḥ karmamalamāyeyabandhanāḥtāsāṃca saṃgrahe tasmāt sarvesyuḥ svīkṛtāstvihaśuddhā bhavanti sarvesyustasmāttacchuddhiriṣyateaghorabījaṃ mūlaṃ ca śāntyatītakalāmapityaktvānyāsāṃ ca mūlaṃ tu svasvabījaṃ smaran nayet

sanskrit: śiraḥ saṃtāḍyacāstreṇa śivamantraṃ tridhāsmaranvyāpakaṃ śānti tatvādeḥ pāśaṃ bandha padadvayamśivaṃ saṃpuṭitaṃ svasvabījaṃ ca bhagavat padambandha bandha padaṃcoktvā huṃphaṣanta samanvitamtatsūtraṃ ca samādāya śarāvayuga saṃpuṭamnivedya tasya rakṣārthaṃ śivakuṃbhāntikaṃ nyasetācāryaḥ śiṣyasahito niḥsṛtya makhamaṇḍapātśucau sāvaraṇe deśe vivikte lepite bhuvaḥbhūtaye pūrvavaktrebhyaḥ saumyāsyebhyaḥ vimuktayeantarjānūpaviṣṭebhyaḥ sakuśe dakṣiṇekareculukaṃ pañcagavyasya dadyādekaṃ hṛdānvitamculukaṃ cāparaṃ cāpi datvā dadyāttataścarummumukṣubhyo bhubhukṣubhyaḥ kṛte pippala patrakaiḥśucibhyo dantakāṣṭhaiśca kṣīra vṛkṣasamudbhavammaṅgalārkāṅgulānmuktibhukti liṅgaprakāśakamāmuktaṃ nipatedyatra tena vidyācchubhāśubhammukhapāto'sya śeṣāsu śobhanaḥ karmaṇāṃ vaśātsvapnādhigamanenaiva sarakṣān svāpayenniśipūrvayāmyottamāṅgāsu śayyāsu kuśabhasmanācaturdaṇḍikayāstreṇa guptāsu vitamassu cahadāropya śikhābaddhaśikhān varmābhimantritaiḥastrābhimantritaististro rekhāḥ saṃkalpya bāhyataḥdatvā bāhyabaliṃ dikṣu dikpatibhyo yathākramātviṣamārciṣamādīpya hutvā caikaikataḥ śatamprakṣālitāṅghrihastastu svācāntaḥ snānamambhasā

sanskrit: śivīkṛtatanurdhyātvā samastādhvatanuṃ śivampūrvavatprayato bhūtvā śuddhaḥ svayamapi svapetśiṣyān pṛṣṭvā niśāssvapnān duḥsvapne śāntimācaretśubhe pūrvavacchiṣyapraveśādikamācaretavalmbya ca tatsūtraṃ śiṣyadehe'dhivāsitamlabdhānujño nyasedagnau śaktimādhāra rūpiṇīmpṛthivī tatvaṃ kṣakāraśca mantrau hṛdayasadyakauraudraṃ ca bhuvanānyantarbrahmāṇḍasyasthitāni ṣaṭvibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥjvalano dahano babhruḥ bhasmāntakaḥ kṣayāntakaḥsaṃyoktā ca viyoktā ca dharmo dharmapatistathāūrdhvakeśo virūpākṣo dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭriṇaḥśveto'tha jayabhadraśca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥśīghro laghurvāyuvegastīkṣṇaḥ sūkṣma kṣyāntakaḥnidhīśo rūpavān dhanyaḥ saumyadeho jaṭādharaḥvidyādhipeśau sarvajño jñānabhugvedapāragaḥvṛṣo vṛṣadharo'nantaḥ krodhano mārutāśanaḥśaṃbhurvibhurgaṇādhyakṣastriyakṣastridaśeśvaraḥvīrabhadro bhadrakālī sarvordhve bhuvanadvayamyāmyādyā dakṣiṇe bhāge niṛtyādyāśca naiṛteuttare tu nidhīśādyā īśe vidyādhipādayaḥbhuvanānāṃ śataṃ cāṣṭādhikamevaṃ tu vinyasetnamodvayaṃ praṇavaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramataḥ paramśabdadvayaṃ tathā jñānadvayaṃ piṅgadvayaṃ tathāsākṣiyugmapadaṃ paścātpūrvasthitamataḥ param
