sanskrit: brahmaviṣṇurudrapara sarvasannidhyakārakaḥbhavayugmaṃ tathā śarvayugmaṃ ca prathamadvayammahātejaḥ padaṃ sadbhāveśvaraṃ ceti kīrtitamnivṛttyā vyāptamadhvānaṃ tattvādyaṃ kalayā smaretityuccārya nivṛttiṃ tu sūtrātsaṃgrāhya pāvalemalaḥ karma ca māyākhyaṃ bhoktṛbhogaśarīrajamtadvyāpikāṃ ca vāgīśīṃ samāvāhya prapūjayethutvāhutitrayaṃ paścātsvāhāntenaiva mantrataḥprārthaivaṃ śiṣyamastreṇa saṃprokṣya hṛdi tāḍayetsvātmano recakenaiva tasya dehe praviśya caākṛṣya mūlamantreṇa cāhutitrayamācaretsāntabījaṃ samuccārya śiśuṃ saṃhāramudrayākṛtvā mūlaṃ smaran svasya dvādaśānte niyojya casarvāsu yoniṣu śiśoḥ saṃyogaṃ yugapannayetbhagavan deva deveśa śiśossarvāsu yoniṣuniṣpatyai sarvagarbhāṇāṃ dadyānmūlahutitrayamsarvāsu yoniṣu kurukurvityevannayedvijāḥbhagavan sarvagarbhāṇāṃ jananaṃ kuru kurvaṇoḥmūlahutitrayaṃ datvā śivaṃprativadedidamkarmārjanāya mūlena āhutitrayamācaretkarmārjanaṃ paṭhitvaivaṃ viśeṣo lokadharmiṇideśataḥ kālataścaiva dehena viṣayeṇa cabhoktṛtva liṃgitepuṃsi sukhaduḥkhātmavedanambhagavan bhoganiṣpattiṃ sarvatra kuru kurvaṇoḥśivāhuti trayaṃ datvā paramaprīti rūpakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jātyāyurbhogasaṃskāraśuddhyarthaṃ niṣkṛtāvaṇoḥsarvakarmasu śuddhiṃca niṣkṛtyā kuru kurvaṇoḥbahirniṣkāmarūpantu māyāpāśāt smarannayetmalakāryaṃca bhoktṛtvaṃsmṛtvā śuddhyarthamāhutīḥmalaviśleṣa evaṃsyāt karma viśleṣa ucyatesmṛtvāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt mūlamantraṃ samuccaranviśleṣaṃ kuru kurvatra tebhyo nirvāṇasaṃskṛtauastrāhutitrayaṃ datvā śuddhyai tasya ca mūlataḥbhagavan kuru kūrvatreti ājñāṃ prārthyaiva mācaretsaṃbhāvya vauṣaḍantena dadyāt pūrṇāṃ śivāṇunāśabdasparśau gṛhaṇātra brahman svāheti mantrataḥkāraṇeśatvayānāsya dhātuḥ padamanāmayambrahmāṇaṃ saṃvisṛjyātha śuddhatatvāgra saṃsthitamdhyātvāhutitrayaṃ dadyānmūlamantraṃ samuccarankurukurvīti saṃhāramudrayā pūrakena tuāhutīnāṃ trayaṃ dadyācchiśoḥ sthityai śivāṇunāāhutīnāṃ trayeṇāgneḥ kāryamasyā visarjanamtrayoviṃśatitatvāni cāpastejomarudviyatpādau pāṇī ca vāṅnāsā jihvā cakṣustvacaśśrutiḥtatvāni kathitānyevaṃ lādiṭāntāḥ dvijottamāḥaghora iti mantrāssyuṣṣaṭpañcāśat purāṇi tuḍiṇḍimuṇḍistathā bhārabhūtiśca lakulīśvaraḥmadhyameśo mahākālaḥ kedāro bhairavastathāvimaleśo'ṭṭahāsaśca mahendro bhīmasaṃjñakaḥgokarṇobhadrakarṇaśca svarṇākṣaḥ sthāṇurityapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālañcaraḥ śaṅkukarṇaḥ sthūleśvaraḥ sthaleśvaraḥsaumyaṃ caiva tāthājñeyaṃ prājeśaṃ brāhmameva cakaumāramaumaṃ śraikaṇṭhamaṣṭa saptabhavantihigayādi vāyu tatve ca vyomni vastrāpadādi caprakṛtāvakṛtādyevaṃ ṣaṭpañcāśat purāṇāni tumaheśvara padaṃ cādyaṃ paramātmā dvitīyakamnidhanodbhavasaṃjñaṃ ca nidhanākhya padaṃ tataḥoṃbhuvaścapadaṃ cānyadoṃbhūḥ padamataḥ paramanāde tupadaṃ cānyadabhasmeti padaṃ tataḥarūpapadamanyacca jyātirjyotistathaiva caarūpin padayugmaṃca padānyekaṃ ca viṃśatiḥityukta saṃkhyata tvārṇaṃpadamantraistriviṣṭapaiḥśuddhaṃ pāśaṃ laghuṃ smṛtvā śodhyaṃ ca gurumetayoḥsarvasandhānayogāya copadiṣṭaśśivadvijāḥnamaskārāntamiṣṭvānte dadyānmūlāhutitrayamniṣkṛtiṃ śirasādadyācchata homena deśikaḥkalayā vidyayā vyāptaḥ puruṣaścādimo bhavetñakārādidhakārāntā varṇāssapta vilomataḥvāmo bhīmastathograśca bhaveśānaikavīrakāḥkrodheśaścavai saṃvarto jyotiḥ piṅgaścādimo bhavetvāmadevo bhavaścaivodbhavaścāpyekapiṅgalaḥṣaṭkaṃ ca pañcakaṃ caivaṃ yugmaṃ yugmaṃ dvayaṃ dvayampadāni viṃśatirvyāpin vyāpinniti padaṃ bhavetparameśvara parāyeti padaṃ caiva punarbhavetpadaṃ cānidhanāyeti padaṃ goptre prakīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padaṃ brahmāṇi pañcātra sadyādīni krameṇa tuśivāyeti padaṃ paścād oṃ padamantataḥsaṃdhānaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā vidyāmagnau niveśayetrūpagandhau hṛhāṇeti rudre śuklaṃ samarpayetbhavottīrṇamathātmānamātmatatvopari sthitambubhojayiṣurācāryo bhogaṃ śuddhākṣasādhanamvilokya manasā śānti tasyāmantargatāni cavarṇāstu gakhakāḥ proktā mantrau vaktratanucchadaubalavikaraṇī caiva balapramathanītyapipurāṇi nava vidyāyāmanantassūkṣmasaṃjñakaḥśrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍī cetyevamīśe purāṣṭakamekādaśapadānyāsannityaṃyogina ityapidhruvāyetipadaṃ caivānāśritāyapadaṃ tataḥśivāyetipadaṃ sarvavyāpine ca padaṃ tataḥniṣkṛtau śatahomaṃ tu kavacena samācaretīśvaraḥ kāraṇeśassyāt prāgvatsarvamataḥ parambījaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ mantrāścāstreśānaśivāstrayaḥnivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntiśca nābhasīindhikā dīpikā caiva rocikā mocikā tathāvyāpinī vyomarūpā cāpyanantā ca tataḥparambhuvanāni tu śāktāni pañcaiva kathitāni cahyauṃ hauṃ caturthyantaṃ kalādvayamudāharankalopasthāpanādyaṃ tu sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaretastraṃ tyaktvā tu dīpena pāśacchedāya homayetsamayaṃ samayācāraṃ śakto pāśātmake nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śiṣyasya kuru kurvatretyuktvā śuklaṃ samarpayetmano hṛhāṇa svāheti cāhutitrayamācaretrecakenātmasaṃsthaṃ tu śiṣyadehe niveśayetsaṃtarpya pāvakasthāṃ tu tato vijñāpayeditiśāntyatītāṃ kalāṃ śaktitattve līnāṃ vicintya caātmatattvaṃ caturthyantamādau mūlasamanvitamvidhivaikalyaśuddhyarthaṃ svāhāntaṃ śivamantrataḥsadeśāntamupasthāpya hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatamśivatattvamupasthāpya śaktyantaṃ mānasaṃ smaretmucyate śivamantreṇa śikhācchedamathārabhetdhyātvā śikhāṃ tadagrasthaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhamchindhācchikhāṃ tu śikhayā tatassaṃsnāpayecchivamsrugagrasthāṃ śikhāṃ pūrṇāṃ hutvāhutyā ca pāvakeprakṣālyācamya śuddhastu śivamiṣṭvā vadedidamyāvatvayaṃ paraṃ dhāma bhagavan parameśvaraevaṃ kurvityanujñātaḥ prakṛṣṭo'rghyakaro guruḥśiṣyasya prokṣaṇaṃ caiva sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥsakalīkṛtamantrāṇāmekaikāhutidānataḥvidyātattvāspadācāryo bindukḷptāsanasthitaḥtathordhvagāminī ceti sūkṣmā sukṣmāmṛtā matāābhiḥ kalābhissaṃkḷptadehayugdeśikottamaḥanāthānāśritā ceti bahiḥ karaṇasaṃyutaḥātmatattvonmanāśśarve samāpūritadehayukīṣaddhayāvṛttavaktraḥ sa dantairdantānna saṃspṛśannāḍīṃ suṣumnāṃ prāṇākhyavāyunaikīkṛtāṃ smaran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃbhāvya mantramuccārya kāraṇatyāgayogataḥvyāvartitamanaḥ prāṇadānaśaktikalātmanaḥśuddhamudyacchikhākalpaṃ vahnerādāya pudgalamtatra yukto'pyasau tena na samānaguṇīkṛtaḥsāmrājyādhigame'pyuccairnṛpasūnoḥ kṛtārthatāsvaguṇavyaktaye tena sruveṇājyāhutīstu ṣaṭsarvajño nityasaṃbodhaḥ svatantrastṛptimān bhavaātmanniti padopetaṃ svāhāntaṃ dīpasaṃyutamcatvāro brāhmaṇādyāścāpyanulomāśca ye matāḥjāmātṛpitṛpatnyādyāḥ yogyāssyurmokṣakāṃkṣiṇaḥantyajānāṃ na hotrī syāt kiṃ tu teṣāṃ tu cākṣuṣīāryāvartodbhavaḥ śrīmān sarvalakṣaṇa lakṣitaḥsanti devāḥ tathā vedāḥ āryāvarta itismṛtaḥkakārāṣṭaka nirmuktaḥ prasaṃṅgāt so'pi kathyatekoṅkaṇaḥ karahāṭaśca kukkuṭaḥ kāṅka īritaḥviprādayaścaturvarṇāḥ api yogyāḥ sva karmaṇisnapane prokṣaṇe'nyatra prāyaścitte'bhiṣecanesarva devārcane viprāstvādi śaivo gurūttamaḥbrāhmaṇakṣatriyādīnāṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūdra vaiśyayoḥsvārtheṣṭau cala liṃgasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ trayasvimebāṇaliṃgekṣaṇevāpi sthāpako yadi naiṣṭhikaḥtathaiva pāravettāraṃ devalaṃ ca punarbhavatkhaṭvāṅgiśyāmadantau cāpyārūḍhaṃ patitaṃ tu vāasacchastrakṛtaṃ klībaṃ vyādhitaṃ kunakhaṃ tathācitrakaṃ gāyakaṃ caiva nartakaṃ ca vivarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parāpavāda śīlaṃ ca tathā bahukiṇairvṛtambaiddhādi śāstranirataṃ sanyāsaṃ vratinaṃ tathāśuklakarmarataṃ caiva nyāye vaiśeṣikepi cabauddhe lokāyate śāstre mīmāṃsāṃ viśaṣataḥsomasiddhāntake vāpi pūrvāmnāye tu paścimesiddhaprameya jāle ca kṛtāśaṃ ca nirantaramkāmaśāstrakṛtābhyāsaṃ padavyutkrāntakaṃ naraṃtat siddha puruṣārtheṣu kṛtayatnaṃ parityajetsamaṃ yo manyate mohāttaṃ prayatnena varjayetcaryāyāṃ va sva saṃsiddha prameya śivabhāṣiteyodhyatra kurute nyāsaṃ durmatiṃ ca vivarjayetalpavidyāmarṣakau ca virūpaṃ ca vivarjayetsamāna gotra saṃbandhaṃ kusumākṣaṃ ca varjayetabhiṣekaṃ tataḥkuryāt aṃkurārpaṇa pūrvakammaṇḍape saumya vaktre tu vitānenopaśobhitamcaturhasta pravistāraṃ dakṣiṇottara diggatambhuvaḥ parigrahaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapegnau śivaṃ yajetbahirantarbaliṃ datvā vidhāna mida mācaretsiddhārthadadhi toyaiśca nirmṛjya tadanantaramghaṭānvā kalaśānvātha sakūrcān sāpidhānakamcūtāśvattha palāśāsyān bījāpūraphalāvahānpañcapakṣe nivṛtyādi kalābhistvabhi mantrayetathavā kalaśānekaghaṭaṃ vā śiva saṃyutambhadra pīṭhe śivenaiva sāṅgenādhiṣṭitaṃ yathāvarṇabhakta śarāvaistu nirmajya vā jalena vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pari vartita sūtrādyaṃ sottarīyaṃ samālakamānīyaṃ dakṣavedistho bhadrapīṭhe niveśayetārātrikaṃ jvaladdīpaissadvartyā pratibodhitaiḥkaraṇīṃ kartarīṃ tadvat dhaṭikāṃ sruk sruvaupunaḥpādukāṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ hastinaṃ śibikādikamājñāṃ ca śraddhayā yāvadadya prabhṛti deśikaḥtathaivaṃ deva devāya deśikāya mayākṛtamvijñāpayet tataḥ kuṇḍa sannidhiṃ prāpya deśikaḥsva sva mantraiḥ tataḥ pūrṇāṃ kṛtvā taddakṣiṇe kareharahastaṃ ca saṃkalpya svādhikāraṃ samarpayetśivāsanāṅgamantraiśca pūjyadevasya nāmabhiḥtenaiva pūrṇāṃ datvānte bhagavantaṃ kṣamāpayetkiṃtu sadhyānunā labdhai rghaṭairasyābhiṣecanamsāmānya samayī yastu sa tu māheśvarassmṛtaḥtadyuktastu viśeṣasyāt cākṣuṣyādyāstu yāḥ smṛtāḥna tu liṃgārcane yogyāḥ kimu dīkṣādi karmaṇiśivadvija kulotthāye te ca māheśvarā janāḥmadarcanārthaṃ teṣāṃ ca dīkṣā śuddhyarthamiṣyatebahudhā dīkṣitoyastu śīghraṃ śivamavāpnuyātnaiṣṭiko naiṣṭikeṣu syāt bhuktau muktau kramādyataḥsarvānugrāhakaḥ proktaḥ sāntānika gurussadāyoṣit yuktassa keśaśca jaṭārudrākṣa daṇḍayuksa gṛhastha iti proktaḥ muṇḍivā syājjaṭādiyukvratī vratā'sa martho yo vidhinā vratamarpayansṛṣṭyānantara kāle ye dīkṣitāḥ kauśikādayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādiśaivāstu te jñeyāḥ sarvānugrahakāmatāḥpakṣatraya madhaśśāyī naktāśī carubhuk sadāsamūrtikaṃ śivaṃ sāṅgamabhyasecchaktito guruḥācāryassādhakaścānyaḥ putrakaḥ samayīyataḥpratyahaṃ samanuṣṭheyaṃ tannityamiha kīrtyateprayāścitte svanityotthe tasyossyādadhikāritāyadi sāntānikau tau hi so'sau naimittikepi caācāryādhikṛte kṛtye sarvasmin sthāpanādikesthāpanādyaṅga bhūteṣu maṅgalāṅkurakādiṣuācārya sarva yogyasyādyadi sāntāniko bhavetmahā śaivādayo yogyā dīkṣitā nityakarmaṇilakṣādhyāyī guruśreṣṭhaḥ bhukti mukti phalapradaḥsaṃhitā pārago vātha lakṣādhyāyyupadeśataḥśaivaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ tathācaturvaktrānmaheśācca puruṣādyānanodbhavampratyekaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ vāmadakṣiṇa bhedataḥtatrāpi śaivasiddhāntaḥ sarvebhyo hyuttamottamaḥadhyātmaṃ yattato nīcaṃ tasmādvaidikameva cavaktāro laukikādīnāṃ teṣāṃ bheda ihocyatetena vai laukikaṃ śāstraṃ martyaloke'vatāritamkauṭilyaṃ bhārataṃ jyotiśśāstraṃ vātsyāyanādikamlokāyataṃ tathā sāṃkhya mārhato matameva cavāma mantrodbhavo viṣṇuḥ kāraṇeśo dvitīyakaḥdharmaśāstraṃ ca vedāntaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca bauddhakamnyāya vaiśeṣikaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ seśvaraṃ yat praṇītavān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcārthaṃ lākulaṃ tānyat tathā pāśupataṃ matamṛkyajussāmātharvāśca puruṣādyānanodbhavāḥdakṣiṇāt kaulakaṃ śreṣṭaṃ mahākaulaṃ tataḥ paramsiddhāntāt paramaṃ jñānaṃ neti śāstrasya niścayaḥsiddhānto vedasāraḥ syādanyadveda bahiṣkṛtamgarbhā dhānādikaṃ karma yāvacchrāddhāvasānakamtasyāpi dīkṣā kartavyā jātakarmādikā kriyādīkṣā yuktena soḍhā vai tadgarbhādhāna meva catatputrasyāpi kartavyā jātakarmādikā kriyāḥvaidikyādau tadante vā kartavyā lokasaṃvṛtauvaidikyena kriyākāryā bhartā yadyapi dīkṣitāḥhitvā suvarṇaṃ daivajñaṃ tathā syād vaidikī kriyāḥśrutismṛtyādi saṃsiddha manuṣṭānaṃ tu yadbhavetsandhyāyā vandane vāpi tarpaṇe homakarmaṇiaṣṭakā karaṇe vāpi nityanaimittikepi vāvedādhyayanakādau vā dvijānāṃ vihitaṃ tu yatkartavyaṃ tvapyaniṣṭeyaṃ śaivakarma virodhiyatsaṃgrāhyaṃ vaidikaṃ sarvaṃ śaiva vākyā'virodhataḥvaidikānna bahirbhūtaṃ śaivaṃ śaivāttadapyathasiddhāntaṃ kāmikādisyāt nāsmāt paramanuttamamtadāpi vaidikaṃ vedasāra mityādi vākyataḥsarveṣāṃ kāmikādīnāṃ śivadehatvamiṣyatekāmikādvātulāntena vātulāt kāmikāntakaḥaghora makuṭaṃ cintyaṃ vāmagaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavetsūkṣmaṃ tu puruṣāsyaṃ syāt sahastraṃdakṣiṇānanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vijayaṃ karṇa ityukto niśvāsaṃ galamucyatevīraṃ kaṭi pradeśasyāt rauravaṃ gudamucyatecandrajñānaṃ tadagraṃ syāt dakṣasthaṃ biṃbamanyataḥjaṅghā siddhamiti proktaṃ saṃtānaṃ vāmagaṃ bhavetkiraṇaṃ tala mityuktaṃ vātulaṃ vāmakaṃ talampūrvaṃ tantravatāre tu kāmikaṃ pādayugmakambahudhā kathitaṃ viprāḥ bhavadbhiravadhāritamtadā pādau ca hastāśca kiṃ tu dhyātu vibhedataḥbhoga mokṣa prasiddhyarthaṃ jñānadeho mamāgrajāḥparaspara virodhīti matihīnaiḥ prabādhyatena pumbhirārṣakaṃ vākyaṃ daivika mṛṣibhistathāna śaivaṃ viṣṇunā vākyaṃ bādhyate na kadācanakāmikādyajitāntāśca īśa vaktrasamudbhavāḥvijayādvīratantrāntāḥ pañcaite'ghoravaktrakāḥprodgītādyaṣṭa tantraṃ ca sadyavaktrasamudbhavamaṣṭāviṃśati tantraṃ ta sopabhedaṃ ca vettiyaḥanyena guruṇārabdhe tasya syādadhikāritāhīnā rabdhe viśiṣṭasyādhikāra karmaṇīritaḥviśiṣṭe vidyamāne ca haṭhādajñena kāritetena rājño baveddoṣo rāṣṭra syāpi bhayaṃ bhavetlokaprakhyāta vidyāya gurave dattamaṇvapitato hi rājño vijñeyaṃ taddānaṃ cottamottamamnarādhamassa vijñeyaḥ sarvaloka bahiṣkṛtaḥsuvāre sudine pakṣe sumuhūrte viśeṣataḥsacchiṣyāṇāṃ sadācāryo bodhaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuddhadeśe sukhāsīnaḥ pañcagocarasaṃbhavaḥsadgurūṇāṃ sukhāvāse vasejjñānamanusmarangandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya yogapīṭhasya madhyameṣoḍaśenopacāraṇābhyarcayedgurupādayoḥśarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃ ca sadgurubhyo nivedayetsacchiṣye tu viśeṣeṇa bodhaṃ kuryātsadeśikaḥarcitaṃ tu śiromadhye pādaṃ kāruṇya deśikaḥprathamaṃ tattvarūpaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ tattvadarśanampañcamaṃ cātmasandarśaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ syādātmaśodhamannavamaṃ śivayogaṃ ca daśamaṃ śivabhogakamgurorvacanamātreṇa jīvanmuktiprakāśakamityarthaṃ daśakaṃ jñānamārgeṇāsya vidhīyategotrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi āyutānyarbudāni cakauśikaḥ kāśyapaścaiva bhāradvājo'tha gautamaḥaṅgirāśca manuścānyo dvi vidhāste prakīrtitāḥśivasṛṣṭyanvitā ye te pañcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥgotraṃ ca dīkṣayā naiṣāṃ kiṃ tveṣāṃ tu svajātikamnaiva śūdrasya gotraṃ syādevaṃ gotravidhau matamkiṃ tu dīkṣāvihīnaṃ tu śivasṛṣṭivivarjitamubhayaṃ paripālyaṃ vā kalau neṣṭaṃ tu vā dvijāḥkauśikā lihitā raudrā viśvāmitrāḥ katāstathāaghamarṣaṇapūrvāśca kauśikā indra pūrvagāḥlokākṣayo bharadvājāstato raukṣāyaṇā matāḥtato dīrghatamā jñeyāḥ tataḥ kāreṇa pālayaḥmudgalāśca vasiṣṭāśca kuṇḍinā upamanyavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: somavāhanasaṃjñāśca yajñavāhāstato matāḥvainyāśca śunakā viṣṇuvṛddhā kaṇvāstataḥ parammudbhavākkathitāḥ proktā ūnapañcāśadeva hipārakyā audalirmāṇirālarvirbṛhadagnagaḥkāntakā bāṣpakā vācyukitā lomakā dhanāḥyama dūtā ānabhinnā tatastārāyaṇā matāḥdaṇḍā bhuvanayo yājñabalkyaḥ sauśratayastathāśālāvatāṃ mayūrāśca tathodutsarityapitato manuvataścaiva māntavāḥ parikīrtitāḥsyādrālavā unmanaya iti ravyātāstu kauśikāḥdevarāto dadhīcīti pravare ṛṣayastrayaḥjakṣyayaḥ prājñako vājijaya ityapi lohitāḥviśvāmitraḥ sṭaiṣakayo lohitāśca trayastvamīmāṇā udvahalā ete rokṣāstu kuśikā matāḥmāṇiścaiva trayastvete munayo munipuṅgavāḥśraumito devatarasaḥ kāmakāyanikastataḥtrayārṣeyāḥ samuddiṣṭā viśvāmitrastadādimaḥkaṭhāḥ svairandhrisaṃjñāścakarabhāḥ sahitāḥ parekaukṛtyāḥ śaiśirāścaiva tataścodumbarāyaṇaḥete kaṭhāḥ samākhyātāstriyārṣeyāḥ samīritāḥāśvavītāḥ kāriṣayo mayūrāḥ saindhavāyanāḥtriyārṣeyāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ pravare tu munīśvarāḥājāyanastataḥ prokta ekavatsaśca saṃmataḥsyānmadhuścātha sojaśca pravaryā ṛṣayastrayaḥete ca triyerṣeyāḥsyuḥ viśvāmitro'ghamarṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kauśikāścendrapūrvāśca tataḥ proktā munīśvarāḥṛṣayastraya ākhyātāḥ pravaryā yāgakarmaṇiṛṣī dvau saṃmatau viśvāmitraḥ pauraṇaḥ ityapikāśyapānatha vakṣye'haṃ kāśyapaste cādimaḥābhūtyāścaiva vaiśiprā dhūmā dhūmrāyaṇā matāḥrudrāgnayaśca pravarāstathā paimbakayo'parekādrāyaṇā aujvalayo rohitāyanasaṃjñakāḥvaikarṇeyāstataḥ proktā dhūmalakṣmaṇayaḥ surāḥkāmijaṅghodarā gaurīvāyanā daukṣakāyanāḥpaiṭhinasāśca bāndhreprāstato mālandanāmakāḥharitā gākhamitreyā pañcāvāścaiva svairikāḥvaiśampāyanasaṃjñākṣa tataḥ keśāyatāḥ smṛtāḥdevaśca hotasūcyāsthūṇā bhāgurayastathāhiraṇyapāpāḥ musalā āviśreṇyastataḥ paramuttarato gaṇyamānā mantravaikarṇayaḥ paraḥkāśyapaścāpavatsāro nidhavā ṛṣayastrayaḥkāśyapaścapavatsāro rephakṣa munayastrayaḥrabheravyayasaumānau vanasaṃstu kareyutaḥmahākāyo jāṇavaṃśāḥ kauśreyaḥ kārdamāyanaḥtato mauñjāyanāḥ proktāstato gāṃgāyanā matāḥvedāyanāstato jñeyāstato vāśyāyanā matāḥhiraṇyabāhustedehā gomūtrāśca tato matāḥjālandhaririti proktastriyārṣeyāstu śaṇḍilāḥkāśyapakṣāpavatsāro'sitaṃ ityathavā trayaḥkokākṣayo maitravādirveho dārbhāyaṇastataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalayaścāpi kāpuṣṭirlaugākṣaya iti smṛtāḥkaunāmisautayaścoktāḥsyuḥ parastāvirodakīyauthakālakikāleyāḥ syurlokākṣaya ityapiaharvasiṣṭhā naktaṃ tu kāśyapāstriyārṣeyakāḥpūrvoktaiḥ kāśyapaiḥ siddhairvasiṣṭhasya ca saṃmatāḥdevāśvā udvahavyāśca tataḥ prāgvāśayo matāḥājā aumāśca taudehāḥ pariṇaddhedhasaṃjñakāḥvayokṣibhedā aupaśayā agniveśyāḥ śaṭhā apiṛkṣāśca māṇabhidyāśca kāmbodakasusaṃjñakāḥbhāruṇḍeyā iṣumatāstathā vaudodameghayaḥtataḥ syurdevamatayaḥ kalmāṣāśca sadopakṛtvārāhayoḥ devavelā valabhīgaya ityapinṛtyāyanā mahāvelāstataḥ śālālayo matāḥkrodhāyanāstu kauṭilyāḥ saiṃhyakendrāstataḥ paramsomāgnivāyusūryendrayamaviṣṇavāpapūrvakāḥtataḥ kaumudagandhiśca śaktiḥ syātkautukāyanāḥdhūmrāḥ kaukṣeyakā nitutayo dābhaya ityapikāblyāḥ kārupathayaḥ kāriṣāyaṇasaṃjñakāḥbhāradvājā ime sarve triyārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥeko raukṣāyaṇaḥ pañcārṣeyastu prakīrtitāḥsyād māta vacaso vandano'tha gargāḥ samīritāḥsakhīnā bāhulakayo bhraṣṭayo bhraṣṭubindavaḥbhājitākṣaya ityuktā gotrāpacaya ityapipalāśaśākhāvantaste markaṭāyanasaṃjñakāḥtristro tasā śca kāravalyā rājayaḥ pailayastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅgirāśca bharadvājo bārhaspatyāścaśainyakāḥṛṣayastraya ākhyātāḥ pravaryāśca tripakṣakegautamānatha vakṣye'hamāyāsyāstauḍinistataḥsātyakāyaśca taidehāḥ kaumārāḥ sātyamugrikāḥkaṭhoriḥ kāruṇiḥ kīlālayaḥ pārthivasaṃjñakāḥeteṣāṃ triyārṣeyāstu pravare munipuṅgavāḥśaradvantāśca rohiṇyāstatastvabhijitā matāḥsauryāmunistathā aupabindavo rāyaṇo matāḥete ca gautamā jñeyāstriyārṣeyā iti smṛtāḥkaumāṇḍā māsurākṣaśca tato māmānyareṣaṇaḥūrjāyanā ime jñeyā gautamā dvijasattamāḥkaumāṇḍo gautamaḥ pañca tato dīrghatamā matāḥāṅgirasaucathya kākṣīvatā gautamā ityapikāreṇupālayaścaiva vāstavyāścodivāstataḥauduñcāyanasajñāśca ete kāreṇupālayaḥkāreṇu pālirityete trayastvauśanasastataḥvikaṃhataḥ subuddhyāśca nihatāśca guhā itiaṅgirā gautamastvauśanasaśca ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥtathaiva vāmadevaśca triyārṣeyāstu gautamāḥatrīnvakṣye samāsane teṣvādāva trayo matāḥkāmaṅgulyaśca śaivāśca chagālāśchāgalāstathātato mālarukaḥ proktastato vyākalayo matāḥtato dākṣiśca taideho gāṇispataya ityapitato gaviṣṭiraḥ proktaḥ śiśupālastato matāḥśveta nīla mahāśyāma pūrvātreyāścaturvidhāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmarathino vaidehā vājo bhreyāstato matāḥanīlāyayanasaṃjñāśca aṅgirāśca tato matāḥśailelaśca punaḥ sāketāyanāḥ prakīrtitāḥtriyārṣeyāḥ samākhyātāḥ pālikāścātrireva catathā vāgbhūtakā jñeyāstriyārṣeyāstatra vā matāḥtato gaviṣṭhirā jñeyāstriyārṣeyāstu cātrayaḥmudgalo vyālasandhiśca cūrṇavābodhavājakiḥtataḥ śālimato gaurīmato brāhmīmatastataḥityete triyārṣeyāḥ syurmudgalāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥcaturvidhā apyātreyā na samanvayagāminaḥvāṭharakistataḥ prokto gaurīśravasa ityapiśaucivṛkṣāstataḥ proktāstataḥ syuḥ vyāghrapādayaḥkolāyanāśca ko bhojistataḥ paulāyanā matāḥsaptavelāṃ ime khyātā vasiṣṭhāśca dvijottamāḥpravaryaśca samādiṣṭaḥ kuṇḍināśca tato matāḥāviśvāśvatthavaikarṇirājīvakhadirāḥ smṛtāḥsomaraṅgalinaḥ kokāstataḥ kāpaṭavā matāḥmādhyāndiniśca śāntiśca saupadārthaśca kauṇḍinaḥvasiṣṭhamitrāvaruṇau kuṇḍinaśca trayastvamījālāgato jayo lokāstataḥ proktāḥ kapiñjalāḥśailālayo mahākarṇānayā bālaśikhā matāḥityunmāyana saṃjñāśca tataḥ kuṇḍodarāyaṇāḥanṛkṣara vasaṃjñāśca kāpilā vaya eva cavasiṣṭhāstriyārṣeyāste vasiṣṭhāścābharadvasuḥtato vā tritayaḥ proktā bharadavasuriti smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇā parāśarāḥ proktāstataḥ prārohayo matāḥhāryaśviḥ pañcamasteṣāmiti gaurāḥ parāśarāḥśvetayovāruṇisteṣāṃ pañcamaḥ prakīrtitāḥbādariśca tathā gārgo vanā vai kaukasādayaḥtataḥ saudhavasānāśca ālaṃbhāyana saṃjñakāḥcolakāyana saṃjñāśca vārṇavalkāstathaiva catato vāśavayaḥ pañcavājayastadanantaramkaimīyataya ityete pañca nīlāḥ parāśarāḥtataḥ pauṣkarasādiśca śvetayūpaya ityapiśyāmeyā pārṇayaścaiva sahacauliśca saubudhaḥvasiṣṭha śaktisaṃjñaśca parāśara iti trayaḥtato'gastyānahaṃ vakṣye'gastayasteṣu pūrvagāḥtathaupadahaniścaiva dhāvaṇirlāvaṇistataḥbodariḥ śaivaratayastataḥ śyāmātayo matāḥgaurīdīpāśca rohiṣyā ityete triyārṣeyakāḥsāṃbhavāhana saṃjñāśca triyārṣeyāstvagastayaḥsomavāhanasaṃjñāśca triyārṣeyāstvagastayaḥyajñavāhanasaṃjñāśca triyārṣeyāstvagastyaḥagastayastu catvāro nasamanviyagāminaḥmārkaṇḍeyāśca māṇḍūkā māṇḍavyā kāṃsayastataḥśārkarākṣāstato devatāyanāḥ śaunakāyanāḥpaiṅgalāyana saṃjñāśca pailā dādhreṣayastataḥbāhyāgoṣṭāyanāḥ ṣṭaiṣakayo pāṇinayastataḥvaihīnarayo vālmīkiḥ sthaulapiṇḍaya eva cavākāyanāḥ saukṛtayastato bālāyanā matāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ śauddhakayo jñeyā vaikarṇā droṇajihvayaḥkaṭhorakṛdvirūpākṣā devamatyāścabhairaviḥmārkāyaṇaḥ śārṅgaravo vāyavāpanayastataḥnopeyāścaiva gāṅgeyā yājñikāḥ parimaṇḍaliḥtato vaiṣṭapureyāśca uṣṭrākṣāstvapare matāḥnālāyanāścavāsāśca vānā vātyā iti smṛtāḥbhārgavaścyāvanaścau rvāpnuvānau jamadagnayaḥvidāḥ śailāstathā śailāstvavaṭāstu pulastayaḥtatastvabhayajātāḥ syuḥ kāṇḍarathaya eva cakrauñcāyanāśca jāmālāstataḥ proktā bhujāyanāḥbhārgavaścyavanaurvāpnuvānā vidāśca pañcatekaṇāyanāstataścāndrāyaṇāḥ pauṭhikalāyanāḥārṣṭiṣeṇā matāḥ pañca ārṣeyā jāmadagnayaḥārṣṭiṣeṇena pañcete ṛṣayaḥ pravarā matāḥavivāha iti prokta ucyante bhṛgavastataḥvarṣa puṣyaśca vāleyā stato rājitatāyanāḥkauśāmbeyā vākalayo vāsayaḥ prakīrtitāḥbhāgantayastato vārkāśvakayo bhṛgurindhayaḥtriyārṣeyāśca vijñeyā bhārgavāḥ prakīrtitāḥmitrayuvastato ramyāyaṇā dākṣāyaṇāstataḥpurābhināya ejeyāstato rākṣāyaṇā matāḥete mitrayuvāḥ proktāstriyārṣeyāstu bhārgavāḥvainyāḥ pārthā iti proktā bāṣkalā vainya saṃjñakāḥbhṛguśca vainyapārthau dvau pravaryā ṛṣayastrayaḥgāṅgāyana matsyagandhāścaikṣāḥ syuḥ khārdamāyanāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekārṣeyāśca ityete śunakāḥ prakīrtitāḥyaskānāṃ mitrayuvānāṃ vainyānāṃ ca parasparamathāṅgirasa ucyante viṣṇu vṛddhastu cādimaḥśābarāyaṇasaṃjñāśca sātyakiḥ sātyakāyanāḥāruṇyāścaiva vaihoḍhā naitudyāstutya saṃjñakāḥete cāṅgirasaḥ proktāstriyārṣeyā iti smṛtāḥvairudhyaśca rurudhyaśca trāsadasyuścate trayaḥmauñjiśca māñjayaścaiva markaṭāyana saṃjñakāḥmārgaśravasa ityete kanvā syustriyārṣeyakāḥhāritāśca tataḥ kautsāḥ sāṃkhyā dārbhāstathaiva canaimiśreyo haimagavastato miśrodaro tataḥpauṇḍalaścaiva mādhūpā māndhātā māṇḍakārayaḥāṅgirāścāmbarīṣaśca yauvanāśvaśca te trayaḥpaunyaśca śaibhavastārakādyāḥ paribhāvastathācārāyaṇāḥ pūtibhāṣāstata āgrāyaṇā matāḥproktā saṃkṛtayastvete triyārṣeyāḥ prakīrtitāḥrathītarāstataḥ kāhvāyanāḥ syurnaitirakṣayaḥmaikṣavāhaśca sauvāhavāhāḥ syurhastivāsayaḥaṅgirāścāmbarīṣaśca rathītara iti trayaḥmudgalāśca hiraṇyākṣā mitākṣā ṛṣayastataḥtatastoraṇa binduśca mudgalāḥ kīrtitā amīhamyāśvaśca samuddiṣṭāḥ kapayo vaitalāstataḥmiṇḍirvai bhojasiścāpi kiñca śārṅgaravastataḥtathā sāṃśaya ityuktāḥ pauṣpayaśca tato matāḥaṅgirāśca kapitthāśca aṃbarīṣa iti trayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājñāṃ viśāṃ ca vakṣyehaṃ manuścaila pururavāḥvātsapramodako vaiśye nārāsātyādayo'pi cavasiṣṭaḥ śunakaścaiva kaṇvo yaska ime'ṣṭacaathakṣatriya vaiśyānā mācārya pravaro'pi vāsamānagotra pravarāṃ kanyāṃ na vṛṇuyātsadātasyāśca rakṣaṇaṃkāryamāhārācchādanādibhiḥtayāsaha pramādena saṃyogādyaṃ kṛtaṃ yadisakṛdāgamane kuryāt tena cāndrāyaṇena caevaṃ yogāvivṛddhyā tu homavṛddhirihocyateṣaṇmāsādabdaparyantaṃ pūrvoktaissarvamācaretnirvāṇākhyā tadūrdhvaṃsyāt dīkṣāsaṃsāramocanītatputrapautrasaṃyoge prāyaścittaṃ tadeva hihomaścaivamalaṃhanti sarvasaṅkarajaṃ nṛṇāmcaturbhukti vihīnoya upavāsa iti smṛtaḥdvikālahīnovā kṣīṇastvānāṃ durbalātmanāmakālamṛtyu mathanaṃ āyurārogyavardhanamdīkṣitānāṃ purā candrasahasrasya avalokināmsulagne ca suvāre ca sutithau śobhane dinemaṅgalāṅkura saṃyukte maṇḍape samalaṃkṛtepañcādi pañcapañcāśatkarasīmāsamanviteekādi pañcapañcāntabhaktibhiḥ parimaṇḍiteanulomasamudbhūtaṃ viśeṣādbhūpatiṃ dvijāḥtattajjātisamudbhūtastriyaṃ vā śivaviprakāḥabhiṣekadinātpūrvaṃ rātrau kautukabandhanamtatpatnyāśca pradhānāya vāmahaste tu bandhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadrātrau tu payaḥ pītvā śayyāyāṃ kambalādibhiḥmaṇḍapaṃ kārayitvātha pūrvoktavidhinā yatampūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ ca manusūtraṃ prakalpayetteṣāṃ madhye hṛhītvā tu pādānāṃ pañcaviṃśatimcaturdikṣu caturdvāraṃ padadvayavilopanāttanmadhye sthaṇḍilaṃ kāryaṃ śālibhirdroṇasaṃmitaiḥadhamaṃ tvekamākhyātaṃ dviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetāḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā daridrakeśālyabhāve ca vrīhiḥ syād vrīhyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ kṣipetaṣṭāṃśaṃ kṣīṇavittasyuḥkṣipet sthaṇḍilaśuddhayevardhanī ca tadardhena pūritā śivapūritāḥtrisūtryā veṣṭanaṃ kumbhe dvisūtryā karake bhavetpṛthagvastrasamopetaṃ pṛthaksvarṇa samāyutamnādeyāmbhaḥ praśastaṃ syācchivakumbhādipūreṇenānādhātusamāyuktaṃ nānālohasamanvitamnānāpuṣpasamāyuktaṃ nānāgavyasamāyutamaṣṭottaraśatānāṃ tu rudrāṇāṃ nāma kīrtayetvastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya śivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīmprathamāvaraṇe vidvānaṣṭalohādi vinyasetāyasaṃ trapu kāṃsyaṃ cāpyaṣṭa vidyeśvarānnyasetagaruṃ gandhakaṃ tālaṃ makṣikaṃ ca manaśśilamjātiliṅgaṃ ca sindūraṃ tutthaṃ ca vimaladvayamaindradvādaśakoṣṭheṣu vinyaseddvārapārśvayoḥbailvāścaiva śamījātāḥ śirīṣāśvatthasaṃbhavāḥvṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tvacastvetāstvantarvāmādito matāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nadītaṭe tathā goṣṭhe valmīke gajadantakeutpalasya dvayaṃ ścaiva paṅkajasya dvayaṃ tathāmālatīṃ munipuṣpaṃ ca nandikāvartameva cacandanośīrakuṣṭhaṃ ca kuṅkumaṃ ca naraṃ tathānaiṛte navake jñeyaṃ vāruṇyāmatha kathyateapāmārgaṃ tilaṃ mudga priyaṅguṃ sarṣapaṃ tathālakṣmīśca śaṃkhapuṣpī ca viṣṇukrāntiśca haṃsinīsūryāvartaṃ ca kathyante vāyavyāṃ navake matāḥgomayaṃ nālikeraṃ ta mātuluṅgaphalaṃ tathādāḍimīsaṃbhavaṃ caiva nyastavyāḥ kramaśastataḥevaṃ dravyāṇi vinyasya śivādīnarcayet kramātvasāno nūtanaṃ vāsassoṣṇīṣassottarīyakaḥmaṇṭape dvārapūjādi sarvaṃ karma samācaretmanonmanīṃ ca vardhanyāmekapatnī bhavedyadidīkṣitaścenna ceddīkṣā tasminkāle'tha dīkṣayetuttare dakṣiṇe vātha vahnikuṇḍena saṃyutepuṣpapātādikaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥnavāgniṃ vātha pañcāgnimekāgniṃ vātha kalpayetjuhuyāt kramaśo vidvān homayogyāṃśca saṃbhavānśamīkhadiramāyūraśrīvṛkṣāḥ syurvidikṣu casarvadravyāṇi juhuyāt devyāścāpi pradhānakebrahmāṅgānāṃ daśāṃśaṃ tu juhuyāttu pṛthak pṛthakgurūttamaḥ pradhānāgnau teṣāṃ dīkṣāṃ samācaretkiṃtu pañcākṣareṇaiva śivāyai nama ityapipañcākṣareṇa mantreṇa rudrameva samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalpayet sarvatobhadraṃ sarvapāpavimuktayeprātassnānāviliptāṅgaṃ bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇārhakaiḥpādaprakṣālanopetamācāntaṃ śāntamānasampuṣpāñjaliṃ ca tenaiva pradakṣiṇanamaskṛtīkuṇḍasthe'pi tataḥ snānavedyāṃ saṃsthāpya deśikaḥpānase bilvaje vātha jambuje brahmavṛkṣajeanyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ śatadhārāvaṭena vāsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktamante cāmalakādibhiḥgātrasthaṃ toyamatraiva vastrādyaṃ parivartya catadanyatra śubhe deśe vilipte'laṅkate guruḥsavaiyāghraṃ savasraṃ casahemāmbujamasya tuācāntaṃ mantradehāntaṃ gandhādyairbāhumālayāpaṭena mahātācchādya tadagre'tha viliptakesthāpayitvā savatsāṃgāṃ darśayecca payasvinīmsuvarṇapuṣpairanyaiśca geyavādya samanvitamgṛhadvāre purastācca vilipte maṅgalāṅkuresthāpayitvā tu tatpādau kṣīraiḥ prakṣālanaṃ jalaiḥdīpena sahitābhiśca kārayettri pradakṣiṇamśreṣṭhamārgo'yamekonapañcāśat kalaśaistu vāekenavābhiṣekaṃ tu kārayedabhiṣecanamdāsīdāsaṃ bhuvaṃ gāṃ ca gṛhopakaraṇāni castotṛṇāmapi bhaktānāṃ dakṣiṇā pūrvavadbhavetevaṃ yaḥ kārayenmartyastasya dharme matirbhavetāyurārogyamiṣṭāḥ strīrbhuktvāpnoti parāṃ gatimnākālamṛtyustatrāsti nālakṣmīḥ pāpakṛtsvapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāntāni sarvabhūtāni payasvinyaḥ payobhṛtaḥbrāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyovātha vaiśyaśūdronulomajāḥgatāsarvo yadā teṣāṃ kāryā'ntyeṣṭistu dīkṣitaiḥantyeṣṭiḥ itaraṇāṃ syāt adhvaśuddhi vivarjitāprāyaścittamakurvāṇā mṛtāścāntyeṣṭikarmaṇiparihṛtya niṣiddhe ca yaisteṣāṃ apramādināmsadyotkrāntiḥ kṛtāyairvā brahmarandhrādhi bhedataḥyasya prāṇa viyogākhyakālo jantossamāgataḥmumukṣośca tathāgneyaṃ mantra kāyaṃ vidhāya casvakareṇa pareṣāṃ vā karābhyāṃ candanādibhiḥsparśayitvāñjalim tasya mastake sannidhāpya cadīkṣito'yaṃ tvayādeva śivājñāparipālakaḥevaṃ vijñāpya deveśaṃ svasthāne viniveśayetpaṭhedutkrāntisamaye karṇopānte'nusaṃhitāmetat sarvaṃ vidheyaṃ tu deśikenatareṇa vāgata prāṇe nare tasya snānārthaṃ tīrtha saṃbhavamtaiḥ snāpayet gṛhasthaśce llaukika snānasaṃyutamsaṃsnāpya vardhanī hīnaṃ kevalodaka saṃyutampidhānākṣata saṃyuktaṃ vidyāṅgahṛdayārcitamathavā snapanopetaṃ saṃsnāpya āgneyamādarātparivartyākṣamālādyai rbhūṣaṇairbhūṣaṇārhakaiḥanyeṣāṃ ca yathāyogyaṃ rātricūrṇaṃ ca tailayukāsandikāṃ nayedyajñavṛkṣairanyairaninditaiḥtrihastāntasamāyāmāṃ tricatuṣpañcamāṃśataḥāsandikāṃ samāropya kūṭāntordhakṛtakriyām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itaraṃ cedayotkrāntyā saṃsthitaṃ śivayoginamśibikāṃ vedṛśīṃ śuddhāmānīyāropayecchivamsaṃghena samayasthānāṃ pṛṣṭhataścābhinanditamtajjñātayo'nugaccheyuramudghāṭitamastakāḥdakṣiṇasyaśiroyuktaṃ baddhāṅguṣṭhadvayānvitamdīkṣitaistulyajñātīyairapasavyopavītakaiḥvahniṃ ca tatpuro'nyena sadhūmaṃ trikaṭisthitamsuviśuddhe bhuvaḥ pṛṣṭhe mṛtaṃ dakṣiṇamastakamvipannaṃ yo vahettasya nākālamaraṇaṃ bhavetīpsitaṃ sukhamāpnoti paratreha ca bhāvitaḥanugamyāmbhasi snātvā sajātīśaṃ śataṃ japetnītvā saṃskārayedyastu so'riṣṭhairviprayujyateatha sthānamadūrasthamudakasya samaṃ śuciṣaḍaṅgulocchrapopetaṃ mekhalaikaṃ yugāśrakamsaṃkalpya sthaṇḍilaṃ tadvaccitākhātaṃ catuṣkaramkuṇḍaṃdakṣiṇataḥ kuryāt niṣpādyaivaṃ trayaṃ guruḥśuciḥ snāto gururmantrakāyaścāstrālukīkaraḥviparītakṛtanyāso hetimantreṇa rakṣitaḥtajjalaprokṣitairdravyaiḥ pūjāṃ saṃkalpya cātmanaḥbrahmādikāraṇopetāḥ svasmin vinyasya deśikaḥvikīrya vikirāṃstatra kuśān bhasma tilānathapañcabhāgīkṛte kṣetre pañcapañcakakoṣṭhakevaṃśarajjvādisaṃpannai vinyasedvāstudevatāḥnaiṛtyāṃ vāriṇā saṃpanne viṣṇuṃ koṣṭhacatuṣṭayevāyukoṇe catuṣkoṣṭhe vāyunā samamīśvaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvādi vedakoṣṭheṣu śakrādīṃścaturo yajetaiśānyāṃ diśi vardhanyāmiṣṭrā pāśupatāstrakamnidhāya pūjayedūrdhvamadhaḥ padmāriṇāvapiaiśvaryādyāsanaṃ dattvā sadalāmbhoja madhyamevyutkramāsanamiṣṭvaivaṃ sāṅgaṃ saṃpūjya śaṅkaramkravyādāṃśojjhitaṃ vahniṃ vinikṣipyāpradakṣiṇamśivaṃ sthala ivābhyarcya tarpayitvā'sitaistilaiḥathavā pañcavarṇotthamaṇḍalāni vihāya cacitigarte'tha pīṭhe ca māhendraṃ puramālikhettayostaddevate yojye śaṅkūn koṇeṣu ropayetūrdhvamūlānadho'grāṃstānastralabdhān sakṛt sakṛtathavā raktasūtreṇa samantāt pariveṣṭayetśavaśayyāṃ ghanāṃ tatra kāṣṭhairāstīrya yājñikaiḥsaṃpūjya cāstrarājena sakuśaiḥ kusumaistilaiḥsnāpitaṃ dhūpitaṃ tatra bhasmanā navavartmanāāgneyyāṃ śivamiṣṭvāgnerdakṣiṇasyāṃ kuśāsanetato'sya mantrakāyasya hṛtsaroruhakoṭaremahājālena talliṅgaṃ saṃhṛtya viniveśayetuktvānte mṛtadīkṣākhyāṃ natyantāṃ bhāvito guruḥsaṣaḍaṃgaṃśivaṃ nyastvā mūlena juhuyācchatamnivṛtyādi samādāya yugapadvā krameṇa vātāḍanādivibhedena liṅgādādāya liṅginambhogo layo'tha saṃśuddhistattvānāṃ srotasāmapitaddāho vyutkramaiḥ kṛtyaṃ kāraṇādvā paśūddhatiḥevamevopariṣṭācca pāśānanyānviśodhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agneruddhṛtya homānte yojayedamale padekṛtaniśeśeṣapāśāntamiṣṭveśaṃ ca vivarjayetsthaṇḍileśānamapyevaṃ saṃhṛtya svapade guruḥyāmyaśīrṣamudakpādaṃ muktānāṃ struksruvānvitamturuṣkāgarukarpūracandanottaradārubhiḥmadhusattailasarpīṣi prakṣipyojjvalite'naleguruḥ sthitvā śirodeśe saumyāśābhimukhānanaḥtvamamagne dakṣiṇaḥ kālaḥ kālenaivopapāditāmprakṣipyāvāṅmukhau tatra sruksruvāvapyanantaramapradakṣiṇamādāya gṛhītvā khaṅgavardhanīmdhārāṃ vimucya saṃyuktaḥ svadharmasthaiḥ pradakṣiṇamkṣipet tatra yato deśāduddhṛtā sāstravardhanītadūrdhvamapasavyena praṇavaṃ hṛdayaṃ purāskandapūrvaṃ gaṇeśāntaṃ nāma vā bhavapaścimambhūyaḥ snātvā saumyāsyāśśivasaṃhitāmdviguṇaṃ skandhadātārastathā taddāhakā apividaṃśya nimbapatrāṇi niyatā dvāri veśmanaḥpraviśeyussamālabhya kṛtvāśmani padaṃ śanaiḥnirvāṇadīkṣā kartavyā mametyāhitacetasaḥjalena vāgninā śastrairviśeṣeṇebhasiṃhataḥsvahastatāḍanocchedarajjubandhanapātanaiḥavidyamānadehānāṃ tathā vikaladehināmkuśādinirmite dehe kriyāssarvāssamācaretdahedvā kevale vāgnāvamantraṃ nikhanettu vāiṣyate yadi puṇyārthaṃ jñātvaivaṃ karma tannayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuryāt pratikṛtiṃ paiṣṭīṃ pañcagavyapariplutāmasyāṃ ca karma kartavyaṃ yathāpūrvāmudāhṛtambhadre tripadanakṣatre śukrāṅgārabṛhaspatautadarthamevaṃ kartavyaṃ punardahanamādarātna teṣāṃ dahanaṃ naiva balirnaivodakakriyāūnadvivarṣahe prete nāgnirnaivodakakriyālavaṇāpūraṇopetā vinā balyudakaudanaiḥpratyabdamṛddhyā vṛddhaḥ syāt piṇḍe vodakakarmaṇikarma yaccāvaṭe dehe śuddhiṃ kṛtvopalepiteāropya śibikādau ca śmaśāne śuddhabhūtalenyastvā datvākṣatādyaṃ ca tūṣṇīṃ gandhādinārcayetyogināṃ daṇḍamātraṃ vā khaneddaṇḍārdhamātrataḥtatraivālayasaṃyuktaṃ pīṭhaṃ vā liṅgameva vātatra piṇḍodake śrāddhaṃ yadanyadapi neṣyatebhaktānāmathavāpyeṣāṃ neṣyate munipuṅgavāḥsamā vātītya bhartā tu yadi deśāntaraṃ gataḥmṛto vā na mṛto vāpyavijñātaścetsa sarvathāpātramadhye tuṣān kṣiptvā dahedagnikaṇāntakamhomaśeṣaghṛtopetaṃ taṇḍulaṃ kṣīrasaṃyutamnavadvāreṣu hairaṇyaśakalakṣepaṇaṃ hṛdāaṅguṣṭhabandhanachedamadhorāstreṇa kārayetvastrāgreṇa tadā sarve tatpradakṣiṇakāriṇaḥtrayaṃ vidhāya tadvāme nikṣipedastramantrataḥsnānānte pañcagavyaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pītvā jape cchavamtilodakaṃ ca dātavyaṃ mṛtanāmnā samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: antyeṣṭayā ca sametānāṃ teṣāṃ māheśvarātmanāmpṛthak pṛthak trayaṃ kāryaṃ tarpaṇaṃ prathame'hanipañcasaptatisaṃkhyātaṃ tarpaṇaṃ prati bhojanamīśāditrayatṛptyarthaṃ tvekabhojanameva vādāhānte mṛtamuddiśya vastrataṇḍulasaṃyutamnaiṣṭhikasya na kartavyaṃ pratyahaṃ tarpaṇaṃ baliḥtadarthaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā tadarthaṃ pūjayecchivamsamūhyapanayeyuśca yathātmyasmaraṇācchucamna śucaḥ kāraṇaṃ teṣāmasti kiñcidvivekināmna vināśo'sti tasyeha cedasti tathā na saḥtannāśastakṣayo mṛtyuḥ svaguṇānupalabdhitaḥaniṣṭāpagame yasya na bhavediṣṭaśemuṣīcitevaraṇagścāyaṃ bhogastadbhogasādhanammānuṣyakadalīstambhe nissāre sāramārgaṇampañcadhā saṃbhṛtaḥ kāyo yadi pañcatvamāgataḥgantrī vasumatī nāśamudadhirdaivatāni caśleṣmāśru bāndhavairmuktaṃ yato muṅkte mṛto'vaśaḥdvitīye'hani śeṣāṅgadahanaṃ kārayenna vātṛtīye'pyathavādye'hni kuryāt saṃcayanaṃ citeḥpūrṇāṃ trikāṣṭhikāṃ tatra kṛtvā tattvatra vinyasetekatripañcasaptāhe navabhāṇḍe tu mṛṇmayesaktulājaudanāpūpaiścaturdikṣu baliṃ kṣipetaṅgairaṅgāni saṃhṛtya tanmantreṇaiva nikṣipettaddine vātha pakṣānte māsānte vā trimāsikenikṣipya tatra tattīrthe snānaṃ kṛtvā tilaissaha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00125 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
